tei:div.tei:p: gsung 'bum/ dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros/ (glog klad par ma/ )25022 62117—06722250tshibaskulnga'i khyi'i161021057(21022120921pa 27)

ci dkar chagaskyes rabs so bzhi pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i gsol 'debs rgyal sras 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (1)'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs shing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs gru char g.yo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (5)'jam sdud bzang gsum 'don thabs mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ / (14)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (19)'grel pa bzhi sbrag gi bshad lung skabs kyi gsung bshad 'ga' zhig zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs so/ / (29)gzhi'i sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (46)bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi gsol 'debs 'jigs sgrol gyi dpa' bo zhes bya ba'i 'grel ba gdams ngag gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so/ / (67)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sdom tshig dang thig gdab tshul bzhugs so (85)sa skya legs bshad sogs kyi brda don 'ga' zhig dkrol ba bzhugs so/ / (90)rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dgongs 'grel rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (106)rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' gnas bdag gzhan dang bya byed las gsum gyi khyad par zhib tu phye ba nyung gsal 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (127)rnam dbye brgyad dang bya byed las sogs kyi khyad par mdo tsam brjod pa dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (135)1

dbyangs can sgra ṭīka las byung ba'i yumidra asmad kyi cho ga'i tshigs bcad kyi don rags rim bkrol ba bzhugs so/ / (143)mtshams sbyor lnga pa'i tshigs bcad kyi skad dod so sor bkral ba blo gsal 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (158)snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (169)snyan ngag me long gi le'u dang po nas byung ba'i sbyar ba sogs yon tan bcu'i gnad don gsal bar ston pa legs bshad puṇ+ḍa ri ku'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (205)snyan ngag me long gi rgyan rnams kyi dper brjod dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (235)snyan ngag gi lus rgyan skyon sel gsum gyi sdom tshig rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so (282)sdeb sbyor rin 'byung gi gnad don gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (289)ngo mtshar rtogs byed nag 'gros su bkod pa legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (337)sdeb sbyor las nyer mkho rags rim bzhugs so/ / (347)dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du skye ba'i rgyu tshogs la 'bad cing bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs bya tshul zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (351)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la bstod cing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs sogs bstod pa'i skor bzhugs so/ / (359)rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po slob dpon seng ge bzang po la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (370)gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar mjal skabs kyi gnas bstod dang 'brel ba'i mgur 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba dang / dus chen khyad par can gyi rnam bshad 2

bcas bzhugs so/ / (372)'phags pa 'da' ga ye shes zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'grel calam bzang gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (377)dris pa'i lan brjod pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (386)bod gangs can gyi ljongs su byung ba'i grub mtha'i 'byung khungs mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs so/ / (407)rgyal ba tshe dpag med sogs lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skor bzhugs so (411)bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas sdig sgrib sbyong tshul bzhugs so (413)theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi brda don bzhugs so/ / (418)'dul 'dzin rin po ches mdzad pa'i dge slong gi bslab bya chen mo'i brda don go dka' ba 'ga' zhig bkrol ba bzhugs so/ / (426)'dul ba'i gleng 'bum chen mo las byung ba'i ming brda go dka' ba rnams bshad pa blo ldan dga' skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (437)bslab bya'i skor bzhugs so/ / (473)las don gyi lta ba la bag —gas 'jog tshal dang / gsang 'thor ba'i skor bzhugs mi rig (tārdo0 riri r+sha sa ri zi ri so (482)3

— sto༄7/ /skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i gsol 'debs rgyal sras 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru ma hā mu na ye/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed do/ /rlabs chen mdzad pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba shākya'i tog/ cher snyigs nyam thag 'gro 'di bskyab tu gsol/ /khyod sngon bram ze'i slob dpon gyur pa'i tshe/ /ri sul sman ljongs shig tu sta ga drus ma// /phru gur bcas pa nyam thag gzigs nas ni/ /lus srog btang bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /shi bi yu9 — gyi rgyal por 'khrungs pa na/ /brgya byin sprul pa'i bram ze rgan po la/ /ut+pal 'dab 'dra'i spyan zung bstsa la nas ni/ /long ba mig ldan mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /ko sa la yi bdag por gyur pa'i tshe/ /tshe sngon zan dron tsam zhig sbyin pa'i 'bras/ /rgyal srid dang/la 'byor myong ba 'di ltos zhes/ /'bangs rnams sbyin par bskul la gsol ba 'debs/ /sbyin la dpa' bar 'khrungs tshe bdud kyi lhas/ /sbyin las bzlog phyir bar du dmyal ba'i gnas/ /sprul kyang 'jigs rung me 'obs de brgal nas/ /yon gnas thub pa mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshong dpon zil gyis mi non par gyur tshe/ /lha dbang nyams sad phyir du nor sbas nas/ /shin tu dbul yang rtswa sngon rin tsam gyis/ /slong rnams tshim par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod ri bong gtso bor gyur pa'i tshe/ /byis 'khyams bram ze nyam thag gzigs pa na/ /rab 'bar me nang dga' bzhin mchongs nas ni/ /gces pa'i lus 'di sbyin la gsol ba 'debs/ /a ga sta zhes drang srong nags chel du/ /shing lo rnying ba tsam gyis 'tsho ba na/ /nyin gsum slong la byin kyang g.yo med tshe/ /brgya byin dad cing mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa na/ / gnas nas sgyugs pa'i gnod sbyin spun lnga zhig/1

bkres skom gdung bas gzer la bdag nyid kyi/ /sha khrag dron pos bsos la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod rgyal bu thams cad sgrol gyi tshe/ /srid na dkon pa'i glang chen mchog rnams dang / /snying ltar gces pa'i bu dang chung ma sogs/ /gtang dka'i sbyin pa mdzad 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /sa skyong mchod sbyin byed du gyur pa na/ /tshul min byed pa'i mi rnams mchod sbyin gyi/ /gsad bya'i phyugs su byed ces dril bsgrags nas/ /dge bcu'i khrims spel mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgya byin lha ru 'khrungs tshe lha min gyi/ /dmag gis srog la rgal bar thug pa na/ /bya phrug bskyab phyir rang srog blos btang ste/ /shing rta bzlog par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bram zer 'khrungs tshe mkhan pos slob ma'i tshod/ /brtag phyir rgud tshe rku ba chos yin zhes/ /gdams kyang rigs min khyad par legs phyed pas/ /dad cing rgya cher bsngags la gsol ba 'debs/ /shi bi'i rgyal por 'khrungs zo myos byed ma/ /mthong nas bsran dka'i 'dod pas gdungs na yang / /srog la bab kyang log g.yem mi bya zhes/ /tshul khrims mthar phyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs / /legs par pha rol phyin par 'khrungs pa na/ /'jigs rung rgya mtsho'i klong dang nye ba yi/ /nyam thag tshong pa'i tshogs rnams bden tshig gis/ /gru chen bzlog par mdzad la ba / sol ba 'debs/ / mgon khyod nya yi rgyal por gyur pa na/ /dpyid kyi than pas chu mtsho bskams pa'i tshe/ /nya rnams nyam nyes snying rje bden tshig gis/ /char gyi rgyun bzang phabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dab chags sreg pa'i phru gur skyes pa na/ /nags me rlung gis bskyod pa'i me mched pa/ /bden tshig brjod pas zhi bar rme dzad nas ni/ /srog chags grangs med bskyabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /re shig cig na brgya byin du gyur tshe/ /mdza' bo zhes bya'i rgyal po blon 'bangs rnams/ /chang gi nyes dmigs rgya cher bstan nas ni/ /bag med gnas las bzlog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal rigs phyug por skyes tshe khyim gyi gnas/ /gdug can sbrul gyi tshang ltar mthong nas ni/ /nges 'byang mchog gis bskul te rab byang nas/ /dben pa'i nags ring sistotshal bsten la gsol ba 'debs/ / bram ze'i rigs mthor 'khrungs tshe gcung drug da~X / /sring mo grogs bran cibacas pa rab byung nas/ /dben par dka' thub bsten

cing 'dod pa la/ /'phyas shing smad par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal po'i tshong dpon gyur tshe gnyen bshes rnams/ /rab tu byung zhes cho nge 'debs thos nas/ /re //sprin za pa la ne//rdophru ///pu'abras bskang slad ltar bshal btab kyang / /ma gsan rab byung ma da la ga la ba 'debs/ /gtsug phud byang chub ces byar 'khrungs pa na/ /chung ma/ rab byung bcas la rgyal po zhig/ rab brnyas gtses kyang bzod pa'i char chen gyis/ /khro ba'i sa rdul mnan la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngang pa'i rgyal por 'khrungs tshe rje blon gyi/ /ngo mtshar yon tan thos nas tshangs pa'i phyin/ /thabs kyis bkug tshe rgyal por chos bstan te/ /dad cing dga' bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun rgyu byang chub ces byar gyur pa'i tshe/ /sna tshogs log ltas bslad pa'i rgyal blon rnams/ /rdzu 'phrul dri me da rigs pas tshar bcad nas/ /yang dag lam du bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam bzhin spre'u chen por 'khrungs pa na/ /gcong rong zab mor lhung ba'i mi drangs nas/ /drin lan log 'jal gsod par brtsams gyur kyang / /snying rje lhag par skyes la gsol ba di'adebs/ /ri dwags sha ra bha ru 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid gsod phyir bsnyegs pa'i rgyal po zhig/ grog g.yang chen por lhung ba rab bsgral nas/ /brtse bas dam chos bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri dwags ru rur 'khrungs tshe snying rje yis/ /chus khyer nyam thag mi/ zhag bsgral ba na/ /rgyal po dmag bcas sbran nas chas pa'i tshe/ /sdig can brtse bas bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon med spre'u'i bdag por gyur pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po dmag bcas bskor ba'i sprel tshogs rnams/ /rang lus zam par btsugs nas dbugs phyungs te/ /lus srog thar par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod bzod pa smra bar 'khrungs pa na/ /sdig can rgyal pos yan lag nying lag kun/ /bcad kyang gdon gyis brlams pa'i bu bzhin du/ /bzod brtan byams brtse mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod sngon tshangs par 'khrungs tshe 'dod khams su/ /chad lta'i g.yang du lhung ba'i rgyal bo la/ /rang lus bstan te rigs pa brgya phrag gis/ /yang dag ltar bar bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ /lag ldan gtso bor 'khrungs tshe 'brog dgon du/ /bkres skom gdung ba'i nyen pa'i mi bdun brgyar/ /snying rjes rang srog btang nas sha sbyig

gis/ /lam rgyags sbyin par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod byang sems zla bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /sdig can srin po chos kyis legs btul nas/ /rgyal bu brgya phrag nyi bu'i kha nas 'phrogs/ /'phral yun bde bar bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ / rgyal bu lcags kyi khyim du bskyed pa'i tshe/ /kun da'i dus ston gzigs pa'i rkyen byas te/ /srid 'byor gang la'ang snying po med dgongs nas/ /rab byung dben par gshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsal stobs rdzogs pa'i ma her gyur pa na/ /mi bsrun spe'u zhig gis zhon rgyug sogs/ /gnod 'tshe brgya phrag brtsams kyang mi 'khrugs par/ /des shing byams par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dab chags shing rta mo ru 'khrungs pa'i tshe seng ge'i gre bar rus tshal zug pa byungs/ /drin bzo med par khyad gsod brnyas pa la/ /khro med bzod stobs bskyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /e ma ya mtshan kun gyi rtser son pa/ /mnyam med bde bar gshegs pa'i sngon gyi rabs/ /tshig gi srad bur brgyus pa'i rna lung 'di/ / sgra 'dzin rgyan du spud pa'ang skal ba bzang / /kye hud sngon chad rmongs shing 'khrul bar 'khyams/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba slu srid kho nar zad/ /'khor ba'i gnas la bde ba skad cig med/ /pha mar ma gyur sem/sa can gcig kyang med/ /da ni thub chen dpa' bo'i rnam thar 'di/ /sgo gsum gus pas ngang du blang bar bgyi/ /lus srog lan brgyar 'dor yang mi spong zhing / /snying stobs chen pos rjes su bslab par shog/ /ces pa'ang chos med chos 'dod pa/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ /dad 'dun mos pa'i mtshams sbyar nas/ /go sla'i tshigs su bcad par bsdebs/ /

༄khya/ /'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha ba rme cigasol ba 'debs shing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs gru char g.yo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mdzi shri ye/ zhing phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig bsdus nas/ /deng gsum ldan mkhan po'i skur ston pa/ /rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /sngon thugs dam ji ltar bcas pa bzhin/ /rgyud ma dag 'gro ba 'dren sla da du/ /ches snyigs dus theg chen bshes gnyen tshul / /rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /lam zab rgyas dka' gnad kun bkrol nas/ /bka' mdo rgyud gdams par ngo spra da de/ /phyogs gol sa'i dri ma rgyang bsrings pa/ /rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /sngon rgyal ba dbang po tog gi drung / /chos zab don spel bar zhal bzhes ltar/ /zhing ma dag kun tu rgyas mdzad pa/ /rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /chos brgyad lge/ ba zhi stong snying po'i bcud/ /bka' mdo sngags zung 'brel 'a ma bzang gis/ / slar thub bstan nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ / rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /dbyings spros bral bde chen ngang nyid las/ / sku zhi khro ma nges 'byams klas pa/ /rgyud gang 'tsham 'char pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /rje rgyal bsnu/ /zhing dag pa 'og min pho brang du/ /sras sa bcu sems dpa'i 'khor tshogs dbus/ /dpal kha sbyor bdun ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje rgyal bsnu/ /zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med du/ /sku bltams shing mngon par byang chub sogs/ /dpal bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /rje rgyal bsnga/ /mgon rnam 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /lha ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dpal/ /gos ngur smrig tshul 'dzin tsong kha pa/ /rje rgyal bstu/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i skur bzhengs te/ /dgra phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje 'dul/ /5

lha drag po 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i tshul/ /rje rgyal bstu/ /chos snga dar bod kyi bstan 'gro'i ma gon/ /dpal ma/thu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag che/ /mtshan snyan par grags pa pad+ma 'byung / /rje rgyal bsnu/ /lar bshad sgrub bstan pa nyams dmas tshe/ /rje thub bstan bsres bslad legs bsal nas/ /chos bka' gdams srol btsugs a ti sha/rje rgyal bstu/ /sngon thub pa'i spyan sngar pad+ma'i mtshan/ /mgon ma pham mdun sar 'jam dpal snying / /bod gangs can ljongs 'dir tsong kha ba/ /rje rgyal bsnu/ /blo dri bral mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom/ /mtshan snyan par grags pas sa gsum khyab/ /dpal mdzad 'phrin bzang pos 'gro kun 'dren/ /rje rgyal bstu/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /dus snyigs ma'i tshe thung skad cig la/ /don bde blag stsol mdzad bla ma dngos/ /rje rgyal bsnu/ /rigs kun khyab bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /bde gsal stong ye shes/ 'byung gnas dngos/ /lha yi dam mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid/ /rje rgyal bstu/ /dpal nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /dbyings spros bral bde chen chos sku dang / /rgyud gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /rje rgyal bstu/ /spangs rtogs pa mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos 'gog lam 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang / /bgegs kun 'dzomakun rdo je srung ma nyid/ /rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /mgon khyod kyi rjes su slob 'dod bdag/ tshe 'di snang slu brid dbang du song / /rgyud dug gsum drag pos rgyun du bslad/ /'bangs bdag rgyud myur du byin gyis rlobs/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon khyod min re sa gzhan mi 'tshol/ /pha byams brtse thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /gnas 'khor ba'i gcong rong che nas drongs/ /da dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /rje khyod zhabs spyi bo'i rgyan du bsten/ /gsung zab rgyas bdud rtsi'i nying khus 'tsho/ /bka' tshul bzhin bsgrub par snying nas smon/ /tshe 'di snang grogs dang zhen thag bcad/ /gnas khams gsum me 'obs ltar mthong glunas/ /rgyud bslab gsum nor gyi mdzod 'dzin par/ /thugs brtse bas myur du byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /rang gces par 'dzin pa'i gdon gyis brlams/ /da gzhan phan sems kyis rgyud phyug par/ /thugs brtse bas myur du 6

byin gyis rlobs/ / dbyings bdag med rtogs pa'i mtshon non gyis/ /dgra bdag 'dzin 'gong po'i srog rtsa gcod/ /lam stong nyid snying rje snying po can/ /dus myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyud snod rung dbang gis smin byas te/ /gzhi dam tshig the:tho ༷༷| /sdi( ཿ15 /rte/ ཿji( /drosachu pa /byi/ /khye/ /rephru /re/dam pa ga dang ba sa/ /ma/ ga ba da gas zab 'a rnal 'a ra sa 'a la grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon sras bcas rgyal ba'i mdzad pa'i khur/ /bdag snying stobs dpung bas legs bteg ste/ /ma mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sgrol ba la/ /rje khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /dus deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje khyod kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /srog lan brgyar 'dor yang mi zhum par/ /yid dam bca' brtan po bgyid par smon/ /bdag 'di sna nga 'gag par gyur pa na/ /rigs cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa ru/ /rten chos ldan tshangs spyod lus bzung ste/ /rje khyod kyi rnam thar skyong bar shog/ gzhung mdo sngags kun la ris med sbya nga / /gang thos don nyams su len pa la/ /gegs 'gal rkyen ming yang mi grag cing / /grogs mthun rkyen tshang bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dge 'dis mtshon legs byas gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /'phral dal 'byor glu'adzum rlabs ngom bzhin du/ /dus ring min zung 'jug 'grub pa'i gegs/ /yid tha mal snang zhen sbyong gyur cirngo/ ces 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha ba la gsol ba 'debs shing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs gru char g.yo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad pas ma/tshams sbyar te snyoms las pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /༄7/ /bla ma'i thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru bh+yaḥspros bral bde chen ngang las/ /gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma/ /snying nas 'o dod 'bod cing / /lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs rje sprin phung g.yos te/ /byin rlabs char rgyun phob cig/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing gi/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis/ /'dul bar ma nus dmu rgod/ /bdag cag 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig/ snying pyis

'o dod 'bod cing / /lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs rje sprin phung g.yos te/ /byin rlabs char rgyun phob cig/ deng nas byang chub bar du/ /khyod min re sa mi 'tshol/ /skyid rung sdug rung 'bral med/ /spyi gtsug rgyan du bkod de/ /snying nasastu/ /lhang lhang smo/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la/ /sgrib bral lhan skyes bde chen/ / bde blag stsol mdzad bla mar/ /yid ches mos gus chen pos/ /snying nasastu/ /lhang lhang snu/ /thugs rjes/ /byin rlabs5/ /mu mtha' med pa'i bskal ba/ /mtshan tsam shin tu mjal dka'i/ /zung 'jug gzhal med khang du/ /'khrid mdzad yi dam chen po/ /snying nas/ /lhang lhang / /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /sgra rtog yul las 'das pa'i/ /bde gsal mi rtog ye shes/ /stsol mdzad ma dang mkha' 'gror/ /rtse gcig re ba'i yid kyis/ /snying nasasmo/ /lhang lhang snu/ /thugs rjestu/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas/ /'bog lam rang bzhin dam chos/ /rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun/ /kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /snying nas 'o dod 'bod cing / /lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs rje sprin phung g.yos te/ /byin rlabs char rgyun phob cig/ ma/thu rtsal dus mtha'i zhugs kyis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde tshogs rnams/ /skad cig nyid la sreg mdzad/ /chos srung kun 'dus bla ma/ /snying nasasmo/ /lhang lhang smo/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i/ /bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas/ /gcig chog dbang r+shagi rgyal po/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /snying nasastu/ /lhang lhang smo/ /thugs rjeya/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /cher snyigs nyam thag 'gro rnam/sa/ /byang grol mchog gi grong du/ /'god mdzad zla med gluskyabs mgon/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /snying nasasmo/ /lhang lhang stu/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasastu/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan/ /ches cher 'grib pa'i dus 'dir/ /rnam dag bshad sgrub rgyas mdzad/ /bka' drin 'khor med bla ma/ /snying nasasmo/ /lhang lhang smo/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun 'phrog/ thar pa'i sa bon grung po/ /skrun byed drin can bla ma/ /snying nasastu/ /lhang lhang smo/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasasmo/ /zhabs zung dran pa'i 8

mod la/ /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid pa'i/ /mi bzad gdung ba sel mdzad/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /snying nasastu/ /lhang lhang snru/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabs snu/ /mi bzad duḥkha'i grong khyer/ /'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang las/ /phun tshogs mngon mtho'i sa la/ /'dren mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /snying nasastu/ /lhang lhang smo/ /thugs rjesmo/ /byin rlabasasnu/ /yun ring thog med dus nas/ /gting mtha' bral ba'i srid mtshor/ /'khyams shing bying ba'i nyam thag/ sgrol byed ded dpon chen po/ /snying nas 'o dod 'bod cing / /lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs rje sprin phung g.yos te/ /byin rlabs char rgyun phob cig/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal skyin/ /mkhas grub dam pa mang po'i/ /zhabs zung spyi bor reg pa'i/ /skal ba bzang po thob kyang / /bsam da nga sbyor bas tshul bzhin/ /bsten tshul ji bzhin ma byung / /skal chad bdag cag rnams la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig/ shin tu rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i/ /dal 'byor rten bzang thob kyang / /'di ni nga bya bas bslus te/ /don chen shor ba bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig/ nges med glo bur nyid du/ /rgan gzhon ma nges 'chi ba'i/ /rang tshul mthong yang rtag 'dzin/ /gdon chen snying zhugs bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig/ 'jigs rung ngan song sdug bsngal/ /mthong thos tsam gyis/ don snying / /tshal bar 'gas pa'i ngang tshul/ /ma dran smyon pa bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gozigs shig/ sdig pa'i las las sdug bsngal/ /dge las bde ba 'byung yang / /bde 'dod sdig la rngams pa'i/ /bsam brlag snying med bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs sheg/ sdom gsum rim par blangs kyang / /bcas mtshams yal bar bor ba'i/ /nyes ltung phyi sa'i 'dam du/ /ches cher bying ba bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig/ thub pa'i rjes su zhugs te/ /skra breg ngur smrig gyon sko kyang / /g.yo smu byi la'i spyod pas/ /dus rnams 'da' ba bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig/ zog po tshul 'chos dag gis/ /chos med chos par brdzu ba/ /wa skyes seng lpags g.yogs 'dra'i/ /'khril med sdig can bdag la/ /bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig/ kye hud mi tshe phal cher/ /g.yeng ba'i ngang du thal song / /tshe lhag cang dī

zad lus 'di/ /ces kyang don dang ldan par/ /bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig/ ma rgan mkha' mnyam 'gro la/ /thugs rje sprin phung g.yos te/ /byin rlabs char rgyun phab nas/ /nges legs bde la 'god mdzod/ /ces bla ma'i thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di yang / mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor reg pa'i gyi na pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis gang dran 'phral du sbyar ba'o/ / ༄7/ /chos 'brel dngos thob kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol pa btab cing thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu shri ye/ sku mthong bas tshe 'di'i snang ba skyung / /gsung thos pas shes rgyud chos dang sbyor/ /thugs dran pas bar chad g.yul ngo zlog/ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'bangs bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres pa dang / /chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon sras bcas rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs dngos/ /rje blo bzang chos grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /'bangs bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres pa dang / /chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyud gang 'tsham sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /rje 'phrin las bzang po lastu/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /lam bslab gsum nor gyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rje ngag dbang bzod pa lasmo/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasmo/ /rgyud dmu rgod 'dul mkhas bka' drin can/ /rje kun dga' mtshan can lasmo/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag mgon/ /rje drin can rnam gnyis lastu/ /'bangasastu/ /chosastu/ /rgyud brtan mkhas yon tan dpal gyis te mdzes/ /rje shes rab phun tshogs lasmo/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasmo/ / pha mkhas btsun bzang po'i rtser son pa/ /rje bsod nams bstan 'dzin lastu/ /'bangs5 chos྾/ /lha 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i mtshan/ /rje 'jigs med dbang po lasnu/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasmo/ /dpal mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor bsgyur gtso/ /rje chos kyi rdo rje lastu/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /gnas dben par sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs/ /rje ngag dbang rab brtan las/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /tshe blos btang sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel/ /rje blo bzang rgyal mtshan lastu/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasmo/ /10

bka' mdo rgyud lung gis thugs rgyud gtams/ /rje 'jigs med rab rgyas las/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasnu/ /thugs byang chub sems kyi gter kha brdol/ /rje byams pa dge legs las/ /'bangasasmo/ /chos5/ /rigs kun khyab bdag po rdo hūṃ 'dzin/ /rje thub bstan rab rgyas lasmo/ /'bangasastu/ /chos〉/ /chos lung rtogs yon tan kun gyi mdzod/ /rje tshul khrims phun tshogs lastu/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasmo/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen snyigs ma'i mgon/ /rje bstan pa rab rgyas lasmo/ /'bangasasnu/ /chosasnu/ /lha 'jigs mdzad rdo rje bshes gnyen tshul/ /rje 'jigs med rgya mtsho lastu/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /mgon pad+ma dbang chen mi yi gar/ /rje rgya mtsho dbang phyug lasnu/ /'a bangasasnu/ /chos5/ /zhing bde ldan mgon po paṇa chen zhabs/ /rje phyogs las rnam rgyal lasmo/ /'bangasasnru/ /chosastu/ /lung rigs pa sga ba'i dbang phyug gtso/ /rje blo bzang bsam gtan lasmo/ /'bangasasmo/ /chos5/ /chos mdo rgyud gdams ngagam 'doms mkhas pa/ /rje ngag dbang chos 'phel lastu/ /'bangasastu/ /chosastu/ /mgon 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer med pa/ /rje ngag dbang snyan grags lasmo/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /bka' mdo sngags chos brgyud mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rje bsam gtan dar rgyas lastu/ /'bangasastu/ /chosasnu/ /dus deng sang nges don paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rje blo bzang dar rgyas lasmo/ /'bangasasmo/ /chosastu/ /dpa la dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing mchog/rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho lasmo/ /'bangasasmo/ /chos5/ /thugs byams brtse'i mnga' bdag rgyal sras che/ /rje ngag dbang bshad sgrub la5/ /'bangasasnu/ /chosasmo/ /chos lung khrid dbang dang rjes gnang dang / /gzhan thun mong rig gnas slob pa sogs/ /'bangs bka' drin mnos pa thams cad la/ /yid rtse gcig gus pa'i gsol ba ske 'debs/ /'bangs bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres pa dang / /chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas 'khor ba'i gcong rong gting zab nas/ /'bangs chos med 'o dod bod lags na/ /ma brtse ldan sdug pa'i bu la bzhin/ /dus da lta bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /sdug yod dgu myong yang rang gzhan gyi/ /don til 'bru tsam yang ma grub pa/ /'di bsam zhing yid chad gting nas skyo/ /11

dus da res bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus thob na yang / /blo chos dang 'dres pa'i skabs med par/ /chos byed lo'i ngang du mi tshe zad/ /khas zab dgu smras shing bzlas na yang / /las nyon mongs gzhan dbang 'di btsan pas/ /chos gnad du song ba'i skabs ma byung / /'di bsams shing ci drag yi re mug/ don nges legs lam sna lta ci smos/ /tshe phyi ma'i mngon mtho tsam yang dka'/ /dbugs ba thag tsam 'di chad ma thag/ gnas ngan song gting rdo byed kyis dogs/ /don de phyir bla ma dkon mchog la/ /yid zol med snying nas re ltos zhu/ /thugs byams brtse char sprin cher g.yos te/ /'bangs bdag rgyud zhing sar byin rlabs phobs/ /blo ma/ dag 'khrul ngor tha dad kyang / /dbyings spros bral bang du spangs rtogs la/ /don dbyer med gcig tu gsol 'debs na/ /pha nges don bla ma'i zhal mjal shog/ ces chos 'brel dngos thob kyi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams 9pa gsol ba btab cing thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs byin rlabs myur du 'gugs phupa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis rang rgyud chos dang ma 'dres pa'i skyon mtshang la yid skyo ste/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar ngo rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes dge bar sbyar ba'o/ /༄7/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma 'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥswa ra swa ñtsa/ spros bral gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /dbyer med brjod bral rang rig ye shes nyid/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i skur bstan dbyangs can lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so thogs med shes rab stsol/ /'phags mas rjes bzung mkhyen rab mdzod phye nas/ /sgrub 'phrin man ngag nor bu'i spel mdzad pa'i/ /rgya bod dngos rgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thogs med shes rab skestsol/ /khyad par chos 'di'i bka' drin mnos pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog dang skedabyangs can ma/ /dbyer med ro gcig nges pa'i mos gus kyis/ /gsol ba 'debs so thogs med shes rab stsol/ /de ltar gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab mthus/ /nang don rig pa spyi dang tha snyad kyi/ /gtsug lag kun la blo mig rab phye nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med par shog/ ji tsam thos bzhin sems rgyud lhag par snye12

'dul/ /thos bsam sgom pa 'gal med nyams su bstar/ /lung rtogs yon tan dbyar gyi lang tsho ltar/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying ——ga'i pad+mo ru/ / lhan skyes bzhin du mgon khyod nyer bzhugs te/ / zla med mkhas pa 'i yang rtse thob nas ni/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog/ ces lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rgyud 'debs byin rlabs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer can kha shas kyis nan tan bgyis pa'i ngor/ dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis bris/ / 13

༄khya/ /'jam sdud bzang gsum 'don thabs mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /mdun du yid 'phrog seng khri pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma thub dbang rnam pa can/ /sku las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sra sa bcas kyi/ /thugs rje bskul cing snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing pad gdan la/ /sras bcas rgyal kun spyan drangs bskor nas bzhugs/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs 'bul/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'a dar gsol/ /bdag gzhan dge rnams byang chub chen por bsngo/ /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla rin chen bdun/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes tshogs kyi zhing gsal btab ste/ yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal bcas phul/ de nas/ bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag 'gag pa dang /phyin ci ma log pa'i blo sna mtha' dag bde blag tu skye ba dang / rkyen phyi nang gi bar gcod nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas thub pa'i dbang po la thim/ thub dbang rang la thim pas rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur lam gyis gyur pa'i pos pa byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du myur ba myur bar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du sher phyin gyi ma do sde 'don par bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed shugs drag tu bsgom la/ lha klu gnod sbyin mi dang mi min sogs/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i skye dgu rnams/ /bde gshegs dpa' gyi mgur nas legs gsungs pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos mnyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig/ ces brjod cing chos kyi sbyin pa bya bar bsam nas sgra dag gsal gsum gyi sgo nas klog pa dang kha ton du bya'o/ /mthug tu/ 'byung po gang dag phyogs 'dir lhags gyur te/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag/ skye dgu kun la rtag tu byams byed shog/14

nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod gyur cig/ ces smon lam btab pas thams cad rgyud smin cing grol nas so so'i gnas su song bar bsam mo/ /gzhan yang gzhung 'don thabs la/ lung nod pa'i tshul du 'don pa dang / bdag med pa'i ngang las 'don pa dang / che ba'i yon tan du 'don pa sogs mang du gsungs so / /zhes pa 'di yang mdo sdud pa 'don thabs mdor bsdus shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ dbyangs can dga' blos 'phral du bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /bzang spyod smon lam 'don thabs bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang por kun slong bcos te skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni/ phyogs dus kun khyab rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /rnam dag smon pa'i dbang bor spyan drangs na/ /nyam thag 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ /thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla na yod med kyi/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /mi 'jigs gdongalngas btegs pa'i rin chen khrir/ /sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan la dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ /zhes mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad smon lamarlabs po che 'grub pa'i tshogs kyi zhing du spyan drangs/ de nas rang gi mtha' skor du sems can tham sa cad 'khod pa la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems shugs drag po bskyed de/ yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas tshogayogasog sgrib sbyang bya zhing smon lam rgya cher gdab pa ni/ tshig don rnams re re nas dran bzhin pas/ ji snyed su dag ces sogs gdon par bya'o/ /de yang yan lag bdun pa ni smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs gsag sgrib sbyang bya ba'i nyams len gyi rim pa yin la/'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnam sa dang phyogs bcu yi/ /nas/ bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ / zhes pa'i bar ni/ smon lam gyi rim pa dngos nyams su len tshul dang /gang yang phyogs bcu zhes sogs tshigs bcad bdun ni smon lam yid la bya ba'i phan yon dang /gang yang bzang ngo spyod pa zhes sogs tshigs bcad bdun/ smon lam bton pa sogs kyi phan yon ston pa'o/ /mjug gi tshigs bcad gsum gyi dang po gnyis slob dpon phyogs glang gi 'grel par mi 'byung yang / rgya 'grel 'ga' zhig tu byung ngo / /tshigs bcad mtha' ma lo tsā pa'i 'gyur gyi smon lam yin gyi mdo tshig dngos min par basbyod do/ /de ltar na smon lam grangs gsog pa'i tshe'ang /yan lag bdun pa ni smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa dang / 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i nyams len yin phyir nges par 'don dgos/ mjug gi tshigs bcad 15

gsu ma ma bton kyang chad skyon med mod/ skyes bu dam pa'i phyag bzhes yin phyir 'don na legs par sems/ bzang spyod 'bum phrag so gas bton na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ba dang / rang gang du 'phen pa btang ba'i dag zhing du skye ba sogs phan yon tshad med pa 'byung ba'i khungs gzhan ci dgos/ gzhung rang las/ gang phyogs bcu zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis/ phyogs bcu'i zhing mtha' yas pa rin chen sna bdun sogs kyis brgyan te sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa'i bso da nams las/ smon lam 'di lan cig tsam thos nas dad pa bskyed pa bso da nams ches lhag pa dang / de nas rim par smon la ma btab pas ngan song du mi skye ba dang /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas myur du ste tshe 'di nyid la mngon sum du mthong ba dang / ring por mi thogs/ par byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po lta bur 'gyur ba dang / mtshams med lnga'i sdig pa 'dag pa dang / shes bya thams cad la chags thogs med pa'i ye shes dang / gzugs mdzes shing rigs mtho ba dang / mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / bdud rigs las rgyas te sa ngas rgyas nas chos 'khor bskor bar 'gyur bar gsungs/ de nas/ gang yang bzang po spyod pa zhes sogs kyis rim bzhin/ smon lam 'di'i gzhugs tsam bton pa'i bso da nams kyi mtha' sangs rgyas kho na mkhyen gyi/ nyan rang sogs kyi spyod yul las 'das pas na/rgyal ba'i bka' bslu ba med pa la the tshom spangs pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa shin tu gal che bar gsungs shing / bdag ni 'chi ba'i zhes sogs kyis/ 'chi dus rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing bde ba can gyi zhing du thogs med du bgrod nas pad+ma las rdzus te skyes nas byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pa thob pa sogs phan yo na mtha' yas pa smon lam gyi mdo rang las — gsungs shing / khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas kyang dngos su thos so/ /des na 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro bas na tshogs gas ga sgrib sbyang la 'bad de smon lam rnam par dag pa btab na 'bras bu de ltar 'grub pa chos nyid yin te/ mdo dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /'dir 'bad dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid mtshos yid 'byung ste/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i rjes zhugs nas/ /sku gsum rin chen gling du phyin gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni thor go'i sa cha rgyang ring po nas don gnyer can 'ga' zhig yi ge'i lam 16

nas bskul ngor/ gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas dam pa'i gsung bzhin snyoms la4pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis bris pa'o/ /mgilo/ / r+sha ༄༅/ /'jam sdud bzang gsum 'don thabs bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ'ajam dpal mtshan brjod 'don thabs ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i sgo nas skyabasa'agro sems bskyed sngon du btang / rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba yi/ /sku mdog dmar ser phyag gnyis glegs ral 'dzin/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /'od phung dbus su rdo rje dkyil krung bzhugs/ /thugs gar zla dkyil steng du a yig las/ /tshig gi phreng ba spros nas don gnyis byas/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs ma lus pa/ /spyan drangs thugs ga'i a la thim par gyur/ /bar bas mas la 'don co/ /mthug tu/ 'di bton pa las byung ba yi/ /bsod nam sa gang zhig thob pa des/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams/ /myur du rgyud la skye bar shog/ces mtshan brjod kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams rang rgyud la myur du 'byung ba'i smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /mdo sdud pa 'don thabs ni/ skyabs sems sngo na du btang / mdun gyi nam mkhar mchod sprin 'a khyags pa'i dbus/ /rab mdzes 'od 'bar seng khri pad zla'i steng / /'dren pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po la/ /sras bcas rgyal bas bskor nas bzhugs par gyur/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'dar gsol/ /dge tshogs 'gro kun byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa phul/ sras bcas rgyal bas lhang lhang lung stsal ba'i/ /rjes zlos tshul gyis rang nyid brjod par gyur/ /bar bsams nas bton na chos la dbang be+e ba'i nyes gami 'byung zhing / /byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa dang /ring por mi thogs par chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob nas mchog gi sprul sku sogs lasagadams ngag dngos su nod pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur bar jo bo yab sras kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag bzhes yin par gsung / mjug tu/ 'di bton pa las byu nga ba yi/ /dge ba bdag gis ci glu bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bde gshegs shes rab thob par thog/ ces 17

brjod cing / tshogs zhing rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /bzang spyod 'don thabs ni/ gong ltar tshogs zhing gsal btab ste/ yan lag bdun pa phul la/ rgyal ba sras bcas dpang bor bzhugs shing smon lam 'grub pa'i thugs dgongs gtad par bsams la 'don par bya'o/ /mjug tu/ tshogs zhing rnams 'od kyi rnam par rang la thim pas ji ltar smon pa ltar myur du 'grub pa'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo/ /mdo sngags kyi gzhung 'don thabs mang mod kyang 'dir khyer bde mdo bsdus rdzo du bkod/ cung zad rgyas par 'dod na/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku bar ma'i gsung sogs dang /sdud pa 'don thabs yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa'i brgyad stong 'don thabs ltar bya'o/ /'di /skyi// /rdo/rdo //bye/ /rdo/rdo //lnga/ //re/ /rdo/rdo //// 'jam sdud bzang gsum zhal 'a na da 'a da 'ga' ga sa bskul ra/ mas las pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis dam pa'i gsung bzhin 'phral du bris pa'o/ / 18

༄tsho/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhel gyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na rme ār+ya lo ke shwa rā ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i snying rje mchog gi khams/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la brtse bas ma bzod pa ra/ /snang stong lha sku mtshan dpe 'ja' tshon ris/ / ston mdzad bru 'dzin bdag pos dus kun skyongs/ /'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer ji ltar bya ba la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi khyad par gyi sems bskyed rnams rgyud dang 'dres nges bsgom pa sngon du btang la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥs/rba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shurnyo3 haṃ/ sto nga pa nyid du gyur/ sto nga pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las bla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid — ske hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab cing zhabs gnyirnga mnyam par bzhengs pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing / zhal bcu gcig dang lda na pa'i rtsa zhal dkar g.yas ljang g.yon dmar pa/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon ljang ba thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ de'i steng na khro zhal mthing ga mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum pa khro gnyer dang ldan zhing ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi ba'i zhal dmar po 'dzum zhing gtsug tor dang bcas pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs 'dzin cing ma gul ba dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kur thal mo sbyar ba/g.yas gnyis pa na shel phreng / gsum pa na mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rgyun gyis yi dwags tshim par byed pa/ bzhi ba na 'khor lo bsnams pa/ g.yon 19

gyi gnyis pa na gser gyi pad+ma/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blusas/ bzhi pa na mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re mnga' zhing /phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang / mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing / ras bzang po'i sham thabs la nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyug pas mdzes shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥrlu baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ku'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shri ye ā2PROB/ zhes bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma das chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu ba rgyan par gyur/ mchod pa dngos su bshams yod na/ amṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las traṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/oṃ arnya ā2PROB/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra arnya nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags 20

phreng kha dog dkar pos bskor ba las 'od zer zla 'od lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs mun khung du nyi 'od phog pa ltar sangs kyis dag 'od zer ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pas mnyes par byas/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdug bsngal las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od kyi rnam par tshur bsdus rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsams la na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra be+e ro tsa na spru ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.arta de bh+yaḥsamya kra saṃ burnye bh+yaḥn ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo ti satā ya/ mahā satā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhiri/ d+ma ru d+ma ru/ es bas/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma pa re/ i li mi le/ tsi ti dz+wa la mā pa na ya su hā/ zhes gzungs rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang / de nas/ yom〉 pad+me hūṃ/ rnams gang mos brgya stong ci 'grub bzla/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gzhan yang gzugs su gang snang thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i rnam par shar ba snang ba sku'i khyer so dang / sgra gang grags thams cad sngags kyi gdangs su mos pa grag stong gsung gi khyer so dang / snang srid kyi chos rnams ming gis pha ra btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas tshugs thub tu thub pa rdul tsam yang med par nges pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba dang /sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po zung du 'brel ba'i stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can bsgoms pa/ dran rtog thugs kyi khyer so ste/ khyer so gsum gyi ngang nas gnam sa bar snang gi khyon thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skus til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba thamasacad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'thub ldir ba ciltar sgro ga par gyur par pos nas sngags bgrang / bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya lan gsum dang slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog/ de nas yig brgya dang / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / zhes sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥyi shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rim gyis 'od du zhu snying ga'i hrīḥl thim/ de yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang 21

las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bzhengs par gyur par mos la/bsngo smon shes brjod kyis brgyan par bya zhing / thun mtshams su yang dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sngags bzla ba sogs dge ba'i bya ba la gzhol bar bya'o/ /'dir 'bad legs byas ston po'i zla 'od ltar/ /mchog tu dkar ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /tshe rabs kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ / rjes bzung rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog/ces pa 'di ni dad brtson dang ldan pa dge slong yon tan dar rgyas dang / dge slong bstan 'dzin chos dar gnyis kyi rgyun khyer du/ mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis bgyis pa'o/ /seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma ār+ya tā ra yi/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse 'phrin las gcig bsdus —nas/ /rgyal sras sem sa ma mchog gi tshul 'dzin cing / /rgyal dang de sras ma lus bskrun ma dzad pa / / rgyal yum 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ / de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs mchog mang ma chis kyang / /'phags yul grub chen nyi ma sbas pa yi/ /bzhed srol khungs btsun brgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mdzod 'di na dgod/ /'dir slo ba dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lu gas bla med ltar seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas/ yid mthun gyi gnas su rje btsun ma'i bris sku dgram/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor mdzes par bshams/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril so gas yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas skyabs yul gsal btab la / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rgyud dang 'dres ngesasngon du btang / de nas/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kur zla ba la gnas pa'i tī yig gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhes sogs sho lo gas phyag bya/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs rgyun bshags dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cigaces sogs lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin 22

gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shun+taḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shurnyo3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ gzhal yas khang spu bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid tī yig ljang gu/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu margad kyi lhun po la nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs kyis 'khyud pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyas gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon dko na mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgyas ut+pal ljang gu bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan g.yon gyi thad du kha bye ba/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa cung zad khros shing phal cher 'dzum pa nu 'bur rab tu rgyas pa/ de'i g.yas su pad zla'i gdan la me las 'od zer can ma ser mo rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i cha lugs can/gtso mo'i g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las ral gcig ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa/ drag mo'i nyams can spyan gsum dang / glang lpags kyi stod g.yob/sa dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥshā baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ gtso mo la don yod grub pa/ 'od zer can ma la rnam snang / ral gcig ma la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ nang mchod/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swabhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yo las rlung / raṃ las me/ āḥlas mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyangs rtogs spar gsum byas pa las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen 23

por gyur/ oṃ āḥ&/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa rnams kyang snga ra bzhin bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbya ngas/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yo na/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong pa rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+bhe u:zhu/nas/ shag ya~XPROBPROBPROB bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas/shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥmai/ gis nang mchod 'bul/rgyal kuna'aphrin las gcig bsdus bcom ldan ma/ /'jigs pa kun skyob lha mo 'od zer can/ /rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod mdzad ral gcig ma/ /'phags ma gtso 'khor gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzlas pa bya ba ni rang gi thugs gar zla gdan la tī yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang sang sdig sgrib thams cad sbya ngas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang 'dod thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re swā hā/zhes brgya stong khri 'bum sogs gang 'grub bzla/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba(re tshe/ 'od zer can ma'i thugs gar zla gdan gyi steng mi yig le bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsams nas/ rmamā ri rtsu mi swāhā/ zhes dang / ral gcig gi thugs kur hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs nas/ oṃ hrīḥshā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing / bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ yi ge bcu pa 'bru 'bum dang / 'khor gyi sngags khri phrag re bzla bar gsungs so/ /bzlas pa'i mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs shing / gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba lī ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ gtor mgron rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang 21

med na rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon shis brjod kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas thun mtshams la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad du 'phags ma'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar/khrus dang / kha zas dang / nyal ba dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bla med spyi 'gros ltar bya ba dang / gang snang thams cad 'phags ma'i rnam rol tu blta zhing bde stong gi rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /smras pa/ gang zhig bsnyen pa tsam gyis kyang / /srid zhi'i dbul ba kun 'phrogs nas/ / mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin nor/ / ster byed thabs mchog 'di ko mtshar/ /'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /ring nas drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'phags mas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni thor ko pe se'i tho yon bla ma yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen byam/sa pa bstan 'dzin gyis bsku ngor/ snyoms na sa pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /༄khya/ /rang gi lha ga pa'i lha la ma chod cing gsol ba gdab tshul dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang zhig bsten na 'phral yun du/ / nam yang bsru ba med pa'i ske skyabs/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha mchog la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rang gi lhag pa'i lha rnam gsum la mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang / snu/dun gyi nam mkhar ma/chod sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /rab rgyas chu skyes lte bar zla gdan la/ / dbus su rgyal yum 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo// /sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ /g.yas pa pus steng skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad/ /g.yon pas gdugs kyi yu ba thugs gar 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /srab 'jam dar gyi na bza' mdzes par gsol/ /zhal dkyil ston zla rgyas pa'i dpal la 'gran/ /'od phung dbus su rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /de yi g.yas su pad zla'i gdan gyi steng / /rje btsun seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ni/ /sku mdog ljang khu margad ri bo la/ /rin chen phra btab lta bu mtshan dpe 'bar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang / /g.yon pas ut+pal yu ba thugs kur 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan mang gis spras pa/ /g.yas brkyangs g.yo na bskums skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs/ /g.yon gyi gdan steng 'phags pa dzam+bha la/ /sku 25

mdog gser gyi sa 'dzin 'bar ba la/ / thun mtshams nyi 'od 'khyud pa ji bzhin mdzes/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.ya sa pa mchog sbyin gyi/ /mthil na shing thog bi dza snu ra bsnams/ /g.yon pas rin chen gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin/ /'dod dgur yid bzhin nor gyi char chen 'bebs/ /sku sha rgyas shing rab dgyes spyan gdangs pa/ / sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub g.yo/ /yid 'phrog rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i rol ba'i bzhugs stabs kyis/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gter chen mang po mnan/ /de dag gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas rang rang ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs dzaḥshu baṃ hoḥdabyer med gyur/ / rgyal yum bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las gcig 'dus sgrol ma'i zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags pa dzarnya la/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs ma 'u sa 'bul / /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ /skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /'khor ba ma stongs bar du le gas bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bdag gzhan dge rnams byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa dang / de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ spro na mi phyed pa'i dad 'dun shugs drag pos/ gdugs dkar dang / sgro la ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa'am phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs bton rjes/ lha rnams kyi thugs gar blo ba'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon traṃ tai rdza la sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ukhyi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ zhes gdugs dkar gyi snying po dang / oṃ twa re tu re tu re swā hā/ zhes sgrol ma'i sngags dang / oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes rdza lha'i sngags rnams ci 'grub bzla'o/ /gdugs dkar gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / khyad par rang gnas pa'i sa nas dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad 'od zer me lce lta bus bskor bas 'byung po dang / ro langs dang / rims dang /gdon bgegs sogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las srung skyob sbed gsum byed par bsam/ de 26

bzhin du sgrol bstod dang sngags 'don skabs rang dang dmigs yul rnams 'phags ma'i phyag g.yas pa'i 'og tu chud nas 'jigs pa brgyad sogs las skyob cing gang 'dod kyi 'phrin las sgrub par bsam pa dang / rdza lha'i sngags bzla ba na phyag mtshan sogs las nor 'bru rin po che sogs kyi char babs nas rang gi gnas khang dang bang mdzod rnams gang ba'i dmigs pa yang yang bya'o/ /dran pas gdon bgegs 'joms mdzad gdugs dkar can/ /gang 'dod 'phrin las sgrub mdzad sgrol ma'i zhabs/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub char 'beb dzam+bha la/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i gsol 'debs spyod lam thams cad du yang ya nga brjod par bya'o/ /bstod pa dang 'phrin bcol bya ba ni/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i mtshan mchog gtsug tor nas/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i rmad byung lha mo ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod (nabs dran pa'i mod la sa gsum gyi/ /bdud rigs gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs bcas kun/ / skad cig nyid la thal bar brlag mdzad cing / /mthun rkyen 'dod don yid bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/ /rab mdzes 'phrin las lha mo'i skur bstan te/ /lus can thar ba mchog gi khang bzang du/ /'khrid mdzad tā re ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'phags ma khyod la skyabs su bsten pa'i mthus/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang / /tshe bsod stobs 'byor mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs/ /dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gser zhun btso ma'i ri la thun mtshams kyi/ /nyin byed bdag po'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /rab brjid lta bas mi ngoms nor gyi lha/ /'phags pa dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon khyod nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur cing / /nyam thag dbul phongs 'gro la lhag par brtse/ /de slad zas nor longs spyod dbyig sogs kyi/ /'dod dgu'i char gyi re 'bras skong bar mdzod/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /lhag pa'i lha yi go 'phang myur thob nas/ /'gro kun byang grol sa la 'god par shog/ ces brjod cing / rten yod na/'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang / rten med na/27

stebye/ 5khe (ste/ cardo /drardo shebye res /) (sgo/de theg res /nad pyas mas can na kun ma da/ / sa gas sa sa pa ga gas su ga la nga dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /shis brjod kyis kyang mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni cha har kho po sha ra nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dad brtson gtong phod sogs bsngags 'os kyi yon tan du mas rgyud phyug cing yig rigs du mas gtsos chos la blo mig mchog tu yangs pa grun tā pa yan cir gal gyis lha dar dri med dngul maṇa bcas yi ge'i lam nas bskul ba'i ngor/ mkhas grub dam pa du ma'i zhabs /rje//dros /// tshor :jordo smyo ri /rdosaX/snye /bye/ /dro/ /khye/rdul sa ba na pa' bya bral khur 'a na dbyangs can dga' ba' sa sa sug sa su ba sa pa'o 28

༄7/ /'grol pa bzhi sbrag gi bshad lung skabs kyi rgesung bshad 'ga' zhig zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs so/ /mchog thun dngos grub bde blag tu/ /stsol mdzad gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar phyag bgyis te/ /gang de'i zhal bzang las 'ongs pa'i/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gzegs ma 'di/ /rgyud 'grel rgya mtshor 'jug pa yi/ /nyer mkho'i brjed byang don du dgod/ /de yang rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo je 'chang chen ngur smrig gar gyi rnam pa/ra rol pa mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje btsun bla ma dam pa rje blo bzang dar rgyas dpal bzang po nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus si 'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don rnam par phye ba 'grel pa bzhi sbrag tu grags pa'i bshad lung gnang skabs kyi phyag len dang gsung bshad 'ga' zhig brjed thor bri ba ni/ thog mar tshogs 'phral du bla mas dbu bskul te sher snying tshar gsum/mkha' la spyod pa'i nas/ phyag 'tsha la lo/ /aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs sngags phreng skor gcig tar+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te zhes sogs bdud bzlog byas rjes/ yid kyi rol pa zhes sogs rdor sem sa sgom bzlas dang / de nas bying 'dren gyis dbu bskul te 'grel gtor bsngo ba dang / maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba brgyud 'debs rnams sngon du btang nas/ bla mas skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum gyi lam la blo sbyang ba dang / khyad par sngags bla med kyi lam/ la 'jug dgos tshul zhib rgyas gsung / de dag gi skabs kyi gsung bshad la/ de yang skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la blo sbyangs te tshe 'di'i snang shas ldoga'abring gi lam la sbyangs pas 'khor ba'i zhen chags ldog chen po'i lam la blo sbyangs pas rang don yid byed kyi blo ldog sngags lam la sbyangs pa las tha mal gyi snang zhen ldog dgos/ tshe 'di'i ma shi tshun chad kyi bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i 29

thabs tsam la 'bad pa ni dud 'gro dang khyad med pas/ / re shig chos gang gi'ang gdul byar mi rung la/ de la sangs rgyas kyis kyang re shig btang snyoms su 'jog pa ma gtogs gzhan bya thabs pe da/ de ltar ma yin par 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi don zhig bsgrub 'dod pa na bsgrub lugs rang stobs kyis mi shes nga sa/ 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi don sgrub mkhan dang ston ma/khan zhig gi rjes su 'brang dgos/ de 'dra'i lam ston ma khan la phyi nang gi ston pa gnyis las gzhan med pas/ de'i tshe phyi rol pa'i 'a ma ston mkhan zhig la skyabs btsal te skyabs su song na phyi rol pa'i bstan pa la zhugs pa zhes bya la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lam ston mkhan bdag cag gi sto na pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas skyabs btsal te skyabs su song na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la zhugs pa zhes bya ba yi na pas/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo dang phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gro'i sgo nas 'byed tshul de yin/ rme/do sngags gang gi snyeram du 'jug na'ang 'jug sgo ni theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed yin gsung ba ni/ mdo sngags gang gi sgo nas theg pa chen por 'jug na'ang 'jug sgo theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed yin pa'i don yin la/sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang la byed dgos gsung / de yang tha mal gyi snang zhen 'gog pa la lha 'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang gnyis kyi nang nas nga rgyal gtso che/ lha sku sgom pa yang bzhin lag gi rnam pa can du sgom pa'i nges pa med de/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgom pa ni don dam pa'i lha sgom pa yin/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha sgom pa tha mal gyi snang zhen gyi gnyen ngo ra 'gro ba la stobs che chung 'byung ba ni/ bzhin la ga gi rnam pa can du 'char rgyu'i ye shes kyi sku la khyad dang nus pa che chung byung ba'i dbang gis yin gsung /'grel pa bzhi sbrag ces pa'i 'grel pa bzhi ni/ dpal ldan zla ba'i sgro na gsal dang / rje'i mchan dang / bsdus don dang / mtha' dpyod de bzhi yin la/'grel ba bzhi po de sbrag nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi don 'chad pas na 'grel pa bzhi sbrag ces pa yin/ de 'chad pa la bsdus don las/ rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / zhes pa nas/ dang po las phye ba ni ma tha' dpyod du 30

gsal lo/ /mtha' dpyod la phebs par zhu gsungs nas/ mtha' dpyod kyi dbu rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgya cher bshad pa/ zhes pa nas/— dam pa snga ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes la 'dug pa ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar 'phri bsnan med par skabs skabs su gsung bshad dang bcas ljags klog mdzad/ rin chen brgya las zhes sogs sho 'o ka gcig gis gnas phun sum tshogs nga/ gzhal yas khang la bstod/ mkha' dbyings zhes sogs kyis ston pa phun sum tshogacis pa rdo rje 'chang la mchod par brjod/'dis chos phun sum tshogs pa yang don gyis go/ rab 'byams zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis 'khor phun tshogs la mchod par brjod/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras las logs su zla grags la mchod par brjod pa ni 'dir zla grags kyi gzhung sgro na gsal 'chad pa'i phyir yin/ bzhi brgya pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs lkog gyur la/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'dis thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa skye ba la stong nyid rtogs dgos par bstan gsung / gur gyi le'u dang po las/gal te stong pa thabs yin na/ /zhes sogs kyis phar phyin theg pa 'gog pa lta bu zhig yin/ rgyal ba'i thubs chos sku sgrub pa la de dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam bsgom dgos pa bzhin du/ gzugs kyi sku sgrub pa la'ang da lta nas de dang rnam pa ma thun pa'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku sogs nges par bsgom dgos na/ 'o na bde 'gro lha mi'i lus longs spyod sogs thob pa la'ang sbyin pa btang ba dang tshul khrims bsrung ba sogs kyis mi chog par de dag dang rnam/ pa mtshungs pa rgyu dus su bsgom dgos par 'gyur ro zhe na/de ni bde 'gro'i phun tshogs de dag gi ched du rgyu dge ba byas pa tsam gyis sgrub pa min par gzhan gyi lus dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la dmigs nas de dag la sred zhen chen po'i sgo nas yang dang yang du yid yul du byas te smon pa dang 'dris par byas pa dang 'dod 'dun drag po byas pas sgom pa'i dod byed gsung / de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la sogs pa mthong ba la dmigs nas de lta bu yong bar shog cig ces yang dang yang du yid yul du byas te smon pa byas pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku sgrub par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de ni tha mal gyi snang zhen dang 'dres pas de tsam gyis 31

gzugs sku'i rgyur mi 'gro gsung /rgyud 'grel gyi thog mar bla ma rgyud mchod byed pa la/ bla ma cho ga'i mtshams sgo gsum byin rlabs kyi mgor spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod nas bstod pa maṇ+ḍal gsol ba btab pa dang smon lam shis brjod rnams sngon du btang ste/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ 'grel gtor/maṇ+ḍal 'bul pa brgyud 'debs sogs byas/ de nas bla mas spyi bshad kun slong 'chos tshul sogs kyi gsung bshad gnang nas/ khyed rang rnam/sa rgyud 'grel zab mo 'di lta bu gas na pa la gnas 'di yang tha mal gyi snang ba tsam ma yin par ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha sum cu so gnyis kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos dang / bla ma yang seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri steng du lus dkyil gyi lha bkod de dkyil ('khor gyi gtso bo dang ngo bo dbyer med pa dang / slob ma khyed rang rnams kyang 'khor gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal gzung dgos/ de yang shar gyi phyogs na yod pa rnams rnam snang dang / lho na yod pa rnams rin 'byung / nub na yod pa rnams 'od dpas med/ byang na yod pa rnams don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gzung bar bla ma rnams bshad pas dmigs pa de bzhin mdzod gsung /rgyud 'grel 'chad pa la bsdus don la phebs par zhu gsungs te/ gnyis pa bye brag tu rgyud 'grel gnyis kyi don 'chad pa bzhi/ mtshan gyi don/ 'gyur gyi phyagagazhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyud kyi mtshan gyi don dang /'grel pa'i mtshan gyi don no/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud la phebs par zhu gsungs nas/ rtsa rgyud kyi dbu nas rgya gar skad du nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po zhes pa'i bar ljags klog gnang / de'i don ni mtha' dpyod la phebs par zhu gsungs te/ rgyud kyi mtshan don mtha' dpyod du bkod pa bklags nas gsung bshad mdzad/ gnyis pa 'grel pa'i mtshan don ni/ 'grel rkyang la phebs par zhu gsungs nas/ rgya gar skad du nas/ zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa zhes pa'i bar gyi 'grel rkyang tshar gcig 32

bklags/ de'i don ni mchan 'grel la phebs par zhu gsung / mchan 'grel gyi dbu/dngos grub mchog ni bde chen gyis thob pa'i/ /zhes sogs mchan dang sbrags nas bklags te gsung bshad mdzad/ mchan dang 'grel pa sbrag pa'i tshe yi ge mchan thag gis bskor ba rnam/sa yi ge'i ming nas bzung ste/ ('i) zhes pa bcad/ (gyi)bcad/ (ste) bcad sogs dang / yang ('i) bcad nas sogos dang / ('i)bcad de dang bcad pa yin sogs ci rigs pa'i brda sprad pa'i sgo nas mchan thag gis bskor pa'i yi ge gang yin dor bar byed do/ /saṃ skṛ ta ni legs par sbyar ba zhes pa yin la/ de'i don yang ming gcig la'ang dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams so sor phral ba na yi ge re re'i ngos nas kyang don re bshad rgyu yod la/ skad de rgya gar gyi phyi nang gi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi shes/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams shes pa yin zer gi 'dug gsung /gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud ni rang gi brjod bya'i don gsal por ma bstan par sbas nas yod pas na sbas rgyud ces bya la/ de'i don shes pa bshad rgyud la rag las pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la bshad rgyud yod/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud lta bu ni don ma sba sa par shin tu gsal bar ston pas na gsal rgyud ces bya ste/ des na dus 'khor gyi rgyud la bshad rgyud mi srid pa yin/ bla med kyi rgyud yin na/ de'i don dus 'khor ltar bshad rung bas khyab ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud don nā ro pa'i dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel par dus 'khor lugs su bshad yod la/ gsang 'dus dang /bde mchog dang / kye rdor gyi rgyud sogs la rang rang gi bshad rgyud kyis 'chad pa'i srol gcig dang / 'grel chen dri med 'od dang / phyag rdor stod 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel te sems 'grel skor gsum gyis dus 'khor ltar du bshad pa'i srol gcig ste bshad tshul gnyis gnyis yod gsung /bsdus don gyi sa bcad 'di la rgyud dang 'grel pa gnyis ku'i sa bcad cig dang /'grel rkyang gi sa bcad cig mtha' dpyod kyi sa bcad de gsum yod la/ spyi'i don zhes pa'i sa bcad de yin na phal cher mtha' dpyod kyi sa bcad yin dgos gsung /33

'grel pa 'chad tshul gyi go rim ni/ dang por bsdus don la phebs par zhu byas te/ska bas su gang 'bab kyi bsdus don gyi sa bcad rnams bkram/sa/ de nas rtsa rgyud yod na rtsa rgyud la phebs par zhu byas la rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung gang yin bklags la/ 'grel pa la'am yang na 'grel rkyang la phebs par zhu zhes brda sprad nas 'grel rkyang tshar gcig dang / de'i don mchan dang 'grel pa sbrag si/ la'am mchan 'grel la phebs par zhu byas te mchan dang 'grel tshig sbrag nas tshar gcig dang / zur mchan rnams mchan thag gang du yo da pa'i thad kur zur mchan la phebs par zhu byas te zur mchan 'don rjes/ dkyus mchan la phebs par zhu byas nas dkyus mchan la 'jug de nas mtha' dpyod yod na mtha' dpyod la phebs par zhu zhes byas la mtha' dpyod tshar gcig bklags te bshad pa gang 'os bya'o/ / ka rtags dang ang ki bsgrig pa ni/ma chan 'grel klog pa'i tshe bsgrig pa yin te/ de yang ka kha sogs dang ang ki gcig gnyis sogs kyi go rim ma nor bar bsgrigs te bklags dgos pas/ (ka) ka rtags 'di lta bu la ka sgo khyim g.yas 'khor dang / (ka) 'di la sgo khyim g.yon 'khor dang / (ka) 'di la ka kun 'khor zhes tha snyad mdzad/ grangs kyi ang ki gcig dang gnyis go rim mthar chags su byung ba'i tshe gcig nas gnyis kyi pa ra bcad la/ gcig thog nas gnyis thog la phebs byas nas ang ki'i bar gyi yi ge dor/grangs yig rnams go rims bsnol te byung na gcig thog la phebs dang phebs na dang phebs par zhu sogs kyi brda sngo na du 'gro ba'i sgo nas go rim bsgrigs te 'don pa yin no/ /snang mched thob gsum gang rung yin na/ rtog pa yin pas khyab/ 'byung ba thim rim gyi rtags smig rgyu sogs ni/ dbyar dus nyi ma'i 'od zer tsha ba dang bye ma phrad pa na sngo 'khyug 'khyug byed pa ni smig rgyu ste yongs grags ltar dang / du ba ni khang pa'i nang spos sam bsang dud btang ste sgo bsdams pa na du ba khang pa'i bar snang gi phyogs kun khyab nas yod pa lta bu dang / mkha' snang me khyer ni spos mang po sbar te gtor ba lta bu dang / mar me ltar 'bar ni mar me sbar te phyogs bzhi nas shog bus 34

bsgribs pa na steng du 'od kor re yod pa lta bu yin zhes bla ma rnams gsung / mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i bshad pa ni rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ma gtogs gzhan bstan bcos sogs la mi yong yang / grub chen lā li ta badz+ra'i gsung / gzugs mchog ma chog tu drag po che/ /zhes sogs 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa 'di la drang nges kyi bshad pa byed pa yod pas 'di la bla ma yongs 'dzin rin po che nas dmigs bsal yin na ma gsung /bshad pa de dag gang 'grig 'grig la sbyar mi chog tshul bzhi'i bshad pa gcig 'jug na gzhan gsum yang 'jug dgos/ drang nges kyi bshad pa gnyis kyang gcig 'jug na gcig shos 'jug pas khyab/ dgongs dgongs min gnyis gzhi gcig la gnyis ka 'jug pa mi srid/ bstan bcos gcig gi nang du gzhung gcig la drang nges gnyis dang tshul bzhi'i bshad pa ste drug po byas pa mi srid de/ drang nges kyi bshad pa gnyis byas phyin tshul bzhi'i bshad pa mi byed pa yin/ 'on kyang drang nges gnyis dang tshul bzhi dang dgongs bshad de bdun gzhung gcig 'a/ 'jug pa yod par bshad pa de/bstan bcos gcig gi nang du tshul bzhi'i bshad pa byas pa la gzhan du tshul bzhi bzhag nas drang nges kyi bshad pa byas pa yo da pa la byed pa yin te/ drang nges gnyis dang /tshul bzhi'i bshad pa gnyis gcig gi nang du gcig shos kyi don tshang bas bstan bcos gcig gi nang du de gnyis kyi gcig gi bshad pa byas phyin gcig shos byas pa la dgos pa med gsung / gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang / sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras sogs la phan tshun gcig la cig shos kyi ming btags pa mang du byung ste/ dper na bar do la longs sku dang / sgyu lus la bar do dang / chos sku la 'chi ba'i tha snyad dang /'chi ba la chos sku'i tha snyad btags pa sogs mang du yod pas de dag ma 'dres par skabs thob kyis khyad par 'byed shes dgos gsung / lha la bstod pa'am phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs bcad lta bu la tshigs rkang re re nas don ji 'dra ston rung tshigs rkang dang po'i skabs su thugs kyi yon tan dran te rdo rje snying gar 'dzin cing / gnyis pa'i skabs su gsung gi yon tan dran te dril bu dkrol/ gsum pa'i skabs su sku'i yon 35

tan mdzad pa 'phrin las snying ga nas gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa ston pa yid yul du byas te lag pa'i pad skor byas la/ bzhi pa'i skabs su sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan de rnams yid la dran te dad gus chen pos lag pa thal mo sbyar ba yin/ de yang rgyud smad pa'i pad sko ra g.yas dang / dben sa pa'i phyag len paṇa chen rin po che sogs kyis pad skor g.yon skor byas pa bde mchog sogs ma rgyud kyi lugs yin/ bla ma yongs 'dzin rin po che nas 'di ltar gsungs te/ mchod pa'i skabs mchod sngags dal bu byed tshe oṃ zhes brjod pa na se gol phyir gtogs te snying ga nas mchod lha rnams spros/ de nas pad skor lan gsum byed pa'i tshe mchod lha rnams mchod rdzas bzung ste 'bul yul gyi lha la g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor zhing mchod pa'i phyag rgya byas la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam/ yang pad skor lan gsum byas pas g.yas skor du bskor ba gsum byas nas hūṃ zhes brjod de se gol nang du gtogs pa dang mnyam du mchod lha rnams snying gar bsdus par bsam gsung / da lta rang cag rnams kyi lus rten 'di la sngags kyi rtogs pa mi skye bar ma zad phar phyin theg pa'i lam yang skye mi nyan pa ni/ bdag cag gi rten 'di lam de dag skye ba'i snod du ma gyur pa yin la/ lam de dag gi rtog/ sa pa skye ba la de'i snod rung gi rten zhig bsgrub dgos/ 4 de ni theg pa che chung dang mdo sngags rang rang gi dam tshig dang / sdom pa rnams legs par bsrungs pa las sgrub dgos snyam ste/ mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las gzhan med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/paṇa chen sku gong mas brag yer bar rgyud stod pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gnang skabs/ a ti sha la bod rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba e yod zhu bar/ tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba yod/ lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba med gsung ba la/bod rnams kyis a ti shas ma dgongs par byed kyang de a ti shas sngags kyi gnad mkhyen pa'i gsung yin pas thugs shin tu mad/ bod rnams ma shes pa red ces gsung bshad gnang / paṇa chen de nyid kyis rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la rgod lta lag bcangs sogs kyi bde ba dang stong pa sbyar ba'i bde stong gi ye shes yod pa la dgongs nas rgyud 36

sde 'og ma rnams la bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes yod pa'i sgrub byed mang du gsungs/rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya ma/tsho dang yongs grags la rim lnga gsal sgron —las gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde 'og ma la lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang stong pa sbyar ba'i ye shes med pa la bsams nas bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes med par khas len yang tshig gis zer sgros tsam ma gtogs don 'dra gsung / khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshor bka' chos 'butsha skabs/ phyag g.yas pa'i ma/theb mdzub gnyis sbyar sor mo gzhan gsum snying gar bsgreng ba chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad de/ 'o sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rab 'bring tha gsum gyi ched du theg pa che chung gi chos sna tshogs shig mtho dman 'bring gsum gyi tshul du gsungs yod ces pa'i brdar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya'i sor mo gsum bsgreng ba yin/ chos de rnams kyi gnad mthar thug na thugs dag pa don gyi 'od gsal dang sku dag pa dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i zung 'jug las med ces mtshon pa'i brdar ma/theb mdzub gnyis sbya ra ba 'di yin/ des na zung 'jug la go ba chags pa nga lta bu zhig ni phyag rgya 'di ltar chog de min pa rnams kyis mi chog ces gsungs pa red/ nged nas rgyud smad la 'gro ska bas dbang thob pa tsam las bsnyen pa gang yang ma song mod/ lca gas mkhar mang du 'phen dgos byung ba na rang gzhan sems can tham/sa cad kyi rgyud kyi las ngan nyon mongs dang /gces 'dzin dang tha mal gyi snang zhen thams cad mdun du sha za shin tu rid pa mi sdug cing nyam thag pa zhig tu bsams/ dgug gzhug byed pa na'ang rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa gces 'dzin tha mal gyi snang zhen tham sa cad bkugs nas de la thim pa'i mos pa bgyis te/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes gri gug sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs su shar bas gcad gtub sogs dang / gtor ma 'phangs pas rang gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa rnams dang tha mal gyi snang zhen thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlags song snyam du bsams nas bsgral las sogs bgyis pa yin pas/ de la rtsub cha mi yong pa'i khar de 'dra nam byas res kyi rmi lam du zho 'thung ba dang / nam mkhar 'a phur ba sogs ltas bzang po yo nga gi 'dug pas/ thams cad kyis de 'dra'i gtor ma sogs 37

'phen pa la thugs 'tsher gi yod kyang dmigs pa de ltar byas na rtsub cha yod don ga la yod gsung /le'u'i rgyas btab tshul skabs le'u gnyis pa dang lnga ba rnams la mchan cung zhig yo da pa rnams la sngon du 'grel rkyang tshar gcig bklags rjes/ phyag len yin gsungs nas mchan dang sbyar nas yang tshar gcig klog pa gnang / le'u bzhi pa dang brgyad pa la mchan yig 'bru gcig kyang med pa rnams tshar re las mi dgos gsungs nas tshar gcig klog par mdzad do/ /rtsa rgyud kyi 'di skad bdag gis nas bha ga la bzhugs so'i bar gyi gleng gzhi ni sdud pa pos gsungs tshul zhes pa'i sa bcad kyi mgor bklags/ gleng gzhi tshul bzhi'i bshad pa byed pa sogs la bshad pa re re'i mgor rtsa rgyud re bklags nas 'chad na chog pa lta bu zhig 'dug kyang phyag len la thog mar tshar gcig las mi klog par 'dug gsungs nas tshar gcig gis chog pa gnang / gleng gzhi sbas bshad kyi skabs kyi lha bsgom tshul bstan pa rnams la 'di rnams rdzogs rim pa'i lha sgom tshul yin pas/ de bskyed rim la gtan nas sbyar mi chog ste/ sbas don gyis gtso cher rdzogs rim lus dben nas ri ma pa gsum pa'i bar gyi lam bstan —pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rdzogs rim pa'i lha sgom tshul bstan pa cig bskyed rim gyi lha sgom tshul gyi shes byed du drangs na 'chad pa po de shin tu mi mkhas pa yin no/ /rang cag rnams gzhal yas khang gi nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha mngon rtogs nas ji tsam bshad pa de tsam ma gtogs gzhan gzhal yas khang gi nang bar snang stong sang nge yod pa lta bu zhig bsams kyang / sngon byung la 'khor phun tshogs dran don gyi bshad pa dang shes brjod kyi rab yangs nam mkha' til gyi gang bu bzhin/ /zhes sogs dang / bskyed rim khrid yig rnams su tha na phyogs bzhi'i ka ba dang rtsig pa'i rdul phra rab tshun chad lha'i ngo bo shar gyi rnams phyag mtshan 'khor lo dang / lho'i rin po che dang / nub kyi pad+ma dang /byang gi rnams ral gri sogs su bshad pas nges par rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe gzhal yas khang gi nang steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad lhas gang bar bsgom dgos pa mngon rtogs rnams su gsal bar ma byung ba zhig yin nam snyam 38

gsung / lha bsgom pa'i tshe phal che ba zhig gis lha'i zhal dkar nag dang phyag mtshan la sogs cod bcad nas de la gsal snang zhig e yong lta ba ma gtogs/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes chos kyi sku la go ba chags par byas te/ de nyid bzhin lag gi rnam pa can du bsgoms te nga rgyal gtso bor bzung nas tha mal gyi snang zhen gyi gnyen por 'gro dgos par shes pa nyung bar snang / paṇa chen sku gong ma'i zhal nas/ gang yang ma byas gong nas rang gi go sar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar khyil le ba zhig gi khar 'jigs su rung ba kha gdangs pa mthong tshad thams cad za bar byed pa lta bu thogs bcas rags pa de 'dra sgom mi rung / des ni de 'dra'i 'dre gdug pa can zhig tu skye mi yong ba'i nges pa med gsung / bla med kyi lha sgom pa sbyang gzhi dang mthun par sgom pa zhig dgos pas khro bo sogs sgom pa yin gyi dngos gnas la khro ba ga 'a/ yin/ gzungs dkyil ni rig ma la gzungs ma zer ba yin pas rig ma sbrul pa'i dkyil 'khor la gzungs dkyil zer ba yin/ le'u bshad zin par bstan pa ni rtsa rgyud kyi dbang du byas na dang po'i dang / gnyis pa'o zhes sogs yin gsung /le'u gnyis pa'i bsdus don gyi mgor par gsar rnying mang por gnyis pa zhes 'byung ba ma dag ste/ de ni gong gi sa bcad gsum pa yin pas 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyud ṭīka tu gsum pa zhes yod pa dag pa yin/ 'dul 'dzin rin po che'i kun rig ṭīka chen du/ hūṃ gi klad kor mar bklag dgos te/ de yi ge btus pa'i tshe ma yig btus pa'i phyir gsung yang / rgyu mtshan de ma nges te sngags btus pa'i tshe ma yig btus na klog pa'i tshe mar bklag dgos pas ma khyab ste/ hūṃ gi klad kor ngar bklag dgos pa rje'i dgongs pa yin pa ni rje'i gsung rab rnams su rnam dbye 'dren pa na hūṃ gi mthar ka sde'i gsum pa la i sbyar ba gi zhes pa sha stag 'byung bas ma yig gi sbyar na sum rtags kyi dgongs pa dang 'gal zhing ma dang ga gnyis skye gnas mi mthun pas klog kyang shin tu mi bde ba'i phyir dang / gzhan yang rdor bzlas kyi skabs su rlung oṃ gyi gdangs kyis nad du zhugs pa dang / āḥ'i gdangs kyis gnas pa dang / hūṃ gi gdangs kyis phyir dbyung dgos pas hūṃ gi klad kor mar bklags na shin tu mi 'grig 39

pa'i phyir ro/ /bka' drin gsum gyi rgyud bshad ni rgyud 'grel 'di lta bu 'chad pa dang /man ngag sbyin pa ni bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gnang ba la byed pa yin/ lus la lha 'god nas sgom pa dang / lus dkyil sgom pa gnyis gtan nas mi 'dra/ pan chen sku gong mas sangs rgyas pa 'a rigs lnga ga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas dgos pas khyab ste/ rnam snang gi ngo bor sangs ma/ rgyas na sangs rgyas de la sku med dgos/ de bzhin du 'od dpag med kyi ngo bor sangs ma/ rgyas na gsung med dgos/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor sangs ma rgyas na thugs med dgos/ rin 'byung gi ngo bor sangs ma rgyas na yon tan med dgos/ don grub kyi ngo bor sangs ma rgyas na sangs rgyas de la mdzad pa 'phrin las med dgo sa pa yin gsung / de yang gzhi la shin tu phra ba'i rlung 'od zer lnga ldan ngo bo gcig pa bral mi srid pa bzhin du
