rirtags mtshungs sam sgra mthun brjod bde 'dren pa'i phyir rnam dbye dang tshig phrad gzugs mi 'dra ba 'byung ngo / /zhes pa'i don te/ chos dngos ni rnam dbye dang po dang / sbyin pa rnam dbye bzhi pa'i ming ngo / /gsum pa de'i nang gses 'jug tshul ni/ de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ / nas/ de dag nang gses rnam par dbye/ /zhes pa'i bar sho lo ka phyed dang lnga gsungs/ de yang rnam dbye dang tshig phrad de dag gang dang gang 'jug tshul ni/ ming tshig sngon ma so so'i 'phro la de ma thag sbyar rgyu'i tshig don 'og ma gang yin de'i nus pas shesadagos te/ dper na/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa'i ming lha zhes pa'i 'phro la legs sbyar la rnam dbye dang po sbyar yod na ming tsam du ma bsdad par tshig tu gyur pa yin kyang / bod la ming de ka rang la rnam dbye dang po zhes pa ma gtogs rnam dbye logs su ster rgyu med do/ /rnam dbye sbyar ba'i ming tsam la spyir 'jug ces bya ste/ ming de rnam dbye dang tshig phrad rnams sbyar rgyu'i spyi la 'jug pas na spyir 'jug ces btags par mngon no/ /ming de'i mthar de ma thag sbyar ba'i don gsal byed char 'bebs par byed ces pa lta bu byed pa'i sgra yod na ming sngon ma'i mthar rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug ste/ lhas char 'bebs par byed/ ces pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du tshig don 'og mar ched du byed pa'i sgra mchod pa 'bul lta bu yod na rnam dbye bzhi pa 'jug ste/ lha la mchod pa 'bul lta bu dang /bdud rtsi yod lta bu rten byed kyi sgra yod na rnam dbye bdun pa 'jug ste/ lha la bdud rtsi yod/ lta bu dang / blta bar bya lta bu las su bya ba'i sgra yod na rnam dbye gnyis pa 121

'jug ste/ lha ru blta bar bya/ lta bu dang / dngos grub blang lta bu 'byung khungs kyi sgra yod na rnam dbye lnga ba 'jug ste/ lha las dngos grub blang / lta bu dang / tshig don 'og mar bsgrub par bya ba dar gos lta bu 'brel ba'i sgra yod na ming snga ma'i mthar rnam dbye drug pa 'jug ste/ lha yi dar gos/ lta bu dang / ming de'i sngon du bod ba'i sgra kye lta bu yod na rnam dbye brgyad pa 'dren pa yin te/ kye lha/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang tshig phrad 'dren pa ni/ tshig don 'og ma las gong ma'i don lhag ma 'dren rgyu yod pa rnam mkhyen gyi bar zhes pa lta bu yod na/ ming snga ma'i mthar nas lta bu sdud pa'i sgra 'dren te/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar/ zhes pa lta bu dang /don lhag ma bsdu rgyu med na gzugs so/ /tshor ba'o lta bu slar bsdu'i sgra 'dren no/ /tshig don gong ma las kyang de bzhin du don phyi ma 'dren te/ ji snyed ces pas de snyed ces pa 'dren pa dang / ji snyed kyis de skad dang / ji ltar gyis de ltar dang / gang yin gyis de yin zhes pa 'dren pa la sogs pa'o/ /ming tshig gi rnam grangs dag bkod pa ni/ dper na/ 'dam skyes rnams ni rab tu bye/ /'dab rgyas ge sar so phreng rgod/ /dri bsung 'thul bas phyogs kun khyab/ /bung ba'i dga' ston rnam par di 'phel/ji /zhes pa lta bu ste/ rab tu bye/ rgyas/ rgod/ 'thul/ khyab/ 'phel rnams don pad+ma kha bye nas rgyas pa la 'jug pas don bskyar yang tshig mi 'dra bas bskyar bldab kyi skyon med cing / legs so legs so legs par gsungs/ /zhes dang / me tog gtor/ mngon par gtor mngon par rab tu gtor/ zhes pa lta bu tshig bskyar rmi nga don legs so 'bul ba chung 'bring che gsum dang / gtor ba chung 'bring che gsum la byed pas don bskyar ba'i skyon mi 'byung ngo / /phyi mar ming tshig gi rnam grangs gnyis gsum sogs bgod yod na don snga ma bskyar ba la 'jug pa dang / phyi mar pho sgra ste bdag po'i sgra med pa la gsar du sbyar yod na ming snga ma bdag po'i sgrar 'gyur zhing / mo sgra dgag tshig med pa la gsar du sbyar ba yin na ming snga ma de nyid dgag sgra can du 'gyur ro/ /rgyan du gyur pa kyang yang 'ang rnams/ don mthun pa yin na ming snga ma la mthun pa'i tshig phrad sbyar zhing / tshig snga phyi mi mthun na mi mthun pa'i tshig 122

phrad sbyar ro/ /tshig gi rgyan la'ang don la snyeg pa ste don logs su ston rgyu yod na nges par sbyar dgos la/ don lhag pa snyig rgyu med pa tshig gi kha skong ngam mdzes byed tsam du sbyar ba rnam par/ nges par/ rab tu zhes pa lta bu yin tshe dorno la sbyor mi sbyor gang byas kyang rung ngo / /don snga ma'i 'phro de ma thag bstan bya lhag ma/ yod na snga mar lhag bcas kyi sgra sbyar zhing / bstan bya lhag ma med na slar bsdu'i sgra rdzogs tshig sbyar ro/ /de ltar brjod bya'i don rdzogs pa dang ma rdzogs kyis rnam dbye dang tshig phrad de dag gi nang gses gang dang gang 'jug cing don ji ltar ston tshul rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /gong gi ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis ni/ zhes sogs kyis ming snga ma'i mtha'i rjes 'jug gi nus pas rnam dbye sogs 'dren tshul yin la/ 'dir ni tshig don 'og ma'i nus pas ming snga ma la rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'thob tshul 'chad byed yin pas khyad par yod do/ /ming mtha'i rjes 'jug gi shugs kyis rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'thob tshul ni slar bsdu'i skabs su rjes 'jug bcu/ /rang 'drar rna ru sbyar ba dang / /na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ /da drag thob tshe ta la sbyar/ /sa su ga ba da drag tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /'a dang mtha' rten med pa'i mthar/ /ra dang ru ni gang rigs sbyar/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/ /na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi/ /'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i/ /rkang pa skong tshe yi thob po/ /ga da ba sa da drag mthar/ /kyang dang rjes 'jug gzhan gyi mthar/ /'ang thob rkang pa skong tshe yang / /da de na ra la sa te/ /ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang / /mtha' rten med mthar sa ste thob/ /'byed sdud skabs su rjes 'jug bcu/ /rang 'drar ma yig sbyar ba dang / /da drag thob tshe ta dang sbyar/ /ga da ba sa na ma'i mthar/ /ba phyed nga 'a ra la ba/ /ga da ba dang da drag mthar/ /cing ces ce 'o ce na cig/ nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /rjes 'jug med pa'i ming gi mthar/ /zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig/ sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs/ /shes shig she 'o she na 'thob/ /kha cig lhan cig cig car sogs/ /cig ni ming gi cha shas yin/ /zhes pa ste/ dper brjod rnams dag yig za ma tog dang / ngag sgron sogs las shes par bya'o/ /rnam dbye zhes pa ni/ chos gnyis ma 'dres par so sor 'byed par byed pa'i sgra'i cha shas sam 123

tshig phrad cig la rnam dbye zhes pa yin te/ rnam dbye dang po don gyi ngo bo tsam rjod pa bum pa zhes pa la'ang bum pa'i ngo bo chos gzhan dang ma 'dres par 'byed pa'i sgra'i cha shas shig yod par khas len dgos so/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba ni/ las dang bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso bor la sa la nye ba'i rnam dbye yin/ rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa ni/ byed pa po dang bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso bor byed pa po la nye ba dang / rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched ni/ dgos pa dang bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso bor dgos pa la nye ba dang / lnga ba 'byung khungs ni/ 'byung khungs dang byung ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso bor 'byung khungs la nye ba dang /drug pa 'brel ba ni/ 'brel yul dang 'brel chos gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso bor 'brel yul la nye ba dang / rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas ni/ gnas dang gnas pa po gnyis so/ sor 'byed cing gtso bor gnas la nye ba'i rnam dbye yin zhing / rnam dbye brgyad pa bod pa ni/ 'bod pa'i brda sbyar ba tsam ma gtogs don rnam dbye dang po las logs su med la/ rnam dbye rnams tshig phrad yin yang tshig phrad rkyang pa min no/ /tshig phrad ni/ tshig snga phyi'i bar du mtshams sbyor byed du 'byung ba shas che ba zhig la byed pa yin zhing / legs sbyar gyi tshig phrad ni pā da dang don mi 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa la/ ci'i phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /zhes pa man chad de/ rjes 'jug rnams dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa ni/ don bsdu na/ spyir yi ge ni ming tshig rjod pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu yin te/ yi ge re re ba 'dus pa'i khongs nas ming phyungs/ ming 'dus pa las tshig phyungs nas brjod bya'i don thams cad ston par byed pa'i phyir/ tshig ni ming gzhi la rjes 'jug gang yang rung ba zhig ma zhugs na rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sogs sbyar ba mi srid de/ rjes 'jug gi shugs kyis rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'dren pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rang 'bras ming tshig gi gzhir gyur ba'i skad kyi gdangs de/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/dbyangs dang / gsal byed gnyis yod/ don gyi ngo bo tsam rjod pa'i sgra de/ ming gi mtshan nyid/ dper na/ ka ba/ bum pa zhes pa lta bu/ de 'dra'i sgra de ka ba 124

dang bum pa'i ngo bo tsam gyi ming yin pa'i phyir/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad chos sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra de/ tshig gi mtshan nyid/ dper na/ tsan dan gyi ka ba/ gser gyi bum/ pa zhes pa lta bu'o/ /sgra de don gyi ngo bo ka ba dang khyad chos tsan dan— sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ mo yig dbyangs med na/ pho yig gsal byed rkyang ba gdangs kyi nga ro dang bral bas brjod pa med par 'gyur la/ pho yig de dag dbyangs dang ldan na'ang sngon 'jug yod med gang yang rung / rjes 'jug ma zhugs na ming dang rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs sbyar ba'i tshig kyang gsal mi nus shing / ming tshig gsal ba med na brjod bya'i don rnams gzhan la zu/tshon zhing go bar byed pa'i rjod byed dag kyang yod par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir dbyangs yig ces pa dbyangs mtshon byed gu gu/zhabs kyu/ 'greng bu/ rna ru bzhi la bya ste/ a yig ni gang la 'dogs pa'i gzhi brjod don tsam ma gtogs gsal byed yin pa'i phyir/ des na bod la legs sbyar lta ra dbyangs yig srog zhugs kyi tha snyad med cing rjes 'jug zhugs pas go chod par mdzad de/ sum cu pa las/ rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyo ra ba yod mi srid/ /ces dang / 'dir yang rjes 'jug gi 'jug pa 'chad pa na/ rjes 'jug ni yi se/ thams cad kyi mjug tu khyad par med par 'jug par pa sungs pa dang /'jug par bcas pa med par ni/ /ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rjes 'jug gzhan dgu po gang rung med pa'i mtha' 'a yig re res par bzhag pa sgra bsgyu ra snga ma rnams kyis ma dzad la/ dper na/ ka zhes brjod pa'i tshe rjes 'brel du 'a yig mi gsal ba'i tshul du yod pa'i phyir ro/ / skad gsar bcad la/ dga'/ mda'/ bza' lta bu yig rkyang 'phul yig can la 'a yig mtha' rten dngos su med na ming gzhi rjes 'jug tu 'khrul la/ brtsegs pa dang 'dogs can la 'khrul gzhi med pas yig tshogs skyung ba'i ched ma bzhag pa yin te/rngog lo chen po'i dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa las/ rkyang ba 'phul la 'a mtha' dgos/ /brtsegs pa bu drug can la spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /bu drug ni gu gu sogs bzhi dang ra btags ya btags bcas drug la bshad do/ /de ltar gong smos bzhin ming 125

tshig rjod pa thams cad med na ni 'jig rten du don mtshon pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra kun kyang med par 'gyur bas/ rig pa'i gnas spyi dang bye brag tu gzhan sde'i rig byed bzhi'i don smra ba dang / rang sde'i theg pa gsum gyi sde snod dang / de'i brjod bya bslab pa gsum rnams kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /dper na 'jig rten du sems can rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched sogs dang / grub mtha' mchog dman dang / gzhan yang don gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa yod mod kyi/ de dag 'di dang 'di'o zhes tshig gis brda ma sprad par rang nyid kyis mi shes pa bzhin no/ / de bzhin du yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams rang rang gi smra ba'i ngag kun la rang chas su yod kyang / brda ma sprad par tshig rang gi gnas tshul de nyid ji bzhin mi shes pas tshig 'dis don 'di ston no zhes don la sbyor tshul ga la shes te mi shes so/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyi ra 'phags tshul gyi smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhas pa rnams kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos kyi rjes su 'brangs nas thon mi sasto ṭa bdag gis bod kyi brda sprod kyi tshul smras pa 'di'i don gangs can gyi skye bo kun gyis rtogs par gyur cig ces thugs smon rgya cher mdzad pa'o/ /smras pa/ gang zhig rtogs na gsung rab don/ /ma nor lta ba'i 'dren byed mchog/ sbyin mdzad rnam dag brda sprod gzhung / go sla'i ngag gis cung zad bkral/ /brjod don 'khrul med mthong 'dod dag/ rab gsal sgron me 'di zungs shig/ dran dbang mi gsal 'gal 'khrul sogs/ /gang mchis gzur gnas mkhas la bshags/ /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs su/ /dal 'byor rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /rig gnas rgya ma/tsho'i mthar son nas/ /kun mkhyen gling du phyin gyur cig/ cesapa 'di ni khal kha se chen han gyi shog rig gnas la mkhyen dpyod rab tu yangs pa tā bla ma blo bzang sbyin pas mkhas pa chen po bra ti dge bshes kyi sum cu pa'i 'grel pa rgyas par bzhugs na'ang / rtags 'jug gi bshad sbyar tshigs bcad ma mdor bsdus tsam las ma mthong bas dper brjod dang bcas cung zad rgyas tsam zhig dgos zhes lha dar par gyi mthun rkyen dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ snyoms las pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling du sbyar ba kun la phan thogs par gyur cig/126

ce ༄༅/ /rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' gnas bdag gzhan dang bya byed las gsum gyi khyad par zhib tu phye ba nyung gsal 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so /na mo mchu shri ye/ rmad byung thugs bskyed skya rengs kyis/ /bho ṭa'i yu la ljongs mkha' dbyings su/ / rgyal bstan nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /'dren mdzad thon ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang thugs dri bral mkhyen mtsho las/ /legs 'ongs gtsug lag phyi mo mchog/ brda spro da gzhung gi dka' gnad mdud/ /rnam dpyod sor mos dgrol bar bya/ /de yang rta ges kyi 'jug sa las/ pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad si 'i brjod bya'i don bdag gzhan gnyis dang / bya byed las gsum dang / 'das ma 'ong da ltar gsum gyi khyad par rnams rtogs dka' zhing zhib tu phye ba gal che bas don nyung ngur dril te brjod na/ las gang dang gang gi byed pa po la bdag dang / gang bya ba'i yul de la gzhan zhes bya la/ bya byed las gsum du phye ba'i tshe byed pa po gtso phal gnyis la byed pa dang / bya ba'i yul la las dang /byed pa pos la sa de bgyi ba la bya ba zhes bya'o/ /bya ba de byas zin pa ni 'das pa dang /byed bzhin pa ni da lta ba dang / byed 'gyur la ma 'ong bar 'jog pa yin no/ /de yang gzhi gcig gi steng du dper brjod na/ shing mkhan gyis sta res shing gcod pa'i tshe/shing mkhan ni byed pa po gtso bo dang / sta re ni byed pa phal ba yin te/ de gnyis bdag gzhan gnyis las bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas byed pa yin no/ /shing ni las dang / de bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan yin zhing / shing la sta res brdeg pa'am sta res shing gcad pa ni bya ba yin te/ 'di la byed pa po la yod pa'i bya ba dang / bya ba yul la yod pa'i bya ba gnyis yod de/ sta res shing 127

gcod pa'i rtsol ba ni byed pa po shing mkhan la yod cing / shing dum bur bcad pa'i cha ni bya yul shing gi steng du yod pa bzhin no/ /dang po 'di la byed pa'i las sam bdag dang 'brel ba'i las dang / phyi ma la bya ba'i las sam gzhan dang 'brel ba'i las zhes kyang bya'o/ /de bzhin du bya byed dang 'brel ba thams cad la shes par bya ste/ gang zag ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga len pa po ste bdag dang / phung po lnga ni las te gzhan dang / gang zag nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga blang bar bya ba ni bya ba'o/ /mig gis gzugs la lta ba'i tshe/ lta pa po gang zag dang lta byed mig ni byed pa dang /yul gzugs ni las/ mig gis gzugs blta ba ni bya ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /don de rnams blo yul du nges par byas na 'grel pa rnams kyi dper brjod bde blag tu go bar 'gyur ro/ / 'dir yang nyung sa/sal gyi dper brjod cung zad 'god pa la/sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig bya ba'i las 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ nor bsgrubs/ lha bsgo mas/ chos bsgra gas/ yid la bcangs/ sgro 'dogs bcad/bdud bcom/ sbyin pa btang / chos bstand par byas/ chos bsgyu rad zin/bka' bstsald to/ /tshul khrims bsrungs/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ de rnams ni bsgrubs/ zin pa dang bsgrub sa par byas pa sogs kyi don yin pas dus 'das pa sto na no/ /dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa dper na/ bsgrub bya/ bsgom bya/ bsgrag bya/bstan bya/ bsgyur bya/ bsgral bya/ bsrung bya/ btsal bya/ zhes pa lta bu dang /bsgrub par bya/ bsgom par bya/ bsgrag par bya/ bstan par bya/ zhes sogs bya tshig sbyar na bya ba'i las ma 'ong ba la 'jug par zha lu lo chen sogs bzhed la/mkhas pa 'ga' pra ti dge bshes zhig de la bya ba'i las da lta ba zhes bzhed do/ /'on kyang bsgrub lta bu tshig grogs kyi dbang gis ma 'ong ba dang da lta ba gnyis kur 'jug rung ste/bsgrub par bya zhes pa bya las ma 'ong ba dang bsgrub bzhin pa/ bsgom bzhin pa sogs bya ba da lta ba la 'jug par gsal lo/ /de dag gi zlas drangs pa'i dngos po bdag la bas 'phul mi 'jug ste/ nor sgrub pa po/ lha sgom pa po/ sgrog pa po/ ston pa po/sgyur ba po/ srung ba po/ zhes pa lta bu dang / sgrub byed/ sgom byed/ srung byed/128

ston byed sogs byed pa po phal ba dang / sgrub par byed/ sgom par byed/ ston par byed/ srung bar byed sogs byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i las yin te/ dus da lta ba la 'jug cing / sgrub par 'gyur/ sgom par 'gyur/ srung bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs byed las ma 'ong ba la 'jug go/ des na spyir btang bas 'phul dang yang 'jug kyang yod pa'i bsgrubs/ zhes pa bsgrubs zin 'das pa'i don du 'jug pa dang / bas 'phul yod la yang 'jug med pa'i bsgrub dang / bsgom sogs ni dngos po gzhan dang / bya las ma 'ong ba dang da lta ba ci rigs pa'i don la 'jug cing / bas 'phul med pa'i sgrub bang / sgom sogs ni dngos po bdag gam byed pa po dang / byed pa dang / byed las ma 'ong ba dang da lta ba thams cad la skabs thob kyis 'jug tshul shes par bya'o/ /bskul tshig la bas 'phul med cing yang 'jug 'thob ste/ nor sgrubs shig lha sgoms shig chos sgrogs shig yid la chongs shigasgro 'dogs chod cig bdud choms shig sbyin pa thongs shig chos stond cigadabang skurd cig bka' stsold cig dge ba sngos shig mig gis ltos shigade bzhin du skyongs shig tsoms shig srungs shig soms shig rjod cig/slobs shig sogs mang ngo / /yang 'jug 'thob tshul ni/ ga nga ba ma bzhi'i mthar sa dang / na ra la gsum gyi mthar da yig 'jug la/ 'on kyang skad gsar bcad la da drag dngos su mi sbyor yang 'das tshig dang bskul tshig gi na ra la gsum/ gyi mthar rnam dbye dang phrad sogs da drag thob pa bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ /sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga dang da ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang / dus da lta ba la 'jug pa gtso che ste/ga yig bdag la 'jug pa dper na/ gcod pa po/ gtong pa po/ gnon pa po/gsod pa po/ zhes dang / dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ gcad bya/ gtang bya/ gnan bya/ gsad bya/ gzhom bya/ gdul bya/ gzung bya/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /gcod par byed/ gtong bar byed/ gnod par byed sogs byed pa'i las da lta ba dang / gcod par 'gyur/ gtong bar 'gyur sogs ni byed las ma 'ongs pa'o/ /gcad par bya/ gtang bar bya sogs bya ba'i las ma 'ong ba dang /129

gcad bzhin pa/ gtang bzhin pa/ gzhom bzhin pa sogs bya las da lta ba la 'jug go/ da yig bdag la 'jug pa dper na/ dpyod pa po/ dpog pa po/dgyes byed/ dga' byed/ ces sogs dang / dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa ni/dpyad bya/ dpag bya/ dbyung bya/ dgag bya/ dgod bya/ gtan la dbang bya zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ dpyod par byed/ dpog par byed/ dga' bar byed sogs byed las da lta ba dang / de dag la 'gyur zhes sbyar na byed las ma 'ong ba yin zhing / dpyad par bya/ dbyung bar bya/ zhes sogs su tshig sbyar na bya las ma 'ong ba la 'jug pas na/ rtsa bar ga dang da gnyis dngos su da lta ba tsam la 'jug par gsungs pa gtso che ba la dgongs pa'o/ /des na mkhas pa'i dbang po pra ti dge bshes rin chen don grub kyis/ ma ning da ni bdag dngos dang / /bdag dang 'brel ba'i las mi 'jug/ ces gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad par rtogs sla'o/ /sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig ni/ dngos po bdag la 'jug pa dper na/ 'god pa po/ 'dogs pa po/'dzin pa po/ 'dul mkhan/ 'gro mkhan/ 'joms mkhan/ 'ja' byed/'jog byed/ 'jug pa po/ lta bu dang / dngos po gzhan la'ang 'jug par gsal te/ dper na/ 'khor bya/ 'khrid bya/ 'dod bya/ 'jug bya/ lta bu'o/ /ma 'ong ba la 'jug pa ni/ 'god par 'gyur/ 'grel par 'gyur/ 'chad par 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ 'byung ngo / /'dzad do/ /'grub bo/ 'chi'o/ /'gyur ro/ / 'jig go/ zhes pa dang / da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ 'god par byed/'dogs par byed/ 'jigs par byed/ 'dul byed/ 'dzin byed/ ces pa la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /gzhung rtsa bar dngos su dngos po bdag dang ma 'ong ba tsam las ma byung yang gtso che ba la dgongs pa'o/ /sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang / dus 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum sogs thams cad la phyogs res med par mnyam par 'jug ste/ dngos po bdag la 'jug pa ni/ mkhas pa po/ mchod pa po/ mthong ba po/ mda' mkhan/ mtshon byed/ ces sogs dang / dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ mkhas bya'i chos/ mchod bya'i lha/130

mdzad bya/ mtshon bya/ lta bu'o/ / 'das pa la 'jug pa/ mkhas par byas/'og tu mnan/ duḥkhas mnar/ sdom pa mnos/ mchod zin/zhe zhes pa lta bu dang / da lta ba ni/ mkhas par byed/ mthong bzhin pa/ mchod par mdzad/ces pa dang / ma 'ong ba la 'jug pa ni/ mkhas par 'gyur/ mtshon par 'gyur/mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs lta bu ste tshig grogs las dpag ste shes par bya'o/ /bya byed sogs dang dngos su ma 'brel ba yang yod de/ dper na/ grub/byung / gyur/ byang / babs/ lta bu 'das pa dang / 'grub/ 'byung /'gyur/ 'byang / 'bab/ ces sogs lta bu ma 'ong ba la 'jug ste/ de dag gi don ni chos de byed pa po sogs la dngos su ma ltos par rang nyid grub zin pa dang 'grub nges kyi don no/ /gzhan yang bdag gzhan dang dus gsum sogs kyi dper brjod gnad che ba 'ga' zhig 'god pa ni/ bsgrubs dang sgrub byed bsgrub bya sgrubs/ /bsgoms dang sgom byed bsgo ma bya sgoms/ /bskangs dang skong byed bskang bya skongs/ /bsgral zin sgrol byed bsgra la bya sgrol/ /bstan zin ston byed bstan bya ston/ /bsrungs dang srung dang bsrung bya srungs/ /bskyangs dang skyong dang bskyang bya skyongs/ /bsngos dang sngo byed bsngo bya sngos/ /bcad dang gcod byed gcad bya chod/ /bca95 dang 'jal byed gzhal bya 'jol/ /btang dang gtong dang gtang bya thongs/ /btings dang 'ding dang gding bya things/ /btags dang 'dogs dang gdags bya thogs/ /btab dang 'debs dang gdab bya thob/ /btul dang 'dul ba gdul bya thul/ /btegs dang 'degs byed gdegs bya thegs/ /bton dang 'don dang gdon bya thon/ /mnan dang gnon dang gnan bya non/ /bcom dang 'joms byed gzhom bya choms/ /bkas dang 'gas byed dgag bya khos/ /bshad zin 'chad byed bshad bya shod/ /bzhag dang 'jog byed gzhag bya zhogs/ /bcug dang 'jug byed gzhug bya chugs/ /btsug dang 'dzug byed gzugs bya tshugs/ /bzung dang 'dzin dang gzung bya zungs/ /bsad dang gsod dang gsad bya sod/ /bkang dang 'geng dang dgang bya khengs/ /bkag dang 'gog dang dgag bya khogs/ /bkram dang 'grem byed dgram bya khroms/ /bkrol dang 'grol byed 131

dgrol bya khrol/ / bkug dang 'gug byed dgug bya khug/ bgod dang 'god dang dgod bya khod/ /phul zin 'bul dang dbul bya phul/ /phab zin 'bebs dang dbab bya phob/ /phug zin 'bigs dang dbug bya phugs/ /phrogs zin 'phrog byed dbrog bya phrogs/ /phye zin 'byed byed dbye bya phye/ /brjod zin rjod byed brjod bya rjod/ /sbyangs dang sbyong dang sbyang bya sbyongs/ /spangs dang spong byed spang bya spongs/ /brlabs dang rlob byed brlab bya rlobs/ /bslang dang slong byed bslang bya slongs/ /bslab dang slob byed bslab bya slobs/ /brtags dang rtog byed brtag bya rtogs/ /brtsams dang rtsom byed brtsam bya rtsoms/ /brtsad zin tsong byed bcod bya rtsod/ /spyad zin spyod byed spyad bya spyod/ /bklags dang klog byed bklag bya klogs/ /bzlas dang zlo byed bzla bya zlos/ /bltas dang lta byed blta bya ltos / /bsregs dang sreg byed bsreg bya sregs/ /bsams dang sems byed bsam bya soms/ /zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu ste de rnams rim pa bzhin 'das pa dang da lta ba dang ma 'ong ba dang bskul tshig la 'jug pas so so'i yi ge ma nor ba gal che ste/ yi ge nor na don log pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i 'das pa dang ma 'ong ba gnyis bya ba'i las dang / da lta ba dang bskul tshig gnyis byed pa'i las su gtogs la/bdas gzhan gnyis su phye ba'i tshe byed pa po dang / byed pa dang / byed pa'i las rnams bdag dang / las dang bya ba dang bya ba'i las rnams ni gzhan gyi khongs su 'dus so/ /des na rjod byed kyi tshig rnam par dag pa zhig byung na/ brjod bya'i don ma nor ba zhig yong bas sgra shes na don la mi rmongs zhes pa'ang de la zer bas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung la legs par bslab par bya'o/ /smras pa / yi ge'i brda la brten nas ni/ /ma nor don rnams 'tshol dgos phyir/ /rnam dag brda sprod gzhung lugs la/ /mkhas par sbyangs pa shin tu gces/ /don ldan tshig ni gcig gis kyang / /rnam dpyod can la don mang ston/ /mkhas mang legs bshad kun 'dus kyang / /blo dman dag la phan pa dka'/ / de phyir nyung gsal lde mig ske'adi/ /gzhung brgya'i sgo phar cig car 'byed/ /gnad 'gag ma phigs dper brjod phreng / /mang yang mgo bo 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /tshul 'di gzur gnas gtsug rgyan du/ /132

zhabs zung pad+mo ngal gso ba/ /mkhyen dpyod spyan ras rab bkra ba'i/ /bshes gnyen gsung gis bskul ba'i tshe/ /gang de'i thugs bzhed bskang slad du/ /tshig nyung gnad don rab gsal ba'i/ /legs bshad nor gyi skyes bzang 'di/ /dbyangs can dga' blo bdag gis phul / /'dir 'bad legs byas ston zla yis/ /blo mun rgud pa kun sel te/ /rnam dpyod kun da'i skyed tshal tshogs/ /cir yang bzhad pa'i rgyur gyur cig/cesapa 'di yang u shi'i dgon pa'i khri zur gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mkhyen dpyod kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs pa'i bshes gnyen gang de'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar/ ngabyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su bod las sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ / oṃ swa sti/ tshul 'di khal kha jo nang pe so'i shog/dpyod ldan dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis/ /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ / ma/thun rkyen sbyar te par du legs par bsgrubs/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten brgyud de/ /dpal ldan bla mas rjes bzhin rjes bzung nas/ /smin grol lam bzang myur du mthar phyin shog/ / yi ge'i thob thang nyer mkho rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ra we/ rgyal kun yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /bdag snying pad+ma'i dbus bzhugs te/ /thogs med smra ba'i spobs pa stsol/ /dbyangs yig i u e yo bzhi/ /gas/la byed ka sogs sum cu yin/ /ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ /ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug bcu/ /da dang sa gnyis yang 'jug go/ ga da ba ma 'a sngon 'jug/ go ngo do no bo mo 'o/ /ro lo so rnams rdzogs tshig ste/ /slar sdud zla sdud ces kyang bya/ /rjes 'jug rang 'dra'i mtha' la sbyar/ /na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ /da drag thob tshe to zhes sbyar/ /su ru ra dang du tu na/ /la don rnam pa drug yin te/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa bzhi pa dang / /bdun pa de nyid dus la 'jug/ sa su ga ba da drag tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /'a dang mtha' rten med pa'i mthar/ /ru dang ra gnyis ci rigs sbyar/ /gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga po/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/ na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi/ /'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i/ /rkang pa skong tshe yi 'thob 133

bo/ /gi kyi sogs mthar sa sbyar tshe/ /rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i sgra'o/ /kyang yang 'ang gsum rgyan sdud de/ /ga da ba sa'i rjes su kyang / /da na ma 'a ra la yang mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang yang / /de te ste gsum lhag bcas te/ /da de na ra la sa te/ /ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang / /mtha' rten med mthar sa ste 'thob/ /gam dam dam nam bam mam 'am/ /ram lam sam rnams 'byed sdud sgra/ /rjes 'jug rang 'dra'i mtha' la sbyar/ /da drag can mthar tam sbyar ro/ /nas dang las gnyis 'byung khungs dang / /dgar dang sdud pa la yang 'jug/ kye dang kwa ye bod sgra ste/ /phal cher ming gi thog mar sbyor/ /ni sgra dgar dang brnan pa'o/ /gang su ci ji spyi sgra ste/ /dpe dang gzhan la ji sbyor zhing / /don la ci dang gang zag la/ /su 'thob gang ni kun la sbyar/ /pa dang can lda na bdag po'i sgra/ /ga da ba sa na ma pa/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' med ba/ /bdag po'i sgra la pa nyid do/ /ma mi min me da dgag par 'i sgra/ /ma mi gnyis ni thog ma dang / /min med gnyis po rjes la spya ra/ /tshig 'phrad cing la sogs pa ni/ /ga da ba dang da drag mthar/ /cing ces ce 'o ce na cig/ nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /rjes 'jug med pa'i ming mtha' ru/ /zhing zhes zhe 'o zhe na zhig/ sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs/ /shing shig she 'o she na 'thob/ /kha cig lhan cig thabs cig dang / /lan cig sogs kyi cig sgra de/ /ming gi cha shas yin pas na/ /tshig 'phrad grangs su ma nor gces/ /tshigs bcad rkang pa'i mtha' la shes sbyar na blo'i shes par 'khrul ba 'byung bas mi bya gsung / ni/ /nyis bshad nges par 'thob pa yin/ /ga mthar chig shad nga yi mthar/ /shad kyi gong du phye tsheg dgos/ /nga yig gi rkang pa shad dang mi 'dre ba'i ched yin/tshigs lhugs la ni rdzogs tshig mthar/ /nyis shad rnam grangs so so dang / /don tshan phal cher mtha' dang ni/ /bod pa'i skabs la'ang chig shad bya/ /sde tshan chen mo rdzogs pa dang / /le'u'i mtshams su bzhi shad 'thob/ /rkang pa skong dang mi skong las/ /'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg bar yang / /'thob tshul skabs dang sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar rjes 'jug dbang gis ni/ /rnam dbye tshig 'phrad mi 'dra ba'i/ /khyad par zhib tu shes par bya/ /tshig gi 'dab mas ma bsgribs pa'i/ /gnad bsdus 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /blo gsal don gnyer dga' ston du/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros spel/ /mgo lo/ /134

ci ༄7/ /rnam dbye brgyad dang bya byed las sogs kyi khyad par mdo tsam brjod pa dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab ni/ /gzhon nu mtshan dpe brgyan pa la/ /rgyal sras mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhes/ /snyan par grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rig gnas kun gyi phyi mo'i gzhung / /thon mi'i legs bshad sum rtags las/ /rnam dbye brgyad kyi khyad par sogs/ /dka' gnad mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /chos rnams kun gyi ming tsam zhig/ brjod si rnam dbye dang po yin/ /dper na bum pa zhes brjod tshe/ /bum pa'i ming tsam go ba bzhin/ /'di mthar 'o sogs sbyar ba na/ /dang po dang 'brel slar bsdu 'o/ /legs sbyar la ni ming gi mthar/ /rnam dbye dang po sbyar ba na/ /tshig tu grub pa yin mod kyang / /gangs can 'dir ni ming tsam las/ /logs su rnam dbye dang po med/ /des na khyad par shes pa gces/ /bya ba'i yul zhig gzhir bzung nas/ cader ni bya ba ci rigs par/ /dngos su byas par ston pa'i sgra/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba ste/ /dper na shar du 'gro ba dang / /bum par chu blug ces brjod na/ /bya gzhi shar dang bum pa ru/ /bya ba 'gro dang chu blug pa/ /go phyir de 'dra'i du sgra dang / /bum par zhes pa'i ra sgra gnyis/ /bya ba byas pa'i gzhi 'am las/ /gtso bor ston pa'i rnam dbye yin/ /byed pa po zhig nyer bzung nas/ /de yis bya ba byas pa ru/ /dngos sam shugs la ston kyang rung / /de ni gsum pa byed pa ste/ /dper na 'phags pa rab 'byor gyis/ /zab chos ston ces brjod pa'i tshe/ /byed pa po ni rab 'byor dang / /bya ba zab chos ston par go/ zab chos de yi bdag po ni/ /gang yin tshig 'dis mi shes phyir/ /bdag po mi ston byed po ston/ /rab 'byor bdag por ston na ni/ /gyi mthar sa yig mi 'thob la/ /de phyir sa yig sbyar ba 'di/ /gang gis byas pa'i byed pa po/ /ston phyir 135

byed pa'i rnam dbye nyid/ /dgos pa gang gi ched du ni/ /bya ba byas par go nus pa/ /rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched de/ /bya gzhi gang yin 'dis mi ston/ /dper na lha la mchod pa dang / /chos la 'bad ces brjod pa na/ /mchod pa phul dang 'bad pa de / /gang gi ched du byas pa yi/ /dgos pa bde blag go ba'i phyir/ /de 'dra'i la yig dgos ched do/ /'byung khungs gang las byung ba ni/ /tshegs med go ba'i nas las sgra/ /rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs te/ /dper na zhal nas legs bshad dang / /mtsho las nor bu zhes brjod tshe/ /dbyung bya legs bshad nor bu yi/ /'byung khungs zhal dang mtsho ru go/des na de 'dra'i nas las sgra/ /'byung khungs ston pa'i rnam dbye nyid/ /bram ze dag las rgyal po gtso/ /gcig nas brgya yi bar zhes sogs/ dgar dang sdud pa'i don la'ang 'jus/ khyad chos gang dag khyad gzhi ni/ / gang dang 'brel ba'am gang gi yin/ /go byed gi kyi gyi 'i rnam/sa/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba yin/ /dper na mig gi dbang po dang / / gos kyi kha dog gzhan gyi nor/ / rgyal po'i mdzod dang lha yi mig/ces pa khyad chos dbang po ni/ /khyad gzhi mig gi yin pa sogs/ /gang gi yin pa'i 'brel gzhi de/ /gtso bor ston la gang zhig gis/ /byas pa'i byed po ston pa min/ /brte na bya'i chos de rten pa'i gnas/ /gang du gnas dang yod pa sogs/ /gtso bor go ba'i sgra de ni/ /rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas te/ /dper na steng na nyi zla gnas/ /sa la mi yod la sogs bzhin/ /sgra 'dis brten bya nyi zla mi'i/ /rten gzhi steng dang sa yin par/ /gtso bor ston pa'i rnam dbye ste/ /bya ba byas pa'i don mi ston/ /gang ming brjod tshe kye sbyar ba/ / rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa ste/ /dper na kye lha zhes pal bzhin/ /phal cher thog mar kye sbyar yang / /bdag la srungs shig khyab 'jug kye/ /zhes sogs ming mthar sbyar ba'ang yod/ /de yang ming dang 'brel ba yi/ /kye ni 'bod pa'i rnam dbye yin/ /ming dang kye gnyis so so min/ /des ni rnam dbye brgyad rnams kyi/ /khyad par cung zad gsal bar byas/ /zhib tu gzhung las shes par bya/ /da ni rtags kyi 'jug pa yi/ /dka' gnas mdo tsam brjod pa la/ /pho ni 'das dang ga'an bsgrub phyir/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa'i don/ /bya byed las dang 136

bdag gzhan dus/ /dper brjod dang bcas gsal bar bya/ /gang zhig bya ba'i yul de la/ /'dir ni las zhes brjod pa yin/ /dper na gcad bya'i shing lta bu/ /gcad bya zhes pa las kyi sgra/ /las der 'jug pa bya ba ste/ /dper na sta res bsnun pa bzhin/ /gcad par bya dang bcad par byas/ /bya ba'i sgra ru shes par bya/ /shing mkhan byed pa po yin te/ /gcod pa po ni de yi sgra/ snun byed sta re byed pa ste/ /gcod byed byed pa'i sgra yin no/ /spyir na las kyi sgra de yi/ /'jug yul gsum du shes bya ste/ /gcad bya zhes pa las sgra dngos/ /gcod par byed sogs byed pa'i 'a/sa/ /gcad par bya dang bcad par byas/ /rim pa bzhin du bya ba'i las/ /ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa 'o/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su phye ba'i tshe/ /byed pa po dang byed pa dang / /byed pa'i las rnams bdag yin la/ /bya ba'i las dang las dngos la/ /dngos po gzhan du 'jog pa yin/ /chos gang grub zin 'grub gyur dang / /da lta grub bzhin pa rnams la/ /rim bzhin 'das dang ma 'ongs dang / /da lta ba ru bshad pa yin/ /byed las dngos ni da lta dang / /byed las su gtogs skul tshig ni/ /ma 'ongs pa yin bya las la/ /bya zhes sbyar ba ma 'ongs dang / /byas zhes sbyar na 'das pa yin/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su ma 'dus pa'ang / /skyes dang grub dang gab dang byang / / thung dang zhig sogs 'das pa dang / /skye dang 'grub dang 'gab dang 'byang / /'byung dang 'jig rnams ma 'ongs pa'o/ /de nas las dang byed pa dang / /bya las ma 'ongs pa dang 'das/ /skul tshig dang bcas rnam pa lnga'i/ /dper brjod rim bzhin shes par bya/ /bskyang bya skyong byed bskyang bar bya/ /bskyangs par byas dang skyongs shig dang / /bskyab bya skyob byed bskyab par bya/ /bskyabs par byas dang skyobs sheg dang / /brko bya rko byed brko bar bya/ /brkos par byas dang rkos shig dang / /bskon bya skon byed bskon par bya/ /bskond par byas dang skond cig dang / /'dir da drag dngos su sbyor ba ni gang la da drag 'thob mi 'thob kyi khyad par shes pa'i ched yin gyi/ skad gsar bcad la da drag dngos su sbyar dgos pa min no/ /bskur bya skur byed bskur bar bya/ /bskurd par byas dang skurd cig dang / /bskul bya skul byed bskul bar bya/ /bskuld par byas dang skuld cig dang / /137

mkhas bya mkhas byed mkhas par bya/ /mkhas par byas dang mkhas par gyis/ /dgag bya 'gog byed dgag par bya/ /bkag par byas dang khog cig dang / /dgug bya 'gug byed dgug par bya/ /bkug par byas dang khugs shig dang / /dgang bya 'geng byed dgang bar bya/ /bkang bar byas dang khong zhig dang / /bkad bya 'gas byed bkad par bya/ /bkas par byas dang khos shig dang / /dgod bya 'god byed dgod par bya/ /bkod par byas dang 'khod cig dang / /dgyes bya dgyes byed dgyes par bya/ /dgyes par byas dang dgyes shig dang / /bgyi bya bgyid byed bgyi bar bya/ /bgyis par byas dang gyis shig dang / /dgrol bya 'grol byed dgrol par bya/ /bkrol par byas dang khrold cig dang / /dgram bya 'grem byed dgram par bya/ /bkram par byas dang khroms shig dang / /brgal bya rgol byed brgal bar bya/ /brgald par byas dang rgold cig dang / /bsgom bya sgom byed bsgom par bya/ /bsgoms par byas dang sgoms shig dang / /bsgrag bya sgrog byed bsgrag par bya/ /bsgrags par byas dang sgrogs shig dang / /bsgyur bya sgyu ra byed bsgyur bar bya/ /bsgyurd par byas dang sgyurd cig dang / /bsgral bya sgrol byed bsgral bad bya/ /bsgreld par byas dang sgro lad cig dang / /brnga bya rnga byed brdza bar bya/ /brngas sgor byas dang rngos shig dang / /bsngo bya sngo byed bsngo bar bya/ /bsngos par byas dang sngos shig dang / /bcag bya 'chag byed bcag par bya/ /bcags par byas dang chogs shig dang / /gcad bya gcod byed gcad par bya/ /bcad par byas dang chod cig dang / /bcing bya 'ching byed bcing bar bya/ /bcings par byas dang chings shig dang / /bcol bya 'chol byed bcol bar bya/ /bcold par byas dang rka'achold cig dang / /mchod bya mchod byed mchod par bya/ /mchod par byas dang mchod cig dang / /mjal bya mjol byed mjal bar bya/ /mjald par byas dang mjold cig dang / /brjod bya rjod byed brjod par bya/ /brjod par byas dang rjod cig dang / /mnyan bya nyan byed mnyan par bya/ /mnyand par byas dang nyond cig dang / /bsnyeg bya snyig byed bsnyeg par bya/ /bsnyegs par byas dang snyogs shig dang / /btag bya 'thag byed btag par bya/ / btags par byas dang thogs shig dang / /138

gtang bya gtong byed gtang bar bya/ /btang bar byas dang thongs shig dang / /bstan bya ston byed bstan par bya/ /bstand par byas dang stond cig dang /gyu /brten bya rten byed brten par bya/ /brtend par byas dang rtend cig dang / /blta bya lta byed blta bar bya/ /bltas par byas dang ltos shig dang / /bstim bya stim byed bstim par bya/ /bstims par byas dang stims shig dang / /gdags bya 'dogs byed gdags par bya/ /btags par byas dang thogs shig dang / /gdab bya 'debs byed gdab par bya / /btab par byas dang thobs shig dang / /gdon bya 'don byed gdon par bya/ /bton par byas dang thond cig dang / /gdegs bya 'degs byed gdegs par bya/ /btegs par byas dang thegs shig dang / /bda' bya ded byed bda' bar bya/ /bdas par byas dang ded cig dang / /brda rnying des shig kyang rung / drang bya 'dren byed dang / /bsdeb bya sdeb byed bsdeb par bya/ /bsdebs par byas dang sdebs shig dang / /bsdu bya sdud byed bsdu bar bya/ /bsdus par byas dang sdus shig dang / /gnan bya gnon byed gnan par bya/ /mnan par byas dang nond cig dang / /bsnam bya sdom byed bsnam par bya/ /bsnams par byas dang snoms shig dang / /bsnub bya snub byed bsgrub par bya/ /bsgrubs par byas dang snubs shig dang / /spang bya spong byed spang bar bya/ / spangs par byas dang spongs shig dang / /dpyad bya dpyod byed dpyad par bya/ /dpyad par byas dang dpyod cig dang / /dbul bya 'bul byed dbul bar bya/ /phul bar byas dang phuld cig dang / /dbab bya 'bebs byed dbab par bya/ /phebs par byas dang phobs shig dang / /dbral bya 'bral byed dbral bar bya/ /phral bar byas dang phrold cig dang / /dbyi bya 'bri byed dbyi bar bya/ /bris par byas dang phris shig dang / /dbyung bya 'byin byed dbyung bar bya/ /phyung bar byas dang phyungs shig dang / /dbye bya 'byed byed dbye bar bya/ /phye bar byas dang bye zhig dang / /sbyang bya spyod byed sbyang bar bya/ /sbyangs par byas dang sbyongs shig dang / /myang bya myong byed myang 139

bar bya/ /myangs par byas dang myongs shig dang / /btsong bya 'tshong byed btsong bar bya/ /btsongs par byas dang tshongs shig dang / /btso bya 'tshod byed btso bar bya/ /btsos par byas dang tshos shig dang / /brtsam bya rtsom byed bcom par bya/ /brtsams par byas dang rtsoms shig dang / /bstsal bya stsol byed bstsal bar bya/ /bstsald par byas dang stsold cig dang / /brdzang bya rdzong byed brdzang bar bya/ /brdzangs par byas dang rdzongs shig dang / /gzhal bya 'jal byed gzhal bar bya/ /bcald par byas dang 'jold cig dang / /gzhug bya 'jug byed gzhug par bya/ /bcug par byas dang chugs shig dang / /gzhom bya 'joms byed gzhom par bya/ /bcom par byas dang choms shig dang / /gzung bya 'dzin byed gzung bar bya/ /bzung bar byas dang zungs shig dang / /gzug bya 'dzug byed gzug par bya/ /btsug par byas dang tshugs shig dang / /g.yab bya g.yob byed g.yab par bya/ /g.yabs par byas dang g.yobs shig dang / /bklag bya klog byed bklag par bya/ /bklags par byas dang klogs shig dang / /lho gas shig kyang rung / blang bya len byed blang bar bya/ /blangs par byas dang longs shig dang / /bzla bya zlo byed bzla bar bya/ /bzlas par byas dang zlos shig dang / /brlag bya rlog byed brlag/ par bya/ /brlags par byas dang rlogs shig dang / /brlab bya rlob byed brlab par bya/ /brlabs par byas dang rlobs shig dang / /bslang bya slong byed bslang bar bya/ /bslangs par byas dang slongs shig dang / /bslad bya slod byed bslad par bya/ /bslad par byas dang slod cig dang / /bslab bya slob byed bslab par bya/ /bslabs par byas dang slobs shig dang / / bshad bya 'chad byed bshad par bya/ /bshad par byas dang shod cig dang / /bsham bya gshom byed bsham par bya/ /bshams par byas dang shoms shig dang / /bsag bya gsog byed bsag par bya/ /bsags par byas dang gsogs shig dang / /gsad bya gsod byed gsad par bya/ /bsad par byas dang sod cig dang / /bsab bya gsob byed bsab par bya/ /bsabs par byas dang sob cig dang / /bsam bya sems byed bsam par bya/ /bsams par byas dang soms shig dang / /bsal bya sol byed bsal bar bya/ /bsald par byas dang sold cig 140

dang / /bsreg bya sreg byed bsreg par bya/ /bsregs par byas dang sregs shig dang / /bsrung bya srung byed bsrung bar bya/ /bsru ngas par byas dang srungs shig sogs/ /ma/tha' dag brjod kyis mi langs pas/ /rigs pas dpag ste shes par bya/ /des na bya byed la sogs pa'i/ /tshig grogs dngos su ma sbyar ba/ /bskyangs dang skyong dang bskyangs skyongs sogs/ /snga phyi'i tshig nus la brtags te/ /dper brjod 'di nas 'byung pa bzhin/ /don la sbyor tshul ma nor gces/ /ga nga ba ma na ra la'i/ /ma tha' rten can gyi bya ba'i las/ /ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa gnyis/ /yi ge 'dra bar 'byung ba na/ /bya las 'das par yang 'jug thob/ /ma 'ongs pa la yang 'jug spang / /da yang ga nga ba ma'i mthar/ /sa dang na ra la gsum rjes/ /yang 'jug da dang skul tshig la'ang / /phal cher yang 'jug sbyar ba yin/ /'on kyang yang 'jug da yig ni/ /don la 'thob pa gzhir byas kyang / /gsar bcad skad la dor ba yin/ /yig rkyang 'phul yig ldan pa la/ /mtha' rten 'a yig nges par dgos/ /dbyangs yig bzhi dang brtsegs pa dang / /ya dang ra yi 'dogs can la/ /mtha' rten 'a yig spang bar bya/ /zhar byung nyer mkho 'ga' zhig ni/ / nye ba bsnyen pa nyung ba bsnyungs/ /thim pa bstims pa thung ba bstungs/ /mthun pa bstun pa mthud pa bsdud/ /nag pa gnags pa nan pa brnan/ /nor ba dang ni bsnor ba sogs/ /snga ma don gyi khyad par dang / /phyi ma rnams ni khyad par der/ /byas pa'i ming du shes par gyis/ /mi dang mi bo mi'u dang / /nya dang nya bo nye 'u dang / /sha dang sha bo sha 'u dang / /rnga dang rnga bo rnge'u dang / /mda' dang mda' bo mde'u dang / /rdo dang rdo bo sde'u dang / /rdza dang rdza bo rdze'u sogs/ /dang po dngos po rang bab dang / /bar ba chen po'am mchog la 'jug/ tha ma chung ngu'am dman pa'i ming / /spra dang spre'u bya byi'u/ /sta re ste'u gri gri'u/ /mthe bo mthe 'u khri khri'u/ /khang pa khang bu sgo sge'u/ /mtsho dang mtsho'u la sogs pa/ /snga ma dngos po'i rang ming dang / /phyi ma de rnams chung ngu'i ming / /rnga mong rje'u rta rte'u/ /sha ba she'u ba be'u/ /ra ma re'u khyi khyi gu/ /lug dang lu gu la sogs pa/ /snga ma sems can rang ming dang / /phyi ma phru gu'i ming du grags/ /141

smras pa/ rnam dag brda sprod gzhung lugs la/ /ma sbyangs rmongs pa'i pho tshod kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khur 'khyer ba/ /gang de ngal bar ma gyur tam/ /sgra shes don la mi rmongs zhes/ /mkhas pa'i gtam du grags pas na/ /blo gsal don gnyer lda na pa rnams/ /rab gsal me long 'di zungs shig/ brda sprod gzhung don phra zhib rnams/ /tshur mthong skye bos dpag dka' bas/ /'dir ni 'khrul ba'i tshogs mchis na/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams la 'chags/ /'di ni 'jam dbyangs gong ma yi/ /rgyal khab chen por bgrod pa'i skabs/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ /mtsho bdun dgon pa g.yon du sbyar/ /dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /thos bsam gru rdzings la brten te/ /rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ /kun mkhyen gling du phyin gyur cig/ sarba maṅga lam̐/ / ci— 142

༄khya/ /dbyangs can sgra ṭīka las byung ba'i kuṣ+ṭhadra amadra kyi cho ga'i tshigs bcad kyi don rags rim bgrol ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ra we/ srid zhi'i mdzes sdug ma lus pa/ /byed pos gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin/ /rab mdzes yid 'ong lha mo la/ /gus pas 'dud do blo mchog stsol/ /de yang si sogs kyi rnam dbye nyer gcig po gang la 'jug pa'i yul ming le drug bshad zin nas/de rnams kyi zur bkol 'chad pa la/ lhuṣ+ṭhadra dang asmad kyi rtags 'di gnyis ni/yul pho mo ma ning gsum ga la 'jug rung zhing / gzugs dang cho ga sogs pho mo ma ning gi khyad par med pa zhig yin pas na brjod pa'i rtags zhes bya la/ ming le drug po der 'du mi rung ba min rngo da kyi cho ga dang rnam 'gyur sogs mi 'dra bas 'dir logs su bshad do/ /de yang yumidra asmad la rnam dbye sde tshan bdun sbyar te spyir btang gi cho gas bsgrubs zin pa de nyid tshigs bcad dang sdeb sbyor sogs kyi dgos pa'i dbang gis slar yang shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gzugs gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/lusadra dang asmad kyi go rims bzhin gcig tshig gi rnam 'gyur rnams/ te / me dang / gnyis tshig rnams/ bas / rna dang / mang tshig rnams/ bsra/ nasra dang / rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig gi nywa māṃ ni yang na tā mā zhes par bsgyur ba ste/bsgyur tshul brgyad po de spyir btang rnam dbye drug pa dang / bzhi pa dang / gnyis pa rnams la bsgyur bas na rtsa bas dngos su bstan la/ rnam dbye gzhan rnams la mi 'gyur bas dngos su ma bstan mod/ 'on kyang dgos pa yod na dang po'i traṃ dang a haṃ nas bdun pa'i yurmi su dang asmra su'i bar thams cad bsgyur rung ngo / /de las rtsa bas dngos su bstan pa rnams kyi dper brjod 'grel par tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas 'chad pa la gnyis/ bsgyur tshul dngos dang / de'i dmigs bsal lo/ /dang po la/ kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor sho lo ka phyed dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po rnam dbye drug pa dang 113

bzhi pa'i gcig tshig gi rnam 'gyur te me zhes par 'gyur pa'i dper brjod ni/ sā nī te sa sa mā yā taḥswā nī me ṭ+wāṃ pre haṃ ga taḥn ma ste bha ga bā: yo/ /de hi me mok+ṣa ma bya yaṃ/ /khyod kyi rje de legs par byon gyur tam/ /bdag gi rje bo yang ni da lta byon/ /bcom ldan khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi zad thar ba bdag la bstsal tu gsol/ /zhes pa ste/ swā sī ni rje bo/ te ni khyod kyi/ saḥni de/ 'di'i rnam bcad ni/ sa dang e ṣa las ha sa la 'os/ phyis pas rnam bcad med par dag go/ samā ni legs pa/ ā yā taḥston gyur tam/ ya la ring cha med na sdeb sbyor mi 'grig pas ring cha dgos so/ /yang swā nī ni rje bo/ me ni bdag gi/ sī pra haṃ da lta/ ga ta:byon pa dang gshegs pa sogs la 'jug tshigs rkang 'di gnyis kyi yi ge gsum pa te me zhes yod pa ni/ yumidra dang asmad la drug pa'i gcig tshig sbyar ba'i rnam 'gyur ta ba dang /ma ma gnyis slar yang te me ru 'gyur ba'i dper brjod do/ /na maḥ'adud pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ rnam bcad ni rnam par bcad bya'i sa 'os sra ru ba bsgyur ba'o/ /te ni khyed la/ bha ga bān ni bcom ldan/ 'dir bān zhes pa'i ring cha chad/ rtsa yo ni bhū yas te mang po dang / yang yang sogs las 'dir gus pa/ de hi ni stsol lam bstsal tu gsol/ me ni bdag la/ mok+ṣa la saṃ amra du bsgyur bas mok+ṣi ni thar pa/ a bya yaṃ mi zad pa'o/ /tshigs rkang phyi ma gnyis kyi yi ge gsum pa te me zhes yod pa ni bzhi pa'i gcig tshig gi tu r+ghaṃ dang / ma haṃ gnyis te dang me zhes par 'gyur ba'i dper brjod do/ /tshigs bcad gnyis pa drug pa dang bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig gi rnam 'gyur bas dang /rna zhes par 'gyur ba'i dper brjod ni/ swā ṭī baṃ sa dza hā so rtso26 rna dā na yā tsa nī/rā dzā baṃ dā su te dā rna dz+nyā rna rna ma rnyu sku de naḥgad rgyangs mtho de rje bo khyed dag gi/sbyin pa'i khrom 'khrugs 'chos pa bdag gis mthong / /rgyal pos khyed dag la ni sbyin pa byin/ /nged dag la yang ye shes sbrang rtsi dgras/ /zhes pa'o/ /swā nī rje bo/ baṃ ni drug pa'i gnyis tshig gi yu ba yoḥbasda du bsgyur ba ste khyed dag gi zhes pa dang / saḥni de ste rnam bcad phyis pa'o/ /dza hā sa bzhad gad dam gad rgyangs/ u tses dang / u tsus mtho ba/ de mtshams sbyar bas dza hā so stoḥn ro gcig lhag go/ rnam bcad nā 144

mi las dra 'os dra ru gyur/ dṛ ṣ+ṭa mthong ba dang lta ba sogs la 'jug/ rna ni drug pa'i mang tshig gi ā ba yoḥrna ru bsgyur ba ste/ nged dag gi zhes pa 'dir bdag gis zhes bsgyur yang byed tshig gi rnam dbye min no/ /dā na byin pa/ yā tsa ṭ+wāṃ khrom 'khrugs 'chos pa ste/ dā na yā tsa nī ni sbyin pa gtong ba'i tshe slong ba po rnams hab thob byed phyir khrom 'khrugs pa 'chos pa'i don no/ /rā dzā rgyal po/ bam̐ ni bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig gi yu bā bhan/ bas du bsgyur ba ste khyed dag la'am khyed dag gi ched du zhes pa dang / dā su te ni ḍū hā& sbyin pa'i byings la 'byung 'gyur 2sto'i āt+pa ni'i pa da'i dang po'i gcig tshig te dang / bar rkyen su ba sbyar ba ste sbyin par 'gyur ba'am byin pa/ dā dze+e sbyin pa/ dz+nyā rna ye shes/ no bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig gi ā bā r+ghaṃ ste nged dag la'am nged dag gi ched du/ ma dhu sbra nga rtsi dang / ci da naḥdagra'o/ /de yang sbrang rtsi'i dgra ni khyab 'jug gi ming ste/ des lha ma yin sbrang rtsi zhes bya ba bsad pas na sbrang rtsi'i dgra zhes grag chigs bcad gsum pa rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig dang drug pa'i mang tshig gi rnam 'gyur blde rna dang bsra nasra ru 'gyur ba'i dper brjod ni/ de bo ba ma ba dā dī ju rna ra hāto dza nā ja naḥswā nī bo ba la ṭ+wāṃ rā dzā sā nī no so dza nā dza naḥkhyab 'jug lha yi 'jug pas khyed dag la/ /skye 'gro'i mchong pas nged dag dmyal las sgrol/ /stobs ldan rgyal po khyed cag rnams kyi rje/ /'gro ba'i mchod de nged cag rnams kyi rje/ /zhes pa la/ de bo ni de baḥste lha/ bsda ni gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig gi yu bī ste khyed dag la/a pa ta 'jug pa/ de la ngasi atra du bsgyur ba'i a ba tāṭa ni 'jug ba las zhes thob kyang don 'jug pas zhes byed pa'o/ /bik+ṣuḥkhyab 'jug na ra ka la lnga pa'i ngasi sbyar ba'i na ra kātra ni dmyal ba las zhes pa ste/ sgrol zhes ba'i skad dod dngos su med do/ /rna ni gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig gi ā ṭ+wāṃ ste nged dag la/ dza na skye 'gro'am skye bo/arta naḥmachod pa'o/ /swā sī rje bo/ po ni bsra te drug pa'i mang tshig gi khuṣ+ṭha ki bsgyur ba khyed rnams kyi'am khyed cag rnams kyi zhes pa'o/ /de la bsra kyi sra rnam bcad dang /ha ba la'os rnam bcad u/ a u la o'os yor 'gyur ba'o/ /ba la bān ni stobs ldan te/ tshig mtha' dang dzha sa la yang na'i 'o sra na rjes su nga nor song ba'o/ /rā dza 1454

rgyal po/ swā mi gong dang 'dra/ no ni nasra te drug pa'i mang tshig gi asna kai bsgyur ba/nged rnams kyi'am nged cag rnams kyi/ nasra zhes pa'i sra rnam bcad dang / pha rol a sau dang / a las a la u'os mtshams sbyar bas/ no3mo zhes pa yin par sems/a sau ni 'di zhes pa ste/ a dasra la rnam dbye si byin pa'o/ /dza nād na gong ltar te/na yig gi ring cha chad pa'o/ /tshigs bcad bzhi pa rnam dbye bzhi pa dang gnyis pa'i ma nga tshig gi rnam 'gyur bas/ nasra ru 'gyur ba'i dper brjod kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor ni/ na mo bo brah+ma bisto bh+yo dz+nyā rna no dī ya rda dha 3 sā rna dā daḥpra pa byā maḥpa byā mo naḥsu duḥkhi na/ 'dud do rnam ma/khyen tshangs pa khyed rnams la/ /ye shes nor sbyin bdag cag rnams la stsol/ /dus kun dga' bar khyed rnams rab tu mthong / /bde dang sdug bsngal bdag cag rnams la mthong / /zhes pa'o/ /na mo ni na maḥste 'dud pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ bo ni ba'i pa'i mang tshig gi luṣ+ṭha haṃ bsra ru bsgyur ba ste/ khyed rnams kyi ched du'am khyed rnams la/ brah+ma tshangs pa/ bi rnye ni rab mkhyen nam rnam ma/khyen/ de la bzhi pa'i mang tshig bh+yas byin/ skyes pa'i rtags a thung mtha' ltar bsgrubs nas/ rnam bcad u sogs kyis bi rnye khyo ni rnam dbye thob ltar na rnam mkhyen rnams kyi ched du zhes ba'o/ /dz+nyā rna ye shes te si amu du song ba'o/ /no ni bzhi pa'i mang tshig gi asma r+ghaṃ nas ru bsgyur ba'i dpe ste/ nged rnams kyi ched du'am bdag cag rnams la zhes ched don gyi sgra'o/ /dī ya rda ni sbyin pa byin cig gam sbyin pa stsol cig ces pa ste/ de yang ḍū'inya sbyin pa la 'o'i byings la/ shis byed losto'i ad+ma ne pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig tī byin/ kun bshad kyi le'u gnyis pa'i skabs ltar las kyi don la yag rkyen sbyar/ dā sogs kyi yi'os/ dbyangs sngon ma i dang / ya la'os de ring por bsgyur ba yin pas/ dī ya rda gyi dī la ring cha med pa yi ge nor ba'o/ /dha rna na nor te/ de ltar na dī ya t+t+waṃ dha rna ni nor gyi sbyin pa stsol ces pa'i don no/ /sā rna dā ni sā nan+da ste dus kun dga' ba/ de yang sa dā ni rgyun du zhes pa'i dus la 'jug phyir sa ni 'dir dus dang / ā nan+da kun tu dga' ba yin pas/ des na mtshams sbyar bas sā nan+da zhes dgos pa la/ sā rna da zhes klad kor byas pa cung nor bar 146

sems/ de la lnga ba'i ngasi ata du song bas sā na t+natwa byung / baḥni gnyis pa'i mang tshig gi luṣ+ṭhan bsra ru song bas khyed rnams la zhes pa'o/ /pra ni rab dang / pa khyu maḥdang pa sh+ya mo ni mthong ba'am lta ba/ naḥni gnyis pa'i asman nas ru song ba ste/nged rnams la'am bdag cag rnam sa la'o/ / su ni rab dang bde sogs la 'jugaduḥkha sdug bsngal dang / duḥkhi na sdug bsngal ba zhes pa'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa bzhi po 'di te me sogs drug gi dper brjod yin no/ /de nas rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig gi rnam 'gyur traṃ māṃ gnyis dgos pa yod na tā dang mā ru 'gyur ba'i dper brjod ni/ pa byā mi tā ma dā lī snya/ pa byā mā ma da bhe da kai/ khyed la bltas na myos byed kun nas len/ /nged cag la ni myos byed 'jigs par mthong / /zhes pa tshigs rkang gnyis te/ pa byā mi ni bltas nas sam bltas na/ tā ni t+t+waṃ bsgyu ra pa'i dper brjod de khyod la/ ma da ni myos byed de chang / ā lī r+ghaṃ ni kun nas len pa/ pa byā mthong ba/mā ni paṃ ste bdag la'ang nged la/ ma da myos pa'am myos byed/ ste da kai 'jigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa de'i dmigs bsal la gsum/ tshigs rkang gi dang po la te me sogs su mi 'gyur ba/ bod tshig gi mjug thogs la mi 'gyur ba/ tsa sogs dang sbyor ba la mi 'gyur ba'o/ / dang po la kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad gnyis las/drug pa'i gcig tshig gi dper brjod ni/ ta ba ya sha tra bo rā dzad+ma ma ta pya ti sha tra baḥta ba mi tā ṇi yā ni snyarma ma rma tā ṇi tā n+ya pi/ /ji ltar rgyal po khyod kyi dgra bo rnams/ /de rnams bdag cag gi yang nges par dgra/ /nges par khyod kyi gnyen bshes gang yin pa/ /de rnams bdag cag gi 44 nga gnyen bshes so/ /zhes drug pa'i gcig tshig gi ta ba dang ma ma gnyis tshags rkang gi thog ma la te me ru mi 'gyur ba'i dper brjod de/ ta ba khyod kyi/ ye ni bud med dang ma ning gi rtags ltar na/ yadra la au sbyar/ ṭi a/ au yī dang / a i la e'os/ ye grub ste/ gang dag dang /gang dag la zhes par 'jug skyes pa'i rtags ltar na/ yadra la dzas byin/ dzas yī'os/ josra yī ru song bas ye zhes 'byung ste/ gang rnams zhes par 'jug mod/'grel ba 'dir ji ltar zhes pa las gzhan ma byung / sha tru dgra/ de la dzas byin/147

josra phyis/ e o dzasga la'os/ rtags mtha'i u o dang / o yab sogs kyis/sha tra baḥste dgra bo rnams zhes pa'o/ /rā dzan rgyal po/ ma ma bdag gi/ te ni bud med dang ma ning gi rtags ltar na/ tad la rnam dbye gnyis kyi gnyis tshig rma sbyar/au yī ru song ba sogs kyis/ te grub ste/ de dag dang / de dag la zhes par 'jugaskyes pa'i rtags ltar na/ dzam yī ru bsgyur bas te ste/ de rnams zhes par 'jug go/a pi ni kyang 'ang yang sogs dang / a ti shin tu phul byung sogs dang mtshams sbyar bas/ te bya ti zhes pa la/ te ci te zhes su dang te zhes 'greng bu nor bar sems/sha tra baḥgong dang 'dra'o/ /des na tshigs rkang gnyis pa ni/ de rnams bdag cag gi yang shin tu dgra zhes par 'gyur ro/ /yang ta ba khyod kyi/ mi tra bshes gnyen nam gnyen bshes la/ dzas byin/ dzapra sham dag gi shi'os/ sogs kyis mi tā ṇi ste gnyen bshes rnams zhes pa'o/ /yā ni zhes pa/ yadra la dzasga byin/ ma ming gi rtags ltar bsgrubs pas/ gang rnams te/ nges par gyi skad dod med/ sman ni/ yas yod pa la'o'i byings asga la/ chog 'byung ling gi yum byin/ nas smos kyi a'osra a phyis drangs yus kyis rnam bcad/ yiḥste gyur tam yin zhes pa la 'jug rnam bcad pha rol la ra ru bsgyu ra ba'o/ /'grel bar slad dang sur zhes pa yig nor du sems/ ma ma bdag gi/ mi tā ṇi gong ltar/ tā ni zhes pa ni/ tad la dzasga sbyar te/ ma ning gi rtags le ltar bsgrubs pa'i tā ni ste de rnams zhes pa'o/ /a pi dang mtshams sbyar ba'i tā mya bi ni skad dod ltar na de rnams kyang zhes par 'gyur ro/ /de nas drug pa'i mang tshig gi yurmi kai dang asmra gi gnyis thog ma na yod pa sasra nasra ru mi 'gyur pa'i dper brjod ni/ ru dro bi sha shwa ro de bo luṣ+ṭha gi ku la di pa tā/ sa a ba bha ga pā n+d+ra tho asmra kai bā pa nā sha naḥdrag po sna tshogs dbang phyug lha/ /khyed cag rnams kyi rigs kyi lha/ /de 'dir mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag rnams kyi sdig pa 'joms/ /zhes pa ste/ ru draḥni drag po/ bi shwa sna tshogs/ yī shwa raḥdabang phyugade baḥlha ste/ de rnams rim par mtshams sbyar bya'o/ /luṣ+ṭha gi ni drug pa'i mang tshig gi rnam 'gyur te khyed rnams kyi/ ku la rigs te ring cha med/ de ba tā lha nyid de/148

tā ni nyid ces pa'i kha skong gi tshig phrad do/ /yang na tā tshogs pa'i don la 'jug pas de ba tā lha tshogs zhes pa'o/ /saḥni de/ rnam bcad phyis pa'o/ /e ba 'di/ bha ga bān bcom ldan/ 'das zhes pa'i skad dod dngos su med/ nā thaḥmagon po/〉smra kai ni nged rnams kyi'am bdag cag rnams/ kyi/ pā pa sdig pa/ nā sha naḥ'ajoms pa zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshigs rkang gi dang po la te me sogs su mi 'gyur bar ma zad tshigs rkang gi dang po bod tshig yin na'ang de'i rjes thog la mi 'gyur te/ dper brjod ni/ de bā smra t+pā nyi dṛ ha re po ṇi3 smu na k+ṣa sarba dā/ /saṃ bho da na pa dā da gre na bha pa ti ba sā da yaḥtshig gi thog mar kun tu bod pa la/ /bsra la sogs par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ /kye lha mi yi seng ges bdag skyongs shig/ dus kun bdag rnams srungs shig khyab 'jug kye/ /zhes pa ste/ tshigs rkang dang po gnyis kyi thog ma la rim bzhin bod si byin pa'i de ba ngang / biṣ+ṭa zhes yod par rjes thos/sa su asmran yod kyang nasra zhes par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang 'di'i tshigs rkang dang po gnyis kyis dper brjod dang / phyi ma gnyis kyis don bstan no/ /de ba la bod pa'i d+dha phyis pa'i de ba ni kye lha/ asman ni nged rnam/sa la'am/ bdag rnams la ste/ /masmad la gnyis pa'i mang tshig sbyar ba'o/ /bā hi ni skyongs shig sa ni mi dang / ha ri ni 'phrog byed de seng ge'o/ /de la bod si byin pas ha re zhes pa'o/ /bisnu la bod si byin pas bikhyi ste kye khyab 'jug gam khyab 'jug kye/ a.ān gong mtshungs/ rak+ṣa ni srungs shig sarba dā ni thams cad du dang / sa dā rgyun du/ ni dā rtag par zhes pa ste/dus ston pa'i skabs de rnams don 'dra bas 'dir dus kun zhes bsgyur ro/ /etra otra dag las atra'o dang / dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor no sogs kyis mtshams sbyar ba'i bekho3r+sā nak+ṣa sarba dā zhes pa ste/ des na nag la trak+ṣa zhes 'byung ba yi ge nor ba'o/ /saṃ bho da na kun tu bod pa/ pa da tshig la ngasi byin/ pa datwa tshig las te 'dir tshig gi a gra rtse mo dang thog ma'am dang po/ de la bdun pa'i rnam dbye di byin/ mtshams sbyar/ pa dā dā gre ste tshig las thog ma'am tshig gi thog mar zhes pa'o/ /na dgag tshig par 'dir saṃ zhes pa yig lhag shor bar nges bha 149

ba ti/ 'gyur ba/ bas ni mang tshig 'gyur ba'o/ /ā di la sogs pa la dzas byin pas/ i thung ma/tha' ltar bsgrubs pa'i ā da yaḥbyung ba rnams mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /bsra la sogs pa zhes pa'i sogs sgras nas dang / te/ me/ bas rna rnams bsdus pa'o/ /tshigs bcad 'di'i dper brjod ni/ kha sgo'i nang tshan bcu gcig pa kha sgo bla bre'i sdeb sbyor yin/ tshigs rkang gi dang po bod tshig ma yin na de dang 'brel yang bsnga sogs su 'gyur te/ dper brjod kha sgo phan ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/ pā tai po na ra si dha su na kha lī ga la ko ṭa yaḥhi ra ṇa ka shi po rba k+ṣaḥk+ṣi dā mṛ k+ka rda mā ru ṇaḥskyongs shig khyed rnams mi yi seng ge yis/ /sen mo'i gshol gyi rtse mos 'drob skyong bu/ /gser can gyi ni lto ba'i ngos dral ba'i/ /khrag gi 'dam rdzob 'char ga'i dmar po 'dzin/ /zhes pa ste/pā haṃ ni skyongs shig po ni gnyis pa'i mang tshig gi luṣ+ṭhan bsra ru bsgyur ba ste khyed rnams 'a 'o/ /dṛ dang na ra ni mi dang / sidha seng ge ste/ mi'i seng ge ni khyab 'jug ge ming ngo / /dṛ sidha zhes 'byung yang sdeb sbyor mi 'grig pas skabs 'dir na ra sidha yin par sems/ de la drug pa'i ngas su ru bsgyur ba'o/ /na kha sen mo/ lī ga la gshol te thong gshol/ ko ṭi ni rtse mo sogs la 'jug la/ dzam byin pas ko ṭa yaḥsdeb sbyod gyi dbang gis dang po'i dzam byung yang don ni rtse mos zhes byed pa'o/ /nyi ra ṇa ni dbyig dang gser sogs dag ka shi pa 'od srung ste/ hi ra ṇa ka shi pa 'od srung gser can nam 'drob skyong bu gser can te lha ma yin gyi ming ngo / /urba k+ṣaḥni lto ba'i ngos dral ba/ k+ṣi tā 'char ba/ a sroku ni khrag garda ma ni 'jim pa dang 'dam rdzab sogs la 'jug karda ma la kurma zhes pa yi ge nor ba'o/ /a ru ṇa dmar po sogs la 'jug go/ de yang nyi ra ṇa ka shi pa ni skad dod ltar na 'od srung gser can zhes pa yin te/ drang srong 'od srung gi bu brgyud dang / lha ma yin 'drob skyong gser can sogs kyi bu brgyud yin pas na lha ma yin la de ltar btags pa'o/ /a sroku ni a d+dha sro dza ti zhes pa lhag par 'dor byed de khrag gi ming dang / a ru ṇa dmar po dang / skya rengs dang / 'od 'gro ste nyi ma'i ming la'ang 'jug par bshad do/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni legs bshad rin po che'i gter las/ gser can khrims 150

la 'das pa yis/ /sa kun thob kyang seng ges bsad/ /ces pa'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar ba ste/ dpe 'ga' zhig tu/ chu skyar zhes 'byung yang / lha min chu skyar dang /gser can gnyis ming gi rnam grangs so/ /de yang sngon lha ma yin gyi dbang po 'drob skyong bu gser can zhes bya ba/ lha dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs te/ khang pa'i nang du mi gsod/ phyi ru mi gsod/ de bzhin du sa dang / nam mkha' dang / nyin mo dang / mtshan mo dang / mi dang / mi ma yin dang / mtshon dang / mtshon ma yin pas mi gsod pa'i dngos grub thob ste/ re shig 'jig rten na stobs che zhing thams cad las rgyal te gnas pa na/ khang pa'i nang du mi gsod pa sogs kyi gnyen por lha khyab 'jug gis/ mi'i gzugs la seng ge'i mgo dang / sder mo sogs yod pa mi'i seng ge zhes bya ba gcig tu sprul te/ nyin mo'i thun mtshams la bab pa na sgo'i them pa'i khar khri bshaca sa te lha min gser can bzhag nas/ bus bstod pa byas pa na/sgo'i ya them gye ser kha nas khyab 'jug mi'i seng ge byung nas/ sen mos lha min gser can gyi lto ba dral nas bsad do/ /zhes grag pa'i gtam rgyud de dang sbyar ba'o/ /gsum pa ni mi zad pa'i nang tshan/ tsa/ bā/ a ha/ e ba/ e bam̐ lnga ci rigs dang sbyor ba la'ang te me sogs su mi 'gyur te/ dper brjod ni/ ta ba tsa ma ma tsa mi ṭī tsan+d+ra le khe ba brta te/ khyod dang bdag gi byams 'dris ni/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar 'phel/ /zhes pa'o/ /ta ba tsa khyod kyi dang / ma ma tsa bdag gi dang ngam yang zhes pa dang / mi tī byams 'dris/ tsan+d+ra le kha zla ba'i yar ngo / i ba bzhin dang ltar sogs dang / brta te ni 'phel ba zhes pa'i don no/ /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs su/ /tshangs spyod rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /rnam dag brda sprod gzhung don la/ /blo gros thogs pa med gyur cig/ ces pa'ang sgra gsar slob kyi bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos bzhin dbyangs can dga' blos bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /mi zad pa dang bud med kyi rkyen gyi brjed byang bzhugs so/ /'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas mi zad pa'i sde ni/ gong du rtags la drug dang / yu smad asnadra du rnam dbye 'jug tshul dang de dag gi rnam 151

'gyur ji ltar 'byung ba rgyas par bshad nas/ de rnams kyi dmigs bsal du rnam dbye rnams 'jug kyang rnam 'gyur med pa 'chad pa'i phyir mi zad pa'i le'u bstan pa yin no/ /de la ni pā taḥzhes pa tshig phrad du bsgyur ba yod mod/ sgra thad bsgyur byas na/ ni nges pa dang / pā taḥtshig yin pas nges tshig ces bya la/ de'i don yang ni pā taḥrnams la pho mo ma ning gi rtags kyi dbye ba med cing / si sogs kyi rnam dbye gang sbyar yang de'i rkyen gyis sgra'i gzugs phal cher mi 'gyur bar nges pas na nges tshig ces bya zhing / tshig gcig la'ang skabs thob kyi don sna tshogs 'byung bas don med pa med pa'i phyir mi zad pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /bod kyi tshig phrad dang ming don mi mtshungs te/bod kyi tshig phrad ni/ tshig gi bar bar du mtshams sbyor ba'i ‘ raphrad du 'byung ba shas che bas na tshig phrad ces btags pa'o/ /mi zad pa'i rtags la dbye na gsum yod de/ngo bo nyid kyi mi zad pa dang / bsgyur ba'i mi zad pa dang / rkyen gyi mtha'i mi zad pa'o/ /dang po la nyer bsgyur yin min gnyis las/ nyer bsgyur ni/ bra la sogs pa nyi shu'am ā be bgrangs pas nyer gcig dang / nyer bsgyur ma yin pa'i mi zad pa la lnga yod de/ ming rkyang pa a i u la sogs dbyangs kho na ming du bzhag pa dang / a mā no nā ste dgag tshig kyang pa rnams dang / tsa la sogs pa mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig dang / mū rna la sogs pa rang rkang can gyi tshig dang / sa bya la sogs pa dus kyi don can gyi mi zad pa ste rigs lnga yod do/ /gnyis pa bsgyur ba'i mi zad pa ni/ tosmin zhes pa ta tra dang / yasmin ya tra dang / gasmin ku tra dang / purba smin zhes pa pu ra statra du bsgyur ba la sogs pa ste/ de dag ni rtags rnam dbye dang bcas pa gzugs bsgyur ba'o/ / gsum pa rkyen gyi mtha'i mi zad pa ni/ tam dang / a hi dang /citra dang / tsan dang / sngaṭa dang / k+ta dang / tu mun gyi mtha' can la sogs pa rnams yin no/ /de yang tsa la sogs pa ni/ tsa bā a ha e ba dang / /e baṃ nu rna bṛ bkra dang / /bi nā nā nā su snyi dang / /aste do ṣā nasnyi dang / /mṛ ṣ+ṭha mi bya mi thas dang / /a tha a tho byas dang shasnyi/ /usra nī tsi4sra sun an+tarā/ /phra ta ra dang bu nadra dang / /tū yas a ho srita an+t+ra dang / /sa ha de bzhin ṛ te dang / /an+ta re ṇa an+ta ra/ /na mas a /sdug/treshārti mchog skuringami tsho ri

yaṃ kṛ rta dang / /a mā no nā dgag tshig bzhi/ /i ṣa twa ki la kha lu be+e/ /hi dang ā rātra ṣ+ṭṛ shaṃ dang / /ṛ rta hā kai sidha dang / /yadra dang tedra bcas da gsum mo/byu /ta tra ya tra ku tra dang / /ku ha ka dang ta dā dang / /ya dā dang ni e ka dā/ /a n+ya dā dang ka dā dang / /ta thā ya thā ka khri dang / /in+d+ra twa taḥya taḥdang / /ku taḥ.a taḥ.i taḥste/ /bcu dgu rnam dbye'i don can yin/ /dus kyi don can bco brgyad de/ /sabya dang ni sa pa ti/ /ā r+ya de bzhin a blu nā/ /i dha nā dang saṃ pra ti/ / sī pra tai dang pu rbe byuḥ/ /pa re byuḥdang a nu byuḥ/ /ya di yarti ta di dang / /ta rti ā shu shī r+ghaṃ dang / /dzha ṭi ti dang tū sh+lau 'o/ /nyer bsgyur nyi shu 'di lta ste/ /pra dang ba rā a pa samā/ /a nu a ba ni dra dudra bi/ /āng ni a d+dha a pi dang / /a ti su utra a bhi dang / / pra ti ba ri u pa ste/ /phyogs mtshungs ā bi dang bcas so/ /mi med pa de dag blo la byang bar byas pa gal che'o/ /mi zad pa'i 'ogs de rnams la rig byed dang tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa 'ga' tsam ma gtogs pa/zhan rnam dbye bdun gsum nyer gcig po thams cad 'jig nas rnam 'gyur mi 'byung zhing / pho mo ma ning gi rtags kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba cung zad kyang med do/ /mjug gi tshigs bcad ni/ sa dṛ shaṃ tri 6 liṅgā 6/ sarba su tsa bi bha k+ṇi ṣ+ṭha/ ba tsa ni khu tsa sarba khu/ yan+da byi ti ta da bya /sri/ kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor yin la/ tshigs rkang bzhi pa'i mthar bye zhes pa'i klad kor yig nor ro/ /sa dṛ sha mnyam pa dang 'dra mtshungs sogs la 'jug de la gnyis pa'i gcig tshig amu byin pas/ sa dṛ shaṃ mnyam par zhes pa la 'dir mnyam par mtshungs zhes mnyam mtshungs gnyis kur bsgyur/tri gsum dang / liṅgā rtags te/ gnyis kur bdun pa'i mang tshig supu sbyar bas/tri ṣ+ṭha liṅge 6 ni rtags gsum la zhes pa'o/ /sarba la supu byin pa'i sarba su thams cad la/tsa yang don/ bi bsti rnam dbye zhes pa'i la'ang supu sbyar/ ba tsa na tshig de la sus sbyar ba ba tsa ne ṣā tshig rnams la/ tsa yang don/ sarba la supu byin pa'i sarbe bhu/thams cad la/ ya twa gang / na med ces pa'i dgag tshig nya ma la nya ma yang na 'os mtshams sbyar bas/ yan+da byung / bya ti dbye ba'am tha dad de/ na pye ti dbyer med/ ta dra ni de/ a bya ya mi zad pa/ si am du bsgyur bas klad kor byung 153

ba'o/ /bod 'gyur/ rtags gsum la ni mnyam par mtshungs/ /rnam dbye thams cad la yang ngo / /tshig rnams thams cad la yang ste/ /dbyer med gang de mi zad pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum ga la mnyam mtshungs su 'jug pa dang /rnam dbye thams cad kyi 'jug yul la yang 'gro ba dang / ming tshig thams cad la yang sbyar ba na skabs thob kyis don sna tshogs ston pa la khyad par ram dbyer med gang yin pa de dag la mi zad pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de nas mo rkyen gyi le'u ni/ le'u snga ma rnams su rtags so so dang rtags kyi dbye ba med pa rnams la rnam dbye ji ltar 'jug tshul rgyas par bshad zin nas/ da ni rtags gsum gyi khyad par ma nor bar ngos bzung ba'i ched du mo rkyen gyi 'jug tshul 'chad pa yin te/ de la pho dang ma ning gi rtags gnyis phal cher ming du bsgrubs tsam nas rang chas su grub pa yin la/ mo rtags ni gsar du sgrub tshul rgyas par yod pas legs su bshad do/ /mo togs la dbye na/ byings las ming du bsgrubs pa tsam gyi gdod ma nas mo rtags su grub pa dang / sngar ming du bsgrubs zin pa cig slar mo rtags su bsgyur ba gnyis yod do/ /dang po ni/ skṛ dang / mā tre dang / su saṃ la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la blos bsgyu ra ba tsam dang / mo rtags su sgrub byed kyi rkyen byin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tri dang / tsa turā gyi sgra dag bud med du brjod pa la rim bzhin ti sro dang / tsa ta mṛ zhes par bsgyur ba lta bu'o/ /'di ni gzugs bsgyur ba tsam yin gyi/ mo rkyen byin pa min no/ /gnyis pa mo rtags su sgrub byed kyi rkyen la gzhung 'dir lnga gsungs te/ āX dang / r+sāpu dang / ā dīpra dang /upra dang / ti zhes pa ste lnga'o/ /sgra gzhung gzhan du/ dīpra dang skyusdi dang dī'i dang /ud dang 〈pu dang ti dang 6dra / zhes rkyen bdun bshad do/ / don bud med la 'jug pa la mo rtags yin mi dgos te/ dā ra zhes pa'i sgra ni don bud med la 'jug kyang rtags ni pho rtags kho na yin pas mo rkyen mi 'jug go/ de yang a thung mtha' dang / ha sa'i mtha' la mo rkyen āX 'jug cing / dgos pa ni/ mo rkyen 'jug yul gyi rtags de rnams pho dang ma ning gi dngos po la 'gro ba'ang yod pas āX byin pa 154

ni rtag tu mo rtags kho nar go ba'i ched do/ /na yig dang / ṛ yig dang / rkyen aṇa gyi mtha' can dang / ṣ+ṭha yig dang / ṭā yig dang u yig dang / 2ta rjes 'brel can rnams dang / na da la sogs pa la mo rkyen khrid 'jug la/ in+d+ra sogs la ā nīs 'jug go/ u thung mtha' can ni sor gnas sam yang na mo rkyen uX 'jug cing /yu ban gyi sgra la mo rkyen ti 'jug pa yin no/ /mo rkyen de dag byin nas mo rtags su grub pa rnams tshig tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ si sogs kyi rnam dbye ster dgos la cho ga'i sgrub tshul rnams ni gong du bud med kyi rtags le'i skabs su bshad pa ltar yin te/ de la āX kyi mtha' thams cad gaṅgā dang 'dra la/ 〉pu mtha' dang / /l+la ṇipu kyang r+sāpu tu gtogs pas de gnyis kyi mtha' ni na dī dang 'dra'o/ /upra mtha' kun pa dhū dang 'dra/u mtha' ni dhe nu dang / ti'i mtha' ni burnyi'i sgra dang sgrub tshul 'dra ba yin no/ /de yang ma ya/ me dha sogs a thung mtha' can la/ bud med la a la eX'os/āX rkyen byin/ bla rjes 'brel phyis/ 'dra ba ring po/ si/ āX las sos/phyis pas/ ma yā/ me ṅgā sogs so/ /kālda ces pa ni/ pi/ la mo rkyen āX byi ra ba'i ming ngo / /pa rā gī sogs ni/ pa ra 'a / ṣā ka u u kuṇa 'os/ ṣā ga'i rkyen byin/ ṣā mo rkyen r+sāpu kyi don phyis/ srog gi ā bzhag/ drangs pas pa rā ku ṣa ṭā u rin las so sa/ 9pu byin/ i a dag gi dbyi 'os/ rkyen mtha'i a phyis nas drangs/pa rā ki si has yis la si dbyi'os/ si phyis pa'o/ / tsa dra la/ a ṭa dag gos ṭa rkyen byin/ sto 'ipu kyi don phyis/ a lus/ ku ru gong du bzhag drangs/ ku ru tsa ra/ khris byin/ si 'jig ku ru tsa rī/go ma tu la/ 9pu byin/ u phyis drangs/ go ma tī si phyis pa'o/ /bha ba tro/ ṛ nus gyi don phyis/ u ritwa dag las nalnga'os/ nus byin pas bha ba tre+e tra āX drangs/ bha bci si phyis/de bzhin du/ ba tsa zhu dang / ba ṭha zhu la'ang gong ltar bsgrubs pas/ pa tsartsi/ pa ṭha ṣ+ṭha/ zhes so/ / 155

na da/ nas sharba ra'i bar yang a thung mtha' ste/ r+sāpu byin/ i a dag gi dbyi'os/ rtags mtha' phyis nas drangs/ na dī/ gau rī sogs so/ /in+d+ra bha ba ru dra la ā rīpu byin/ 'dra 'dus ring por 'gyur te/ in+d+ra ṇi sogs si 'jig go/be da/ āmā/ tri/ yas la/ nasto byin/ tri'i yi a yadra du 'gyur ba gong ltar te/ pe dā ṭ+wāṃ twa yā ṭ+wāṃ/ zhes pa la/ bsdu ba dang rkyen dag la 'os/ don gsal byed rnam dbye bcas phyis/ tri lus par/ srisdi byin/ rtags mtha' yon tan e/ e ayu drangs/ tra yī si phyis/shu dra/ ka ṇa ka la srid byin pas/ tso dz+rī ka ṇa gī/ go pā la ka la āX sbya ra/ u pa jo'i a i/ 'dra 'dus/ go pā li kā'o/ /me ṣa nas/ dra h+ma na'i bar a thung mthar hrīsdi byin pas/ me jo/ ma hi ṣ+pe sogs so/ /ku mā ra/ ke sho ra/ ka la bha la khris dang / zhusnyi dang / sgyu bi ra la āX sbyar no/ /i dang u mtha' can la yis mi 'thob ste/ shi shuḥlta bu'o/ /su mu kha/ mṛ gak+ṣa/ ta nadra la srisdi sbyar te/ su mu khri sogs so/ /pad+ma ba da ni/ nas/ su ha sta'i bar a thung mthar/ āX byin/ 'dra 'dus byas/ pad+ma ba da nā sogs so/ /i yig ma/tha' can/ at+pa li/ blu li/ a dzi rnams la khris byin na/ rtags mtha' phyis nas drangs/ aṅga lī sogs te/ si phyis/ zhis ma byin na/ argya liḥsor gnas te/ si rnam bcad do/ /kṛ tiḥbhu tiḥm taḥsogs ni/ kṛta rkyen k+ṇi byin/ kra yon tan 'gog pa'i don phyis pas rang bzhin gyi mo rtags te/ si rnam bcad do/ /pasni/ an+ta bsna/ sa khi/ a sa khe/ arna dza ra ti/ yu ba ti/ a shi shi rnam sa la r+sāpu sbyar/ i a dag gi dbyi'os/ rtags mtha'i i phyis/ drangs/pani sogs su 'gyur/ si phyis pa'o/ /rtsa 'grel gnyis gar/ pat+na zhes ya btags 156

'byung yang / pasna zhes i thung mtha' can yin par sems/pra tī tsa/ a dī tsa/ pa tsa/ a ba tsa rnams la khripa sbyar/ i a dag gi sa shāmi la snye 'a ga —6dbyi'os/ rtags mtha' phyis/ drangs pas/ pra tī rtswa sogs so/ /pargya 'a mo rkyen uX ma sbyar na/ pargyaḥ.āX sbyar na/ 'dra 'dus ring por 'gyur te/ paṅgāḥsi rnam bcad do/ /yu ban la/ mo rkyen ti byin/ na dbyi'os/ na phyis// si rnam/ bcad/ yu ba tiḥzhes pa'o/ /āro upā ā nī pra srid ti lnga/ /dang po gsum la 'dra 'dus ring / /srid la phal cher rtags mtha' dbyi/ /ti la rtags mtha' 'gyur ba med/ /rnam dbye āX mtha' gaṅgā 'dra/ /r+sāpu dang ā ༷sdi na dī dang / /upra mtha' rnams ni ba dhū dang / /ti ni burnyi'i sgra dang 'dra'o/ / rte157

༄tsho/ /mtshams sbyor lnga ba'i tshigs bcad kyi skad dod so sor bkral ba blo gsar 'jug jogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /phul byung thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis/ /gdul bya'i blo mun sel mdzad cing / /rnam dpyod kun da 'bum bzhad pa'i/ / tshangs pa'i sras mos bdag skyongs shig/'dir 'dar 'gyur dbyangs can sgra ṭīka las mtshams sbyor lnga pa'i dbu zhabs kyi tshigs bcad rnams go bde bar skad dod so sor 'phral te bsgyur ba ni/ thog mar shis pa brjod pa/ oṃ swa sti pra dza bh+yaḥzhes pa'i susti'i su ni/ bzang / bde/rab/ legs sogs dang / a nyi yod pa/ ldan pa sogs kyi don la 'jug pas/de gnyis mtshams sbyar ba'i swasti bde ldan nam/ bde legs/ pra dza skye dgu/ de la rnam dbye bzhi pa'i mang tshig bh+yas byin/ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad do/ /zhes pas sra rnam bcad du bsgyur bas/ skye dgu rnams la bde legs zhes pa las mi 'byung yang yo dang 'brel bas na/ skye dgu rnams la bde legs stsol zhes pa'am/ yang na pra rab/dzan skye dgu ste/ bh+yas sbyar/ dhe rma yin pa la ming gi na dbyi'os / na phyis pas/skye dgu rnams la rab tu bde legs stsol/ ces shis pa brjod pa'o/ /de nas/ bla ma dang ngag gi dbang phyug 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ rang gi bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha 'jam dpal yab yum dbyer med par mchod par brjod pa'o/ /zab yangs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal dbang lnga pa chen por cha shas gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi sgo nas shis pa brjod pa dang / mtha' yas zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la rgyan gong mtshungs kyis bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i blo stsol bar bskul ba'i shes brjod mdzad/ tshul 'di rtogs na zhes sogs kyis sgra'i che ba dang don gnyer can la 158

thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'jug dgos par bskul ba gnyis 'thus mdzad/ de yang 'dir/ nas/ 'jug par bya ste/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan ribacos 'di nyid bsgyur bar dam bca' ba ste/ de rnams lo tsā pas bkod pa'o/ /de nas bstan bcos dngos kyi thog mar/ mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ pra 9mya pa ra māt+pa rna bā la dhī krarnyi sirnya ye/ /sā re swasti mṛ rdzu kuza pra kṛ yaṃ nā ti baṃ sta raṃ/ /ma/chog gi bdag nyid la ni rab btung de/ /byis pa'i blo gros 'phel bar bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mtsho ldan mas mdzad rab tu bya ba rnams/ /shin tu rgyas min go bder brtsam par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ mchog gi bdag nyid ni nang pa ltar na sangs rgyas dang / phyi rol pa ltar na dbang phyug sogs la byed do/ /de yang / pra ṇa mya ni rab btud de/ pa raṃ rnga/chog gi/āt+pa rna bdag nyid la/ bā la byis pa/ dhī blo gros/ bṛd+dhi 'phel ba/ sisnyi ye bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sā ra r+sā ste mtsho ldan ma/ mṛ rdzu go bder/ kurbi bcoms pa'am byas pa/ pra kṛ yaṃ rab tu bya ba/ na ni min zhes pa'i dgag tshig a ti shin tu/bista raṃ rgyas par zhes pa'o/ /rnam dbye rnams dang mtshams sbyor tshul cung zad phye ste bshad na/ nyer bsgyur pra ni rab/ namā rab tu 'dud pa dang sgra la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la/ capu sha ka las so/ /zhes pas ya rkyen byin drangs pas 9mya ste 'dud do/ /pa ra mchog de la rnam dbye drug pa'i ngasra byin/ a twa las ātwa ma yin pa'i a mā'o/ /zhes pas ngasra amra du bsgyur/ yamā shas dag gi a'o/ /zhes pas a phyis/ mā ni rjes su nga ro'o/ /zhes pas mra sro ga med rjes su nga ro byas pas pa raṃ mchag gi/ āt+pan bdag nyid/ de la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig amra byin/ na'i u pa dha'i 'o/ /zhes pas na'i u pa dhā ring po dang / na srog med ya la drangs/ mā nga nor btang bas/ āt+pa rna bdag nyid la zhes pa'o/ /bā la byis pa/ dhī blo gros/ krurnyi 'phel ba/sirnyi grub pa'am bsgrub pa 'a/ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i nge byin/ 'og tu ming le'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bsgrubs pas sirnya ye bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sā ra mtsho/ swasti ldan pa'i don la mo rkyen slopu sbyar bas sā ra swasti mcho ldan ma/ mṛ dzu gtsang ba dang rgyan dag la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la/ ṣ+ṭha ka u u kuṇa 'os/ u byin/ byings mtha' phyis twa/159

drangs/ gnyis pa'i amu byin pas mṛ rdzu go gler ram go bder/ kube mdzad pa'am bcom pa dang byas pa/ pra rab/ kṛ yaṃ byed pa'am bya ba/ na dgag tshig ati shin tu/ bista ra rgyas pa la amu byin pas bista raṃ zhes pa'o/ /skad dod thad 'gyur byas na/ rab tu 'dud do mchog gi bdag nyid la/ /byis pa'i blo gros 'phel par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mtsho ldan ma yis go bder byas pa yi/ /rab tu bya kha shin tu rgyas min par/ /zhes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa khengs skyung ba ni/ in+d+ra da yo3 pi yas rnye na ya yuḥshasnya bā ra d+dhaḥ/ /pra kro yi te su kṛtā su k+ṣa mo bārnya na raḥka baṃ/ /gang zhig sgra yi chu gter dag gi mtha'/ /dbang po la sogs kyis kyang ma spobs pa'i/ /de yi rab tu bya ba rdzogs par ni/ /mi yis brjod par bya ba ji ltar bzod/ /ces pa ste/ in+d+ra ni dbang po/ ā ti la sogs/ de la rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzasba byin/ i thung mtha' ltar bsgrubs pas ā da yaḥ.a pi kyang ngam yang / de rnams mtshams sbyar ba'i in+d+ra da yo3 pi zhes pa ste/ in+d+ra do3pe ni yi ge nor ba'o/ /yasu gang gi'am gang zhig ste/ yadra la drug pa'i ngasra byin pa'o/ /an+ta mtha' la si amu du bsgyur bas arnya/ na dgag tshig ya yuḥthob pa la 'jug kyang don 'gyur dpog pa'am/ spobs pa/ shap+ta sgra / bā ra chu/ dhi 'dzin pa ste don 'gyur gter/ si rnam bcad/ pra kro yaṃ rab tu bya ba/ tad la bsra byin pas tasu de yi/ kṛtā gtsang byed la 'jug kyang 'dir rdzogs pa la ngasra su/ k+ṣa ma bzod pa/ si rnam bcad/ ny-i ba la'os/ rnam bcad u dang / u la o 'os yor bsgyur k+ṣa mo/ bsti brjod pa/ na ra mi/ si rnam bcad/ ka baṃ ji ltar dang / ga la zhes pa sogs la 'jug go/ skad dod thad 'gyur byas na/ dbang ngo/ sogs kyang gang gi mtha'/ /ma spobs sgra yi chu gter gyi/ /rab byed de yi rdzogs par ni/ /bzod cing brjod pa mi ji ltar/ /zhes pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /bshad ma thag pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis kyi skad dod kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor yin te/ rin chen 'byung gnas las/ rkang pa yig brgyad dang po las/ /sa na min mtsho las ya kha sgo/ /rkang pa zung dag dza yig gis ni/ /kha sgo phan pa zhes par grags so/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshigs rkang re la yi ge brgyad brgyad yod pa la/ yi ge thog mtha' 160

gnyis bor ba'i bar gyi yi ge drug sum tshan gnyis gnyis byas pa'i sum bsgrigs dang po rnams mtha' lci ba dang / na kun yang ba gang rung ma yin zhing / sum bsgri gas phyi ma rnams ya thos yang ba yin na kha sgo spyi dang / rkang pa dang po dang gsem kha sgo spyi ltar la/rkang pa zung ste gnyis pa dang bzhi ba'i sum bsgrigs phyi ma dza dbus lci ba yin na/ kha sgo'i bye brag kha sgo phan pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas 'grel pa'i 'phros don mjug gi tshigs bcad rnams ni/ spyir btang la rnam/ bcad phyis pa'i rjes su slar mtshams mi sbyor yang / sdeb sbyor dang tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa'i yi ge ma 'grig pa sogs 'byung tshe rnam bcad sogs phyis nas slar mtshams sbyor byed pa'i dper brjod kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor tshigs bcad gnyis te/ si ṣa dā sha ra bī rā maḥsi ṣa rā dza yu snyi ṣi raḥsi ṣa kur+ṇa mahā t+yā gī si ṣa dhī mo mahā ba laḥde 'di shing rta bcu pa'i bu dga' byed/ /de 'di rgyal po g.yul ngor brtan pa 'o/ /de 'di gtong ba chen po rna ba can/ /de 'di 'jigs pa stobs ni chen po'o/ /zhes pa ste/saḥde/ e ṣa 'di zhes pa yin pas tshigs bcad 'di lta bu la/ saḥ.e ṣa'i rnam bcad phyis rjes mtsham sa sbyar mi byed na yi ge lhag pa'i skyon 'byung phyir/ tad la si byin/ tad sogs kyi si sogs la ṭi a'os/ ṭi a/ ta'i sa'os/ ta sra ru bsgyur/ sra rnam bcad byas/ saḥ.e ṣa zhes gnas pa la/ ā las a ba la — dbyi'os/ rnam bcad phyis/ mdo 'dis a ring thung gnyis ka las/ pha rol a thung ma gtogs pa'i dbyangs gzhan la rnam bcad yang na dbyi bar ston te/ ka lā pa las/ a las pha rol dbyangs gzhan la dbyi ba'am yang na ya'o/ /zhes dang / pā ṇi'i mdo las/ saḥ.agro la dbyi la de rkang pa rdzogs pa la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/saḥ'i rnam bcad phyis/ e dang i la yi'os/ mtshams sbyar bas si ṣa ste/ de 'di zhes pa'o/ /da sha bcu/ ra tha shing rta/ da sha ra tha la bu rgyud kyi rkyen yis byin/de phan gyi le'u'i skabs ltar bsgrubs nas si byin pas/ dā sha ra thiḥshing rta bcu pa'i bu/ rā ma la si byin pas rā maḥdaga' byed/ nā mi las ra 'os/ ra thiḥ'i rnam bcad dra/ ra la dbyi ste ring po yang ngos/ dra phyis dbyangs snga ma ring por bsgyur 161

bas/ dā sha ra bī rā ma byung / yang si ṣa 'dra/ rā dzan la tshig phrad las na phyis/rā dza rgyal po/ yu dhe g.yul ngo / khyi ra la si byin/ 0 khyi raḥbartan pa ste ring cha mi 'thob/ si ṣa 'dra/ kur+ṇa rna ba/ ma hā chen po/ t+yā ga gtong ba la zhis byin/sdo rjes 'brel phyis/ i a dag gi dbyi'os/ rtags ma tha'i a phyis/ gra srog med yī la drangs/ t+yā gī gtong ba can zhes pa'o/ /si ṣa de 'di/
