wī ma la si byin/ dhī maḥ'ajigs pa/ rnam bcad u sogs kyis dhī mo/ mahā chen po/ ba la stobs/si rnam bcad de ba laḥzhes pa'o/ /de yang mi rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i dus su byung ba rgyal po rā ma ṇa ni/ 'jig rten na mda' la shin tu mkhas par grags te/ mda' rgyab tshad 'phog pa/ phog tshad 'chi ba/ shi tshad lhar skye ba'i dngos grub brnyes par grags/ g.yul ngor brtan pa ni/ g.yul 'gyed pa la dpa' ba ste/ 'thab sar mi 'bros shing / rdzun nam yang mi smra ba'o/ / rna ba can ni/ gtong phod che ba ste/nyin re bzhin srin po gcig la gser bhā ra gcig bzhi char bcas pa ster zhing / rang gi pags pa dang so gser gyi rang bzhin byin pa sogs slong mo pas ci bslang sterababa'o/ /'jigs pa'am 'jigs sde ni/ stobs shin tu che ste/ glang po che stong phrag bcu'i stobs yod ཿpur grags so/ /des na tshigs bcad 'di/ saḥ.e ṣa zhes pa la si ṣa zhes sdeb sbyor sogs kyi dbang gis rnam bcad phyis pa las slar mtshams sbyar ba'i dper brjod sngon gyi gtam rgyud de rnams dang sbyar nas bkod pa'o/ /de bzhin du rnam bcad phyis nas slar mtshams sbyor byed kyang nyes pa med cing legs pa'i dper brjod gzhan ston pa ni/ ya dulta lo ki kā yi ha tang de ba hu lam̐ bha betwa/ /se nī rtsu mya da de so ṣā mi t+yā dī nā ma du ṣ+ṭha tā/ /gang dag 'jig rten pas bshad 'di dag las/ /rig byed la ni de 'dra mang po 'byung / /de 'di sa gzhi kun nas ma byin blangs/ /bur shing ma de zhes sogs nyes pa med/ /ces pa ni/ yad gang / uk+ta bshad pa ste/ la dulta gang bshad ces pa'o/ /lo ka 'jig rten la de phan gyi rkyen i ka byin/ dbyangs dang po 'phel/ rtags mtha'i a phyis drangs pas/ lo ki ga rnam dbye bzhi pa'i nge byin pas lo ki ka ya ste/ 'jig rten ched du/ i ha 'di dag tad de/ be da rig 162 4

byed la rnam dbye bdun pa'i nge byin/ de dag mtshams sbyar bas tade de/ de rig byed la zhes pa'o/ /ba hu mang po/ la 'dzin pa'i don la i as du bsgyur bas lo/bhū yod pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la chog 'byung ling gi skyes bu dang cipo'i gcig tshig yuta byin/ kun bshad kyi byed pa po'i le'u skabs ltar bsgrubs pas bha betwa ste/'byung ba'i don no/ /saḥde/ i dan la bud med kyi rtags le ltar gnyis pa'i amu byin/ ṭi a/ da'i ma'os/ da ma/ bud med kyi ās rkyen byin pas i māṃ 'di/saḥ'i rnam bcad phyis mtshams sbyar se māṃ de 'di/ bhū mi sa gzhi/ bhū yod pa la'o'i byings la/ uṇa sogs kyi ma rkyen byin pa yin pas ring cha dgos/ a dgag tshiganyer bsgyu ra ād+ma gi rjes 'brel dra phyis pas ā kun/ da de byin pa/ des na snyu mi/a/ ā/ da de rnams mtshams sbyar/ ju mya da de byung ngo / /saḥde/ u ṣa bur shing / mo rkyen rdzab dang gnyis pa'i amu sbyar bas u ṣ+pe bur shing ma/ saḥ'i rnam bcad phyis/ u khaṃ dang mtshams sbyar/ so ṣi bur shing ma de/ i ti zhes pa/dbyangs la mā'os/ so ṣi gi nga ro mu/ ā di la sogs/ drug pa'i ām nuṭa bcas byin/ de rnams mtshams sbyar bas mit+ta dī ā+oṃ/ nga ro ma dgag tshig a la drangs/tu//tri tā nyes pa'am gnod pa/ gong du dgag tshig a sbyar bas a tus tā nyes pa med/ces pa ste/ kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi yi ge mnyam pa'i ched saḥ.i māṃ dang / saḥ.u ṣi gi saḥ'i rnam bcad phyis nas slar mtshams sbyar ba'i dper brjod do/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis skad dod ltar na/ gang bshad 'jig rten ched du 'di dag la/ /de 'dra rig byed la ni mang 'dzin 'byung / /zhes par 'gyur ro/ /'o na sdeb sbyor sogs dgos dbang gis spyir btang las 'das pa de lta bu yo da na/ spyir sgra sgrub tshul gyi cho ga la mi 'dra ba du yod ce na/ mang du yod kyang de thams cad sgrub tshul gyi cho ga bzhir 'dus so zhes ston pa ni/ kwa cipo brasaḥka tsi da pra bran+tiḥku tsi dz+wa bhā ṣa kwa tsi dmya de ba bi nibi dh+wa rna ba hu d+mā sa mi rtsi tsa tu rbi ṭ+wāṃ bā hu la ki ba da n+ti/ /la lar 'jug dang la lar mi 'jug pa/ /la lar gdam nga la lar gzhan du 'gyur/ /cho ga'i rim pa mang po yang dag 'dod/ /sgrub tshul bzhi po mang du bshad par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang sgra sgrub tshul la 163

lar te phal cher ni/ sgra mdo rnams kyi dngos zin spyir btang dmigs bsal gnyis dang shugs bstan te mdo don gsum ci rigs pa 'jug pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa dang / la lar te skabs 'gar de mi 'jug par nges tshig dang man ngag gsang tshig gis sgrub pa dang / yang la lar mdo don yin min gnyis gdam nga byed de sgrub pa dang / la lar mdo tshig gis zin ma zin gang yang rung rgyu mtshan med par gzhan du bsgyur ba ste/sgrub tshul gyi cho ga bzhi yod ces pa'i don no/ / kwa tsita la lar/ pra rab/bruḥ'ajug pa la si rnam bcad/ kwa tsita la lar/ a dgag tshig tsa pa'i yaṃ ba 'a dza pa'os/ twa dra a la drangs/ pra t+pan+tiḥrab 'jug yang kwa tsita la lar/ bi bhā ṣa gdam nga / 'di bha ṣa gsal ba'am brgyad bkag la'o'i byings la/ dngos po la gha3'os/ ghanya'i rkyen byin 3 'phel ba dang gh+ra khyad don phyis/ srog gi a bzhagabyings mtha'i a brjod don yin pas phyis nas drangs/ nyer bsgyur bi sngon du bzhag pas bi bhā ṣa ste/ ṣa kle ring cha mi 'thob/ kwa tsitra la lar/ aḥtra gzhan/ e ba 'gyur/ mtshams sbyar te/ kwa tsi dmya de ba grub/ bi dhi cho ga 'dir ba'i i chad/drug pa'i ngas byin skyes pa'i rtags i thung mtha' ltar bsgrubs pas bi dhe:nā mi las ra'os rnam bcad du/ bi d+mā na la si amra bi d+mā rna rim pa/ ba hu mang po/ d+mā 'dzin pa'am nyid ces pa'i don la 'jug kyang 'dir kha skong ngo / /saṃ yang dag zhiyi lha ba'am 'dod pa/ tsa tud bzhi/ tsa la ring cha yig nor/ bi dha sgrub par byed pa la'o'i byings la/ nasto ki dag gos ki rkyen byin/ byings mtha'i a brjod don dang ka yon tan 'gog pa'i don gyis phyis drangs pas bi dhe cho ga dang / byings de la uṇa sogs kyi rkyen yī byin pa'i pi d+dhā sgrub tshul/ ba hu la mang po/ de la de phan gyi rkyen ka byin/ dbyangs dang po 'phel/ si yamā/ bā hu la ki byung / ba darnyi bshad par bya/ zhes pa'o/ /'di nye dbang rdo rje'i sdeb sbyor yin te/ rin chen 'byung gnas las/ dza ta dza lci gnyis ni nye dbang rdo rje ste/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshigs rkang re la yi ge bcu gcig las sum bsgrigs dang po dza dbus lci ba/ gnyis pa ta mtha' yang ba/gsum pa dza dbus lci ba/ yi ge mtha' ma gnyis ka lci ba'o/ /rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi 164

mtha'i dbyangs thung ngu yin pas spyir btang yang ba yin mod/ rin 'byung las/rkang pa'i mtha' rnams su mang po zhig lci ba dang ga dang 'khyog po'o/ tsha/zhes rkang mtha' la dbyangs thung ngu lci ba dang prastar 'khyog po 'thob pa mang bar gsungs so/ /'o na sgra sgrub tshul de ltar yin na/ yi/ ge'i rnam 'gyur gyi cho ga la rigs mi 'dra ba du yod ce na/lnga yod par ston pa ni/ bar+ṇa ga mo bar+ṇa pi pad+ma yañtsa dwo tsā ba ro bar+ṇa bi kā ra nā sho/dhato sta da t+pa ti sha ya na ya gasta du tsu ta pañtsa bi r+ghaṃ ni ru ste/ yi ge glo bur yi ge bsnol ba dang / /gzhan yang gnyis ni yi ge rnam 'gyur nyams/ /byings kyi don de phul byung sbyor ba ste/ /des gsungs cho ga lnga po nges par bshad/ /ces pa ste/ rnam 'gyur gyi rigs de la yi ge glo bur ba dang / yi ge bsnol ba dang / yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba dang /yi ge nyams pa dang / byings kyi don la phul byung du sbyar ba ste lnga yod do/ /'di nyer bskyed brgyad pa'i sdeb sbyor yin te/ dbang po rdo rje dang / nye dbang rdo rje gnyis kyi rkang ba ci rigs par spel bas nyer bskyed bcu bzhi 'byung ba las 'di brgyad pa ste/rkang pa dang po gsum dbang po rdo rje dang / bzhi pa nye dbang rdo rje'i rkang pa'o/ /dbang po rdo rje'i sdeb sbyor ni/ gal te dbang po rdo rje ta gnyis dza lci gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bar+ṇa yi ge/ ā ga maḥslo bur te si rnam bcad/ bar+ṇa yi ge/bi rnam par/ pad+ma yaḥbasnol ba si rnam bcad/ tsa dang don/ rnam par bcad bya'i sra'os/ /rnam bcad sra/ sa tu'i sha tsu rnams la sha tsu'os/ sra thar bsgyur bas sh+tsa byung ngo / /di gnyis/ dang po'i oṃ sbyar/ ṭi a drangs/ sdu/ tsa yang gi don/a pa ra gzhan/ dang po'i au byin ma tshams sbyar tsā pa ro byung / bar+ṇa yi ge/ bi kā ra rnam 'gyur/ nā sha nyams pa au byin na sho/ dhā tu la ngasra byin pas dh+wa hoḥbyings kyi/tad de/ at+pa don/ a ti sha phul byung / de rnams mtshams sbyar te d+mā tosta dasgyu ti sha byung / yagrwa gang / gsum pa'i ṭā byin/ ṭi a/ ṭā i na'os/ /ṭā i na dang mtshams sbyar bas/ ye na gang gis zhes pa ste 'gyur la ma thon/ yo ga la si byin/yo gaḥsbyor ba/ tang de/ utsu te gsungs/ de rnams mtshams sbyar ba yo gasta tu tsu te/ pañtsa lnga/ bi dhe cho ga nidra nges pa/ uk+ta bshad/ si yamā dang mtshams 165

sbyar te/ ni ru lti nges par bshad ces pa'o/ /de nas bshad ma thag pa'i rnam 'gyur lnga bo'i dper brjod ston pa kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor sho lo ka gnyis te/ bar+ṇa ga mo ga ben+d+ra di/ sidhe bar+ṇa bi brla yaḥkho ḍā shā do bi kā raḥswā ngaṇi nā shaḥbru kho da re/ /yi ge glo bur ba lang dbang po sogs/ /yi ge rab tu bsnol ba seng ge'o/ /bcu drug sogs ni rnam par 'gyur ba yin/ /yi ge nyams pa rgyas pa'i lto ba zhes/ /zhes pa ste/ bahā ga mo gong ltar la/ yi ge glo bur ba de'i dper brjod ni/ gong du dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyo ra gyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ go in+d+ra bzhag bar du a yig ā ga ma byin/ ka lā ba las/ rim pa las ma 'a das par phral bar bya'o/ /zhes pas go'i srog gi o phral/gra srog med ha lan+tas mtshan bya/ o ab dang / a i la e'o sogs kyis ga ben+d+ra sgrub pa/ ming la yi ge sngar med pa glo bur du bcug pa'i dpe brjod de/ ba lang dbang bo zhes ba khyu mchog gi ming ngo / /ā di la sogs/ bdun pa'i ngi byin/ nga khyad don phyis/ srog gi i/ ri rma'os/ o/ de yang ṭita'o/ /ṭita la ṭi'os/ rtags mtha'i ṭi phyis/ drangs pas ā rda rnams mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge bsnol ba'i dper brjod ni/ hid+ma si 'tshe ba la'o'i byings la/ yi ge bsgyur ba la'ang ngos/ a rkyen byin/ byings mtha'i i phyis/ drangs pas hing sa byung / dbyangs so sor phral/hra ing sra a/ gsal byed gong 'og gnyis phan tshun go sa brjes nas drangs pas/sidha ste 'tsho ba phul du byung ba'am ri dwags la 'tshe bar byed pas na 'tshe byed de seng ge'o/ /de la bdun pa'i ngi byin pas sidhe zhes grub po/ /bar+ṇa bi brla yaḥgong bzhin no/ /yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba'i dper brjod ni/ ṣa ṣ+ṭha drug da sha bcu zhes pa rme/da zhu dang da sha dang dhā rnams pha rol la sha ṣ+ṭha'i ṣ+ṭha srog med yur 'gyur zhing ta sde yang ṭa sder 'gyur bar bshad pas ṣ+ṭha u dang da stor bsgyur/ a sum̐ la yo'os/ kho ḍa sha grub ste bcu drug ces pa'o/ /gong ltar ā di la ngi byin pas ā do/ bi kā raḥrnam 'gyur/yasga yod pa la'o'i byings la/ chog 'byung ling gi dang po'i gcig tshig lngatwa sbyar/nas masra kyi a'os/ aswa kyi a phyis drangs pas sgyutwa ni yin zhes pa'i don no/ /yi ge nyams pa'i dper brjod ni/ bar+ṇa nā shaḥgong bzhin/ sbo dzitra rgyas pa/ u da ra 166

lto ba zhes pa la/ yi ge nyams pa ta yig rgyu mtshan 'brel med par phyis/ a u la o'os/ mtshams sbyar bas mṛ ṣi da ra grub ste/ rgyas pa'i lto ba'amasto thig le khra bo can gyi lto ba zhes pa ste/ 'dod 'jo las/ mṛ ṣaṭa thig le khra bo can/ zhes phro gatra ni ri dwags thig le khra bo can zhig yin par bshad do/ /zhes kyi skad dod iti byin/ ti phyis nas mtshams sbyar bas bṛ ṣi da re'am/ rnam dbye bdun pa'i ngi byin/ dra phyis/i dang sbyar bas mṛ kho da re ste/ rgyas pa'i lto ba la zhes par 'gyur ro/ /byings kyi don la phul byung sbyor ba'i dper brjod ni/ bar+ṇa bi kā ra nā shā r+ghaṃ dhā to ra ti r+sha yi na yaḥ/ /yo gaḥs utsu te pradzha rma yu ra bh+ra ma rā di 6/ /yi ge rnam par 'gyur dang nyams dag gis/ /byings las phul du byung ba 'dren pa gang / /rma bya dang ni bung ba la sogs su/ /shes rab can gyis sbyor ba de smras so/ /zhes pa ste/ bar+ṇa bi kā ra gong bzhin/nā sha la gsum pa'i gnyis tshig r+ghaṃ byin/ bha la ā'os/ rtags mtha' ring po/ nā shā ṭhā nyams dag gis/ 'dir byed tshig chad do/ /bhā tu la lnga pa'i ngasi byin/ d+mā toḥbyings las/ a ti sha phul du byung ba/ rnam bcad dra drangs pas d+mā to ra ti sha/yadra gang / dzes byin/ dz+ra phyis/ ṭi a/ dzasga yī os/ rdzas i/ a i la e'os/ ye gang rnams zhes par 'a gyur ro/ /na yaḥ'adren pa dang / yo gaḥsbyor ba rnam bcad ni si byin pa'o/ /saḥde/ utsu te smras so/ /ā las a ba la dbyi'os/sa'i rnam bcad phyis/ pradzha shes rab la gsum pa'i mang tshig nyis byin/ nyis kyi in+da phral/ bha'i bha a'os/ bh+ra ar bsgyur te rim par mtshams sbyar bas pradzhaḥ'adi gsum pa'i mang tshig byin pa yin pas shes rab can rnams kyis zhes byed tshig 'thob bo/ /phul byung la gnyis las/ yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba'i byings la phul byung gi dper brjod ni/ rma bya'i skad dod ma lca ra zhes pa yin la/ de yang ma tī sa gzhi'i ming dang / raḥsgra 'byin pa'i don la/ phul du byung ba'i yi ge rnam 'gyur ni/ tī dbyangs bcas yu ring por bsgyur bas/ ma lca ra:grub ste/ sa steng du skad phul du byung bar sgrog pa'i don te rma bya'i ming ngo / /yi ge nyam/sa pa'i byings la phul byung gi dper brjod ni/ bung ba'i skad dod bh+ra ma raḥzhes pa ste/ de yang bh+ra ma ra 'khor ba/167

raḥgang ltar te/ phul byung gi don la ta yig phyis nas nyams par byas pas bh+ra ma raḥni/ sgra chen po dang bcas te 'phur lding byed pa'i don te bung ba'i ming ngo /'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jo las/ ma yu raḥs 'gro dang / bh+ra ma raḥ'akhor 'gro zhes bsgyu ra/ 'ga' zhig tu ma yu raḥsar sgeg dang / bh+ra ma raḥ'akhor byed ces 'byung ngo / /de gnyis kyi rnam bcad/ ā las a ba la dbyi'os phyis/ ā di la rnam dbye bdun pa'i ma/nga tshig sub byin/ pra rjes 'brel phyis/ ku i la la ṣa ru byed de sa'os/ sa ṣa ru bsgyur mtshams sbyar bas bh+ra ma rā di 6 ste bung ba la sogs su/ zhes pa'o/ /tshigs rkang phyi rme gnyis thad 'gyur byas na/ sbyor de smras so zhes rab can rnams kyis/ /rma bya dang ni bung ba la sogs su/ /zhes par 'gyur ro/ /don mdor bsdu na/ mjug gi tshigs bcad drug las/ tshigs bcad dang po gnyis/ saḥ e ṣa dang / saḥ.e māṃ dang / saḥ.u ṣi rnams tshigs rkang gi yi ge mnyam pa'i ched du rnam bcad phyis pa'i rjes su slar mtshams sbyor bya ba'i dper brjod du bkod pa yin la/ tshigs bcad gsum pa de las 'phros nas spyir sgra sgrub tshul gyi cho ga la mi 'dra ba bzhi yod par bshad/ bzhi pas yi ge'i rnam 'gyur la mi 'dra ba lnga yod par bstan nas/ tshigs bcad phyi ma gnyis kyis de lnga 'i dper brjod rim pa bzhin du bstan pa'o/ /smras pa/ sgra rig rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /nyer mkho mu tig phreng mdzes 'di/ /blo lda na rnam sad mgul rgyan du/ /spel byed dbyangs can skedaga' blo 'o/ /'dir 'bad legs byas chu thigs dang / /dus gsum dge tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /lhan cig sgrib gnyis sbyor ba dang / /kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig/168

༄7/ /snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / rgyal kun mkhyen rab chu gter che/ /bsrubs skyes nyin mor byed pa'i gzis/ /mun sel rnam dpyod mchog stsol ba'i/ /yab gcig mkhyen gter bdag skyongs shig/sgrib bral shes rab mchog gi khams/ /yid 'phrog mtshan dpe 'bar ba la/ /rnam sad bu mo stong dag gis/ / skrun min dbyangs can lha mor 'dud/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i mtsho/ /blo bzang klong dzu 'khyizlo ba las/ /grags pa'i rba rlabs cher g.yo ba/ /kun mkhyen dang zlo ldarno bla mar 'dud/ /'a(4gas tshul ma/sa dbang daṇ+ḍi yi/ / legs bshad tshig rgyan bang mdzod nas/ /gnad bsdus mu tig phreng mdzes 'di/ /skal bzang ma gul ba'i rgyan tu spel / /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis sdun bsu sa te/ 'dir las dang po pa dag la phan pa'i phyir snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long gi don bsdus te cung zad 'chad pa la bzhi/ snyan ngag shes pa'i phan yo na/ ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs/ snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ gzhung dngos kyi don mdor bsdus te bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ snyan ngag legs par shes pa de gnas skabs su mkhas pa tshogs pa'i ma dun sar 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang /rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / smra ba'i khri la 'dug pa la dbang ba sogs mkhas pa'i snyan pa dang / grags pa 'thob pa dang / dam pa'i chos gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa dang / yul dam pa dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa dang / de ltar bstod pas tshogs rlabs po che bsags te rang gi lhag pa'i lha yang mnyes nas dngos su zhal ston cing byin gyis rlob pa sogs 'byung ste/ dper na/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis 'jam dbyangs dang / shrī badz+ra de was spyan ras gzigs dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis sgrol ma la tshig rgyan gyi sdeb sbyor phul du byung ba'i sgo nas 169

bstod pa bgyis pas dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus lta bu'o/ /mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i bo 'phang 'thob pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa yod de/ snyan ngag me long las/ snyan ngag chung ngu la yang ngal byas mi/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sa dag tu 'dug la dbang / /zhes dang / mdo las/ dam pa'i chos gsal bar bya ba'i snyan ngag bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa bya'o/ /de las bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / mdo sde bskal bzang las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan de bde gshegs rtswa mchog la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs shing / bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / sngon snyan ngag mkhan du gyur pa'i tshe sangs rgyas skar rgyal la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas bskal pa bzhi'i khri'i tshogs bzlums par gsungs pa sogs shin tu mang ngo / /gnyis pa snyan ngag ma shes pa'i nyes dmib/sa ni/ bstan bcos spyi dang khyad par snyan ngag ge bstan bcos la ma sbyangs shing mi shes pa des skyon yon gyi khyad par ji bzhin 'byed mi nas pa dang / nang don rig pa'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams kyang phal cher snyan ngag gi gzugs kho na ra gnas pas na/ de dag gi sgra don mi shes par dgongs pa phyin ci log tu bkral bas de la mkhas pa rnams kyis blun rmongs ba lang dang ne+e tso lta bur smad cing / snyan ngag dang mi ldan pa'i grong tshig tsam la brten pa la don bzang po ra rlom yang rma khas pa'i mdun sar rtsis med de/ dper na/ 'jig rten na lang tsho rgyas shing mdzes pa'i skyes bu zhig rgyan gos dang bral te gcer bur rgyu na skyes bu kun gyis 'phya smod byed pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang me long las/ skye bo bstan bcos mi shes pas/ /yon tan skyon dag ji ltar dbye/ / gzugs kyi dbye ba dmigs pa'i skabs/ /long pa dag la yod dam ci/ /zhes dang / de nyid nyes par sbyar na slar/ /sbyor po ba lang nyid rjod byed/ /ces dang / rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing las/mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / zur mkhar pas/ rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na 170

skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ / bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang tshig gi tha snyad la brten sgonas don zab mo 'tshol dgos pas snyan ngag la sogs pa'i tshig gi tha snyad la mi mkhas pa des/ gsung rab kyi dgongs don phyin ci log tu bzung zhing de ltar nyams su blangs pas rang gzhan thams cad 'phung bar byed pa sogs nyes dmigs mtha' yas te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ gang dag snyan ngag la so/gas pa'i/ /tshig gi tha snyad mi mkhas pa/ /de yis gsung rab dgongs don yang / /phyin ci log tu bkral bas lhung / /zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ /mdor na grol ba don du gnyer ba rnams kyis shes bya rig pa'i gnas thams cad la phyogs ris med par sbyang zhing shes dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mi 'dod na skyur zhog thob 'dod phyin sangs rgyas yin min shes bya thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen mi mkhyen gyi sgo nas 'jog cing / sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra don yang ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs shing shes bya la blo rgyas pa la byed pas na/ 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod du khas blangs nas de'i rgyu rig gnas thams cad shes mi dgos par smra ba ni 'gal ba ltag spro da rgyu 'bras kyi rnam dbye la rmongs pa'i 'cha pa gtam yin te/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen pos / nyi tshe ba la nye tshe dang / /mtha' dag pa la mtha' dag pa'i/ /'bras bu 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /ma/khas pa su zhig phyogs res tshim/ /zhes dang / rje sa paṇa gyis/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring / /zhes dang / ma bslab ba la kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rig gnas rgya chen por thos pa bya long med pa'am sngon gyi bag chags srab pas skal ba med pa rnams kyis kyang rig gnas la sbyong mkhan dang shes mkhan rnams la rjes su yi rang bar byed/ shes pa'i smon lam 'debs/ tha na mgar pa dang lham mkhan sogs kyi bzo spyad lag tu blangs nas 'di lta bu la'ang mkhas par gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs dgos par chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /mgar pa sogs kyi bzo de dag shes pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ma gtogs/ lag len 171

du byed pa'i smon lam mi 'debs te/ shes tshad lag tu len ga la dgos/ des na rnam/ dpyod dang ldan pa rnam/sa kyis rig gnas spyi dang / khyad par snyan tshig gi rig pa 'di la bslab cing mkhas par bya dgos te/ snyan ngag ni rig gnas kun la lta ba'i ri/ga lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag la lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs pa 'i bshad par bya ba zhin tu mang yang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal nas/ don ldan tshig ni re res kyang / /shes rab can la don kun ston/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gis kyang / /rmongs la phan pa sgrub pa dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos nus chung ba dang yi ge mangs kyis dogs nas ma spros so/ / gsum pa snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu ni/skye stobs kyi shes rab che ba dang / tshe 'dir snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dang / sngo na byung gi gtam rgyud dang / ming gi mngon brjod sogs la mang du thos pa'i shes rab dang / rig pa'i gnas rnams la nyan bsam goms pa la gus sbyor dang / rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus che ba ste gsum ni snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa shes pa'i rgyu yin te/me long las/ rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang / /mang du thos pa dri med dang / /mngon nga/ra sbyor ba mi dman pa/ /snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs/rgyu de gsum ga ma tshang yang mang du thos pa dang / snyan rog gi rig pa la 'bad rtsol chen po bsten pa ste/ rgyu phyi ma gnyis yod na snyan ngag shes pa'i skal ba dang ldan te/de nyid las/ gal te sngon gyi bag chags yon tan gyi/ /rjes 'brel spobs pa rmad byung med pa la'ang / /thos dang 'bad pa dag gis ngag bsten na/ /ci zhig ltar yang nges par rjes 'dzin byed/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ snyan ngag shes dang ma shes pa'i/ /phan yon nyes dmigs legs bsams te/ /snod rung rgyu la 'bad nas ni/ /mkhas par slob pa shin tu gces/ /zhes pa bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bzhi pa gzhung dngos kyi don mdor bsdus te bshad pa ni/ spyir snyan ngag ces pa ni rna bar snyan cing yid 'phrog pa'i tshig la bya ste/ 'ga' zhig tu snyan dngags zhes 'byung ba'i dngags ni tha snya da ces bya ba'i brda rnying yin pas don la khyad med cing / de'i bstan bcos la snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid ston pa'i gzhung dang / gzhung de dang mthun par 172

sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gnyis yod la/ dang po ni/ snyan ngag gi gzhung yin la snyan ngag ma yin te/ mtshan gzhi ni/ snyan ngag gi gzhung me long lta bu dang / gnyis pa ni/snyan ngag yin la snyan ngag gi gzhung ma yin te/ dper na/ skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing lta bu'o/ /zhes mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ des na 'di la gsum/ lus bshad pa/ rgyan bshad pa/ zhar la skyon sel ba bshad pa ste/snyan ngag gi gzhung gi brjod bya thams cad de gsum du 'dus pa yin zhing / de la gang mdzes par bya ba'i gzhi'am chos can la lus dang / de mdzes byed kyi chos la rgyan zhes bya la/ de dag gi zhar la spang bya'i skyon ngos bzung nas de spong dgos par bstan pa'i ched du skyon sel bshad do/ /dang po ni/ smra ba po'i brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang dang gang yin de rjod byed kyi tshig gi phreng bar spel ba'i tshig sbyor ni snyan ngag gi lus yin la/ de la dbye na gsum/ tshigs bcad dang / lhugs pa dang / de gnyis spel ma'o/ /dang po tshigs bcad la sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bṛt+ta dang /dzā ti gnyis yod/ rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na bzhi/ grol ba dang / rigs dang /mdzod dang / 'dus pa'o/ /sho lo ka gcig gis brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de rdzogs par ston pa ni grol ba dang / bsngags brjod kyi yul gcig la sho lo ka du ma yod pa la bya ba'i chig gcig gis thams cad gsal bar byed pa ni rigs dang /gocod mtshams dang bya tshig sna tshogs shing sho lo ku'i grangs nges bzung med cing brjod bya du mas phyug pa ni mdzod dang / brjod bya'i don gcig la sho lo ka mang po bya tshig kyang mang po yod pa ni 'dus pa yin no/ /de rnams ni sargas bcings pa ste le'u mang po yod pa'i snyan ngag chen po'i gzhung gi cha shas la yod pa ste/ dper na/ snyan ngag chen po ni snam bu lta bu dang / grol ba sogs bzhi de'i rgyu snal ma lta bu'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i snyan ngag le'u gnyis yan chad kyi bdag nyid can la snyan ngag chen po zhes bya zhing / de'i mtshan nyid la sgo dang / rten gzhi'am srog dang / ji ltar rtsom tshul gsum las/ thog mar shis pa brjod cing phyag bya ba/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya'i don bsdus te bstan pa/ dngos po nges bstan te rnam pa gsum ni sgo dang / gang la 173

brten pa'i gzhi ni/ sngon byung gi gtam rgyud dang / sde bzhi dang / mkhas pa'i yon tan dang / rgyal po'i mnga' thang sogs da lta'i gtam brjod par 'os shing 'dod pa thams cad do/ /ji ltar rtsom tshul ni/ nyams dod cing yid 'gyur ba'i tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa/ le'u'am skabs mang nyung 'tsham pa dang / sdeb sbyor legs shing le'u'i mjug rnams su gzhung dkyus dang mi 'dra bar sdeb sbyor gzhan sbyar ba la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa lhugs pa ni/ rkang par ma bcad pa'i tshig gi rgyun te/ dbye na brjod pa dang / gtam gnyis yod cing / de gnyis ming tsam gyi sgo nas dbye ba'i tha snyad mi 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs don la khyad par med de/ dper na/ gnyis 'thung dang / lag ldan zhes pa'i ming gnyis kyis glang po che'i rigs gcig go ba lta bu'o/ /'on kyang paṇ+ḍi ta rig byed rgya mtshos/ sngon byung gi gtam rgyud las brtsams te brjod pa ni gtam dang / de las bcoms pa ma yin pa'i rigs brjod pa ni/brjod pa'i mtshan nyid du bzhed pa ni legs zhes mkhas pa snga rabs pa du ma gsung ngo / /gsum pa spel ma ni/ tshigs bcad lhugs gnyis spel mar byas te brtsams pa'i snyan ngag rnams yin te/ 'di la skad rigs bzhi tshang ba'i spel ma ni/ zlos gar gyi bstan bcos lta bu dang / skad rigs gang rung gcig la brten pa'i spel ma la tsan+d+ra zhes bya ste/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa lta bu'o/ /brjod 'dod dngos po gang dang gang / /rjod byed tshig tu bsdebs pa yi/ /tshig sbyor bcad lhugs spel gsum la/ /snyan ngag lus su bshad pa yin/ /zhes pa bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams ni rgyan gyis mdzes par bya ba'i gzhi lus kyi rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyan bshad pa la/gong du bshad pa'i snyan ngag gi lus de rnams mdzes par byed pa'i chos la rgyan zhes bya ste/ de yang lus sgeg pa dang / nyams kyi rol pa dang / rkang lag gi gar stabs sogs mig gi blta bya'i don gtso bor ston pa'i snyan ngag ni/ lta ba la sbyor phyir gtso bor zlos gar ston la/ blta bya'i don ma yin par rna bar snyan pa'i mnyan bya'i ro nyams gtso bor ston pa ni/ snyan ngag chen po yin pas na rgyan gyi sbyor tshul la de ltar lugs gnyis yod do/ / rgyan dngos la gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan dang /174

thun mong ba'i rgyan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lho phyogs be+e dar+bha'i mkhas pa dang /shar phyogs gau ḍā pa'i mkhas pa gnyis kyis rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed tshul shin tu mi 'dra ba re yod pa'i rgyan yin pas na thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan zhes bya ste/dbye na bcu yod de/ sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid dang / /snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang / /don gsal ba dang rgya che dang / /brjid dang mdzes dang ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes pa ltar bcad lhugs spel ma gsum gang rtsom yang lus kyi nyams yon tam bcu po 'di'i sgo nas skabs su gang bab kyi nyams 'don pa yin la/ nyams 'don tshul la dngos lho phyogs bai dat+ta dang / bzlog pa shar phyogs gau ḍā wa'i nyams 'don lugs kyi lam srol gnyis su phye ba yin no/ /de las be+e dar+bha'i bzhed pa ni/ tshig gi sbyor ba 'jam zhing mnyen pa dang / gau ḍā wa'i 'dod pa ni/ tshig sbyor phal cher rtsub cing gyong ba lta bu cig go/ dang po sbya ra ba'i yon tan la gnyis las/ bzlog pa gau ḍā wa 'dod pa'i sbyar ba'i yon tan ni/ sbyor ba lhod pa srog chung gi yi ge 'ba' zhig lta bu la yi ge gang yang rung ba zhig yang yang bskor ba'i rjes khrid cig yin te/ dper na/yang yang yid kyi yul nyid du/ /yid 'ong yongs kyi yab gcig la/ /yun ring g.yel meXd 6 /nga dbo mos/༷ /yal yol ma rmidzad yud tsam dgongs/ /zhes ming 0gzhi srog zlung gi yi ge 'ba' zhig tu 6da r+sha la ya yig rlon du mar r+shaskor ba'i rjes khrid lta bu'o/ /dngos be+e dar+bha 'dod pa'i sbyar ba'i yon tan ni sbyor ba lci ba srog chen gyi yi ge mang du yod pa'i tshig spyor zhig yin te/ dper na/ sna tshogs shes bya'i chu gter la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gru rdzings kyis/ /pha mthar bgrordo 'chad tshul bzang dag/ dri bral thu/sa rjos skyong bar mdzod/ /ces mirngo gzhi'i yi ge la sros chen ༷sa dang / tsha dang /sha ldang / zlo dang / tha dang / pha dang / za ste mang du tshogs pa lta bu'o/ /srog che chung ni/ rgya yig la sde pa'i dang po ka tsa ṭa ta pa dang / gsum pa ga ḍa da ba dang /lnga pa nga nya ṇa na ma dang / mthar gnas ya ra la wa ste bcu dgu ni srog chung dang /srog chen ni/ sde pa'i gnyis pa kha tsha ṭha tha pha dang / bzhi pa snya dzha snya dha bha dang / dro ba sha ṣi sa ha dang / mthar zad kyi yi ge k+ṣa ste bco lnga'o/ /bod yig ca cha ja gsum ni 175

rim bzhin tsa tsha dza dang / zha ni sha dang / za ni sa dang sbyar te shes par bya la/ 'a yig ni a la 'dus shing srog chung dang / gzhan rnams rgya yig ltar ro/ /gnyis pa rab dwangs kyi yon tan la gnyis/ dngos lho phyogs pa'i 'dod pa ni/ brjod don 'jig rten la/ grags pa rab tu dwangs shing gsal bas rtogs sla ba zhig yin te/dper na/ rnyog bral dwangs pa'i ma tsho nang du/ /skad snyan sgrog pa ngang mo dkar/ /'bod dgu'i gar gyis brel ba 'di/ /sred ldan mig gi dga' ston no/ /zhes brjod don 'jig rten la grags shing gsal bas brjod pa tsam gyis tshegs med du go nus pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar phyogs pa'i 'dod pa ni/ 'jig rten la grags mi che yang sgra bshad rgyu yod na go dka' ba zhig la 'ang 'dod pa yin te/ dper na/ dwangs gsal mtsho yi 'jug ngogs su/ /yid 'ong nag min gnyis skyes dag/ mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol bzhin du/ /lang long rgyu 'dis gzhan yid 'gug/ ces nag min gnyis skyes ni ngang pa dkar po'i ming du 'jig rten na grags pa min pas go dka' yang sgra bshad rgya yod pa lta bu'o/ /gsum ba mnyam nyid kyi yon tan la gnyis/ dngos lho pa'i 'dod pa ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba 'jam rtsub cha mnyam pa zhig yin la 'jam rtsub kyi don yang srog che chung la byed de/ dper na/ mar gad mdangs kyis byug pa yi/ /dbyar gyi dpal mo yid 'ong ma/ra/ /chu khur cher 'khrigs sgra sgrog tshe/ /sar sgeg phal cher skad snyan 'khrol/ /zhes tshigs rkang dang po gnyis ming gzhi 'jam pa kho na dang /phyi ma gnyis rtsub pa kho nar yod pas tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa 'jam rtsub cha mnyam pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i 'dod pa ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba 'jam rtsub cha mi mnyam pa zhig la 'dod de/ dper na/ yid 'ong dpyid kyi nor ldan ma/ /rtswa ljang 'dab ma'i gos gyon cing / /tshang skyes phan tshun sgra snyan sgrog/ yid can dga' bde'i dpal gyis brel/ /zhes rkang pa gsum pa rtsub cing gzhan rnam/sa 'jam pas cha mi mnyam yang don dang rgyan gyi tshogs phun sum tshogs pa la ltos nas mnyam pa'i yon tan du 'dod do/ /bzhi pa snyan pa'i yon tan ni/ tshig don gnyis ka la sgra dang don gyi nyams khyad par can dang lda na pa zhig yin te/ de la sgra'i nyams/ don gyi nyams/ gnyis ka la 176

grong tshig spar ba gsum las/ dang po la/ lho ba kho na 'dod pa'i tshig mtshungs nye ba'i sgra'i nyams ni/ tshig snga mar yi ge dang / skye gnas dad / phyi mo dang /brtsegs pa sogs gang sbyar ba de 'og ma rnams su'ang de dang mtshungs par thag nye bar sbyar ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ dad gus gdung bas 'dud pa dang / kun la smra mkhas dngos grub stsol/ /dge mtshan bye ba'i mdzes sku de/ /rtag tu bsten cing snying nas bstod/ /ces tshigs rkang bzhi po la rim par da yig dang / skyes gnas 'greng bu ste phyi mo dang / brtsegs par mtshungs pa rnams sbyar ba lta bu'o/ / 'di la ming gzhi'i gsal byed dang / skye gnas sogs ma/tshungs pa tsam gyis chog la/ sgra rgyan gyi zung ldan la dbyangs gsal sogs cha thams cad nas 'dra ba zhig nges par dgos so/ /lho shar gnyis ka ci rigs par 'dod pa rjes khrid kyi sgra'i nyam sa ni/ tshigs gong 'og tu ming gzhi la gsal byed kyi yi se/ gcig yang yang gcig rjes su gcig khrid pa ltar bzlas te 'byung ba ni rjes khrid kyi do na yin te/ 'di la lho shar gnyis ka 'dod pa'i rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/ rgya chen chos kyi dgongs don rnams/ /rgyab rten lung dang rigs pa bcas/ /rgyal ba'i bzhed pa ji bzhin du/ /rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa legs par sto na/ /zhes pa lta ra rkang pa so sor rgya dang rgyab ces sogs ra mgo can gyi rgya la bskor bas na rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ces bya'o/ /gnyis ka 'dod bi tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/ rab 'byams chos kyi rang ba'in rnams/ / ma lu sa ji bzhin ma nor gzigs/ /thugs rjes kun la rjes brtse ba'i/ /mgon po khyod la mgo ngos 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu rkang pa'i tshig la rab dang rang / ma gnyis/ rjes gnyis/ mgon dang mgo zhes pa rnams bzlas te byung bas na tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ces bya ste/ rjes khrid la bod skad kyi dbang du byas tshe ming gzhi'i yi ge mtshungs pas chog cing 'phul dang mtha' rten sogs gcig pa mtha' gcig tu mi dgos so/ /ring bar thos pa'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/ dpal gyi 'dab ma'i bzhin ras la/ /bung ba'i mig gi dpal 'dzin cing / /dri bral zhal hūṃ ge sa rang / /ma la ya yi dri bsung 'thul/ /zhes dparnyi gnyis dang / traṃ zhes pa gnyis kyi ༷ 177

bar du yi ge shin tu mang pos chod nas rgyang ring bas na ring bar thos pa'i rjes khrid ces bya ste/ 'di rjes khrid du lho pas nam yang mi 'dod cing / shar phyogs pa'ang mtha' gcig tu 'dod pa ma yin no/ /zhes rin spungs pas gsung / dharma kirti ni/yul dbus pa 'ga' zhig dang / shar phyogs pa 'dod par bshad do/ /shar pa kho na 'dod pa'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/ sgom sgrub chos sgras sgrib las sgrol/ /sgeg mo sgor sgug mchu sgrog sgrib/ /gdong mdzes 'chad glon 'dod ༷pa daXg/ bsdig parme don dzu mdoX ru dong /༷/zhermi tshigs ༷su bcad pa'i phyed snga ma sgrob pa'i yi ge sa rmego can gyi ༷sga yig ༷bskor zhing / phyed phyi ma 'jam pa da yig la o sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsub bsres pa'i rjes khrid lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa don gyi nyams ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i sgra'i nyams kyang snyan pa'i ro nyams phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan mod/ de las kyang rgyan rme tha' dag la snyan pa dang sgeg pa sogs brjod bya'i don gyi nyams khyad par can 'don pa shin tu gal che ste/ sgra'i nyams rna bar snyan pa tsam pi wang dang gling bu'i sgra la'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sgra don gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba la/ dang po spang bya don gyi grong pa ni/ dper na/ snying sdug mdzes ma khyod mthong bas/ /yid la chags pa lhag par rgyas/ /'o dar 'khyud pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /'dod dgu'i rtsed 'jor rol zhig gu/ /zhes pa'i brjod don ngo tsha'i gnas su gyur pa tshogs pa'i mdun sar dbyung du mi rung ba lta bu ni don gyi grong ba dang / de spong byed kyi nyams ji ltar 'don pa ni/ zla ba'i bzhin ras 'dzum 'od kyis/ /yid kyi chu gter ci yang rgyas/ /ku mu da yi dga' ston gyis/ /longs spyod gsar ba stsol cig kye/ /zhes pa lta bu ste tshig snga phyi gnyis kyi brjod don 'dod pa'i gtam du mtshungs kyang snga ma ltar na btsog gtam du 'gyur la/ phyi ma ni btsog gtam de bsgribs te snyan pa'i ro nyams dang ldan par byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgra'i grong pa la/ tshig gi mtshams sbyor gyis zhugs pa ni/ tshig gi gcod mtshams nor na don log 'gro ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ ma ma byas pa'i lus can ni/ /gang yang tshad mas ma dmigs phyir/ /pho mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yis/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par lta bar byed/ /ces pa ma dang pho zhes yar gcod dgos pa la ma ma dang po 178

ma tshan zhes mar bcad na don 'o ga nas mi mdzes par 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /ngag tshig gi don la zhugs pa'i grong ba ni/ tshig gcig yin na'ang don tha dad la 'jug pa'i dbang gis log pa mi mdzes par nor 'gro ba zhig yin te/ dpewa na/ rab tu gdung ba 'phrog byed pa'i/ /yid 'ong pad+ma can dag la/ /tshim med ci dgar rol ba yi/ /dga' bde'i snang ba yud tsam yin/ /zhes pa pad+ma can ni mtsho dang bud med gnyis ka la 'jug pas tsha bas gdung ba mtsho la 'khrus kyi phyir rol ba'i don du bas ma mod/ go lugs gcig la chags pas gdung ba bud med la rol ba'i don du go nas btsog gtam du 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /dmigs bsal skyon med pa ni/ dper na/ mi brtan 'gyur ba'i chos can gyi/ /ma sring mo yi rang bzhin la/ /bu tshas byams shing dbang po ni/ /nam yang g.yo ba'i go skabs bral/ /zhes mo'i rang bzhin ni mo mtshan dang / dbang po pho mtshan la 'jug kyang ma sring dang bu tsha smos pas btsog gtam du go thabs med pa 'di lta bu ni skyon yod pa ma yin no/ /lnga ba shin tu gzhon pa'i yon tan la/ dngos lho pa'i lugs ni/ 'jam pa'i yi ge shas che zhing mang ba'i tshig sbyor zhig ste/ dper na/ yid 'ong 'dam skyes dga' tshal du/ /'dod dgur rgyu ba'i glu dbyangs mkhan/ /dregs ldan sbrang rtsi spyo no pa rnams/ /sna tshogs gar gyis rtsen par byed/ /ces yi ge tsheg bar nyer 0brgyad zlos rtsub pa'i tshe/ parno bdun dang 'jam pa nyer gcig yod pas shas che ba lta bu yin zhing / yi ge thams cad 'jam pa ni sbyor ba lhod pa'i skyon du bshad do/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i lugs ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i 'jam pa shas che ba de skabs 'gar sbyar yang phal cher rtsub pa'i yi ge mang zhing brjod dka' ba zhig la 'dod de/ dper na/ legs skyes rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i tshul/ /snye ma phang phung chags pa'i rtser/ /skad snyan sgrog spro'i ko ki rlo/ /sgro /shog brkyangs te garja staXbs ༷bsgyung/ /zhes rtsub pa'iX yi go mdza bas brjod dga' ba'i 6ga sbyor lta bu'o/ /drurgo pa dorno gsal gyi yon tan la/ dngos lho shar gnyis ka 'dod pa ni/ brjod bya'i don de sgra dang rtags las gsal bas gtan tshigs kyis brtag mi dgos pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ bde 'byung gtsug rgyan zla tshes 'di/ /sum rtsen tshogs kyis 179

nor rgyas sprul/ /lhun por dkris nas 'o ma'i mtsho/ /legs par bsubs pa dag las byung / /zhes dbang phyug gi gtsug rgyan zla tshes ni rgya ma tsho bsrubs pa las byung bar tshig zin la gsal bas brtag mi dgos par go nus pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ni/ bstan don de rjod byed kyi sgras ma zin cing rigs pas kyang bsgrub mi nus pas mi gsal zhing go dka' ba zhig ste/ dper na/ mtho ris gtso bo mgrin sngon gyi/ /gtsug rgyan gsar ba'i zla tshes ni/ / nag po brtsegs pa'i spun zla ste/ /chu gter chen po dag las byung / /zhes pa'i brjod bya snga ma dang gcig kyang zla tshes rgya mtsho la/sa ji ltar byung ba mi gsal bas brtags kyang go dka' ba lta bu'o/ /'di dang gong gi rab dwangs gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ rab dngas ni brjod bya'i don de 'jig rten la grags pa zhig nges par dgos la/ don gsal ni 'jig rten la grags ma grags khyad med cing sgra dang rtags las don gsal bar rtogs nus pa zhig yin/ shar pa'i lugs la'ang rab dwangs ni nges tshig 9pa brtags pas go nas shing / don gsal ni de ltar ma yin par gtam rgyud ma shes na brtags pas go mi nus pa'o/ /bdun pa rgya che ba'i yo/na tan la/ dngos lho pa'i 'u gas ni/ don 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs las brjod yul de khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan dang ldan par rtogs nus pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ mtsho byung lha mo'i mtshan snyan ni/ /sgra 'dzin lam du lhung tsam gyis/ /mkhas pa tshogs pa'i ma/dun sa ru/ /smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i mtshan la byin rlabs che bar dngos su ma smras kyang / mtshan tsam thos pas mkhas pa'i mdun sar smra ba'i spobs pa che bar gyur par smos pa'i shugs kyis mtshan tsam la'ang byin rlabs shin tu che ba'i yon tan yod par rtogs nus pa lta bu 'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i lugs ni/ bsngags par 'os pa'i khyad par gyi chos 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs las chos de dang ldan pa'i chos can de ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan rgya chen po dang ldan par go nus pa zhig ste/ dper na/ yid bzhin pad+ma'i dga' tshal du/ /rnga yab thogs pa'i bu mo yi/ /gser gyi mgul rgyan las 'phyang ba'i/ /mu tig do shal sil sil sgrog/ ces pad tshal dang mgul rgyan mu tig gi do shal sogs 180

khyad par gyi chos dngos su smos pa na de ldan gyi gzhi chos can de 'byor ba'i yon tan rgya chen po dang ldan par shugs la go nus pa lta bu'o/ /'di dang 'og gi rgya che ba'i rgyan gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ 'di ni bsngags par 'os pa'i khyad par tharmes cad la sbyar du rung la/ don rgyan gyi rgya che ba ni bsam pa dang 'byor ba rgya che ba gnyis tsam du zad pas spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod do/ /brgyad pa brjid pa'i yon tan ni/ tshig sdud mang po can gyi sbyor ba zhig yin zhing / 'di la shar pa'i lugs ni/ tshig sdud mang zhing yi ge lci yang grangs mi mnyam pa'i tshig sbyor zhig la 'dod de/ dper na/khyod gdong mdzes pa la gnas pa'i/ /brten pa 'phrog pa mig gi 'phrul/ /chu skyes lte ba la g.yo ba'i/ /bung ba'i dpal la co 'dri byed/ /ces pa'i tshig sbyor tshig sdud can la lci ba bco brgyad dang yang ba bcu ste lci yang cha mi mnyam pa lta bu'o/ /lho pa'i lugs ni/tshig sdud can gyi sbyor ba lci yang mnyam pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ ku mu da kha bye ba bzhin/ /zhal dkyil rgyas pa dkar la mdzes/ /me gcig sgra dbyangs lha mo las/ /smra ba zla med spobs pa stsol/ /ces yi ge lci yang bcu bzhir yod par mnyam pa'i tshig sdud can gyi sbyong ba lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir bod yig la lci yang gi khyad par ni/ 'greng bu dang / na ro dang / mtha' rten can rnams lci ba dang / gu gu dang / zhabs kyu can dang / mtha' rten med pa rnams yang bar mkhas pa rnams gsung ngo / /dgu pa mdzes pa'i yo na tan la/ dngos lho pa'i lugs ni/ bstod yul de'i bsngags pa 'jig rten pa'i grags tshod ltar mchog dam na bar ma kun gyi blo ngor 'tsham par brjod pa zhig yin te/ 'di la sbyar gzhi sngon byung gi gtam la sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/sra mkhregs sa 'dzin bgrod pa dag/ phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /'joms pa'i lha dbang grags snyan gyis/ /sum rtsen khyon kun dog por bgyis/ /zhes pa'i gtam rgyud sngon ri rnams 'gro 'dug byed pas sems can mang po la gnod pa na brgya byin gyis rdo rje bsnun nas ri'i rkang pa bcag ces pa'i grags pas lha yul gyi khyon thams cad 'gengs zhes ran pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bsngags pa la sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/ legs byas bye ba'i dpal yon can/ /lha cig 'di yi gtong phod kyis/ /181

'bangs rnams dbul ba kun btang nas/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par byed/ /ces rgyal po'i gtong ba'i yon tan 'jig rten pa'i blo ngor 'tsham par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i lugs ni/ bstod yul gyi bsngags pa 'jig rten gyi grags tshod las 'das par blo yul du mi shong ba lta bur sgro btags te brjod pa zhig yin te/'di gtam la sbyar ba ni dper na/ mkhar nyal gtso bo lha dbang gi/ phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /sa 'dzin bgrod pa 'joms pa yi/ /grags snyan kun gsal khyon las brgal/ /zhes gtam/ rgyud snga ma ltar la brgya byin gyis ri rnams 'joms pa'i grags pa nam mkha'i mtha' las brgal ces 'jig rten na mi srid par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bsngags pa la sbyar ba ni/ dper na/ bsod nams bgo skal la spyod pa'i/ /sa gzhi skyong ba khyod kyi ni/ /phun tshogs dge mtshan yon tan 'di/ /lha dbang la yang yod re skan/ /zhes mi yi rgyal po 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal lha'i dbang po la'ang med ces ha cang sgro btags te 'jig rten pa'i blo yul las 'das par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /shar pa'i mdzes pa'i yon tan 'di dang 'og gi phul byung gi rgyan gnyis 'khrul so che yang / phul byung gi rgyan ni/ 'jig rten na ji ltar gnas tshod kyi mtshams las 'das par gyur pa'i nyams kyis blo ngor 'tsham par brjokhu pa zhig yin la/ 'di ni ha cang 'ud che ba'i ngag gis sgro btags te phal ba'i blo yul du mi shong bar brjod pa zhig yin pas khyad par che'o/ /bcu pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan ni/ chos can gzhan la yod pa'i khyad par gyi chos dngos po gzhan zhig la btags nas bkod pa na 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad la mdzes shing rna bar snyan pa zhig yin te/ 'di la dper brjod gsum las/ spyir brjod pa ni/ dper na/ tsha zer myos chu 'thung ba yis/ /ut+pal gnyid du yur ba la/ /rgyu skar bdag po 'dzum mu le/ /bsil zer bran pas sad par byed/ /ces 'ga' zhig chang 'thung nas ra ro ste gnyid du song ba dang sad pa'i khyad par gyi chos de chos can gzhan ut+pal dang zla zer la btags nas brjod pa lta bu'o/ /chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dper na/ chu gter zla 'od zag pa rnams/ /'thungs nas rlabs phreng zag pa yi/ /rab g.yo'i kha las lhu ba'i rgyun/ /yang 182

nas yang du zag pa bzhin/ /zhes gzhan gyi chos zag pa gcig pu de dngos po gzhan rgya mtsho dang zla ba la btags nas bkod pas na chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dper na/ snang byed 'od kyi lde mig gis/ /dri bzang khang pa kha phye tshe/ /ra yig gnyis pa gnyid sad nas/ /bag med rol rtsed ci dgar 'thung / /zhes dngos po gzhan la yod pa'i khyad par gyi chos du ma de gzhan pad+ma dang bung ba la btags nas bkod pas na chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan zhes bya'o/ /'di dang don rgyan gyi bsdus brjod dang / rab rtog gi rgyan gsum gyi khyad par ni/ 'di ni gzhan gyi chos gzhan la btags nas bkod pa zhig yin la/ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/ gzhan gyi chos gzhan la 'jo/da dgos par ma nges shing mtshungs pa'i dngos po tsam brjod cing thams cad la sbyar du rung ba'ang yin no/ /rab rtog gi rtan ni/ dngos po'i gnas tshul gzhan du sgro btags pa tsam las gzhan gyi chos gzhan la bkod pa'i nges pa med cing / dpe rgyan gyi mtshungs gsal bzhin rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra'ang nges par tshang dgos pa yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan 'di ni lam gnyis ku'i thun mong gi yon tan du dpang los gsungs pa ltar mkhas pa phal cher 'dod la/ snar thang lo tsā pas/ yang na snga ma gnyis bai dat+ta'i yin la/ phyi ma gcig pu gau ḍā wa'i yin par byas na'ang legs gsung ba/thun mong ma yin pa zhes pa'i go don dang mthun pa sogs dgos pa du ma yod pas legs bshad du snang ngo / /lho shar mkhas pa so so yi/ /thun mong min pa'i yon tan bcu'i/ /dper brjod go don dang bcas pa/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal tshul du bkod/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u dang po'i don bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong gi rgyan bshad pa ni/ lho shar gnyis kyi mkhas pa rnams mthun par thun mong du bzhed pa'i rgyan yin pas na thun mong gi rgyan ces bya'o/ /'di la dbye na gsum/ /don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan dang / gab tshig gi rgyan no/ /dang po ni/brjod bya'i don sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i rgyan yin pas na don rgyan ces bya zhing /dbye na so lnga yod de/ gzhung nyid las/ rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /183

gzugs can gsal byed skor ba dang / /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ldog pa can dang srid pa can/ /bsdus dang phul byung rab btags dang / /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can/ /rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan/ /rgya che bston dor sbyar ba dang / /khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang / /'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang / /zol bstod nges par bsta na pa dang / /lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shis/ /rab spel de nas dgongs pa can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de las dang po rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ chos de'i gnas tshul las gzhan du sgro ma btags par rang bzhin gang yin drang por brjod pa'i rgyan cig yin te/dper na/ mtshan dpe lang tsho rab rgyas sku/ /snyan 'jebs tshangs dbyangs ldan pa'i gsung / /dri bral chos kun gzigs pa'i thugs/ /dbyangs can lha mos dge legs stsol/ /ces dbyangs can ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams skro ma btags par gnas tshul drang lor brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dpe rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor der dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor phye ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa zhig yin te/dper na/ mdzes sdug 'dzum ras rgyas pa'i zhal/ /ston zla bye ba'i dpal dang mtshungs/ /thags bzang tshems dkar phreng ba ni/ /mu tig star la brgyus pa 'dra/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i zhal ras dang tshems phreng ston zla dang mu tig gi phreng ba dang mtshungs par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor ma phye bar dpe can de dpe'i gzugs su bkod nas brjod pa'i tshig sbyor zhig yin te/ dper na/ mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor cha shas rdzogs/ /byin mebs 'od brgya'i dra ba can/ /blo gros ku mun bzhad mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i lha mo mtshan mo'i mgon/ /zhes dpe can dbyangs can ma sogs dpe zla ba'i gzugs sogs su bkod de brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan ni/ tshigs su bcad pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung na yod pa'i tshig gcig gis de'i don gzhan rnams gsal bar byed pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ smon no lha dbang dpal 'byor la/ /'dod ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams te/ /khyod kyi yon tan phung po la'ang / /blo gsal thar 184

'dod rnams kyis so/ /zhes thog ma'i tshig smon zhes pa 'dis sred ldan lha dbang gi dpal 'byor la smon pa dang / thar 'dod kyis dbyangs can ma'i yo/ na tan la smon pa gnyis ka gsal bar byed pa lta bu'o/ /lnga ba skor ba'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor de'i thog ma/tha' bar gsum gang rung du don dang tshig dang tshig don gnyis ka 'dra ba ci rigs bskor te brjod kyang zlos skyon med pa zhig ste/ dper na/ mtshar sdug sku yis gzhan yid 'phrog/ yid 'bab gsung gis som nyi bcil/ /byin rlabs rgyan gyis sdig ltung 'khrud/ /thugs rjes blo mun ma lus sel/ /zhes 'phrog bcal/ 'khrud/sel sogs don 'dra ba bzlas te brjod kyang dbyangs can ma'i sku sogs khyad gzhi tha dad la sbyar ba'am brjod tshul tha dad pas zlos skyon mi 'byung ba lta bu'o/ / drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor der dgag bya'i yul gang yang rung ba la de 'gog byed kyi tshig brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan bzhin du/ /'jam ma nyen phra ldem phyag zung gis/ /rgyud mangs sbreng ba'i ngal 'dis ci/ /zhes ngal ba 'dis ci bya zhes 'gog byed kyi tshig gis rgyud mangs sbreng ba 'gog pa lta bu'o/ / bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan ni/brjod 'dod kyi chos 'ga' zhig sngon 'a bkod nas de'i sgrub byed cig spyi khyab tu rjes su brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ thugs rje'i gter chen tshangs sras ma/ /'gro la ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /yid ba'in nor bus skye dgu yi/ /re 'dod rab tu skong bar byed/ /ces dbyangs can ma ngag gi dngos grub ster nus pa'i sgrub byed du yid bzhin nor bus re 'dod skong nus pa bkod pa lta bu'o/ /brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan ni/brjod bya'i dngos po gnyis sngon la mtshungs par bstan nas slar mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ mtsho byung ma dang bsam 'phel nor/ /re 'dod skong la nyer mtshungs mod/ /'di ni bem chos rang bzhin te/ /lha mo sgrib bral ye shes dngos/ /zhes sngon la mtsho byung ma dang bsam 'phel nor bu gnyis re 'dod skong ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par bstan te/ slar de gnyis ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin min gyi khyad par phye nas mi mtshungs par ston pa lta bu'o/ /dgu pa srid pa can gyi 185

rgyan ni/ rab tu grags pa'i rgyu la ma ltos par 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo 'byung srid par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri rngo/ bkra/ /ma phyis dri bral zhal dkyil mdzes/ /bcol med phan bde spel bar mdzad/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes dbyangs can lha/ /zhes rgyu tshon gyis 'bri ba sogs la ma ltos par 'bras bu mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba sogs 'byung srid par ston pa lta bu'o/ /bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po 'ga' zhig la bsams nas de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan zhig dngos su brjod pa'i sgo nas brjod don dngos de go bar byed pa yin te/ dper na/ shin tu snyan pa'i gre 'gyur dang / /ngo mtshar 'dab gshog zung 'brel can/ /yid 'ong ngang pa'i bu mo yis/ /bdag la rab tu brtse bar mdzod/ /ces brjod don dbyangs can ma la bsams nas dngos su de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan 'dab chags ngang pa brjod pa lta bu'o/ / bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan ni/brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de la blo yul du mi shong ba ltar bsngags pa lhag par byas pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ rgyal kun gcig bsdus yum khyod kyi/ /ngo mtshar yon tan phung po ni/ /dpag nus min yang 'dir shong ba/ /e ma khyod thugs shin tu yangs/ /zhes dbyangs/ can ma'i yon tan la bsngags 'dod kyi blos yon tan rkya che ba de shong ba ni thugs kyi khyon shin tu yangs zhes ha cang phul du byung ba'i rnam pas brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gnyis pa rab btags kyi rgyan ni/ rab rtog kyang zer ro/ /dngos po de'i gnas tshul drang por mi brjod par rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags nas brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ dbyangs can lha mo phyag sor gyis/ /nor bu'i rgyud mangs sbreng ba 'di/ /ting 'dzin bde bas thugs sun te/ /'dod yon sgra la g.yengs sam snyam/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i phyag mtshan pi wang sbreng ba la ting nge 'dzin gyis bde bas thugs sun nas sgra snyan la g.yengs par sgro btags nas brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan ni/ /brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de'i byed po'i rgyu'i rigs go bar byed pa'i sgo nas ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ phul byung chu zheng gab pa'i sku/ /yid 'ong zhal dkyil 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /ga bur thigs phreng spro ba 'di/ /yid la dga' ba skyed pa'i 186

rgyu/ /zhes dga' ba skyed pa'i rgyu khyad par ba dbyangs can ma'i sku'i yon tan ston pa lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir skyed byed dang / nyams byed dang / sgyu ra byed sogs byed po'i rigs la rgyur 'jog pa yin pas skyed byed kyi rgyu kho nar ma nges/ de dag brjod byar byed pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba ni rgyu'i rgyan du bshad do/ /bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan ni/ lu sa kyi brda'i zur ram rnam 'gyur phra mo'i sgo nas don de go bar byed pa zhig yin te/dper na/ khyod kyi zhabs zung dran pa'i tshe/ /sor bcu snying ga'i ngos su zum/ /ma/khas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa ru/ /bzhin gyi mdangs kyang rab tu rgyas/ /zhes kedabyangs can ma'i zhabs zung dran pa na thal mo sbyar ba'i brda dang / bzhin mdangs rgyas pa'i rnam 'gyur phra mo des nang gi dad pa dang spobs pa mchog tu gyur pa go nus pa lta bu'o/ /rgyan 'di la 'ag 'a zhig ngag tu ye ma brjod pa'i snyan ngag tu 'dod zer ba ni brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi khyad par ma phyed pa ste/ 'dir ngag gi rnam 'gyur du ma thon pa'i lus kyi brda dang rnam 'gyur phra mo de brjod byar byed pa'i tshig phreng la bya dgos pas ngag tu ma brjod pa dang snyan ngag yin pa 'gal lo/ /des na dper brjod dang 'grel pa 'gar/ lus ngag sogs kyi brda dang rnam 'gyur zhes pa'ang ngag si brdas don gzhan go bar byed pa ni bsdung ge brjod kyi rgyan du gtogs la/ sogs kyi sgras kyang don gzhan bsdu rgyu med pas 'thad par ma mthong ngo / /bco lnga pa cha'i rgyan ni/dngos po'i rang bzhin gsal ba'i rnam pa de zol gyis sgrib cing sped par byed pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ sgra dbyangs lha mo'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rig gzhung thogs med smra ba la/ /sgyu ma lus kyi khams snyoms pas/ /smra lce bde ba yin pa skad/ /ces 'phags ma'i mthus spobs pa thogs pa med pa de zol gyis sbed pa'i phyir khams snyoms pas smra lce bde ru song zer ba lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir cha'i don la/ sgrib byed kyi cha la sbyar tshul dang / bsgrib bya'i cha la sbyar tshul gnyis yod do/ /bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni/dngos po 'ga' zhig sngon la bkod nas de dang 'brel ba'i don rnams rim pa bzhin du rjes su brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ 'phags ma khyod kyi sku dang ni/ /gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba dang / rab tu mdzes dang zab cing snyan/ /dri bral chos kun 187

gzigs pa la gas/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i sku gsung thugs rnams sngon du bkod nas/rjes su de gsum gyi yon tan rim pa bzhin rab tu mdzes pa sogs brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan ni/ rgyu 'ga' zhig la brten nas dga' ba khyad par can skyes par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gcig pu/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo'i mtshan snyan 'di/ /de ring thos pas dga' ba la/ /bsam gtan bde bas mtshon nus min/ /zhes 'phags ma'i mtshan thos pas dga' ba khyad par can skyes par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de yid du 'ong mi 'ong sogs kyi nyams dang ldan par brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ dpag yas bskal par mjal dka' ba'i/ /'phags ma'i gsang gsum yon tan gyi/ /cha tsam/ mos pa'i skal ba 'di/ /bsam gyin dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen/ /zhes 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan la cung zad mos pa'i skal ba thob pa 'di bsam bzhin yid la dga' ba cher rgyas nas lus kyis gar byed par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gong gi dga' ba'i rgyan gyi dga' ba ni/ nang bsam pa'i 'gyur ba lus ngag tu ma thon pa dang / nyams ldan gyi dga' ba'i nyams ni/ nang gi dga' ba de 'phel nas lus ngag shi/ rnam 'gyur du thon pa'i phyi rol gyi nyams yin no/ /'o na rnam pa'i phra mo dang khyad par ci yod snyam na/ de ni 'dod don dngos su ma brjod par phyi'i brda dang rnam 'gyur phra mo las go dgos la/ nyams ldan ni 'dod don de brjod pa la gsal bar yod do/ /le'u dang po'i snyan pa'i yon tan dang mi 'dra ste/ snyan pa'i yon tan ni sgra don gnyis ka la grong tshig spangs pa'i sgo nas ro nyams khyad par can gtso bor 'don tshul yin zhing / 'dir nyams ldan ni/ dga' ba 'phel ba sgeg pa'i nyams dang / khro ba 'phel ba drag shul gyi nyams sogs phyi lus kyi nyams brgyad kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can gyi rgyan ni/ shin tu nga rgyal ba lta bu'i tshig zil che ba brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ mthu stobs shugs kyis bdud sde'i dpung / /lhag med bsregs zhes 'jigs mi dgos/ /tshul ldan zhabs rdul bsten pa la/ /'phags ma'i thugs rje mchog tu bsil/ /zhes dbyangs can ma nus mthu shin tu 188

che ba'i gzi brjid can du ston pa'i tshig sbyor lta bu'o/ /nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ 'dod don de dngos su ma brjod par de 'grub pa'i thabs kyi rnam grangs gzhan brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ mi bzad duḥkhas mnarno ba yi/ /mkha' mnyam yid can ma/ lus min/ /'phags ma'i thugs rjes sgrol bar mdzod/ /bdag lta ji ltar 'gyur yang bla/ /'di ni bdag sgrol bar mdzod ces ma smras kyang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i khongs su rang nyid yod pas rang sgrol ba'i thabs su gyur ba lta bu'o/ /rgyan 'di bsdus brjod dang / phra mo dang / cha rgyan rnams dang 'dres par mi 'gyur te/bsdus brjod ni/ 'dod don dpe can dngos bsdus nas dpe brjod pa yin la/ phra mo/ ni/ bsam don de brda dang rnam 'gyur phra mos go dgos pa dang / cha rgyan ni/don dngos mi mdzes pa lta bu zol gyis sbas nas rnam pa gzhan du brjod pa zhig yin pas mi 'dra'o/ /nyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ bya ba 'ga' zhig rtsom pa la 'bad mi dgos par de la phan pa'i rkyen gzhan byung bar ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ lang long 'du 'dzis yid sun zhing / /bsags pa'i las la zhe 'tsher dus/ /'phags ma'i thugs rjes rkyen ngan rnams/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs su shar/ /zhes 'du 'dzis sun zhing las ngan bsags pa rnams dran te 'jigs skrag nas chos byed 'dod byung ba'i tshe/ 'phags ma'i byin rlabs kyis rkyen ngan gang byung de la phan pa'i grogs su shar zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/ bsam pa'am 'byor ba rgya che ba blos gzhal mi nus pa lta bur brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ bgrang yas skye dgu rnams kyi khams/ /byang chub gsum la ma bkod pa/ /de srid gzhan don kho nar gzhol/ /e ma 'phags ma'i thugs bskyed rmad/ / ces skye dgu glurnams nges legs gsum la ma bkod par du de rnams kyi don kho na mdzad pa'i 'phags ma'i thugs bskyed ni rmad du byung zhes bsam pa shin tu rgya che bar ston pa lta bu'o/ /nyer gsum pa bston dor gyi rgyan ni/ chos de'i rang bzhin la de ma yin no zhes bston nas gzhan du ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ ngag dbang lha mo'i zhal dkyil 'di/ /bzhim ras ma yin nya gang zla/ /dkyus ring g.yo 'di spyan min gyi/ /bung ba zung dag 189

'khor ba'o/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i zhal dang spyan la de ma yin zhes bston nas gzhan zla ba dang bung ba yin par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/ rjod byed kyi tshig gcig brjod bya'i don gnyis la sbyar rung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/kun khyab dbyings la rab gnas shing / /dkar mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho can/ /gdung sel bdud rtsi ci yang spro/ /mtsho las byung ba gtsug gi rgyan/ /ces pa 'di dbyangs can ma dang zla ba gnyis ka la sbyar rung ste/ dbyangs can ma ni thugs kun khyab chos kyi dbyings la g.yo med du gnas shing sku mdog dkar ba sogs dang / srid zhi'i gdung ba sel ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi spro ba dang / mtsho byung mar grags shing skal ldan gyi gtsug rgyan du 'os pa yin la/ zla ba ni kun khyab nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas shing tsha gdung sel ba'i bdud tsi'i 'od dkar 'phro ba sogs dang / sngon lha rnams rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung bar grags shing lha dbang phyug chen pos gtsug rgyan du byas pa'o/ /gong gi dpe dang gzugs can gyi rgyan sogs kyi sbyar ba rnams kyang 'di'i bye brag go/nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ dngos po 'ga' zhig la chos de'i khyad par ma tshang yang de'i bya ba byed nus par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ zur mig 'khyog pos ma btab la/ /yid 'ong 'dzum gyis ma bsus shing / /mdza' ba'i tshig gis brid min par/ /bdag yid 'phrogs so tshangs sras ma/ /zhes dbyangs can ma yid 'phrog pa'i khyad chos zur mig gis lta ba dang / 'dzum gyis bsus pa dang / mdza' ba'i tshig gis brid pa sogs ma tshang yang yid 'phrog nus par ston pa lta bu'o/ /nyer drug pa ma tshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ni/ yul 'ga' zhig don la mi mtshungs kyang bstod smad ci rigs pa'i don du mtshungs par sbyor te brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ zla zer byugs pa'i gangs kyi ri/ /dkar mdzes chu 'dzin lang long dang / /yid 'ong ngang pa gzhon nu ma/ /dbyangs can lha rnams 'dren byed rgyan/ / ces dbyangs can ma la bstod pa'i don du zla 'od 'phrog pa'i gangs ri sogs dang dbyangs can ma rnams phyogs gcig tu sbyar te brjod pa lta bu'o/ /nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du bya ba dang las dang rdzas la sogs pa'i chos 'gal ba du ma rnams lhan cig 190

tu 'grogs par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ bzhin ras rab blum spyan dkyus ring / /dbu skra gnag cing tshems phreng dkar/ /nu 'bur mtho yang long bu dma'/ /'phags ma'i sku 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /ces zlum pa dang ring ba/ gnag pa dang dkar ba/ mtho ba dang dma' ba sosas chos 'gal ba du ma dbyangs can ma'i sku la lhan cig tu 'grogs par ston pa lta bu'o/ /nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan ni/ yul 'ga' zhig bstod pa'i 'os sam skabs min yang rang gi 'dod pa kho nas rang dgar bsngags pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ dbyangs can sgom sgrub mchod bstod sogs/ /long med dka' spyad tshul 'di las/ / bag yangs spyod pa'i ro nyal mkhan/ /'du gsum pa 'di snang ba bde/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i sgom/ bzlas la brtson pas rtags tsam yang ma byung bas yid skyo nas bstod pa'i 'os min pa bag med ci dgar byed pa la bsngags pa lta bu'o/ /nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan ni/ yul 'ga' zhig la smad pa ltar byas te don la bstod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ 'ching ba kun lda na bde 'byung yang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol nus na/ /nyon mongs dri bral dbyangs can ma/sa/ / mchog thun stsol la mtshar ci mchis/ /zhes 'ching ba dang ldan pa'i lha dbang phyug gis ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster nus na/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma spangs pa'i dbyangs can ma khyod kyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsol pa 'di la ngo mtshar rgyu ci yod ces smad pa ltar byas kyang don la dbang phyug las lhag par bstod pa lta bu'o/ /sum cu pa nges bsta na gyi rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i don snga mas de dang mtshungs pa'i 'bras bu mchog dman ci rigs rjes su nges par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ 'od ldan nyin byed shar ba na/ /mtshan mor spyod rnams ldong bar 'gyur/ /'phags ma'i ngo mtshar mdzad bzang dag/ nag phyogs nyams pa gsal bar byed/ /ces nyi ma shar bas 'byung po'i bya rnams yod par gyur pa des 'phags ma'i mdzad bzang dag gis nag phyogs pa rnams nyams par byed pa mtshon no zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /'di don gzhan bkod pa dang mi 'dra ste/ don gzhan bkod pa'i sgrub byed rjes su dgod la/'di sngon du dgod dgos pas mi mtshungs so/ /so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan 191

ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po de'i yon tan dang bya ba rnams lhan cig tu brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ tshangs sras dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dang / /nya rgyas zla dkyil mnyam du shar/ /phul byung mtshan dpe gsal ba dang / /ri dwags mtshan ma lhan cig bkra/ /zhes dbyangs can ma/'i dgyes zhal dang zla dkyil mnyam du shar ba sogs kyi yon tan lhan cig par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i don rnams kyi yon tan dang bya ba sogs phan tshun brjes pa ltar ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ ma smad thugs rje'i snang ba'i gzis/ /gdul bya'i blo mun kun 'phrogs nas/ / thogs med smra ba'i rnam dpyod dag/ ris med yongs la ci yang sbyin/ /zhes dbyangs can mas gdul bya'i blo mun 'phrogs pa dang rnam dpyod stsol ba gnyis brjes pa lta ra brjod pa lta bu'o/ /so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan ni/ mngon par 'dod pa'i don 'ga' zhig la smon pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ bdag cag tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshangs spyod dpal ldan rten brgyud de/ /lhag pa'i lha mos rjes bzung nas/ /dri bral chos mig 'thob gyur cig/ ces 'dod don tshe rabs kun tu dri bral chos mig 'thob par smon pa lta bu'o/ /so bzhi pa rab spel gyi rkun ni/ tshig sbyor gcig la rgyan tha dad pa mang po bsres pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ khyod sku mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis ma dzes/ /gsung ni dri za'i dbyangs ltar snyan/ /rmad byung thugs rje 'od stong gis/ /'phrogs so bdag cag blo mun kun/ /zhes pa'i tshigs rkang dang po rang bzhin brjod pa dang / gnyis pa dpe rgyan/ gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan/rkang pa bzhi pa ni gsal byed kyi rgyan te rgyan bzhi spel ba lta bu'o/ /'di la dpal sgang pa dang / rin spungs pa sogs rgyan gnyis bsres pas kyang chog par bzhed mod/ shong lo dang / snar thang lo tsā pa/ kun mkhyen lnga ba sogs mkhas pa phal cher gyis rgyan gsum phan chad bsres pa zhig dgos par bzhed pa ni gzhung co ba'i don dang 'byor bar sems/ so lnga ba dgongs pa can gī rgyan ni/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi bsam don bcad lhugs spel ma'i tshig sbyor ci rigs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par zhig la byed pa yin te/ dper na/ de ltar dbyangs can byin rlabs mkhar/ /don rgyan gsal ba'i 192

dbyar skyes sgra/ /sgrog las ska la bzang ma/dongs mtha' can/ /rab dga'i gar gyis rtsen par shog/ ces dbyangs can lha mo'i byin rlabs la brten nas don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod go don bcas legs par bshad pa 'dis/ snyan ngag don du gnyer ba'i skal bzang rnams rab tu dga' ba'i gar byed par shog ces brjod bya rnams mdor bsdus te bstan pa lta bu'o/ /de yang snyan ngag mkhan gyis bsta na bcos de grub par ma gyur gyi bar du de'i tshig sbyor gyi rgyun sgrub pa 'i bsam pa ni dgongs pa dang /bcad lhags spel ma'i tshig sbyor gyi rgyun la gnas pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par de nimadagongs pa can gyi rgyan yin no/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ de ni gzhung gi rgyun la yod pa yin pas/ zhes dang / dpang lo chen pos/ dang po dang bar dang tha ma rnams su rgyun la rjes su 'jug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas bod mkhas pa so gas kyis sho lo ka re re tsam gyi nyi tshe ba'i rgyan ma yin par bshad la/dpal sgang pa / rin spungs pa/ kun mkhyen lnga ba chen po sogs kyis/ rjod byed kyi tshig dang brjod bya'i don nyi tshe ba ma yin par snyan ngag gi bstan bcos re re'i don yongs su rdzogs pa tshigs bcad gcig gnyis kyis kyang brjod nus pa dngos po nges bstan /wo na'am/ shis brjod dang dngos po nges bstan lhan cig tu bshad pa lta bu dgongs pa can gyi rgyan du bshad do/ /don rgyan so so'i dbye ba la/ /rang bzhin brjod bzhi dpe rgyan ni/ /so gsum gzugs can nyi shu'o/ /gsal byed bcu gnyis skor rgyan gsum/ /'gog rgyan nyer gsum don gzhan brgyad/ /ldog spyan bcu dang srid rgyan gsum/ /bsdus brjod bzhi dang phul byung bzhi/ /rab rtog gsum dang rgyu rgyan ni/ /bcu drug phra mo'i rgyan la gnyis/ /cha rgyan bzhi dang rim rgyan gcig/ dga' rgyan gnyis dang nyams ldan brgyad/ /gzi brjid rnam grangs kun phan gsum/ /re re nyid yin rgya che gnyis/ /bston dor gsum dang sbyar ba'i rgyan/ /dgu dang khyad par rgyan la lnga/ /ma tshungs par sbyor gnyis 'gal rgyan ni/ /drug dang skabs min bstod pa gcig/zol bstod gsum dang nges bstan gnyis/ /lhan cig brjod gsum yongs brjes 0cig/ shis brjod rab spel dgongs rgyan gsum/ /re re dang bcas gzhung nyid 193

du/ /dper brjod dngos su zin pa'i grangs/ /kun dril nyis brgya rtsa gsum ste/ /rtsa 'grel dag las shes par bya/ /de ltar don rgyan so lnga yi/ /mtshan nyid dper brjod go don bcas/ /mdor bsdus gsal bar bshad pa 'di/ /snyan tshig rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs yin/ /snya na ngag me long las le'u gnyis pa'i don bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgra rgyan bshad pa ni/ rtsod byed kyi sgra sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i rgyan yin pas na/ sgra rgyan ces bya zhing / de la dbye na gsum/ zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa/ bya dka'i khyad par gzhan brjod pa/ dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshig sbyor gang du dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge du ma tshogs pa zhig lan gnyis su bzlas pa'i zung dang ldan pa ni zung ldan zhes bya ste/ dbye na drug bya sla rkang pa'i thog ma na yod pa'i zung ldan/ bya dka' gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan/ mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ kun tu zung ldan/ 'dres pa'i zung ldan/ bzlog pa'i zung ldan no/ /dang po la gsum/ thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ bar du chod pa'i zung ldan/ chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan no/ /dang po ni/ rkang pa'i thog mar dbyangs gsal tshogs pa'i ming lan gnyis su bzlas pa'i zung gi bar du yi ge'amyo/ tshig gzhan gyis bar mchod pa zhig yin te/ dper na tshigs rkang gcig la yod pa ni/ lham lham gser gyi ri bo la/ /thun mtshams gsar bas 'khyud 'dra ba'i/ /yid 'ong mchen 〈pe'i 'jo sgeg can/ /yab gcig rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /zhes tshigs rkang dang po'i thog mar lham zhes pa gnyis kyi bar du yi ge'am tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa lta bu dang / rkang pa gnyis la yod pa dper na/ 'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi bum bzang las/ lhug lhug gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /blo mig dri mas kun sdokrus nas/ /grol mdzad thar 'asdod glengs kyi mgon/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / rkang pa gsum la yod pa dper na/ gsal gsal yid kyi me long ngos /mdzes mdzes khyod sku shar byas nas/ /lhang lhang nga| gis /sol 'debs na/ /thugs rje/ gzinas shig 'jam mgon lha/ /zhes da/ / rkang pa bzhi ga'i thog ma la yod pa ni/ mang mang rgyal sras dbus nyid na/ /zab zab ngo mtshar rten 'byung gtam/ /194 ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷

snyan snyan gsung gis 'doms mdzad pa/ /mkhas mkhas kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje/ /zhes pa lta dzu thog rma 'i tshig 'dra ba gnyis kyi bar du chos /zhan gyis bar ma chod pas na thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa thog ma'i bar chordo pa'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa'i thog ma'i tshig gzugs 'dra ba gnyis kyi bar du chos gzhan gyis chod pa zhig yin te/ tshigs rkang gnyis tsam la yod pa dper na/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes ni/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i 'jo sgeg can/ /dran pa'i byin rlabs bsil zer gyis/ /blo spos ku mud bzhad par mdzad/ /ces tshigs rkang dang po gnyis kyi thog mar rab ces pa zung gi bar du tshig gzhan gyis chod pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du rkang pa gsum la yod pa ni/ dper na/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab gcig bsdus pa/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i rol gar gyis/ /rgyal ba'i /sang gsum mdzad pa'i khur/ /'degs mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma lha/ /zhes ༷dang / rkang pa bzhi ga la yod pa dper na/ rab mdzes yid du 'thad pa'i sku/ /rab 'jebs tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ /rab mang skal bzang gdul bya la/ /rab gsal rnam dpyod spobs pa stsol/ /zhes pa lta bri'o/ /gsum pa thog ma 'i chod cing 0ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ tshigs rkang so so la ltos te tshig gzhan gyis bar du chod kyang rkang pa rang rang gi yi ge 'dra ba zung gi bar du gzhan gyis ma chod pa zhig ste/ dper na/ 'dzum 'dzum ge sar rangs pa ltar/ /'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /snyan snyam zab ldang rgya che'i don/ /snyan snyan rna r+sha'i bdud tsir 'jo/ /zhes tshigs rkang dang po'i 'dzum 'dzum dang / gasnyes the'i 'dzum 'dzum gyi bar du tshig gzhan gyis chod cing / rkang pa rang rang la ltos pa'i 'dzum gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gzhan gyis ma chod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa bya dka' gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa'i thog ma las gzhan du chod pa dang chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan de dag ci rigs byung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab rab 'dus pa/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal rab rab 'bar lhas/ /rgya chen gsung rab rab 'byems la/ /thogs med shes rab rab tu stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa chod cing ma chod pa dang /༷ sdud pa ni dper na/ rmad byung dpal 195

ldan dpal gyi mchog/ 'jam pa'i dpal dang dpal lha mo/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'chad dpal skun 'dus/ /dge legs dngal mnga' jopal gyi zhing / /zhes pa lta bye'o/ /des mats+tshan nas rkang bzhi'i mtha' dang 0/ bar mtsha' dang / thog bar dang / thog mtha' dang / gnas gsum ga la yod pa rnams gnyis gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa snga ma'i mtha' dang / phyi ma'i thog ma gzugs 'dra bar sbyar ba zhig yin te dper na/ bgrang yas rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /yab gcig rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbyangs can lha mo yab yum zuXng/ /zung 'jug mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /༷zhes pa lta bye'o/ /bzhi pa kun tu zung ldaXn la/ /0rkang pa bzlas pa/ tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ zung ldan chen po dang gsum/dang po la tshigs bcad kyi phyed rkang pa gnyis bzlas te yang brjod kyang don tha dad pa ni yang dag sbyar ba zhes pa yin te/ dper na/ rab 'bar 'jam dpal 'od kyis yongs bskor ba/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi 'di/ /zla ba rab 'bar 'od kyis yongs bskor ba/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi 'di/ /zhes phyed snga phyi bzlas te brjod kyang don tha dad pas zlos skyon mi 'byung ba lta bu dang / de las gzhan rkang pa bzlas pa ni/rkang pa lan cig dang / lan gnyis dang / lan gsum gyi bar du ci rigs bzlas te brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ phul byung mkhyen rab gter mnga' ba/ /mtshungs med rgyal sras 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phul byung mkhyen rab gter mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba kun dngos tsong kha ba/ /zhes pa lta bu lan gcig bzlas pa dang / lan gnyis bzlas pa dper na/ rab mdzes yid 'ong mig gi dpal/ /rab mdzes yid 'ong mig gi dpal/ /rab mdzes yid 'ong mig gi dpal/ /'jam dpal zla ba pad gzhon mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lan gsum bzlas pa ni/ rmad byung 'jam dpal gyi sku 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /rmad nyi mi'i dkyil 'khor byung 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /rmad byung zla dkyil 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /rmad byung norabu'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /ces rkang pa gcig lan gsum gyi bar du bzlas kyang sbyor gzhi dang don tha dad pas zlos skyon med pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshigs bcad bzlas pa ni/ tshigs bcad gcig lan gnyis brjod 196

pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ gnyis skyes bram ze tshogs kyis nyer bstan cing / /kun gsal ngogs su rgyu ba yi/ /dkar mdzes yid du 'ong zlabab 'di/ /lus can mig la dpal ster byed/ /gnyis skyes bya/ tshogs kyis nyer bsten cing / /kurno gsal ngogs su rgyu ba yi/ /dkar mdzes yid du 'ong ba 'di ngang pa'i rgyal po/ /lus can mig la dpal ster byed/ /ces tshigs bcad gcig nyid bzlas te brjod pa don tha dad pas na zlos skyon med pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa zung ldan chen po ni/ rkang bzhi'i yig gzugs rnam pa gcig pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ 'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jam dpal mkhyen/ /'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jam dpal mkhyen/ /'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jal dpal mkhyen/ /'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jal dpal mkhyen/ /zhes nan tan dang do gal che ba'i don la yang yang bldabs te brjod kyang dmisas bsal skyon med pa lta bu'o/ /'di lan gsum bzlas pa dang khyad par yod de/ rkang pa lan gsum bzlas pa tsam gyis mi chog par 'di ni rkang pa re re la yang zung ldan gzugs gcig pa snga phyi bar ma chod pa re dgos so/ /lnga ba 'dres pa'i zung ldan ni/ gong du bshad pa'i zung ldan sna tshogs 'dres pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ zab zab dka' gnad ma lus skemakhyen/ /ma khyen rab gter chen 'jam dpal dbyadros/ ༷/dbyangs can lha mo lha mi'i ma lhan/ /margon khyod 'gro kun kun tu skyongs/ /zhes tshigs su /cad pa gcig rla bar ma sdud pa da/ / mtha' thob sbyang ba dang / bar chod pa'i zung ldan rnams bsres pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa dang / tshigs bcad phyed dang /tshigs bcad rangs po gang yang rung ba'i yi ge lugs 'byung las bzlog ste 'byung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ dpal ldan mkhas mdzes rab mchog lha/ /lha mchog rab mdzes mkhas ldan dpal/ /gsung ngag snyan pa'i tshangs dbyangs sgra/ / sgra dbyangs —tshangs pa'i snyan ngag gsurngo / /zhes tshigs rkang dang po ni gnyis pa dang / tshigs rkang gsum pa ni bzhi par rim bzhin yig 'bru rnams lugs ldog tu byung ba lta bu'o/ /des tshigs bcad phyed dang rangs po ldog tshul yang mtshon nus so/ /gnyis pa bya dka'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa la gnyis/ ba glang gcin gyi bya dka' dang / 'khor ba'i 197

rnams mchu dang / ka sde ni mgrin pa'i skye gnas can te gnas gnyis su nges pa'o/ /gsum pa gsal byed nges pa ni/ dper na/ le los lang long las la lus/ /la la lam la lag len log/ 'dod 'dun don du gdung gdung 'dong / /da 'di dad dad dul dul 'dug/ ces pa lta bu ste gsal byed la dang da yig gnyis su nges ṅge'o/ /sgra rgyan bya sla'i zung ldan gyi/ / thog ma'i bar ma chod pa la/ /rkang pa gcig la yod pa bzhi/ /gnyis yod drug dang gsum yod bzhi/ / bzhir yod gcig bcas bco lnga dang / /thog ma'i bar chod bcu gsum ste/ /rkang pa gnyis rer yod pa drug/ gsum yo da gsum dang bzhir yod gcig/ bzhi gar cha gnyis yod pa gsum/ /thog ma'i chod cing ma chod pa/ /gsum bcas thog ma'i zung ldan gyi/ /dbye ba sum cu rtsa gcig yin/ /bya dka' gnas gzhan zung ldan la/ /rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa dang / /de bzhin mtha' dang bar mtha' dang / /thog bar dag dang thog mtha' dang / /gnas gsum mnyam par yod pa la/ /bar chod chod cing ma chod pa/ /gnyis gnyis sbyar bas bcu gnyis yod/ /mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gcig/ bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la/ /phyed bzlas yang dag sbyar ba gsum/ /rkang pa lan gcig bzlas pa drug/ lan gnyis bzlas pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /lan gcig bzlas nga nga tshigs bcad bzlas/ /re re zung ldan chen po ni/ /gcig bcas dbye ba bco lnga'o/ /lnga ba 'dres pa'i zung ldan gcig/ drug pa bzlog pa'i zung lda na la/ /rkang pa bzlog dang tshigs bcad kyi/ /phyed dang rangs po bzlog pa dang / /gsum bcas zung ldan dbye ba ni/ /kun dril drug cu re gsum mo/ /bya dka'i khyad par gzhan la ni/ / ba lang gcin dang phyed 'khor dang / /kun tu bzang po'i 'khor lo gsum/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' la/ /dbyangs dang gnas dang gsal byed gsum/ /re rer bzhi gsum gnyis gcig tu/ /nges pa'i dbye ba bcu gnyis yod/ /de ltar sgra rgyan bya dka' sla'i/ /tshig don rab gsal ut+pal phreng / /gnad 'gag dri bsung 'thul ba 'di/ /blo gsal mgul ba'i mdzes rgyan yin/ /sgra rgyan gyi don mdor bsdus te gsal bar bshad zin to/ /gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du brjod don dngos de gab nas 200

gzhan zhig tu 'khrul ba skyed par byed pa zhig yin la/ dbye na bcu drug yod de/kun tshogs slu byed rim pa bral/ /rab bcom mthun gzugs rtsub myo dang / /grangs dang rab brtags ming du 'dus/ /bsgribs dang mthun sgra rmongs pa dang / /yongs 'phrogs gcig bsgribs gnyis ka bsgribs/ /yongs 'dres dang bcas bcu drug go/dang po kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig ni/ /tshig snga phyi tshogs nas mtshams sbyar ba'i dbang gis ming 'dres te brjod don sbas nas don gzhan du 'khrul bar byed pa zhig yin te/ bod skad la dper na/ rigs ldan mchog tu bzhin bzang ba/ /de ni ma ma lags pas na/ /kun tu sred pa'i zhags pa yis/ /bdag yid 'ching phyir dga' ma yin/ /zhes pa'i brjod don dngos ni rigs ldan bzhin bzang ma de a ma min yang 'dod sred skyed phyir chung ma yin zhes pa la/ don de gab nas bzhin bzang ma de a ma yin pas na yid sred phyir bdag dga' ba ma yin no zhes par 'khrul ba skyed pa lta bu'o/ /de ba'in du don gzhan la grags pa'i sgra dag gis phyogs mthun gyi ming gzhan du 'khrul nas slu bar byed pa ni slu byed kyi gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor gyi gong 'og gi rim pa 'khrugs par byas te gzhan rmongs par byed pa ni rim pa bral ba'i gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i don rtogs dka(1 ba'i tshig sbyor gyis don de bcom pa ltar gyur ba ni rab bcom gyi gab tshig dang / phal ba'am btags pa pa'i don bkod nas brjod don dngos de bsgribs par byas pa ni mthun pa'i gzugs kyi gab tshig dang / sgra brtsod rung tsam yod pa'i tshig rtsub mos brjod don dngos de bsgribs pa ni rtsub mo'i gab tshig dang / yi ge'i grangs kyis kun tu rmongs par byas nas brjod don bsgribs pa ni grangs kyi gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i don de sbas nas rnam pa gzhan zhig tu rtog cing / snang bar byed pa ni rab brtags kyi gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i ming gcig la sna tshogs pa'i don du mar brtags nas gab pa ni ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig dang / bstan bya'i tshig de ni chos mtshungs gzhan zhig la 'jug pas de go zhing brjod don dngos de bsgribs pa ni bsgribs pa'i gab tshig dang/ ming mthun pa'i sgra'i rnam grangs du ma bkod nas brjod don dngos de rtogs dka' bar byed pa ni ma thun pa'i 201

sgra'i gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i don mngon sum du bstan yang tshig de nyid 'khruba'i rgyur song nas rmongs par byed pa ni rmongs pa'i gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor mang brgyud mar byas te snga ma snga ma'i don phyi ma phyi mas 'phrogs pa ltar gab nas go dkabar byas pa ni yongs 'phrogs kyi gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor gang du rten lus lta gsal bar byas nas brten pa yan lag lta bu sbas par byas pa ni gcig bsgribs pagab tshig dang / rten dang brten pa'i dngos po gnyis ka sbas shing bsgribs pa gnyis ka bsgribs pa'i gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor gang du gong du bshad pa'i gab tshiso so'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dres par sbyar ba ni yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig ces bya so so'i dper brjod 'dir mangs kyis dogs pas rtsa 'grel dag las shes par bya'o/gab tshig gi rgyan gyi dgos pa ni/ rtsed mo byed pa'i mdun sar bzhad gad kyi dodang / gab tshig shes garnams phan tshun tshogs su gsang gtam smra ba dang / pha ropo rnams blo rmongs shing 'khrungapa bar byed pa'i ched du yin no/ /gab tshig gi rgyan gyi don rnams mdor bsdus te go sla bar brjod zin to/ /gsum pa skyon sel bshad pa ni/ tshig sbyor gang du sgra don gang rung nyams dbral zhing mi mdzes 2 /ra byed pa'i chos de ni snyan ngag gi skyon yin zhing / dbye na bayod de/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim pa nyams/sgra nyams gcod ma/tshams nyams pa dang / /sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral/yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / /'u nga rigs dag dang 'gal ba ste/ /skyon bcu dag snyan ngag la/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ya/tshig tshogs pa'i rang bzhin la brjod bya'i don gyis stong pa le'u bcu pa'i ngag lta bu don nyams kyi skyon dang / tshig sbyor de'i don snga phyi 'gal ba ni don 'gal gyi skyodang / sgra don gang yang rung ba gcig nyid dgos pa med par slar brjod pa ni dogacig pa'i skyon dang / brjod don de go ba'i ched du sbyar ba'i tshig gis de la the tshoskyed par byed pa ni the tshom can gyi skyon dang / bstan bya'i don snga phyi'i go rimanyams te gong 'og 'khrusas pa ni rim pa nyams pa'i skyon dang / tshig sbyor gyi rnam da202

dang 'phrad sogs sbyor tshul brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mi mthun pa ni sgra nyams kyi skyon dang / tshig gi gcod mtshams ngal gso ni ming mthar bya dgos pa la thog ma'am dbus su ngal gso ba ni gcod
