bral/ /nyer drug pa mang ba'i dpe ni/ yid 'phrog zla 'od dung dang ku mu da/ /kha ba'i phung po pad+ma'i rtsa ba bzhin/ /mchog tu dkar ba'i dri ma med pa'i zhal/ /mjal bar 'tshal lo 'phags ma thugs rje can/ /nyer bdun pa rnam 'gyur gyi dpe ni/ 'chi med bu mo stong gis skrun min sku/ /'o ma'i chu gter che nas phyungs pa bzhin/ /nyams 'gyur 'bum gyis mdzes pa'i snyan pa'i gsung / /dri za'i rgyud mangs sgra las drangs pa bzhin/ /nyer brgyad pa phreng ba'i dpe ni/ ngangs ca bsil 'od kyis ston kya'i zla ba dang / / mtshan mo'i mgon pos kun da'i tshal la tsho bzhin/ /ut+pal dkar po des kyang dga' ston bzhin/ /smra ba'i lha mo sa rnam dpyod rgyas par byed/ /nyer dgu pa ngag don gyi dpe la gnyis kyi bzhin sgra gcig pa ni/ sna mang rgyan mdzes phra ldem phyag zung gis / /yid 'ong rgyud mangs sbreng ba'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ /char sprin lang long g.yo ba'i phang ba nas/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang dal bus ldir bzhin snyan/ /bzhin sgra du ma ni/ dpag bsam ljon pa bzhin du 'phags ma'i sku/ /'dod dgu'i re ba skong bzhin legs bshad ba /sung / /bdud tsi zas can bzhin du bdag gis ni/ /tshim pa med par longs su spyod cing rol/ /sum cu pa zla bo dngos po'i dpe ni/ 'chi med smin legs bye ba'i dbus na yang / /ngag dbang lha mo'i dpal la 'gran nus su/ /'od ldan rgyu skar bgrang 'a sa 'das na yang / /gnyis skyes rgyal po kho na lham mer mdzes/ /so gcig pa mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe ni/ rgya mtsho'i lha mo skal ldan gdul bya dang / /lha yi bla ma skabs gsum gtsug na mdzes/ /'phags ma khyod kyis mchog thun dngos grub dang / /phur bus tha snyad rig pa'i spobs pa stsol/ /so gnyis pa rgyu'i dpe ni/ khyod sku mdzes pas pad dkar 'khri shing dang / /gsung dbyangs snyan pas dri za'i rgyud mangs glu/ /thugs ni brling bas zab yangs chu gter te/ /ci 'dod stsol bas yid bzhin nor dang mtshungs/ /de ltar dpe rgyan so gnyis kyis/ /dbyangs can lha mor bstod pa'i dges/ /snyan dngags gzhung brgya smra ba la/ /rnam dpyod 242

thogs pa med gyur cig/ dpe'i skyon sel las rtags tha dad kyang skyon med pa'i dpe ni/ rigs ldan bu mo 'di ni skyes pa bzhin/ /brtan cing smra ba'i spobs pa mchog tu dge/ ya rabs brtul zhugs ldan pa'i gzhon nu ni/ /na chung ma /zhin ngo tsha khrel dang ldan/ /tshig tha dad kyang skyon med pa ni/ yid 'ong 'dam skyes rgyu skar tshogs rnams bzhin/ /'dab brgya rnam par bzhad pa'i 'dzum ras bkra/ /dbyar skyes rkang 'thung rgyas pa'i lo 'dab rnams/ /'bras ldan snye ma bzhin du rnam par dud/ /dpe don mchog dman byung yang skyon med pa ni/ kun gsal ngogs su 'od stong rgyu ba bzhin/ /rab mdzes lag ldan 'gros 'di yi gar 'ong / /dpyid kyi pho nya'i glu dbyangs ji lta bur/ /dri za'i rgyud mangs sgra 'dzin lam du snyan/ /de rnams sbyor ma shes na skyon du 'gyur ba'i dpe ni/ skyes bu 'di ni dga' ma bzhin du mdzes/ /rgyu skar rnams ltar blo gros rab tu gsal/ /chu mig bzhin du rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas/ /kun khyab khyon ltar phug pa 'di dag yangs / /gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan la nyi shu las/ dang po bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab 'o mtsho 'khyil ba las/ /legs 'khrungs gzugs sku rin chen rdul mangs brtsegs/ /spangs rtogs yon tan nyi zla zung gis mdzes/ /'jam rmegon sa 'dzin dbang por gus phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis pa rmi bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ phurla byung mkhyen brtse'i chu mthongs khyon yangs su/ /thugs rje'i nyin mor byed pa'i 'od stong gis/ /bdag r+bha'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i ke sar dbus/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i sbra nga rtsi 'khyil bar mdzod/0 /gsum pa bsdus shing ma —bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ rib mdzes khyod sku dpag bsam 'khri shing ni/ /mthon mthing zur phud lnga ldan 'dab rgyas rtser/ /yid 'phog nor bu'i me tog 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /skal bzang mig gi drung ba'i tshogs rnams 'gug/ bzhi pa rmetha' dag gzugs can ni/ srab 'jam dar tsū 'ja' tshon bkra ba la/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan gyi ri dwags gzugs mdzes pa'i/ /yid 'ong ༷zhal gyi zla ba gang ba las/ /byin rlabs 'dzum gyi ga bur bsil zer 'phro/ /lnga pa cha shas gzurges can ni/ tshems dkar kun da gas/ ba'i phreng ba dang / /dkyus ring spyan zung g.yo ba'i ut+pal bzhad/ /mtshang sdug dzi ma 0 243

stug po'i ge sar can/ /khyod zhal myur du mjal ba'i skal bzang stsol/ /drug pa cha shas can gyi gzugs can ni/ snyan 'jebs gsung gi dri za'i rgyud mangs las/ /zab dang rgya che'i legs bshad sgra dbyangs kyis/ /skal bzangaX snying gi mun pa rab bsal te/ /ma smad rnam dpyod mchog gi dpal ster mdzad/ /bdun pa yan lag gcig gzugs ni/ma lus rgyal ba'i yab gyur mgon khyod kyi/ /yid 'ong lang tsho rgyas pa'i zhal dkyil ngogs/ /snyan shal zla tshes gsar bas 'khyud pa la/ /rin chen rna lung zung gis mdzes par spud/ /yan laXg gnyis gzugs ni/ khyod kyi gsung zab rnam pa thams cad pa/ /'jam snyan legs bshad gling bu rgyud gcig pas/ /skal ldan ri skyes rna bar ngo mtshar sgra / /sgrog mkhas ya mtshanaX dpal 'di rmad du byung / /yan la rme gsum gzugs ni/ 'dod dgu'i legs bshad 'byung gnas zhal sgo'i 'gram/ /bisba'i mdangs 'dzin chu sgros nags klung g.yo/ /tshems phreng puṇ+ḍa rī ka dngar ba la/ /srab 'jam ja gas kyi glog darmer 'khyug pas mdzes/ /brgyad pa ldan pa'i gzugs can ni/ khyod phyag phra ldermo li khri'i rkang 'thung la/ /rab r+ya dzes gdub kor me tog ci yang bkra/ /ye shes dang bsnyen ral gri 'dab skyes rtser/ /'od stong 'bar rbe'i dbang po'i gzhu ris gas la/ /dgu pa ldan min gzugs can ni/ khod snyoms 'jam ༷pa'i phyag mthil 'dab brgya'i dbus/ /mtshan bzang 'khor lo rgyu skar phreng ba mdzes/ /legs skyes sor mo'o chu shing gsar ba la/ / dmar ba'i mdangs ldan bcad skyes glog 'od 'khyug/bcu pa mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can ni/ srab 'jam dar gyi gos (zang lhab lhub g.yo/ /mu tig do shal mdzes ma gar byed pa/ /khyod sku gser ri'i nyin byed mgon po 'di/ /skal ldan yid kyi glengs pa ༷ma lus 'phrog/ bcu rgicig pa rted par gzugs can ni/ smra ba'i rgyal po khyod zhabs zla tshes gsar/ /rgyal sras mgrin sngon gtsug tu bkod pa las/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pas mi brdzi zhing / /phun chags dge mtshan dpal gyi dga' bde rgyas/ /bcu gnyis pa 'gal ba'i gzugs can ni/ 'dam skyes tshogs rnams zum par mi byed cing / 'phel 'grib 'gyur ba'i cha shas mi mnga' ba/ /mgon po khyod gsung rgyu skar bdag po'i 'od/ /shar pas bdud snying 'thibs shing sreg 244

pa mtshar/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs can ni/ legs bshad bsil zer spro phyir zla ba ste/ /ma rig mun pa sel bas nyi ma/ dang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol bas yid /zhin nor/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras bskrun pas yab gcig lags/ /bcu bzhi pa zlur ba'i gzugs can ni/ rnam 'dren khyod kyi legs gsung yid bzhin mtsho/ /gnyis skyesadage slong dang bya ngang ba/ tshogs kyis 'dod dgur nye bar bsten/ /dwangs gsal gsung dang mtsho gnyis ka la yod pa'i khyad chos/ 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dag byed kyis/ /dri ma'i ra ri nang gi nyon mongs pa dang phyi'i nag nog/ ma lus 'khrud par byed/ /bco lnga pa dpe'i gzugs can ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas skrun byed pa'i/ /snying po'i don ston glegs bam nam mkha'i nor/ /'od zer bye ba'i lding khang la chags pa'i/ /sprin bral rta ljang bdage po'i dpal la 'gran/ /bcu drug pa sdog pa can gyi gzugs can ni/ tshangs pa'i bu yis gsar ba'i zla ba dang / /thar 'dod khyod zhabs rgyu skar mgon po mchod/ /de ni 'phel 'grib dri ma/'i skyon dang ldan/ /khyod zhabs nam yang dri mas reg pa med/ /bcu bdun pa 'gog pa'i gzugs can ni/ blo gros gter chen nyid kyi mkhyen rab dpyid/ /rnam dpyod 'dab brgya 'byed pa'i tsha zer can/ /bdud sde mya ngan mun par 'thum pa'i phyir/ /'od stong can du bsnyad par ga la rigs/ /bco brgyad pa mnyam 'jog gi gzugs can ni/ gang gi rnam dkar mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /nag phyogs 'byung bo'i sems rgyud rab sreg pa/ /'gro la 'tshe ba'i bag chags mthu brtas pa'i/ /mi bsrun yid kyi brlang spyo da 'di yang skyon/ /bcu dgu pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can ni/ mgon khyod thugs rje'i lha lam skyed tshal las/ /legs 'ong nyin mor byed pa'i pad dkar phreng / /rnam dpyode snang tshas rtsen pa'i sbrang rtsi'i slo rbocud/ /bdag blo bunge ba'i rtsal gsum brtas par mdzod/ /nyi shu pa bsnyen dor gyi gzugs can ni/ shādi ni khyod sku ma lags gser sbyangs ri/ /gsung dbyangs min te dri za'i rgyud mangs sgra/ /khyod thugs ma yin rirno chen 'byung gnas te/ /lha min mkhyen reb gter dngos mjal gyur cig/ de ltar yab gcig mkhyen gter la/ /gzugs can nyi shus bstod pa'i dges/ /rig gzhung 'dab brgya 'byed pa la/ /rnam dpyod 245

'od stong 'bar gyur cig/ bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan la bcu gnyis las/ dang po rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ legs bshad gtam gyis shes bya'i rig pa'i gnad/ /lhag ma med par rab tu gsal bar byed/ /'khru'i ldan nyes bshad ngag sgros gzhan dag kyang / /skad cig nyid la drung nas 'byin par mdzad/ /gnyis pa bya ba brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ khyab par byas so mkha' mnyam/ yid can la/ /rmad byung lhag pa'i bsam pa mchog gis te/ /nyam thag (bul zhing phongs pa dag la yang / /khyod kyi rlabs chen gtong ba'i sbyin pas so/ /gsum pa yon tan brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ rab tu gsal lo phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khyon/ /nyin mor byed pa'i 'od kyi snang bas te/ /blo gsal don ༷gnyer kun gyi spobs pa yang / /lhag pa'i lha yi byin rlabs mchog gis so/ /bzhi pa rdzas brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ snyigs ma'i mgon po zas gtsang sras po yis/ /gdul dka'i mi mjed zhing 'di yongs bzung nas/ /bgrang yas rigarmi can gsum gyi gdul bya rnams/ /smin cing grol ba'i grags snyan bla na 'bar/ /lnga pa rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ bdag cag yan lag mchog gi cod pan du/ /zhabs zung rnam par bsten no skyabs mgon rje/ /gting mtha' bral ba bskal dka ri srid mtsho las/ /tshad med thugs rje'i gru yis myur du sgrol/ /drug pa bya ba brjod pa bar gyi sasal byed ni/ gang sku mtshan bzang ma/chog gis brgyan pa 'di/ /skal ldan thar 'dod mig la dpal ster byed/ /shin tu snyan pa'i gsung 'di rna ba dang / /thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'di yang yid la 'o/ /gzhung gi shugs bstan yon tan brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ legs bris lam du rgyu ba'i mkha' glang gi/ sgrib g.yogs bral ba rta bdun bdag po'i 'od/ /rab tu 'bar zhing dri ma rgyang bsrings pa'i/ /chos kun cig car gzigs pa'i ye shes kyang / /rmos brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ bskal bzang 'dren pa stong las pad dkar ltar/ /rab bsngags shākya'i gtso bo'i phyag mtshan ni/ /mig sman mdangs 'dzin drang srong snod mchog ste/ /rjes 'brangs dge sbyong yon snod kyang de lags/ /bdun pa rigs brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ skye dgu yongs la bu gcig lta bur brtse/ /thugs rjes gzhan 246

gyi don la skyo ngal med/ /shin tu bya dka'i spyod la mi zhum par/ /rab dgas 'jug pa rgyal sras dpe' bo rgyal/ /brgyad pa bya ba brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ rgyu skar bdag po'i 'od kyis sa mos tshal/ /mdzes ma'i 'gram chang siskyo wa ra'i kha/ /mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍis snyan tshig rig pa'i gnad/ /mtsho byung lha mos rnam dpyod sgo 'phar 'byed/ /shugs bstan yon tan brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ baiḍūr+ya'i 'od phog pa'o chu gter dang / /rdul bral 'bras ldan dus kyi me zhal lam/ /rnam 'dren mi bskyod rgyal po'i sku yi mdangs/ /in+d+ra nī la'i mdog ltar rab tu sngo/ /rdzas brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ rnam dag lung dang rigs pa'i byi dor gyis/ /thub bstan dri ma'i ra ri legs phyis te/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa gser sbyangs btso ma ltar/ /gsal mdzad rgyal ba tsong kha pa nyid do/ /dgu pa phreng ba'i gsal byed ni/ zla bral 'jam mgon bla ma'i legs ba'od kyis/ /ma nor thub pa'i dgongs pa legs par phye/ /de yis nges legs mchog gi khang bzang sgo/ /des kyang skal bzang gdul bya'i blo mig go/ bcu ba 'gal don gyi gsal byed ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me mgon khyod kyi/ /legs bshad bla na med pa'i skyes bzang gis/ /nor 'khrul rmongs pa'i rgud pa ring dor nas/ /phun tshogs thos pa'i nor brgya thob par byed/ /bcu gcig pa don gcig gi gsal byed ni/ khyod kyi rnam dkar mdzad ༷'phrin bzang po 'des/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i sa chen 'degs byed cing / /mtha' dag 'gro la blang dor 'doms pa dang / /nyesabashad dri rmis bslad pa ma lus bsal/ /bcu gnyis pa sbyar ba'i gsal byed ni/ legs pa'i dpal 'dzin re 'dod skorngo ba dang / /skal ldan rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu chu gter dbus na gnas/ /'jam mgon bla ma bsil ldan ljongs na 'o/ /lnga ba bskor ba'i rgyan la gsum las/ /dang po don bskor s+t+waṃ/rnam grol ched du rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs/ /rgya chen gzhung la thos pas 'jug par byed/ /rnam gsum ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes par klubs/ /zhi dul bag yordo khrims kyis nye bar brgyan/ /gnyis pa tshig bskor ni/ dbyar rnga sgrog pas rma bya dga' bar byed/ /rgyu skar ༷bdag pos gnyis skyes tshogs rnams dga'/ /zang zing nor gyes sred ༷ 247

ldan dga' ba dang / /legs bshad skyes kyis mkhas rnams dga' bar byed/ /gsum pa gnyis ka bskor ba ni/ skal ldan blo gsal don gnyer ldarno pa'i tshogs/ /shes bya rig pa'i gnas rnams 'tshol bar byed/ /srid 'byor snying po med par mthong ba dzornams/ /thos bsam sgom/ r+sha'i nor mchog 'tshol bar byed/ /drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan la nyer gsum las/ dang po byung ba 'gog paX ni/ dpal ldan zla bas ri mo'i ba brus las/ /'o ma bzhos pas bden zhen bzlog ces pa/ /mi srid yang na rten cing 'brel 'byung gi/ /nus mthu tshur mthong bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /gnyis pa da lta ba 'gog pa ni/ shing rta chen po mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ /brgya phrag rigs pa 'god nga/'i ngal 'di ci/ /phul byung mkhyen rab ye shes gcig gis kyang / /mtshan 'dzin 'chang ba drungs nas 'byin min nam/ /gsum pa 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa ni/ dal 'byor rin chen gling du son dus 'dir/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i nor bu ma blangs na/ /nam zhig pha rol bskyas chen 'degs pa'i tshe/ /mi bzad gdung bas 'gyod par gyur ta re/ /bzhi pa chos 'gog pa ni/ kun khyab yangs pa'i rgyan gyur mtshan mo'i mgon/ /bsil sbyin zu/khan du grags 'di ya ma brla/ /gzhan du dman pa'i 'gro ba yi dwags la/ /mi bzad bsreg pa'i reg pa ci la ster/ /lnga ba chos can 'dog pa ni/ bcu gnyis bdag po'i dkyil 'khor rgya khyon ni/ /dpag tshad du mar yod med dpyad 'di ci/ /'dren byed yul du phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun/ /'geng ba'i 'od snang tsam las gzhan ma mthong / /drug pa rgyu 'gog pa ni/ rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa yis/ /kun nas smad pa 'i las rnams ma byas pas/ /'jigs rung nyi bu'i pho nyas zin pa na/ /zhe 'tsher gnong 'gyod gdung bas ga la sngar/ /bdun pa 'bras bu 'gog pa ni/ snyigs ma'i rgud pa rgyas pa'i kha rlangs dang / /mi bsrun skye bo'i bsam sbyor gdug rtsub kyis/ /gzhan phan 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rgyal ba'i sras/ /bdag nyid chen po'i ba spu g.yo mi nus/ /brgyad pa rjes gnang gis 'gog pa ni/ dmu rgod bsam brlag skye bo phal mo che/ /sgo gsum spyod pa bag yangs ci bder mdzod/ /byams brtse thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /dag pa'i zhing khams mchog tu dgongs gtad mdzad/ /dgu pa 248

dbang gis 'gog pa ni/ dam pa'i mgon khyod gang du gshegs pa der/ /skal bzang gdul bya tshogs kyi dga' ston spel/ / bkra shis dge mtshan du mas brgyan 'gyur d+kumod/ /'on kyang gnas 'dir bdag cag mgon du bzhugs/ /drocu pa ma gus pas 'gog pa ni/ tshe 'di'i chos brgyad srin mo'i bslu brid la/ / bdag nyid nam yang chags pa ma lags te/ /tshul 'dir nyid kyis dgyes sam mi dgyes rung / /kho bo'i gnas tshul gsong por smos pa 'a gas/ /bcu gcig pa shis brjod kyis 'gog pa ni/'tsho ba'i lhag ma tha snyad rig pa la/ /ches cher gzhol ba'i bzhed don 'grub gyur cig/zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ma myangs na/ /lag stong gcer bus 'gro tshe ma 'gyod cig/ bcu gnyis pa rtsub mos 'gog pa ni/ mtshungs med mgon khyod gzhan du gshegs bzhed na/ /brgyud 'dzin 'os pa'i bshes gnyen 'tshol bar rigs/ /zhabs zung gtsug gi rgyan du bkod pa bdag/ dmigs pus bor bas 'tsho ba'i re ba gluskyung / /bcu gsum pa grogs kyis 'gog pa ni/ 'di snang chos brgyad bya bas yid 'byung nas/ /dben pa bsten par 'dod tshe myur du bzhud/ /phyis nas mdza' bshes nye du'i so tshis kyis/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i gegs shig 'ong par nges/ / bcu bzhi pa 'bad pas 'gog pa ni/ col chung chos brgyad mkhan rnams dgyes pa'i phyir/ /ngo srung gcam bu la sogs byed bsams kyang / /thub pa mchog gi bka' khrims ches lci bas/ /mthun 'jug rgya las 'gongs la ci byar yod/ /bco lnga pa gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa ni/ rtag 'dzin rab rib bsgribs pa'i cir long dag/ zang zing nor dang grags snyan gal cher sgrog/ nam 'ong cha med gshin rje'i pho nya la/ /gros dris bdag ni de yi 'dod pa bstun/ /bcu drug pa thabs kyis 'gog pa ni/ tshe thung 'di yi chos brgyad rol rtsod la/ /ci dgar spyod pa'i khur chen 'degs par bgyi/ /gang zhig myangs pas 'chi bdag rgyang bsrings shing / /shi ba'ang slong nus bdud rtse dam pa stsol/ /bcu bdun pa khro bas 'gog pa ni/ lus sems dar babs rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i dus/ /'jig rten bya bar mgo 'khor shi spar 'thams/ /da ni rgas 'khogs 'chi khar dam pa'i chos/ /rnam dag byed ces sgrog kyang mtshar ci zhig/ bco brgyad pa mya 249

ngan gyis 'gog pa ni/ dam pa'i zhing la mchod sprin ma spel zhing / /nyam thag slong ba'i tshogs la ma sbyin la/ /rang yang ci bder spyad par ma phod pa'i/ /ngal brgyas bsags pa'i nor rnams yud kyis brlag/ bcu dgu pa 'gyod pas 'gog pa ni/ring nas rang don gang yang ma bsgrubs shing / /gzhan phan sem/sa kyi dmigs rnam/ ma sbyangs la/ /gtan bde'i yon tan gang la'ang ma reg par/ /'jigs rung gting mtha' bral ba'i srid mtshor 'khyams/ /nyi shu pa the tshom gyis 'gog pa ni/ mtshams sprin gsar ba'i dum bu g.yo ba 'am/ /dge sbyong ngur smrig gos kyis klubs sam ci/ /zhi dul bag yod 'gros kyis rgyu ba yi/ /rnam 'gyur mdzes pa mthong phyir chu khur min/ /nyer gcig pa sbyar bas 'gog pa ni/ rab rgyas smin legs bsil ba'i dpal ster zhing / /'dod dgu'i re ba yid bzhin skong byed pa'i/ /khyod sku dpag bsam ljon pa 'di yod bzhin/ /yongs 'du'i rkang 'thung gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /nyer gnyis pa don gzhan 'gog pa ni/ gang mgrin bcu phrag rig pas nyer brgyan yang / /da dung mang du thos la rings 'di mtshar/ /'on kyang gting mtha' mi ma ngon chu yi gter/ /chu phran 'dus pas ngoms pa ga la zhig/ nyer gsum pa rgyus 'gog pa ni/ rnam kun dge ba'i sbyor sga mtha' dag ni/ /gzhan phan kho na'i don du mdzad do zhes/ /skyes mchog khyod la bstod bsnga gas su zhig sgrog/ bdag nyid chen po'i rang bzhin nyid du zad/ /bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan la brgyad las/ dang po kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa ni/ kye ma sngon byon mchog dman mtha' dag pa/ /deng dus ming gi lhag ma tsam du bas/ /'dus byas skyes mthar 'jig pa'i ngang tshul 'di/ /ji ltar mkhas kyang bcos su ga la yod/ /gnyis pa khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dam pa rnams ni zang zing longs spyod la/ /chags med gtong bas slong rnams dga' bar byed/ /klu dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /skal ldan skye dgu yongs kyi re ba skong / /gsum pa sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ grags pa'i mu 'khyud bdud rtsi zas can gyi/ /ral ba'i cod pan rtse na mngon par 'gying / /snang ba'i bdag nyid lha yi rdzing ring du/ /dal med rgyu ba 'jig rten rgyan du 'os/ /bzhi pa 'gal 250

ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ gzugs dang lang tsho dman yang mkhas pa rnams/ /blo gsal don gnyer can gyi yid dga' byed/ /'dam dzab dri mas g.yogs pa'i nor bu yis/ /don mthun dag gi re 'dod mi skong ngam/ /lnga ba mi 'os pa'i shen gzhan bkod pa ni/ 'phral phugs kun tu dge la sbyor ba yi/ /lugs gnyis srong ba'i sha tsha'i snying gtam ni/ /rna bar rtsub cing snying la gzan pa yi/ /las ngan bag chags brtas pa 'di re sdug/ drug pa 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i legs bshad bdud rtsi yis/ /phas rgol tshogs kyi snying la zug rngu skyed/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i lung rigs zegs ma ni/ /brgya phrag spro phyir de ltar rigs pa nyid/ /bdun pa 'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ nyes bshad gtam gyis tshul min yid byed skyed/ /dam chos bdud rtsis nyon mongs ci la spel/ /snum gyis me lce 'bar bar byed mod kyi/ /bsil ba'i chab kyis 'bar ba ga la rigs/ /brgyad pa mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gci nan bkod pa ni/ rab byung rnyed dang bkur sti la chags na/ /khyim pas nor la sred pa smos ci dgos/ /rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug bca' khrims khyad gsod na/ /phal bas blang dor 'chol bar cis mi spyod/ /brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyam la bcu 'a sa/ dang po gcig gi ldog pa can ni/ bstan pa'i snying po za ba gsang las btsams pa'i/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la zla bral mkhas snyan gyis/ /'jam mgon bla ma klu sgrub dang mtshungs mod/ /'byed chos 'di nyid gangs can bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /gnyis pa gnyis kyi ldog pa can ni/ rje btsun bla ma'i gsung dang tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /snyan cing brjid chags yid du 'thad pa ste/ /des ni tha snyad rig pa'i gnad don dgrol/ /khyod gsung zab rgyas gdams nga 'i gter mdzod bye/ /gsum pa sbyar ba'i ldog pa can ni/ khyod kyi thugs dang zla ba'i ma ma gnyis/ /zab yangs dpag dka' rin chen 'byung gnas te/ /mgon po khyod thugs sgrib bral ye shes dngos/ /rgya mtsho ba tshwa'i chu yi rang bzhin no/ /bzhi ba 'gog pa'i ldog pa can ni/ gzhan phan don la nam yang skyo ngal med/ /ris su ma chad snang ba'i dpal ster yang / /'char nub sprin gyis sgrib g.yogs ma spangs pa/ /pad+ma'i gnyen gyis khyod la 'gran nus min/ /lnga ba gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa 251

can ni/ 'khor gyis yongs bskor brjid chags mtshungs zla bral/ /rin chen rang bzhin rab tu brtan mod kyang / /blun zhing bem chos nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ /sa 'dzin dbang po khyod kyi sku las dman/ /drug pa rten gyi ldo ga pa can ni/ kur gum chos kyis btsos pa'i bla gos dang / /rab mdzes mtshams sprin gsar ba'i khyad par yang / /ngur smrig gos kyis khyod sku nye bar brgyan/ /thun mtshams chu 'dzin mkha' dbyings ngos su chags/ /bdun pa dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can ni/ rgyud mangs sgra la gsung —dbyangs drug cu dang / /zab rgyas gnad 'gag so sor 'byed pa med/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod gsung la/ / ngo mtshar yon tan de dag nyid kyis brgyan/ /brgyad pa mtshungs chos dang 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can ni/'dren pa khyod dang lha yi bla ma gnyis/ /blo gsal don gnyer re 'dod skong ba ste/ /phur bu mkhar nyal 'khor gyi dbus na brjid/ /khyod ni gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug na mdzes/ /dgu pa 'byed byed tsam sgras zin pa'i ldo ga pa can ni/ dri bsung 'thul ba'i pad dkar skyed tshal rgyan/ /zla med bla ma mkhas pa yongs kyi rgyan/ /yid 'ong tshal 'di lus can dga' byed cing / /ma/khas pa legs bshad gtam gyis dga' ston spel/ /bcu pa rigs mthun ldog pa can ni/ dal 'bab mdzod kyi 'jing las ma 'khrungs shing / /gdengs can bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /bdag cag re ba'i 'dod kun 'grub par mdzod/ /dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan la gsum las/ dang po phyi dus la sbyar ba'i srid pa can ni/ tshon gyis ma bsgyur ri klung sngo mdangs 'dzin/ /ma bris kha dog sna lnga'i me tog bkra/ /ma bskul bung ba'i mgrin glu dar dir sgrog/ ma ngos mgron du khugs pa'i dbyar gyi dpal/ /gnyis pa nang lang tsho la sbyar ba ni/ ma phyis na yang zhal dkyil dri ma bral/ /ma byug dmar ba'i mdangs 'dzin mkhur chos can/ /ma bsdus mdzes pa'i cha shas kun rdzogs pa/ /sgeg ldan min yang lang tsho'i dpal gyis 'gying / /gsum pa ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ bcos pa med par bag yod zhi dul can/ /'dod pa spangs kyang yon tan nor gyis phyug/ 'dris pa med par lus can yongs kyi grogs/ /bcol med 252

rnam kun phan mdzad bdag nyid che/ /bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la bzhi las/ dang po spyi'i bsdu sa brjod ni/ phun tshogs yan lag brgyad ldan yid bzhin mtsho/ /nye bar bsten pa'i dga' ston ring dor nas/ /ba tshwa'i rnyog chus gang ba'i lteng ga la/ /ched cher 'dzin pa byis pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /gnyis pa khyad gzhi tha dad cing khyad chos mtshungs pa'i bsdus brjod ni/ gang zhig bsten na legs pa'i dpal ster zhing / /'phral phugs 'dod dgu ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /srid pa'i khyon 'dir ches dkon yid bzhin nor/ /e ma sngon bsags legs byas zong gis khugs/ /gsum pa khyad chos mtshungs shing mi mtshungs pa'i bsdus brjod ni/ ri dwags gzugs kyi mtshan mas rnam par bkra/ /rgyu skar phreng bas yongs bskor 'phel 'grib can/ /rab brjid gdung sel skyo ngal dang bral ba'i/ /bsil sbyin mkhan 'di lus can dpal du che/ /bzhi pa sngon med bsdus brjod ni/ legs skyes khyon yangs yal ga mi ldan zhing / /lo 'dab stug po'i tshogs kyis ma bsgribs pa'i/ /yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i dpag bsam rkang 'thung 'di/ /skal lda na lus can rnams kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan la bzhi las/ dang po khyad 'phags phul byung ni/ srab 'jam lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' la/ /sna mang rin chen rgyan phreng rnam par bkra/ /yid 'ong lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal/ /ston zla lan brgyar phyis kyang mtshon nus min/ /gnyis pa the tshom phul byung ni/ khyod kyi rmad byung ma khyen rab las 'gong ba'i/ /zab dang rgya chen chos kyi gnas tshul 'ga'/ /srid dang zhi bar dmigs sam ma dmigs zhes/ /gzhar yang yid ni dpyang thag la 'ju'o/ /gsum pa nges pa phul byung ni/ rang mo zhig nas don gnyis mthar phyin kyang / /ngo mtshar rgya chen 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /nam yang rgyun chad med par 'jug pa 'dis/ /da dung skal ldan bgrang las 'das par nges/ /bzhi ba ngo mtshar phul byung ni/ khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rnams/ /shin tu gzhal bar dka' ba'i khur lci ba/ /gcig pus 'degs bzod nor gyi blo gros ma/ /chu gter klong du ma bying e ma mtshar/ /bcu gnyis pa rab rtog gi rgyan la gsum las/dang po sems ldan rab rtog ni/ bslab gsum nor bu'i lcid kyis non pa yi/ /tshangs 253

spyod dpa' ldan rgyal pa'i rjes 'jug gis/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yis mi theg ces/ /rab zhi dal bu'i 'gros kyis rgyu ba 'dra/ /gnyis pa sems med rab rtog ni/thub pas rtsod ldan tshe 'o brgya pa'i dus/ /sgrib gnyis dgra sde'i g.yul ngo pham mdzad pas/ /dug gsum 'khor bcas ches cher khros gyur te/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par 'tshe 'am snyam/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rab rtog ni/ in+d+ra nī la bzhus pa'i khu 0 yis/ /dri bral ston gyi mkha' la byug pa bzhin/ /sgeg ldan zla ba'i bzhin ras ngom pa na/ /kun da gzhon nu dga' nas 'dzum pa bzhin/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan la bcu drug las/ dang po skyed byed kye rgyu ni/ gsar ba'i lo 'dab stug po rab rgyas shing / /smin legs mdangs ldan 'bras bzang phang phung chags/ /yid 'ong skyed tshal rkang 'thung phreng ba 'dis/ /kun dga'i dpal gyi dga' sto na skyed par byed/ /gnyis pa nyams byed kyi rgyu ni/ dbyig ldan dga' ma ser skya'i mdangs 'dzin cing / /bsil ba'i dri bzhon dal bus phyogs kun nyul/ /rkang drug tshogs rnams rgyang glu len pa yi/ /nam zla ston gyis yid dga'i dpal nyams byed/ / gsum pa rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu ni/dwangs bsil chu klung bregs ma rab 'thor zhing / /tsan dan sngo 'khrungs skyed tshal grib ma dang / /dri yi shing rtas bskyod pa'i gru char rnams/ /mi bzad las can 'ga' zhig sreg par byed/ /bzhi pa 'thob byed kyi rgyu ni/ mkha' mnyam lus can yongs la rjes brtse ste/ /ring nas thugs bskyed snying stobs go bgos pas/ /bya dga' rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa la/ /zhum pa med par ngang gis 'jug par byed/ /lnga pa phyi shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ gser ldan ma yi sngo ljang gos gyon cing / /nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan lang ling dal bur rgyu/ /dbyar rnga ldir zhing rma bya gar gyis brel/ /bung ba'i na chung tshogs rnams glu gar rtsen/ /drug pa nang shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ khyod ni srid 'byor sgyu mas yid 'byung ba/ /grags snyan 'khor dang zang zing longs spyod la/ /ltos med chos brgyad byis pa'i rol rtsed kyis/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i tshul 'dis rtogs/ /bdun pa snga na med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas la ma sbyangs shing / /snyan par grags pa'i go sa ma non la/ /sred ldan dga' ba'i nor yang ma bsgrubs par/ /lang tsho yol ba'i mi 254

rnams 'gyod pas gdung / /brgyad pa zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ byis pa'i rol rtsed kho nar g.yeng ba sangs/ /lang tsho dar ba'i khengs dregs ngang 4gis yal/ / sna tshogs yul phyir 'brang ba'i rnam rtog rnams/ /'grib pas phyi ma'i don la gzhol bar gyur/ /dgu pa phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ thos mang btsal ba chags pa'i nor ma lags/ /legs bshad smra ba'i sgra 'di long gtam min/ /blo gsal don gnyer 'dus pa 'du long min/ /de phyir 'dun ma legs pas yid rab dga'/ /bcu pa spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ don med g.yeng ba'i rtsa ba ngo srung dang / /'dzin chags 'byung gnas nor rdzas ring spangs pas/ /bya btang thub pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la/ /legs pa'i yon tan tshogs rnams ngang gis 'phel/ /bcu gcig pa 'bras bu med pa skyed pa'i byed rgyu ni/ gzhon dus shes bya'i rig pa'i gnas kun la/ /gus rtag brtson pas ma bslab pa min na/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa gang la'ang thogs med kyi/ /mkhas pa'i snyan grags phyogs kun 'geng bar 'gyur/ /bcu gnyis pa ring 'bras kyi rgyu ni/ rab dkar lag ldan dbang po'i steng 'gying ba'i/ /'chi med gtso bo'i sra mkhregs rdo rje yis/ /sa 'dzin bgrod pa ma lus bcom pa na/ /sbyin skyes ma yi ma ngal khur cig car lhung / /bcu gsum pa rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa ni/ mkhas pa'i legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed pa dang / / bstan pa'i bsred bslad bsal ba lhan cig nyid/ / skal bzang gdul bya rnams kyi blo mig phye/ /ma nor blang dor cig car rnam par bkra/ /bcu bzhi pa 'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu ni/ snying khar lag pa'i chu skyes zum pa dang / /zol med dad pa'i rgyu mtsho rab 'phel nas/ /byin rlabs bsil zer 'bum phrag spro ba yi/ /khyod zhal mdzes pa'i zla ba shar ba mthong / /bco lnga pa rigs min gyi rgyu ni/ phyogs 'dir tha snyad rig pa'i 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /rnam par zum/ nas ring zhig lon dus 'dir/ /rnam dpyod 'od stong spro bas kha phye ste/ /skal bzang dga' ston bskrun 'di rigs sam ci/ /bcu drug pa rigs pa'i rgyu ni/ rmad byung gus rtag brtson pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /tshe gang ris med gzhung la sbyangs pa rnams/ /blo gsal 'dod pa ci yang 'jo ba yi /legs bshad smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho/ /bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan la gnyis 255

las/ dang po zur gyi phra mo ni/ zhi dul bag yod rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi/ mtshan ldan dam/ pa'i ma gon gyi rnam par thar/ /sgra 'dzin lam du son tshe rigs ldan 'ga'/ /'jam gnyen lag pa'i sor mo snying gar sbyor/ / gnyis pa rnam pa'i phra mo ni/ blo gsal mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa ru/ /rnam mang rig pa'i gnas las brtsams pa yi/ /dka' gnad lhug par 'grol la mngon phyogs tshe/ /rab dga'i bzhin ras mdzum mdangs ci yang rgyas/ /bco lnga ba cha'i rgyan la bzhi las/ dang po zol gyis sbed pa'i 'os pa'i cha rgyan ni/ 'khor 'das skyon yon snying nas bsams pa'i tshe/ /nges 'byung mchog gis ma/chi ma lhung ba la/ /dri len 'tshub mas bskyod pa'i shing lo yis/ /'dren byed dag la reg pa'i brdzu la brten/ /gnyis pa zol gyis sbed pa 'i mi 'os pa'i cha ni/phun tshogs zas gos gnas mal la spyod tshe/ /grogs la chags pa'i bzhin nyams lus 'dar ba/ /nam zla 'gyur ba'i dus min bser bu dang / /bgrang ba'i reg bya rtsub mos mnar bar sgrog/ gsum pa bsto da pa'i zol gyis smad pa'i cha ni/ snyan par grags pas phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'geng / / 'byor ldan sbyin bdag 'khor la rjes su brtse/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pas rgyal khams kha lo bsgyur/ /stobs 'byor chen pos bstan pa 9 /dzin 'di mtshar/ /bzhi pa smad pa'i zol gyis bstod pa'i cha ni/ kun dang mi mthun lto gos gang byung 'tsho/ /mthun 'jug ngo srung tsam yang mi shes shing / /'khor slob zang zing nor gyis mi skyong ba'i/ /dben par gab pa'i bshes gnyen dag gis ci/ /bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni/ skye dgu'i yon gnas khyod kyi mdzes sku dang / /snyan pa'i gsung dang zab yangs thugs rgyud rnams/ /gser sbyangs btso ma'i ri dang lha yi rnga/ /nyal 'gro'i gter gyis bdag gir byas par nges/ /bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po dngos thob kyi dga' ba ni/ nam yang lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /ris med gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi/ /dga' ston myong ba 'di 'dra gzhan gyis min/ /skye dang skye bar tshul der snying nas smon/ / gnyis pa gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba ni/ snyigs ma'i mgon po rgyal ba zas gtsang sras/ /mngon sum mthong ba'i skal ba phra na yang / /byin rlabs dngos su zhugs pa'i snang 256

brnyan 'di/ /mjal bas skal ba bzang snyam spro ba 'phel/ /bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan la brgyad las/ dang po sgeg pa'i nyams ni/ nang don gtso byas tha snyad gzhung rnams la/ /phyogs ris med par sbyangs pa'i lag rjes su/ /blo gsal mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa ru/ / spobs pa dge ba'i 'dzum mdangs ci yang byung / /gnyis pa drag shul gyi nyams ni/ phun tshogs bslab pa gsum ldan 'dus pa'i sder/ /log par 'khu ba'i nag po'i rtsa lag kun/ /sgrib bral ye shes khro ba'i gar mdzad pa/ /gang de'i mdun sar 'tsho bar gyur tam ci/ /gsum pa dpa' ba'i nyams ni/ rnam mang dpung gi tshogs dang mi ldan zhing / /sra brtan rno ngar go mtshon ma mchis kyang / /gcig pus mi bsrun rgol ba'i sde rnams las/ /e ma rnam par rgyal bar gyur 'di ci/ /bzhi pa snying rje'i nyams ni/ shin tu brgal dka'i srid pa'i mtsho chen du/ /nyon mongs chu srin gdug pas rnam par 'tshe/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rlabs kyis cher bskyod pa'i/ /'gro 93de ngang tshul bsam tshe mchi ma dku/ /lnga ba mi sdug pa'i nyams ni/ rab tu dri nga bshang gci'i 'dam rdzab sogs/ /mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang ba'i rdzing bu ru/ /dmangs rigs yi dwags 'ga' dang 'bu sbrang rnams/ /rab dgas 'jug cing tshim med rol bar byed/ /drug pa bzhad gad kyi nyams ni/ klad med col chung kha yis dgra bo 'dul/ /rgyang nas gsod rgyob sgra yis la lung 'geng / /'thab sar rgyab tu yib cing thal mo sbyor/ /rang khyim sleb tshe dregs shing dpa' tshul sgrog/ bdun pa rmad byung gi nyams ni/ nam 'kha'i glang po lang ling gar byed cing / /sgra brgya ba dag dal bur glal ba'i dbyangs/ /dregs ldan rma lca raḥdang tsa ta gaḥ/ rab dga'i dga' ston mgron du 'gug 'di mtshar/ /brgyud pa 'jigs rung gi nyams ni/ 'phags yul rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis kyis/ / phas rgol stong gi spobs pa 'phrog pa'i gtam/ /dran tshe mu stegs rgol ngan mtha' dag ni/ /chos cher dngangs pas srog snying lkog mar 'byin/ /bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can gyi rgyan ni/ dri med lung dang rigs pa brgya phrag gis/ /phas rgol spobs pa cig car 'phrogs so zhes/ /zhum zhing spa 'gong dngangs skrag bya mi dgos/ /zhabs bsten gus pas mchod la byams brtses skyong / /nyi 257

shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ yid 'ong dpyid kyi dga' ston blta ba'i phyir/ /kho bo re zhig skyed mos tshal du 'gro/ /grogs dag yid mthun gnas 'dir bag phebs la/ /thugs lhod bka' mchid gleng mo dal gyis mdzod/ /nyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ phyogs ris med par rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i dga' ston myang 'dod tshe/ /nges pa don ldan mkhas pa'i dbang po ni/ /bsod nams zong gis dgug bzhin gnas 'dir byon/ /nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan la gnyis las/dang po bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur kyang / /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul gyis mkha' khyab 'gro/ /theg gsum byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mgon khyod rlabs chen snying stobs mchog gis mdzes/ /gnyis pa 'byor ba rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/ chu gter bzhi yi ska rags kyis mdzes pa'i/ /'dzin ma'i khyon la dbang bsgyur mi yi lha/ /sna mang rin chen las grub khang bzang dbus/ /chos srid 'byor ba'i rdzogs ldan dpal la rol /nyer gsum pa bston dor gyi rgyan la gsum las/dang po chos la bston pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung dbyangs ni/ /yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhir nges min te/ /gdul bya rang rang skad dang sgra 'dzin sgor/ /'tsham par 'jug pas grangs kyi yul las brgal/ / gnyis pa yul la bston pa ni/'dab rgyas rkang 'thung rtse mor khu byug dang / /pad gzhon lte bar bung ba glu len pa/ /sgra 'dzin la ma du rtsub pa'i tsher ma nyid/ /gzhan dag snyan cing 'jebs pa yin no lo/ /gsum pa rang bzhin la bston pa ni/ mi zad spobs pa mchog stsol 'jam pa'i — dpal/ /ring mo zhig nas srid mtsho las brgal zhes/ /grags kyang don gyis srid 'dir lus can dang / /nam du'ang grogs pa'i gnyen bshes bzang po lags/ /nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan la dgu las/ dang po tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ srid na ches dkon 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skal ldan yid can re ba skong byed cing / /nam yang bkra shis dge mtshan dpal gyis mdzes/ /kun dga'i dga' ston mchog la sbyor 'di rmad/ /'di gcod mtshams tha mi dad cing tshig 'dra la sbyar chos rnams/ /sbyar gzhi mchog gsum dang yid bzhin nor bu gnyis la sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba 258

ni/ gang zhig bsten na 'chi med dpal ster zhing / /'chi med thar ba'i go 'phang dang /dus min gyi 'chi ba med pa'i/ rnam par 'tshe ba'i gdung ba ring du 'phrog/ nyon mongs dang / nad kyi gdung ba/ rab dga'i nyer 'tsho'i bde la sbyor byede pa/ /zhi ba dang /srid pa'i bde ba/ blo ldan skyes bu'i gnyer bya 'di rmad byung / khyad ga'i dam pa'i chos dang / sman gnyis so/ /gsum pa bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ rab mdzes dri ma med cing yid du 'ong / /legs pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi'i gter/ /zla med lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dpal dang / /rgyu skar bdag pos skye dgu'i mun pa sel/ /sbyar chos bzhi bo 'jam dpal dang zla ba gnyis kur sbyar zhing / de gnyis bya ba mun pa sel bar gcig pa'o/ /bzhi ba bya ba 'gal min gyi sbyar ba ni/ rab dwangs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'khrungs shing / /mtha' bral kun khyab dbyings la rol zhing mdzes/ /bdud rtsi zegs pa lus la sim pa dang / /sgra ldan lha mo'i thugs rje snying nas dran/ /bya ba zla 'od phog pa dang / thugs rje dran pa 'ab/la ba minapa'o/ /lnga ba 'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba ni/zla ba'i ma ma'i ngogs su rab sgeg cing / /dkar mdzes lang tsho rgyas pa'i dpal ngom pa/ /snyan sgrog ngang mo srid pa 'phel bar byed/ /yid 'ong ngag dbang lha mos chags sogs 'joms/ /chags pa 'phel 'joms kyi las gnyis 'gal ba'o/ /drug pa nges pa can gyi sbyar ba ni/ nyid kyi gtsug rgyan mtsho byung 'od 'bar 'di/ /dbyangs can lha mo nyid de zla ba min/ /brtse bas skyong ba'i gnyis skyes mang po dang / khrims ldan dge sbyor lags te 'dab ldan min/ /bdun pa nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba ni/ 'dren pa khyod kyi thabs mkhas mdzad bzang la/ /'khyog po ldem por gsungs pa nyid la ste/ /'on kyang yid 'phrog chu zheng gab pa'i sku'i/ /bzhugs stangs la yang tshul de res 'ga' mthong / /brgyad pa 'gal med kyi sbyar ba ni/ dal 'bab mdzod las byung ba 'od dkar 'phro/ /dpe can dbyangs can ma dpe zla ba dang sbyar/ zla ba'i cod pan 'chang ba skye dgu skyong / /dpe dbang phyug dang sbyar/ dri za'i na chung yid 'ong sgra snyan sgrog/ dpe dri za mo dang sbyar/ mtho ris blo ldan rnam dag brda sprod 'doms/ /dpe lha phur bu dang sbyar ba'o/ /dgu pa 'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba ni/ gtsug rgyan zla tshes ldan yang mgrin sngon min/ /259

dpe can dbyangs can ma dang / dpe dbang phyug mchod sbyin brgya phrag mdzad kyang lha dbang min/ /brgya byin dang sbyar/ bdud rtsi'i 'od can yin yang 'phel 'grib rdze ṣ+kaspangs/ /zla ba dang sbyar/ gzi brjid ldan yang kun+da'i dgra ma yin/ /nyi ma dang sbyar ba'o/ /nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan la lnga las/ dang po yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ smra ba'i dbang po khyod kyi rnam dpyod 'di/ /rab tu sra zhing rtsub pa'i rang bzhin dang / /shin tu rno ba'i ngar dang mi ldan yang / /log rtog tshang tshing cig car gcod 'di mtshar/ /gnyis pa rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/mtho ris mkhar nyal rigs las ma byung zhing / /mi rje bdag po'i sras su ma 'khrungs kyang / /zhi dul bag yod ldan pa'i mkhas dbang khyod/ /dregs ldan kun gyi gtsug na mngon par mtho/ /gsum pa bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ mthun 'jug ngo srung 'dzum gyis ma bsus shing / /gzhan mgo skor ba'i tshul 'chos mi ldan la/ /brgya bsheg stong 'gug sbyor ba ma bcoms par/ /rgyal khams dbang sdud dam pa mchog 'di rmad/ /bzhi pa thos ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ dpa' zhing rtul phod dpung dang mi ldan zhing / /sra mkhregs rno ba'i go mtshon ma mchis kyang / /shin tu 'jam pa'i byams brtse'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mi bsrun dgra tshogs cig car 'joms par byed/ /lnga ba rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ rigs stobs dbang dang gzi byin ma mchis shing / /mdzes pa'i chas bzang spra sa pa ma lags kyang / /chos spyod dam pa lung rtogs yon tan can/ / mchog dman skye dgu mtha' dag zil gyis mnan/ /nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub thogs med dang / / kun mkhyen gnyis par grags pa dbyig gi gnyen/ /gangs can bstan pa'i nyi ma tsong kha ba/ /lung rtogs bstan pa spel la 'gran zla bral/ /gnyis pa smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/ lang long rgyu ba'i sprin gyi phreng ba dang / /'khyag 'khyug g.yo ba'i glog gi gar mkhan ma/ / nam zla dus kyi 'gyur dang 'dab rtse'i chu/ /skye 'gro'i tshe srog 'di rnams skyo ba'i rgyu/ /nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan la drug las/ dang po gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba ni/ 'khrul bral brgyud 260

ldan dam pa'i legs bshad kyis/ /skal bzang thar 'dod nges legs mchog la sbyor/ /khengs ldan mkhas rlom nyes bshad gtam spel bas/ /blun po log pa'i lam du 'khrid par byed/ /gnyis pa gzhi gcig gi byed pa 'gal ba ni/ dbang gaphyogs sa 'dzin mthon po'i phrag pa nas/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor shar ba yis/ /ut+pal dkar po'i skyed tshal rab tu bzhad/ /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan 'dab ma zum par byed/ /gsum pa gzhi gcig gi chos du ma 'gal ba ni/ bzhin ras 'dzum mdangs dkar zhing mgo skyes nag/ na tshod rab tu gzhon la blo gros rgan/ /rigs dus cho 'brang mtho yang khengs pa dma'/ /bya btang chos la brtson pa 'di rmad byung / /bzhi pa rdzas 'gal ba ni/ zla ba'i bzhin ras ut+pal rgyas pa'i spyan/ /bisba'i mchu sgros mu tig tshems phreng can/ /'jam gnyen phyag zung 'khri shing rab g.yo ba'i/ /khyod skus yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog par byed/ /lnga ba gzhi gcig gi las 'gal ba ni/ dpyid dpal dar ba'i lang tsho dang 'grogs pa'i/ /rab snyan ko ki la yi glu dbyangs 'di/ /ched du bskul ba min yang sred ldan gyi/ /yid ni brnag dka'i zug rngus mnar bar byed/ /drug pa sbyar ba'i 'gal ba ni/ zab yangs legs pa'i gnas la sa ye shes kyi tshogs dang / mtsho/'ong gyur cing / /mthon po yang rtser skal ldan gyi spyi gtsug dang / nam mkha'/ kun tu mdzes par rol/ /yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i 'od sku'i 'od dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'od zer/kyi snang ba yis/ /skyes ldan 'ga' zhig yongs su nyams par byed/ /blo mun dang / pad+ma ste khyad gzhi dbyangs can ma dang zla ba gnyis la sbyar ro/ /nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan ni/ mthon po'i ngo 'dzin dman rnams skyong dgos pa'i/ /sems khral med cing rang dbang bde bar rgyu/ /'phral la gang byung tsam gyis srog 'tsho zhing / /chog shes mkha' spyod khyu tshogs snang ba bde/ / nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan la gsum las/dang po mthu phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/ sa gsum las rgyal pad dkar mig can gyis/ /dregs ldan sbyin skyes tshogs kun rnam par gnon/ /'dzin ma'i mnga' bdag khyod kyis phas rgol tshogs/ / g.yo med rnal du bkod la mtshar ci yod/ /gnyis pa dpa' ba phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/ 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig thub pa'i rjes zhugs 261

pa/ /tshul ldan khyod kyis nag phyogs bdud sde kun/ /zhum zhing 'dar ba'i gnas su bkod pa 'di/ /chos spyod dam pa'i tshul la rigs sam ci/ / gsum pa stobs phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/ gtsug lag mang thos mkhas dbang legs bsten pa'i/ /rmad byung rnam dpyod brtas pa'i blo gsal rnams/ /nam yang dal ba'i dga' bde mi myong bar/ /ci slad 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul la rings/ /sum/ cu ba nges bstan gyi rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po mchog gi nges bstan ni/ kun dga'i dpal ster dpyid kyi dga' tshal du/ /ra yig gnyis pa'i khyu tshogs ngang gis 'khor/ /gzhung lugs mang thos rig pa'i phreng 'dzin pa'i/ /mkhas la skal bzang dpyod ldan 'du ba mtshon/ /gnyis pa mchog min gyi nges bstan ni/ bdud kyi gnyen gyur mi bsrun skye bo yis/ /bdag gzhan phung ba'i las la 'jug pa ni/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid 'grib la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /dus mtha' snyigs ma lnga bdo gsal bar byed/ /so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan la gsum la sa/ dang po yon tan lhan cig brjod pa ni/ yid 'ong lang tsho dar ba'i bzhin ras dang / /nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lhan cig mdzes/ / rabasadaga'i 'dzum gyis bsu ba'i tshems phreng 'di/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od dang mnyam du rnam par dkar/ /gnyis pa bya ba tha dang pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/ nyin mor byed pa'i 'od stong 'phro ba dang / /lhan cig mang thos mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod rgyas/ /dpal gyi 'dab ma 'dzum ras ston pa dang / /mnyam du kun byang chos kyi blang dor bkra/ /gsum pa bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/ lang tsho rab tu yol ba'i rgas 'khogs dang / /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid las skyo ba'i sems/ /zhi ba'i yon tan dran pa'i dad pa ste/ /rnam pa gsum 'di lhan cig 'gran par gyur/ /so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ nam yang 'dzad med les bshad skyes kyi mchog/ blo gsal don gnyer can la rab sbyin nas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon la grags snyan rgyas pa'i dpal/ /khyod nyid gcig pus ngoms pa med par blangs/ /so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan ni/ mi shis rgud pa'i ming yang mi grag cing / /bde legs mchog gi tshe dang snyan par grags/ /lung rtogs dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor ba yis/ /skye dgu yongs la rtag tu srung bar mdzod/ /so 262

bzhi pa rab spel gyi rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po gcig la gcig brten gyi rab spel ni/rab mdzes smra pa'i dbang phyug khyod kyi sku/ /rang bzhin brjod pa/ nyi 'od kyis 'khyud gser ri'i dpal la 'gran/ /dpe rgyan/ de yi ngo mtshar mkha' khyab zhing rnams su/ /bros pa'i zol gyis gtam gzhan 'phrog pa 'dra/ /rabartog gnyis pa stobs mtshungs pa'i rab spel ni/ ston zla bye ba'i dpal 'phrog 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /dpergyun/ dkyus ring spyan zung ut+pal 'dab ma g.yo/ /gzugs can/ thags bzang tshems dkar tshar du dngar ba ni/ /mu tig do shal dag la 'phya ba bzhin/ /rab rtog so lnga ba dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/ de ltar rjod byed rnam par sgeg pa'i gzugs/ /yid 'phrog don rgyan phreng mdzes spras pa 'di/ /blo gsal don gnyer dgyes pa'i dga' ston dang / /snyan tshig rig gzhung don la 'dris phyir sbyar/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u gnyis pa'i dper brjod do/ / gnyis pa sgra'i rgyan la/ zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag la drug las/ dang po bya sla thog ma'i zung ldan la bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan bco lnga yod de/ rkang pa gcig la yod pa bzhi las/ dang po la yod pa ni/ gsal gsal mkhyen rab snang ba 'bum 'phros pas/ :zab dang rgya chen chos kyi dka' garnod kurno/ /ma 'dres ji bzhin legs par ston mdzad pa'i/ / rgyal ba'i zhal skyin bshes gnyen tshogs la 'dud/ /rkang pa gnyis pa la yo da pa ni/ nang rig spyi dang tha snyad gtsug lag kun/ /mkhas mkhas gsung gis lhug par 'grol ba yi/ /'dren pa khyod kyi gzhal dka'i bka' ༷drin niX/ /nam yang snying gi dbus su khur du ljid/ rkang pa gsum pa la yod pa ni/ ring nas thugs bskyed smon pas nyer drangs te/ /snyigs dus 'gro la gang 'tsham rnam rol skegyis/ /zab zab chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed mkhas pa/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa 'phrog mdzad khyod nyid 0rgyal/༷ /rkang pa bzhi ba la yod pa ni/ mngon mtho nges legs mchog gi dga' ston la/ /yid can ma lus mgron du 'gug byed pa'i/ /brtse chen thugs rje dran pa'i mos gus kyi/ /dung dung yid kyis g.yel med gsol 'debs bgyid/ /rkang pa gnyis re la yod pa drurge las/ dang po gnyis la yod pa ni/ ldem ldem 'jam gnyen ༷ ༷ 263

phyag zung legs brkyangs nas/ /zab zab brgal dka'i srid pa'i 'dam rdzab tu/ /rnam par byin pa'i skyabs med 'gro 'asdi daXg/ gtan bde zhi ba'i skam sar myur du sne drongs/ /dang po dang gsum pa la yod pa/ mang mang bsod nams zong gis nyer khugs pa'i/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang yi/ bsnyen nor/ /yang yang rnyed dka'i tshul la nges 'drongs te/ /gtan 'dun sgrub la rnam kun g.yel merdo 'thel/ /dang po dang bzhi pa la yod pa/ lhung lhung thur du rgyu ba'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /nam du'ang ldog pa med par 'bab pa ltar/ ༷/nyarmo chung tshe srog yud tsam mi gnas par/ /rab rab 'gro ba'i mi rtag ngang tshul soms/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa la yod pa/ las nyoni drag po'i rlung gis rab bdas te/ /'jigs 'jigs dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung gyur nas/ /lhab lhab me chen 'bar bas sreg r+sha yi/ /rmi nga'i ngang tshul bsam tshe skyi re g.ya'/ /gnyis pa dang bzhi pa la yod pa/ mi bzad dmyal ba'o duḥkhas ches mnar te/ /lhang lhang 'o dod bod pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /brtse chen thugs rje mchog gis nyer bzung na sa/ /skyobs skyobs bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa la yod pa/ srid dang t+t+waṃ ba'i 'byor rgud ma lus pa/ /bsru med las 'bras tshul la rag las phyir/ /brtan brtan zhib mo'i blo yis legs brtags nas/ /nges nges dge sdig blang dor ma norno gces/ /rkang pa gsum re la yo/da pa bzhi las/ daji poX gsum la yod pa ni/ btsun btsun bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs bsten te/ /'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi sgo la sa nyer gleng ba'i/ /snyan snyan legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi'i rbecud/༷ /rnam dpyod snyim pas ngoms med 'chang zer 'tshal/ /dang bo gnyis dang bzhi par yod pa/ dul dul bag yod spyod pas lus mdzes shing / /lhod lhod mgrin mtshor dbyangs can ngang 0mo rnol/ /mi zad tshig gi gter mdzod mchog sbyin rmekhan/ /lhug lhug ngag gis blo gsal re 'dod skong / /dang po dang phyi ma gnyis la yod pa/ mther rmetshar 'od ris dbang gzhu bkra ba'i dbus/ /'dab brgya'i lte bar ri bong 'dzin t+pa'i stenge / /ling ling g.yo ba'i srab 'jam dar zab kyis/ /mdzes mdzes mig gi bdud rtsi dbyangs can lha/ /rkang pa phyi ma gsum la yod pa/ yirdo 'phro/ me tog sna tshogs bzhad pa'i dri/ /thul 264 ༷

thul ldang ba'i dpyid kyi dga' tshal du/ /'khor 'khor lding ba'i bh+ra ma raḥyi khyu/ /zir ziXr snyan pa'i mgrin glu len zhing rtsen/ /༷rkang pri bzhi ga'i thog ༄ma la yod pa ༷ni/ma thud mthud rlabs phreng tshar du dngar ba yis/ /chil chil g.yo ba'i yid bzhin mtsho 'armem du/༷ /sil sil snyan sgrog rin chen rgyan phreng caXn/ 0/ dal dal 'gros ldan dri za'i na chung mas/ /zhig ma'i bar du chod pa'i zung ldan la bcu rgesumaX las/ rkang pa gnyis re la yod pa drug ste/ dang po gnyis la yod pa ni/ rnam bkra yid 'ong pad sdong ldem pa'i rtser/ /rnam par dkar ba'i zla dkyil mdangs /phro bar/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab mtshan dpeblo lang tsho gsar/ /'jo sgeg nyams kyis rol ba 'jam pa'i dpal/ /dang po dang gsum par yod pa/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad bzang khur/ /rmad byung snying stobs mchog gi datshung pas btegs/ /rab 'byams zhing du grags pa'i mtshan snyan gyis/ /sgra 'dzin lam du sica/ pa'i dpal kurno skyed/ /dang po dang bzhi par yod pa/ mi da 'phrog rgyud mangs sgra snyan dang 'grogs pa'i/ /legs bshad drug ldan dbyangs su 6sgyur mkhas pa/ /ngag dbang lha mo sgeg cing dgyes pa'i glu/ /yid 'phrog kun dga'i rna ba'i bcud len 'dzin/ /gnyis pa dang gsum par yod pa/༷ skal ldan skye dgu yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /zhabs zung 'od 'bar dbang gi rgyal po ni/ /zhabs rten chu skyes lte bar rab bkod de/ //jo sgeg nyams ldan tsog pu'i tshul gyis 'gyingaX / /gnyis pa dang bzhi par yod pa/ dri bral ye shes mtshan dpe dar ba'i dpyid/ /ngag la dbang 'byor dri za'i na chung tshul/ /mtho ris bu mo stong gis sgrun min khyod/ /ngagaX la smra ba'i spobs pa thogs med stsol/ /gsum/ pa dang bzhi par yod pa/rnam bkra dbang gzhu'i dpal la rab 'khu ba'i/ /rin chen rgyud mangs pang bar 'dzeg pa la/ /legs skyes phyag sor 'phrul gyis bskul ba'i dbyangs/ /legs ldan 'gro la chos kun cirge car 'doms/ /rkang pa gsum re la yod pa gsum las/ ༷ dang po gsum la yod pa/ rnam mang shes bya rig pa'i tshig don kun/ /rnam dpyod me long rab tu dwangs pa'i ngos/ /rnam par bkra ba'i mang thos shes rab kyis/ /thogs med 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs ༷pa rmad/ /dang po gsum pa bzhi pa la yod pa/ lhag bsam 0 265

gangs ri'i mdangs la rab tu 'gran/ /'gro la brtse ba'i 'dzum rab rgyas pa can/ /lhag pa'i lha khyod mkha' mnyam lus can dang / /lhag par snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rjeXs gzigs/ /phyi ma gsum la yod pa/ ngo mtshar ldapal gyi khengs 'phrog mdzes sdug can/ /dkar 'jam chu skyes gsar ba'i lte ba ru/ /dkar bsil bdud rtsi'i 'od can nya rgyas dbus/ /dkar mdzes lang tsho dar ba'i yid 'ong ma/ /rkang pa bzhi gar yod pa/thogs med mkhyen /ba mchog gi mtshon non gyis/ /thogs bcas sgrib pa'i tshang tshing kun+da gcod pa/ /thogs med nus mthu mnga' ba khyod kyi d+me/ /thogs gtugs bral ba'i dpal 'di e ma mcher/ /bzhi gar yod cing phyed snga phyi rigasaX mi gcig pa/ chos dbyings kun gsal khyod la dbang bsgyur cing / /chos spyan rnam par dag pa rab mngaX' ba'i/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog gis mkha' khyab /gro/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang dam par 'khrid pa/ mdzad/ /dang po dang gsum pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa 'dra ba/ phul byung ma/khyen pa'i shar ri nas thon pa'i/ /legs bshad nyin mor byed pa'i 'od stong sgos/ /phul byung gsung rab dka' gnad 'job brgya'i kha/ /legs par phye ba'i don bzang sbraXng rtsi 'khyil/ /thog mtha' 'dra zhing bar ba gnyis 'dra r+sha/ rigs tshul dri ma med pa gcig gis kyang / /log smra'i rgol ngan spobs pa kun 'phrog cing /༷/log rtog ma lus sel la zla bral gyi/ /rigs lam thogs med smra ba'i dge legs stsol/ /0thog ma'i chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldat+na la gsum yod de/ tshigs rkang snga ma gnyis 'dra zhing phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba ni/ dir dir sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i lha rnga bzhin/ /dir dir zab rgyas thal mar brdal ba'i /tarme/ /gsal gsal rmad byung don gyi bculda bzang gis/ /gsal gsal blo ldan snying la ngo mtsharno sbyin/༷ /thog mtha' gnyis 'dra zhing bar ba gnyis 'ji ba/ ༷ lhang lhang snyan par sgrog pa'i khu byug sgra/ /kyur kyur mgrin rnga brdung ba'i 'dab chags zhin/༷ /kyur kyur 'gyur khug ldan pa'i rig nyid spo/ /lhang lhang lding pas yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog/༷ r+shang pa bzhi gar 'dra ba ni/ 'thad 'tshad tshad ma'i lung dang gtan tshigs kyis/ /'thad 'thad rigs par smra ba'i zang don s+t+waṃ/ /'thad 'thad gzhung lugs dpang du bzhane pa'i tshe/ /'thad 'thad don las g.yo ba ne la zheg/266 ༷ ༷

ces pa lta bu ste/ bya sla thog ma'i zung ldan gyi dbye ba sum cu rtsa gcig go/ gnyis pa bya dka' gnas gzhan la yod pa'i zung ldan la bcu gnyis yod de/ rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ bslu med skyabs kun kun 'dus drin can rje/ /skal ldan 'gro kun kun mkhyen lam bzang la/ /g.yotsha meX rnam kun kun tu 'god mdzad pa/ /ra/ 'byems rgyal kun kun dngos bla mar 'dud/ /rkong /zhi'i dbus kyi chod pa/ /khyod sku rab mdzes rar+sha bajid yid du 'ong / /gsung 'di rab snyan rab tu yid 'phrog mdzad/ /thugs ni rib yangs rab zab chu gter bzhin / /lha martsig rab dkar rab dgyes nyams dang rnyen/ /rkang khrozhi'i mtha' chod pa/ mtshan dpe'i tshang tsho dar pa'i mdzes sku ldan/ /yid 'ong rna bar snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs ldan/ /chos kun cig car gzigs r+sha'i thugs dang ldan/ /mgon khyod rmad byung yon taXn kun dang ldan / /rkang bzhi'i mtha' chod cing ma sdud pa/ nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'dzurmi 'dzum/ /yid 'phrog skyed tshal sa mos kha 'dzum 'dzum/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rab dgyesaX zhal 'dzum 'dzum/ /skal ldan yid dge'i dpal gyi mdangs la'adzum 'dzum/ /bar mtha'i chod pa/ khyod ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pas bzeng / /0legs bshad 'bel gtam bzang po skyes bu bzang /༷ /gang bsam 'dod 'ardze bzang dgu'i 'byor ba bzang / /phul byung kun tu ba zang po'i dpal gyis — bzang / /bar mtha'i chod cingaX ma chod pa/ khyod gsung /ba snyan snyan 'jebs dbyangs snyan snyan/ /rgyud mangs bzhin snyan snyan zhing lhag snyan snyen/ /srid zhi'i lo gdangs rmen rmen dgu 'dzom snyan snyan/ /don ldan grags snyan rmen pa lhang snyan snyan/ /thog ba/ gyi chod pa/ rnyi9pre pa'i mchog gyur mkhasaX btsun bzang gsem trermedzom/ /mkhas bya'i gnas la mkhas par rab sbyangs pa'i/ /mkhas mang bdun sar mkhas pa kurno gyis bkur/ /mkharme mchog khyod kyi mkhas snyan kurno tu g.yo/ /dang po gsum pa'i thog mtha' dang gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog ba/ gyi chod cing ma chod pa/ lham lham nyin mor byed pa'i 'od lham lham/ /lham lham kun las lham lham pad dkar ma dngas/ /lham lham dam pa'i /zi snyen rab snyam rnyim/ /lham lharme sku rmichog lham lham ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷267

'od kyis mdzes/ /bzhi ga'i thog mtha'i bar chod pa/ legs bshad gtam gyi dga' ston spel ba legs/ /legs lam rab tu gsal bar byed pa legs/ /legs pa'i dpal la gdulaX bya spyor ba chogs/ /legs gsung chos kyi zhing khu rmeng ba legarmi/ /bzhi ga'i thog mtha'i bar chod cing ma chod traṃ/ mtshar mtshar 'ja' tshon 'khyizlo ba'i 'od mtshar mtshar/ /mtshar mtshar mtshan dpe bkra dri'i rtso mtshar mtshar/ /mtshar mtshar nyarmis 'acer 'bum0 ldan rgesung mtshar mtshar/ /mtshar ma6ra chormi kun gzegs r+sha'i thugs mtshar mtshar/ /gnas gsurmi ga'i 6da pa/ ༷zab sgros chos kyi zab gnad mtsho ltar zab/༷ /zarbe lam legs ston zab yangs blo gros zeb/ /zab dgu'i gdams pa zab rme'i nyams len zab/ /zab rtsong phra ba'i zab gsal gnyis med zab/ /gnas gaXsum ga'i chod cing ma 6da pa/༷ gsal gsal snyen mor byed pa'i gsazlo gsal 'od kyis gzugs ni nga kun gsal gsal/༷ /gsal gsal bkral ba'i tshirge gis rgosal gsal don gyi gnad 'gan rab gsal gsal/ /༷gsal gsal blo ldan rnam dpyod glugasal gsal mchog gis gtsug la| kun /sal gsarnyi/ //sal gsal legs par bzhed pa/ gsal gsal don la blo gros mig gsal garnyil/ /gsem pa rmitha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan t+t+waṃ/ sem kun bcas rang nyes r+shas ma rgos btsun/ /btsun pa'i mchog khyod gzhung lugs don la mkhas/ /mkhas shing grub brnyes 0yongs kyi ༷gtsug rgyan dpal/ /dpal lda na bla ma'i zhebs zungaX spyi bor mchod/ /bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la brtse lnga yod rnyi/ de las phyed bzlas yang dag sbyar ba gsum ste/ rkang pa dang po gsum pa dang gnyis pa bzhi bar bzlas pa ni/ lus can 'dod dgu'i re ba skong byed pa/ /srid pa'i khyon 'dir ches dkon yid dga'i dpal/ /mchogagasum/ lus can 'dod dgu'i re ba skong byed pa/ /srid pa'i khyon 'dir ches dkon yid dga'i rko——dpal/ / yid bzhin nor bu/ dang po gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa/gnyis skyes tshogs kyi dga' ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog/ sangs rgyas/ /gnyis skyes tshogs kyi dga' ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog/ zla ba/ gdung sel bdud rtsi sbyin mkhas 'dren byed dpal/ /gdung sel bdud rtsi sbyin mkhas 'dren byed dpal/ /dang po bzhi pa dang 268

gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/ gang zhig sems pas yid rab skyo byed pa/ /g.yo zhing mi brtan 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can/ /sprinagyi 'du 'god/ g.yo zhing mi brtan 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can/ /gang zhig sems pas yid rab skyo byed pa/ dus ba'i'i 'gyur ldog rkang pa bzlas pa la lan cig bzlas pa drug ste/ dang po gnyis par bzlas pa ni/zla bral mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /zla bral mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub 'phags yul dang /snye /'jam mgon bla ma gangs can ljongs 'dir mdzes/ /dang po gsum par bzlas pa/ yid 'phrog rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'gyed mkhas pa/ /dri za'i rgyud mangs mkhar nyal phang bar mdzes/ /yid 'phrog rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'gyed mkhas pa/ /drug ldan glu dbyangs mgrin pa'i lam du 'jor/ /dang po bzhi par bzlas pa/ dkar gzhon mdzes pa'i zla tshes cod pan can/ /ngag dbang smra ba'i lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /'jig rten byed por grags pa'i mgrin sngon yang / /dkar gzhon mdzes pa'i zla tshes cod pan can/ / gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/rab 'byams rgyal ba 'dus zhal bshes gnyen che/ /dge legs kun 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod skong / /dge legs kun 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod skong / /byams brtse'i gter chen rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams/ /gnying sdo pa bzhi par bzlas pe/ legs pa'i cha shas yongs gang rgyu skor mgon/ /bdud rtsi'i 'dzum rlabs spro bas gdung ba sel/ /mthong ba don ldan rgyal ba'i zhal khyim yang / /bdud rtsi'i 'dzum rlabs spro bas gdung ba sel/ /gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa/ bltar mi mngon pa lha yi rnga chen dang / /rnam rtog mi mnga' rgyal ba'i gzugs kyi sku/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor 'tsham pa'i chos sgra sgrog/gdul bya'i mos ngor 'tsham pa'i chos sgra sgrog/ lan gnyis bzlas pa la gsum las/rkang pa dang po nyid gnyis pa dang gsum par yang bzlas pa/ dkar mdzes mig la dpal ster yid du 'thad/ /dkar mdzes mig la dpal ster yid du 'thad/ /dkar mdzes mig la dpal ster yid du 'thad/ /dbyangs can zhal ras pad dkar zla dkyil mdzes/ /dang po gsum pa dang bzhi par bzlas pa/ dwangs gsal 'od kyis mun pa sel bar byed/ /nyin mor byed dang zla ba sgron sel bar byed/ /dwangs gsal 'od kyis mun pa sel bar byed/ /gnyis pa nyid gsum bzhir bzlas pa/ dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod dgu stsol ba'i dga' bde'i dpal la sbyor/ /'dod dgu stsol ba'i dga' bde'i dpal la sbyor/ /'dod dgu stsol ba'i dga' bde'i dpal la sbyor/ /rkang pa lan gsum bzlas pa ni/ /yid 'phrog rna ba'i dpyid gyur sgra snyan can/ /rgyal ba'i gsung / yid 'phrog rna ba'i dpyid gyur sgra snyan can/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ yid 'phrog rna ba'i dpyid gyur sgra snyan can/ /driza'i glu/ yid 'phrog rna ba'i dpyid gyur sgra snyan can/ /rgyud mangs sgra'o/ /tshigs bcad /nor longs spyod/ sngon bsags legs byas skal ba mi dman pa'i/ /yid can rnams kyi nye bar spyad bya nyid/ /brel phongs duḥkhas mnar ba brgya phrag las/ /skyob byed kun dga'i dpal ster 'dod 'jo'i dpyid/ /dam pa'i chos la sbyar ro/ /zung ldan chen po ni/ skyabs mchog khyod mkhyen skyabs mchog khyod nyid mkhyen/ /blam dang / / skyabs mchog khyod mkhyen skyabs mchog khyod nyid mkhyen/ /yidam lha/ skyabs mchog khyod mkhyen skyabs mchog khyod nyid mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas/ skyabs mchog khyod mkhyen skyabs mchog khyod nyid mkhyen/ /chos skyong la sbyar ro/ /lnga ba 'dres pa'i zung ldan ni/ lhug lhug gsung gis gsung rab gnad 'gag kun/ /kun tu sto na mkhas mkhas pa khyod nyid rmad/ /rmad byung rnam dpyod dpyod ldan kun las lhag/ lhag pa'i bslab gsum rgyal mtshan 'dzin 'di rgyal/ /drug pa ldog pa'i zung ldan gsum las/ rkang pa bzlog pa ni/ mkhas khyod mchog brnyes dpal ldan bde bas dga'/ /dga' bas bde ldan dpal brnyes mchog khyod mkhas/ /nyid sems gzhan dang bdag la phan byed bzang / /bzang byed phan lam bdag dang gzhan sems nyid/ /tshigs bcad phyed bzlog pa ni/ zhi zhing dul la 'jam dang legs shing des/ /bzang zhing btsun la mkhas grub mchog nyid khyod/ /khyod nyid mchog grub mkhas la btsun zhing bzang / /des shing legs dang 'jam la dul zhing 270

bzhir nges pa ni/ ja chang rnyog chud ches cher chags snying 'joms/ /khyod ko grong dgon gang dgar sgrub kyang 'grub/ /ma smad dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug mar/ /gtan 'dun 'dod don mtha' dag don du 'dud/ /mchu so mgrin gsum du nges pa/dpe med spobs pa daṅgeg par mi spobs pa'i/ /byul byang 'phags pa dpa' bo ma pham par/ / rtag tu nan tan dung dung ltar 'dud na/ /kun dga'i ngag gi dngos grub dgyes dgur 'gyur/ /mchu dang so gnyis su nges pa/ pad+ma'i phung po byur bur srungs pa ni/ /bung ba myos pa'i 'bad pas spyod par byed/ /de ltar gtan 'dun bde blag 'thob phyir du/ /'thad ldan don dam gtam der mno bsam thongs/ /mchu gcig pur nges pa/ spra spre 'bu sbrang mang po phang phung srungs/ /'bad pas ba mo ma phrog pad+ma'i dbus/ /bung ba dpag med bu phrug dpung sbrel bas/ /'phral phugs mi 'bral phangs med brad bran byas/ /gsal byed nges pa la yang bzhir nges pa ni/ kyal ka kā ku'i skad kyis gang ka skyod/ /khram mkhan khral 'khur khrag khrig khrung khrung khyu/ /gral bsgrigs dga' dgu'i sgra sgrog gre 'gyur 'gran/ /cig car gcin gci gcon gcung ca cos ci/ /gsum du nges pa ni/ tab tob btang ste rtag tu bsti star stob/ /rta rte'u brtod rting lta rtog tig tig gtong / /than thun 'thad 'thad thor thum thog mthar mthud/ /nang nas nem nur nag nog nongs na gnod/ /gnyis su nges pa ni/ ga ge gos bgo dga' mgu'i gad rgyang 'god/ /mgron 'grul grangs bgrang gon rgon gra grig bgyid/ /ru ru'i rwa rags ra ru rong rong rig/ rang re'i ra ri re re rug dug red/ /gcig tu nges pa ni/ de de drang don du gda' da de dor/ /de dag drang drag da dung dad dad 'dug/ dal dal dus der 'dod gdung ngos drag 'dul/ /da gdod don dam gdams don de der gda'/ /sgra rgyan gyi rab tu dbye ba bshad zin to/ /gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan la bcu drug las/ dang po kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig ni/ dge mtshan phun tshogs dpal mnga' bzhin mdzes shing / /rnam kun mtshar sdug yid 'ong ma bsten pas/ /mnyam med thub pa mchog gis bcas mtshams rnams/ /lhag ma lus de yid la khur du lci/ /'di ni gab bya mdzes ma dang 'grogs pas bcas 273

ma tshams sdom pa'i lhag de ma lus zhes pa yin yang / gab byed mdzes ma ni ma bsten pas sdom pa'i lhag ma de lus pa yin zhes par 'khrul du bcug pa'o/ /slu byed kyi gab tshig ni/ rnar snyan yid 'bab rgyang glu len la mkhas/ /mthong thos yid kyi brtan pa rab tu 'phrog/ gsar ba'i lang tshos myos pa'i 'gyur khug sogs/ /rkang drug glu yi rtsen 'di yid gar 'ong / /gab bya na chung ma'i glu dang / gab byed bung ba'i glur go bar byed pa ste/ rkang drug ni yongs grags bung ba yin yang / 'gyur khug sbom phra 'degs 'jog ste dbyangs kyi yan lag drug la'ang bshad du rung bas so/ /rim pa bral ba'i gab tshig ni/ dpal gyi byin rlabs thugs rjes skal ldan la/ /mi bzad zug rngu'i khang bur rab bcug pa'i/ /yid srub sde bcas rnam dpyod mchog stsol cing / /lhag pa'i lha der 'dud do rnam 'dren 'jam/ /rjod byed tshig gong 'og dkrugs nas brjod bya'i don gab nga 'o/ /rab bcom gyi gab tshig ni/ 'di na bsgrub byar 'os pa zung spangs shing / /rab 'tsho'i 'byor bas mchog tu khengs sems can/ /bgrod dka'i sa 'dzin spo la rnam 'gyid pa'i/ /'jigs bral nga ro sgrog pa'i seng ge su/ /gab bya ni bya btang chos med dang / gab byed seng ge'o/ /mthun gzugs gab tshig ni/ 'dren byed lam du kun dga'i dpal sbyin cing / /dkar mdzes yid 'ong nga la bu'i 'gros ldan pa/ /'khril ldem g.yo ba'i gar stabs bsgyur mkhas pa'i/ /sprin dkar dum bu 'chag pa 'di na snang / /gab bya glang po che dang / gab byed sprin no/ /rtsub mo'i gab tshig ni/skye ngos dben pa'i nyams dga'i bas mtha' ru/ /'dzin chags yongs btang 'phral la gang byung 'tsho/ /bag yangs gang dgar spyod pas dus 'da' ba/ /snang tshul mu to pa ltar 'o re brgyal/ /gab bya ri khrod pa dang / gab byed ri dwags so/ /grangs kyi gab tshig ni/ 'gro ba'i yon tan sdun bsus mig me la/ /rig byed mtsho yis mtha' brgyan me yi rtses/ /'khrid pa'i chu zlar thub lag rjes 'brang ba'i/ /bar+ṇa dus kyi mtshan mnga' mgon der 'dud/ /gab bya 'jam dpal dang / gab byed bod yig gi dbang du byas pa'i sde pa'i yi ge rnams so/ /rab btags kyi gab tshig ni/ nam yang brel phongs brgya phrag dag gis gzir/ /yid ni re dogs lu gu rgyud kyis bcing / /dga' bde'i go 274

skabs bcom pa'i nyam thag la/ /'dzad med 'byor ba'i bdag po khyod kyis skyobs/ /gab bya gdul bya dang sangs rgyas lta bu/ gab byed slong mo pa dang phyug po'o/ /ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig ni/ rab dga'i dpal ster mtsho las skyes pa 'ga'/ /'di na lus can dag gis mchod 'os nyid/ /yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i 'dzum rlabs g.yo ba ste/ /zla ba ma yin sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan min/ /gab bya dbyangs can ma dang / gab byed zla ba dang pad+ma ste/ mtsho las skyes pa zhes pa'i ming de gsum gar 'jug pas so/ /sgrib pa'i gab tshig ni/ rab gzhon lang tsho gsar bas gzhan yid 'gugs/ /'dod ldan rnams la dga' ba'i dpal skyed cing / /'jam mnyen phra ldem mtshar sdug 'dzum ston pa/ /phung khrol 'byung gnas na chung ma yin no/ /gab bya pad+ma dang / gab byed na chung ma'o/ /mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig ni/ nyin mor byed pa'i rtsa lag mtshan mthun pa'i/ /mgon khyod 'chi med btung ba'i ming zur sde/ /rnam par btul nas 'dzin pa mu khyud can/ /gang de'i ming can bskor ba'i grags snyan 'bar/ / gab bya nyi ma'i gnyen gyis bdud sde btul nas chos 'khor bskor zhes pa la/ gab byed mthun pa'i ming gzhan gyis gab pa'o/ /rmongs pa'i gab tshig ni/ rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po 'dod sred las/ /nges par 'byung ste gnyen pos thag bsrings pa/ /de tshul ma nyams btsun mo stong phrag dang / /dgyes dgur rol pas rigs sras brgya phrag bskrun/ /gab bya thabs mkhas kyi mdzad spyod dang / gab byed 'khrig spyod do/ /yongs 'phrogs kyi cho gab tshig ni/ zab yangs na kra'i grong khyer las skyes pa'i/ /mdza' ba'i gnyen gyur gang de'i dgrar grags pa/ / bskyang bya'i rtsa lag de la rab dga'i glu/ /legs bris dbyangs mkhan rol mo'i sgra la 'gran/ /gab bya bung ba'i glu dri za'i pi wang gi sgra la 'gran zhes pa la/ gab byed rim par rgya mtsho/ zla ba/ ku mu da/ nyi ma/ pad+ma/bung ba ste tshig sbyor skor thag ring pos brjod don go dka' bar byas pa'o/ /gcig sgrib kyi gab tshig ni/ dkar 'jam phra ldem gzhon sha chags pa 'ga'i/ /rab spru/dzes gser gdub spras pa'i sor mo ni/ /'khri shing rkang 'thung gsar ba'i lhug phran dag/lang ling g.yo ba'i gar stabs bsgyur dang mtshungs/ /gab bya rten sbas nas/ gab 275

byed brten pa sor mo gsal bar byas pa'o/ /gnyis ka sgrib pa'i gab tshig ni/ kun dga'i dpyid kyi dpal yon ngom pa na/ /rab myos dregs ldan 'ga' zhig mgrin bsal te/ /ldem ldem g.yo ba mthon po'i rtser 'dzegs nas/ /lhang lhang sgrog pas rna ba'i bcud len byed/ / gab bya rten ljon shing dang / brten pa khu byug gnyis ka sbas pa'o/ /yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig ni/ rgya mtsho'i khams dang mda' yi phung po can/ /gang gi lag zung gdub kor rab spras pa/ /dkar 'jam mnyen pa'i yid 'ong dpal 'dzin yang / / la nga tshos ring du btang tshe rang mtshang ston/ / grangs gab dang /gcig sgrib/ rtsub mo'i gab tshig rnams 'dres pa'o/ / gab tshig gi rgyan rnams kyi dper brjod bshad zin to/ /spyi don gsum pa skyon sel la bcu las/ dang po don nyams kyi skyon ni/ 'bras ldan dus kyi lha lam rang zhal ngom/ /'dab ldan rang thong khang par ca co sgrog/ mdzes ma'i bdag po tshangs spyod dpal gyis mdzes/ /mgrin bzang glu gar byed cing rwa can nyal/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ ngag de tsam tshogs kyang smyon pas smras pa ltar brjod don gyi 'brel ci yang med pa'o/ /gnyis pa don 'gal gyi skyon ni/ rnam/ 'dren mchog gi rjes su zhugs pa khyod/ /sna tshogs 'dod pa'i yon tan dag la g.yeng / /'dod sred bdud kyi zhags pa ring btang nas/ /ting 'dzin dga' bdes 'tsho ba e ma mtshar/ /zhes pa brjod don gong 'og 'gal ba lta bu'o/ /de'i dmigs bsal phyon du mi 'gyur ba ni/ 'dod yon spu gri'i sor chags sbrang rtsi la/ /blo ldan ma/khas pas chags par ga la rigs / /'on tang snyan par grags dang zang zing nor/ /'dod dgu char du bsnyil na cis ma legs/ /mngon par chags pa'i dbang gis brjod pa 'di lta bu la skyon du mi brtsi'o/ / gsum pa don gcig gi skyon ni/dbang phyogs shar gyi ri bo sa 'dzin rtser/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po zla ba shar ba'i tshe/ /ut+pal dkar po ku mud kha phye ste/ /'dab ma bzhad pa'i 'dzum ras ci yang ston/ /dbang phyogs dang shar/ ri bo dang sa 'dzin don gcig pa sogs dgos med du sgra don ci rigs bldabs te brjod pa lta bu'o/ / de'i dmigs bsal skyon med ni/'khor ba'i phun tshogs srin mo'i brdzu bag la/ /nam du'ang yid brtan rung ba'i snying po 276

med/ /chos brgyad byis pa'i rol rtsed snying po med/ /mthun 'jug ngo srung dag la snying po med/ /ces pa dgos pa yod na nan tan dang / ngo mtshar ba sogs la bldabs te brjod kyang skyon med do/ /bzhi pa the tshom can gyi skyon ni/ yid 'ong skyed tshal mdzes pa'i gar ma khan 'di/ /rab rgyas 'dab ma'i rnam 'gyur lang ling gis/ /sred ldan mig gi ltad mor che na yang / /'dab ldan gang du bsnyad par cha ma 'tshal/ /tshig sbyor ni brjod don nges pa'i phyir sbyar yang 'dab ldan ljon shing dang bya gnyis kur 'jug pas gang yin slar the tshom skyed par byed pa lta bu'o/ /de'i dmigs bsal ni/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo khyod/ /bdag cag mgon du bzhugs sam bzhud kyang rung / /byams brtse thugs rje'i kyo ba ring brkyangs te/ /mdza' ba'i rang bzhin nam yang mi ga tong 'tshal/ /zhes gdam nga can lta bu skabs 'gar rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /lnga ba rim pa nyams pa'i skyon ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs/ /rim ba'in rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan mchog/ bcom ldan gsang bdag —'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i gter/ /phyag na pad+mas dus kun dge legs stsol/ /zhes mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi go rims bzlog pa lta bu'o/ / de'i dmigs bsal ni/rgyal ba sa chos phung ji snyed bstsal pa rnams/ /mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa gsum du 'dus/ /de las thog mtha' gnyis ni bstan pa ste/ /bar ba ston dang bstan pa gnyis kur bsngags/ /zhes pa lta bu brjod bya'i don gyi 'brel ba nges pa'i rgyur go rim bzlog kyang skyon med do/ /drug pa sgra nyams kyi skyon ni/ legs ldan 'gro la mig gyur 'od stong can/ri /rab brjid shar ri'i rtse yi thon pa na/ /pad dkar gzhon nu lo 'dab phang phung la/ /ldem ldem 'dzum nas bung ba'i na chung 'bod/ /ces pa 'gro ba'i zhes dgos rgyu la 'gro la dang / rtse nas la rtse yi dang / phang phung nas la phang phung la dang /'dzum gyis zhes pa la 'dzum nas zhes pa sogs tshig phrad dang rnam dbye sogs nor ba lta bu'o/ /dmigs bsal skyon med pa ni/ snyigs dus dmu nod 'gro rnams 'dren slad du/ / rgyal bas rgyal tshab mchog tu dbang bskur ba/ /bla ma bdag la bsnyen bkur legs bzhes nas/ /thugs rjes mthu dpung bskyed la dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal pa'i rgyal 277

tshab dang / bla mas bdag las dang / thugs rje'i mthu dpung zhes dgos pa ltar snang yang tshig sbyor 'di lta bu la skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon ni/ ma lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /rigs gsum gyi spyi gzugs dngos 'jam mgon rje'i/ /zhabs zung zla tshes gsar mkhas grub kun gyi/ /gtsug rgyan cod pan mchog nyid du mchod do/ /tshig gi gcod mtshams ming rdzogs mtshams su byed dgos pa la de ltar ma byung ba 'di lta bu la gcod mtshams nyams pa dang / sdeb sbyor las ngal bso nyams pa zhes kyang bshad do/ /de'i dmigs bsal ni/rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /btang snyoms su mdzad snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i zhags pas nyer bzung nas/ /nges legs khang bzang du khrid shākya'i tog/ ces pa lta bu gcod mtshams su rnam dbye dang phrad ma rdzogs pa 'di lta bu skabs 'gar skyon med kyang / rna bar mi snyan pas ma nga du mi sbyor ro/ /brgyad pa sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i skyon ni/ phun tshogs stobs 'byor dpal gyis mngon rlom zhing / /rjes med nyal 'gro'i gnyer ma lta bu'i/ /chos brgyad zlos gar rol bas 'gying lags kyang / /nyi bu'i pho nyas bsu tshe rang mtshang ston no/ /zhes tshigs rkang rnams la yi ge chad lhag byung ba lta bu'o/ /dgu pa mtshams sbyor nyams pa'i skyon ni/rgyal ba kun dngos su dhī a tiṣ+ṭhaḥ/ /snying la zhugs pas rmongs pa dri ma rnams/ /ring du bsrings nas rnam dpyod 'dab brgya'i kha/ /yongs phye rtsom 'chad rtsod pa'i dri bsung 'thul/ /zhes pa lta bu su d+dhā a tiṣ+ṭhaḥrgyu mtshan med par mtshams sbyor mi byed pa ni/mtshams sbyor nyams pa'i skyon te/ de gnyis mtshams sbyar na su dhī ya tiṣ+ṭhaḥ'am sudha tiṣ+ṭhaḥ'abyung ngo / /skabs 'di'i yi ge snga phyi phrad pa'i mtshams sbyor tshul bod yig la med do/ /de'i dmigs bsal ni/ bsod nams dpung pas kun las bi dza ya/ /in+d+ra khyod kyi mtshan snyan gdugs dkar po/ /khor yug khyab pa'i phan bde'i grib bsil 'di/ /lus can rdzogs ldan dpal la rnam par bkod/ /ces pa lta bu'i bi dza ya dang /in+d+ra gnyis kyi bar du shad kyis chod pa'am tshigs rkang snga phyi'i thog mtha' la 'byung ba ni mtshams mi sbyor yang skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /bcu pa la yul 'gal sogs drug gi yul 278

dang 'gal ba'i skyon ni/ btsong kha'i sa 'dzin rtser 'gying gdong lnga pa/ /gangs ri'i spo mthor rgyu ba'i rgya stag khra/ /thang shing nags kyi tsan dan rkang 'thung drung / /legs skyes u dusba ra'i tshal rnams mdzes/ /dus 'gal gyi skyon ni/ nyin sgyeng zla ba'i bsil zer gyis phye ba'i/ /dpyid kyi ku mud gzhon nu yid 'ong dang / /gsar smin 'bras ldan dgun gyi bza' shing rnams/ /lnga bdo'i 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dpal la 'gran/ /sgyu rtsal dang 'gal skyon ni/ dga' dang khro ba'i 'gyur ba cher 'phel ba'i/ /rmad byung dpa' ba'i nyams can rnam rol gyis/ /snying rje'i yul gyur nyam thag lus can 5 rnams/ /blo gsal dbyangs kyis yid ni 'dun par byed/ /'jig rten dang 'gal skyon ni/ mig sman mdangs 'dzin gser gyi ri bo la/ /sos ga'i kha bas g.yogs pa'i 'od 'tsher bas/ /long pa'i mig dag phyid pa'i sgra bo che/ /'on pas thos te 'jig rten kun tu sgrog/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba la nang pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal skyon ni/ rgyal bas 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces/ /tshad ma'i lung las lan mang gsungs mod kyang / /srid ldan snying la mtshar sdug smin legs ma'i/ /skye mched khyad par rtag tu rnam par bkra/ /phyi rol pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal skyon ni/ dag bya dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la / /zhugs zhes mgrin pa bteg ste smra mod kyang / /sems/ nyid sbyong bas dri ma dag 'gyur phyir/ /glo bur 'bral rung nyid las gzhan du ci/ /lung 'gal la 'dul ba'i lung dang 'gal skyon ni/ mkhan slob cho ga'i brda la brten min par/ /sde lnga'i bsrung sdom yongs rdzogs legs mnos shing / /zang zing nor gyi 'du bgod la mkhas pa'i/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyis mdzes pa'i dge sbyong mchog/ mdo sde'i lung dang 'gal skyon ni/ rten 'brel rgyu 'bras chos la blang dor gyi/ /spros pa thams cad tsam ste legs bzhag nas/ /sems nyid mi rtog ngang la had de zhog/ tshig chog gdams pa'i rgyal po ngo mtshar skad/ /de rnams kyi dmigs bsal la yul 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ mi dbang khyod kyi bsod nams mthu dag gis/ /sum rtsen gnas kyi dpal 'byor dge mtshan kun/ /sa 'dir mngon sum 'gugs pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung mdzes par byas/ /dus 'gal skyon med pa ni/ bstan 'gro'i mgon 279

gyur bdag nyid chen po 'ga'/ /zhing khams gzhan gyi gdul bya'i don dgongs tshe/ /dgun dus spang rgyan me tog bkra ba dang / /char zim g.yo zhing sna lnga'i 'ja' tshon 'khrigs/ /sgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba skyon med pa ni/ mthong ba tsam gyis kha rlangs dug 'khyil zhing / /lus can mtha' dag zas su rngub byed pa'i/ /gdug pa'i klu yis rnam dag khrims ldan gyi/ /dge sbyong de yi ba spu g.yo mi nus/ /'jig rten dang 'gal yang skyon med pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung gsang cha shas phra mo tsam/ /phyogs kun mthar khyab yid can ma lus pa/ /ji ltar 'tsham par rang rang skad nyid du/ /thos shing rmongs blos zab rgyas don dag go/ rigs pa dang 'gal yang skyon med ni/ rang bzhin gcig kyang du ma'i rnam par snang / /kun rtog mi mnga' rtog yul kun la (rajug/ nye bar zhi yang zhi khro ma nges tshul/ /spros med spros pa kun ston khyod la 'dud/ /lung dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ bgrang yas bskal ba'i tshogs gnyis rlabs chen po/ /snyigs dus skad cig nyid la mthar phyin nas/ /spangs rtogs bsam mi khyab pa'i yon tan gyi/ /nam mkha'i rme dzod la mnga' brnyes de la 'dud/ /ces snyan ngag me long las le'u gsum pa'i dper brjod bshad zin to/ /smras pa/ rmad byung tshogs gnyis bdud rtsi'i mtsho chen las/ /'gro 'di'i legs byas bye bas nyer drangs pa'i/ /srid zhi'i mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i dpal yon can/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog tshangs pa'i sras mor 'dud/ /ma/gon de rjes bzung 'phags yul mkhas pa'i khrod/ /snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra la zla bral ba'i/ /daṇ+ḍi zhes grags mtshan snyan dbyar rnga yis/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'geng mdzad khyod nyid bsngags/ /gang mgrin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /dbyangs can ngang mo dgyes dgur rol ba las/ /snyan tshig mgrin rnga 'khrol ba'i glu dbyangs kyi/ /nyams 'gyur kun rdzogs zla med me long gzhung / /sarga rtse mos bcing ba'i dper brjod phreng / /tshang la ma nor legs par bkod pa 'di/ /gzhung don rdzogs ldan dga' ston sdun bsu ba'i/ /kun dga'i dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs yin/ /deng dus phyogs 'dir don rgyan tsam zhig las/ /le'u thog mtha'i don la lce g.yo ba/ / nam mkha'i pad+mor 'gran zhes bsting tshig dag/ 'dzem med smra ba'i kha la rgya yang sbyin/ /rnam 280

dpyod ral ba'i klong du nyer sim pa'i/ /gzhung don yan lag brgyad ldan garga ma/ /blo gsal don gnyer skal ldan shing rta'i ched/ /lhag bsam spar mos btsir bas lhug par bab/ /'dir ni mngon brjod dam pos ma bcing bar/ /tshig gi sbyor ba lhod chags sgeg pa'i nyams/ /zab brling don gyi ngo mtshar dang 'brel bar/ /sgra don rgyan gyi khyad par gsal bar byas/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi 'tshol la ches cher rings/ /legs nyes rnam par 'byed pa'i blo mig gsal/ /legs smra su la yod kyang len mkhas pa'i/ /legs ldan skal bzang rnams kyis 'di bsten rigs/ /snyigs mar spyod pas rang mtshang cher bdo bas/ /phal cher zang zing nor la snying por rlom/ /'ga' zhig grags snyan go sa tsam la 'chel/ /legs bshad don gnyer thar 'dod nyin skar tsam/ /mkhas pa'i grags skam 'do lis ma bteg cing / /stobs 'byor gzi yis khengs ldan zil ma non/ /dpyod lda na gzur sanas ches dkon dus mtha' 'dir/ /tshul 'di spel la cung zad zhe 'tsher mod/ /'on kyang rig gnas kun la ma sbyangs na/ /kun mkhyen nam mkha'i ma/tha' ltar ring zhes gsungs/ /de tshul rnam par lci bas tshe rabs su/ /rang blo legs bshad dag la goms phyir bgyis/ /'dir 'bad legs byas zla zer lhung ba'i gangs ri ltar dkar gang zhig thob pa des/ /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid mtsho nyam ngar thog med nas 'khyams mkha' ma/nyam mar gyur 'gro/ /skye zhing skye bar tshangs spyod rnam smin brgyad lda na rten bzang gru bo cher zhugs te/ /theg mchog mgon gyi ded dpon la brten sku gsu/ma rin chen gling du phyin gyur cig/ ces snyan ngag me long gi rgyan rnam sa kyi dper brjod dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob dam si mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul gtsug gi cod pan du bcing ba'i gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ rang blo goms shing blo gsa'/ don gnyer can rnams la'ang phan 'dod kyi bsam pas rnam 'gyur gyi lo smon zla'i yar tshes bzang ba gnyis pa'i tshes dge bar sbyar ba dza yachu/ /mja lam̐/ /281

༄༅/ /snyan ngag gi lus rgyan skyon sel gsum gyi sdom chig rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal kun ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /thugs rje'i zer 'gyed mtsho byung mas/ /bdag blo'i ku mud bzhad par mdzod/ /lus dang rgyan dang skyon sel gsum/ /snyan ngag gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ /lus ni brjod par 'dod pa'i don/ /rnam par dpyad pa'i tshig gi phreng / /dbye na bcad lhugs spel ma gsum/ /dang por bṛt+ta dzā ti gnyis/spros pa sdeb sbyor gzhung du gsal/ /rigs kyi sgo nas grol ba dang / /ri sa/sa dang ma dzod dang 'dus pa bzhi/ /de rnams sargas bcings pa yi/ /snya na ngag chen po'i cha shas yin/ /sgo dang srog dang rtsom tshul gyis/ /de yi rme tshan nyid shes par bya/ /shes brjo da phyag bya dngos po ni/ /nges par bstan pa de yi sgo/ /sngon byung gtam dang sde bzhi sogs/ /brjod bya'i don ni srog yin la/ /tshig sbyor phun tshogs nyams dang 'gyur/ /rgyan rnams spras shing sargas bcings/ /de mtha' tha dad ldan pas mdzes/ /rkang pas ma bcad tshig gi rgyun/ /lhugs pa yin te ming tsam gyis/ /dbye ba brjod pa dang ni gtam/ /bcad lhugs spel ba spel ma ste/ /skad rigs bzhi 'dus zlos gar dang / /skad gcig ldan pa'i tsan+d+ra gnyis/ /lus srog sgo dang rtsom tshul ni/ /snya na ngag chen por nye bar ma kho/ /sgeg rol stabs la sogs pa'i nyams/ /brjod pa gtso bor blta bya'i don/ /rgyud mang glu sogs mnyan bya ste/ /'dir yang rgyan gyi sbyor lugs gnyis/ /lho shar thun mong min pa'i lam/ /sbyar ba rab dngas mnyam nyid dang / /snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang / /don gsal ba dang rgya che dang / /brjid dang mdzes dang ting 'dzin bcu/ /lho pa'i lam srol phal che ba/ /bzlog pas shar pa'i lam dag mtshon/ /sbyar ba yi ge'i sbyor ba lci/ /rab dwangs 'jig rten grags don can/ /mnyam nyid 'jam rtsub sbyor ba mnyam/ /snyan pa sgra don nyams dang ldan/ /282

'jam pa shas che shin tu gzhon/ /don gsal don brtag mi dgos gsal/ /rgya che khyad 'phags yon tan rtogs/ /lci yang do mnyam tshig sdud brjid/ /'jig rten dang mthun yid 'phrog mdzes/ /gzhan chos ga'an
