bkod ting 'dzin no/ /skyes thob shes rab mang thos dang / /mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa/ /snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /de ltar min yang thos pa dang / /'bad pas ngag gi lha bsten na/ /rjes bzung mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'thob/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u dang po'i don che long tsam bsdus pa'o/ /bcad lhugs spel ma'i snyan ngag lus/ /mdzes byed chos la rgyan zhes brjod/ /dbye na don rgyan sgra rgyan dang / /gab tshig rgyan te rnam pa gsum/ /don rgyan so lngar grags pa ste/ /rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed bskor ba dang / /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ldog pa can dang srid pa can/ /bsdu sa dang phul byung rab rtog dang / /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' dang nyams ldan gzi ba ji bo can/ /rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan/ /rgya che bston dor sbyar ba dang / /khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang / /'gal dang skabs min bstod pa — dang / /zol bstod nges par bstan pa dang / /lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shi45/ /rab spel dgongs pa can rnams so/ 1/ dngos po'i rang bzhin gnas skabs so/ /ji bzhin gsal bar brjod pa'i ngag/ dang po'i rgyan yin dbye ba ni/ /rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas/ /rang bzhin brjod pa bzhi ru 'dod/ 2/ dpe don tha dad bkod pa las/ /ji ltar mtshungs pa rtog byed dag/dpe rgyan zhes bya so gnyis te/ /chos dpe dngos dang bzlog pa dang / /phan tshun nges dang nges med bsdus/ /phul byung rab btags rmad byung rmo/ngas/ /the tshom gtan 'bebs sbyor mnyam nyid/ / smad dang bsngags dang brjod 'dod dang / /'gal dang dgag pa ngo bstod dang / /de nyid brjod dang thun mong min/ /byung min srid min mang ba dang / /rnam 'gyur phreng dang ngag don gnyis/ / zla bo'i dngos dang mtshungs sbyor rgyu/ / rtags tshig tha dad dpe dman lhag/sbyor mkhas skyon ni med pa'ang yod/ /mtshungs gsal sgra ni don drug yin/2/dpe don tha dad ma byas par/ /don nyid dpe yi gzugs su bkod/ /gzugs can 283

zhes bya nyi shu ste/ /bsdus dang ma bsdus bsdus ma bsdus/ /mtha' dag cha shas cha shas can/ /yan lag gcig sogs ldan pa dang / /mi ldan mi mnyam khyad par bcas /'gal dang rgyu dang sbyar ba dang / /dpe dang ldog pa can dang 'gog/ mnyam 'jog gzugs can bston dor ro/4/rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas/ /tshig gcig thog mtha' bar gang na/ /gnas des tshig kun gsal byed dag/ bzhi pa gsal byed rgyan yin te/ /rigs dang bya ba yon tan dang / / rdzas brjod thog ma'i gsal byed dang / /rigs dang bya ba'i bar mtha' dang / /phreng ba 'gal dang don gcig dang / /sbyar ba'i gsal byed dang bcu gnyis/ 5/ gsal byed kyi ni gnas gsum du/ /don bskor tshig bskor gnyis ka bskor/ /don rnams gsal byed bskor ba'i rgyan/6/dgag bya bkag pa 'gog pa'i rgyan/ /'das dang da ltar ma 'ongs 'gog/ chos dang chos can rgyu 'bras 'gog/ rjes gnang dbang dang ma gus dang / /shis brjod brtsub mo grogs 'bad pa/ /pi /zhan dbang thabs dang khro mya ngan/ /'gyod dang the tshom sbyar ba dang / /don gzhan rgyus 'gog nyi shu gsum/ 7/ 'ga' zhig bsgrub byar rab bkod nas/ /de'i rjes sgrub byed nus ldan gzhan/ /'god pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ /kun khyab khyad par la gnas dang / /sbyar dang 'gal dang mi 'os 'os/ /'os shing mi 'os de bzlog brgyad/ ra/ sgra shugs skabs thob ci rigs kyis/ /dpe don mtshungs las khyad gcig gis/ /mi mtshungs 'byed byed ldo ga pa can/ /gcig gnyis sbyar 'gog gtan tshigs can/ / sgra sa zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa lnga/ / rten dang dpe las dpe can lhag/rtogs pas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa gnyis/ /mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis sgras zin/ /mtshungs chos ma zin 'byed byed zin/ / de gnyis 'byed byed mtshungs pa dang / /rigs mthun ldog pa can te bcu/rdzo/grags pa'i rgyu bzlog ma grags pa'i/ /phyi nang rgyu ni cung zad dam/ /'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid/ /ston pa srid pa can te gsum/10/brjod 'dod 'ga' la bsams byas nas/ /de mtshungs dpe dag ngag tu brjod/ /dpe don bsdus pa bsdus brjod rgyan/ /spyi dang khyad gzhi tha dad cing / /khyad chos mtshungs dang mtshungs mi mtshungs/ /sngon med bsdus brjod rnam pa bzhi/11/brjod 'dod yon tan 284

'ud chen pos/ /'jig rten mtshams las brgal gyur pa'i/ /bsngags par byed de phul byung rgyan/ /khyad 'phags the tshom nges pa dang / /ngo mtshar phul byung bzhi ru 'dod/12/sem sa dang ldan pa'am sems med dag/ gnas tshul ji ltar gnas pa las/ /rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags pa/ /rab rtog yin te sems ldan dang / /sems med ting 'dzin rab rtog gsum/ 12/ byed po shes byed dngos btags rgyu/ /ci rigs gtsor ston rgyu yi rgyan/ /dngos po dngos med mtshar ba'i rgyu/ /dang por byed po shes byed gnyis/ /byed la sgrub byed las rgyu gnyis/ /sgrub byed la yang skyed byed dang / /nyams byed 'grub pa'i rgyu gnyis yod/ /las la'ang rnam 'gyur thob bya gnyis/ /shes byed la ni phyi nang ma gnyis/ /dngos med rgyu la rgyu med pas/ /'bras bu yod med bskyed pa gnyis/ /dang po 'a yang snga na med/ /zhi gnas med dang phan tshun med/ /spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu bzhi/ /ring 'bras rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa/ /'bras bu snga ba rigs min rgyu/ /rigs pa'i hūṃ ste mtshar rgyu lnga / /dril bas rgyu rgyan bcu drug po/ 12/ lus kyi brda 'am rnam 'gyur gyis / /mtshon don go byed phra mo'i rgyan/ /dbye na zur dang rnam pa'i gnyis/15/bsgrib bya'i rang bzhin gsal ba gang / /bol gyis gzhan du kha bsgyur nas/ /sgrib pa'i ngag ni cha'i rgyan te/ /'os pa'i cha dang mi 'os cha/ /zol gyis smad dang bstod pa'i cha'o/ sna/ 4 /dngos po 'ga' zhig sngon bstan te/ /'brel 'os rim bzhin 'god pa'i dog/ rim pa can gyi rgyan du 'dod/ 17/ khyad 'phags nyams ldan dga' ba brjod/ /de ni dga' ba'i rgyan te gnyis/ /dngos po thob dang gzugs brnyan no/ 18/ /yid 'ong sgeg sogs nyam sa ldan ngag/ nyams ldan rgyan te rnam pa brgyad/ /sgeg dang drag shul dpa' ba dang / /snying rje mi sdu ga ba'ad gad dang / /rmad byung dang ni 'jigs rung nyams/19/ /nga rgyal skyes pas gzi brjid kyi/ /tshig smras gzi brjid can gyi rgyan/20/'dod don 'grub sla da rnam pa gzhan/ /brjod pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan/ 21/ bya ba rtsom la skal bas kyang / /'grub byed phun sum tshogs gyur gang / /brjod pa kun tu phan pa'i rgyan/ 22/ bsam sbyor ci rigs rgya che gang / /brjod pa rgya che'i rgyan te gnyis/22/ bston dor gnas tshul 'ga' zhig la/ /dngos de min zhes bston byas nas/ /285

don gzhan cung zad ston pa ste/ /chos dang yul dang rang bzhin la'o/ 24/sbyar ba tshig gzugs gcig pa las/ /sgra don gang rung ma/tshungs pa yi/ /phan tshun sbyar gzhi sbyar chos dag/ du ma'i don can nyid du 'dod/ /gcod mtshams tha dad min pa dang / /tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba dang / /bya ba tha dad min pa dang / /'gal min 'gal ba'i las can dang / /nges pa can dang nges nga/ 'gag/ 'gal med 'gal ba can dang dgu/ 25/ khyad par rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ /yon tan rigs dang bya ba sogs /gang du ma tshang ba nyid bstan/ /de ni khyad par brjod par 'dod/ /yon tan rigs dang bya ba rdzas/ /ma tshang khyad par brjod pa dang / /rgyu yi khyad par dang bcas lnga'o/26/ bstod dang smad pa gang rung gis/ /dngos po 'ga' zhig mtshungs par ston/ /mtshungs sbyo ra can te bstod smad gnyis/ 27/ 'gal ba'i chos gnyis gzhi gcig la/ /gnas par ston pa 'gal ba'i rgyan/ /khyad gzhi tha dad bya ba 'gal / /gzhi gcig byed dang chos mang 'grel/ /rdzas 'gal (sgo sa 'gal sbyar 'gal drug/ 2// skabs min 'dod pas bstod pa ni/ /skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan du 'dod/ 29/ /gang la smad pa ltar byas nas/ /ngo bo yon tan brjod pa de/ / zol bstod mthu dang dpa' dang stobs/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i zol bstod gsum/ 20nges pa ston byed gzhan dag gis/ /de mtshungs mchog gam mchog min du/ /nges par bstan pa'i rgyan la gnyis/21/ gang gi yon tan las rnams ni/ /lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan la gsum/ /yon tan bya ba tha dad gcig22/ brjod 'dod yon tan las la sogs/ /phan tshun bsnol ba yongs brjes rgyan/22/mngon 'dod dngos po bsrung bsgrub phyir/ /gegs med smon pa shis brjod rgyan/ 24/ tha dad rgyan gsum bsres pa la/ /rab spel rgyan ces bya ba ste/ /gcig la gcig rten stobs mtshungs gnyis/ 25/ chos bzhi'i bsam pa'i dbang byas nas/ /sbyar pa'i snyan ngag dgongs pa can/ / mtshams sbyor 'jug pa'i yan lag sogs/ /lung gzhan brjod pa'ang rgyan du bshad/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u gnyis pa'i don che long tsam bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgra rgyan bshad pa la/ /tshig sbyor gang du yi ge'i tshogs/ /bar ma chod 286

pa'am bar chod rung / /lan gnyis bskor ba zung ldan te/ /bya sla thog ma'i zung ldan la/ /bar ma chod dang bar chod dang / /chod cing ma chod zung ldan gsum/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa yi/ /re re gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bzhir/ /bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi/ /dbye ba rnam pa bco lnga yod/ /bar du chod pa rkang pa ni/ /gnyis rer yod pa'i dbye ba drug/ gsum rer yod pa rnam gsum dang / /bzhi ga'i thog mar yod pa gcig/ cha gnyis yod pa rnam gsum ste/ /bar du chod pa bcu gsum mo/ /phyed snga gnyis dang phyi gnyis 'dra/ /thog mtha' gnyis dang bar gnyis 'dra/ /bzhi 'dra chod cing ma chod gsum / /bya dka' gnas gzhan zung ldan la/ /rkang bzhi'i dbus dang de bzhin mtha'/ /bar mtha' thog bar thog mtha' dang / /gnas gsum ma/nyam par yod pa la/ /bar chod chod cing ma chod pa/ /gnyis gnyis sbyar bas bcu gnyis so/ /gsum pa mtha' thog sbyar ba gcig/ bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la/ /phyed bzlas yang dag sbyar ba yi/ /dbye ba sasum dang gzhan rkang bzlas/ /la na cig bzlas pa rnam pa drug/ lan gnyis bzlas pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /lan gsum bzlas pa gcig ste bcu/ /de bzhin tshigs bcad bzlas pa dang / /zung ldan chen po gcig rnams so/ /lnga ba 'dres pa'i zung ldan dang / /drug pa ldog pa'i zung ldan la/ /lugs ldog rkang pa gcig ldog dang / /tshigs bcad phyed dang de bzhin du/ /rangs po ldog pa rnam gsum yod/ /bya dka'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa/ /ba lang gcin dang phyed 'khor dang / /kun tu bzang po'i 'khor lo gsum/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' la/ /dbyangs dang gnas dang gsal byed des/ /re rer bzhi gsum gnyis gcig gi/ /dbye bas rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ /gsum pa gab tshig rgyan la ni/ /kun tshogs slu byed rim pa bral/ /rab bcom mthun gzugs rtsub mo dang / /grangs dang rab btags ming du 'dus/ /bsgribs dang mthun sgra rmongs pa dang / /yongs 'phrogs gcig bsgribs gnyis ka bsgribs/ /yongs su 'dres dang bcu drug go/rtsa ba'i gsum pa skyon sel la/ /don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim pa nyams/ /sgra nyams gcod mtshams nyams pa dang / /sdeb sbyor nyams 287

dang mtshams sbyor bral/ /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / /lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba drug/ bsdoms pa'i skyon bcu snyan ngag la/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/ /bsngags 'os snyan tshig rig pa 'dir/ /ngal byas ring min mkhas par 'gyur/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u gsum pa'i don che long tsam bsdus pa'o/ /tshig nyung gnad don kun tshang ba'i/ /legs bshad 'phrul gyi gru rdzings 'di/ /tshig rgyan rig gnas rgya mtsho cher/ /bgrod 'dod blo ldan brten par rigs/ /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs su/ /dal 'byor rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ /'gro kun nyer 'tshor bdag gyur cig/ ces snyan ngag gi lus rgyan skyon sel gsum gyi sdom tshig rab gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /dza yas/ / 288

༄7/ /sdeb sbyor rin 'byung gi gnad don gsal shā'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mdzi sgo ṣā ya/ sgrib bral chos sku mkha' dbyings las/ /gang 'tsham sprul ba'i rnam rol gyis/ /'gro la blang dor gsal mdzad pa/ /drin can bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud/ /phul byung yon tan brgyad ldan pa'i/ /sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /dgongs don nor bu len 'dod dag/ legs bshad gru dzings 'di bsten rigs/ /'dir rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rat+na ka rasharnyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin che/ na 'byung gnas kyi don mdor bsdus te go bde bar dgrol ba la bzhi/ mtshan kyi don/ 'gyur gyi phyag gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar na skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa'i legs sbyar gyi ska da du/ ts+tshan+da rat+na ka ra nā ma/de bod skad du bsgyur na/ sdeb sbyo ra rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ zhes so/ /de yang ts+tshan+da sdeb sbyor/ rat+na rin chen/ ā ka ra 'byung gnas/ nā ma zhes bya ba ste/tshigazhe sdo su bcad pa'i snyan ngag la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge'i lci yang sdeb cing sbyor bar byed pas na brjod bya'i sgo nas sdeb sbyor dang / rin chen 'byung gnas ni mdzad pa po slob dngo na gyi mtshan las btags pa'o/ /rgya gar na paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la rig pa'i gnas bcu zhes grags pa'i rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal gyi sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs zhes grags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo / /zhes pa ste/ oṃ ni 'dir bkra shis pa'i don yin pas mgo 'dren pa dang / ngag gi dbang phyug ni rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs te/ lo tsā pas rang gi lhag pa'i lha la 'gyur mthar phyin pa sogs kyi ched du sgo gsum gus pa'i btud pa'o/ /gsum pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ mchod par brjod pa/ gzhung dngos kyi don bshad pa/bcoms pa'i dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba thub pa nyi ma ni/ /zhes sogs 289

tshigs bcad gcig ste/ don ni/ bdud bzhi las rgyal ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / nyi ma/ ni chos mtshungs te/ de gnyis snang ba mchog gi bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ nyi mas phyi rol gyi mtshan mo'i mun sdug sel zhing gzugs can gyi dngos po rnams gsal bar byed pa ltar/ thub pa'i dbang pos nang gi mtshan mo gti mug gi mun pas ldongs shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi long khrid dang bral ba rnams la blo gros kyi mig legs par phye nas/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad pas na nang gi nyin byed yin zhing / de la bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bar chad zhi ba sogs kyi ched du sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes slob sto dpon gyis thog mar mchod par brjod pa'o/ /tshigs bcad 'di la rang 'grel du 'gyur cung mi 'dra ba byung ngo / /de ltar phyag 'tshal nas bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i dgos pa ci zhe na/ rang gzhan gyi sde bas byas pa'i snyan ngag rnams la tshig gi sbyor tshul gyi khyad par yod pa bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i ched yin te/ de yang thub pa dmar ser gyis sdeb sbyor gyi rtsa ba'i r+ya do dang / de'i dper brjod slob dpon rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad do/ /de dag gis mdzad du zin kyang de yon tan brgyad rnams dang mi ldan te/ brastu ra la sogs pa mdor bsdus te ma bstan pa dang / lci yang gi ming la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pas ma bcings pa dang / phal cher mi gsal ba nyid dang /ngo mtshar ba'i sbyor ba bstan pa yang ma mdzad pa dang / ngal gso dang / lus dang /sdeb sbyor snga phyi'i ming phan tshun 'dres pa dang / sbyor ba'i rim pa med pa dang / tshig 'ga' zhig 'don sla ba med pa dang / ngal gso dang rkang pa'i tshogs dag kyang mi mnyam par bcad pa ste/ de'i phyir tshogs kyi mthar ngal gso ba med do/ /des na slob dpon gyis yon tan brgyad kyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas 'di mdzad pa yin te/ mdor bsdus tshigs bcad bsal ba dang / /mdo yis dper brjod bgyis pa dang / /ma 'dres rim ldan 'don sla dang / /tshogs mthar sdod rnams yon tan yin/ /zhes yon tan brgyad dang ldan zhing dper brjod kyang rtsa ba'i mdo rang nyid kyis bgyis pas dmar ser gyi gzhung las mchog tu gyur pa 290

yin no/ /rang 'grel gyi gong du ngo mtshar ba'i sbyo ra ba bstan pa yang ma mdzad pa dang /zhes pa ltar na ngo mtshar rtogs byed drug yon tan brgyad kyi ya gyal gathig tu bgrangs pa ltar snang yang / tshigs bcad skabs mdo yis dper brjod bgyis pa bgrang ngo / /gnyis pa gzhung dngos kyi don la gnyis/ sdeb sbyor gang la bya ba'i gzhi tshigs bcad dang / sdeb sbyor dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshigs bcad rkang bzhi/zhes gsungs te/ rkang par bcad pa bzhi tshogs kyi tshig phreng / tshigs bcad kyi mtshan nyid/ tshigs bcad dang / sh+lau gaḥdang / tshigs ldan dang / rkang bzhi can rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /tshigs rkang ring thung gang yin yang rung bzhi la tshigs bcad gcig tu 'jog cing / tshig lhug la rgya gar gyi yi ge'i dbang du byas na yi ge sum cu so gnyis dang / bod yig tsheg bar nyer brgyad re la tshigs bcad gcig tu 'jog par bshad do/ /tshigs rkang yang ring thung mi snyoms pa yod de/rkang bzhi 'phel la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /rgyun chags dang / rab bsags sogs kyang tshigs bcad ring po nyid yin pas tshigs bcad las logs pa min no/ /tshigs bcad la 'ga' zhig tu/ mngon pa kun btus las/ tshigs su bcad pa ni/ rkang pa gcig pa dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga ba dang /drug pa rnams su yod do/ /zhes drangs nas/ kun btus lugs la/ rkang pa gcig pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad yod par bzhed pa dang / yang lung des yi ge gcig pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad ston pa'i don du mdzad kyang / mngon pa kun btus dang /de'i rnam bshad rgyal sras ma las/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde gang zhe na/ tshigs su sbyar nas gsungs pa ste/ de ni rkang pa gnyis pa dang / rkang pa gsum pa dang /rkang pa bzhi pa dang / rkang pa lnga ba dang / rkang pa drug pa'o/ /zhes 'byung zhing bshad pa gzhan med do/ /rkang pa gcig pa dang zhes pa rtsa 'grel gang na'ang mi snang /'ga' zhig tu rkang pa gcig pa zhes pa la rtsa ba gcig pa zhes 'byung ba 'gyur khyad do/ /de'i don 'chad par kun btus dar ṭīka las/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde ni/ tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas brjod bya ston pa'i dbang du bya ste/ mdo sde gang tshig rkang pa gnyis 291

kyis skabs kyi don tshan rdzogs pa ston pa nas/ tshig rkang pa drug gis skabs kyi don tshan rdzogs pa ston pa sogs kyi dbang du byas nas shes par bya ba'i phyir/ zhes rkang pa gnyis sogs kyis skabs gang yin gyi don tshan re ston pa sogs la gsungs pas/rkang pa gcig pa'i tshigs bcad sogs yod pa kun btus kyi dgongs pa yin min dpyad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sdeb sbyor dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan gyi sgo nas spyir bshad pa dang / so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ de yang ni/bṛt+ta dzā ti rnam gnyis dbye/ zhes sogs gsungs te/ tshigs su bcad pa de la yang sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bṛt+ta dang / dzā ti gnyis yod/ dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang ba'i sdeb sbyor de/ bṛt+ta'i mtshan nyid/ zhugs pa dang / sbyar ba dang /rgyud 'phel zhes pa rnams bṛt+ta nyid bsgyur ba ste ming gi rnam grangs so/ /dbyangs kyi phyi mo bgrang ba'i sdeb sbyor de/ dz+wa ti'i mtshan nyid/ rigs dang / bskyed ma zhes pa dzā ti nyid bsgyur ba ste ming gi rnam grangs so/ /yi ge bgrang ba na dbyangs bgrang ba yin gyi gsal byed bgrang ba ni ma yin te/ dbyangs bral gyi gsal byed tsam brjod du med pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas dbyangs gsa'/ gyi grangs bshad pa ni/ dpyangs yig ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ dbyangs thub du phyi mo gcig pa ni lnga ste/ a i u ṛ bla rnams so/ /ring po phyi mo gnyis pa ni brgyad de/ ā yī u ṛ e slu o oṃ rnams so/ /shin tu ring po phyi mo gsum pa ni dgu ste/ ā&4྅u32྅khe3.a3.o36྅ste ring po brgyad dang /lo3 la p+lu tas mtshan pa bcas dgu'o/ /de lta na'ang dzā ti'i skabs shin tu ring po phyi mo gnyis su brtsi bar snang ngo / /gsal byed ni so bdun te/ sde ba lnga/ mthar gnas bzhi/ dro ba bzhi/ rjes su nga ro sogs bzhi ste/ rim pa bzhin/ ka kha ga snya nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍū ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ rjes su nga ro i dang / rnam bcad aḥdang / lce rtsa can ṅka dang / mchu can pa rnams so/ /rang 'grel las/ gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun/ /'dir ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis/ /'di rnams yi ge lnga bcu dgu/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang 292

bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lci yang gi khyad par bshad pa ni/ pha rol tu yi ge brtsegs ma dang / rjes su nga ro dang / rnam bcad rnams gang yang med pa'i ——dbyangs thung ngu ni yang ba yin zhing / la zhes brda 'dogs te/ yang ba'i skad dod la lhu'i yi ge thog ma'o/ /pras ra'i ri mo shad kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu 'bri'o/ /dper na/su kro ta klo pi/ legs byas nus bshad la/zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de la dmigs bsal rkang pa'i mtha' rnams su yod pa'i dbyangs thung ngu mang po zhig ni lci ba dang ga zhes brda 'dogs te/ ga ni lci ba'i skad dod gu ru'i yi ge thog ma'i u phyis pa yin/ prasta ra'i ri mo 'khyog po 'di lta bu 'bri'o/ /mang po zhig ces pa phal che ba'i don yin pas sdeb sbyor 'dra mtshungs sogs kyi rkang mtha'i dbyangs thung ngu ni lci bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir kur 'grel las/ 'dra mtshungs kyi yi ge mtsham sa sbyor ma byas pa la sogs pa rnams la mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /sdeb sbyor gzhan la rkang pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa ste/zung gi rkang mtha'i dbyangs thung ngu ji ltar 'os pa bzhin lci bar 'gyur zhing / dbang po rdo rje sogs kyi rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa ste zung ma yin pa'i rkang mtha'i dbyangs thung ngu yang lci bar 'gyur ro/ /pha rol na dbyangs dang bral ba'i gsal byed brtsegs pa'am rkyang pa yod na sngon ma'i dbyangs thung ngu dang / der ma zad rjes su nga ro dang /rnam bcad yod pa'i dbyangs thung ngu rnams kyang lci bar 'gyur bas prasta ra 'khyog po 'bri'o/ /dper na/ mṛ t+paḥshi na nus nas ci/ ki klo staḥlta bu'o/ /dbyangs ring po dang rlu ta'i rtags can ni skabs thams cad du lci ba dang prasta ra 'khyog po kho nar 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ nā rī dz+nyā snu bi lha yi cha byad bud med gar dag bsgyur/ dho di yo/zhes dang / yidabang po me dag rtse mo thob/ sdo35klozhugazhi khaḥzhes pa lta bu'o/ /slu ta bsgyur na/ 'phyong ba'am 'phar ba zhes pa ste/ gang la sbyar ba'i dbyangs de shin tu ring po'i rtags grangs kyi gsum yig tu rang 'grel las gsungs so/ /sdom tshig ni/dbyangs thung yang dang rkang pa'i ma tha'/ /phal cher brtsegs pa'i thog ma dang / /nga ro can dang rnam pa cad can/ /ring po slu ta can lci/ /bṛt+ta'i skabs yi ge gsum tshan re tshogs pa la ming re 'dogs pa ni/ yi ge gsum tshogs pa'i phyi ma gnyis yang zhing thog 293

ma kho na lci ba byung na gsum tshogs de la bha zhes brda byed de/ dper na/ shrī pa ti dpal gyi bdag po/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du dza zhes pa ni dbus kho na lci ba ste/dper na/ swa rang byung /yaṃ rtsu/ lta bu'o/ /sa zhes pa ni mtha' kho na lci ba ste/ dper na/ ka ma chuston/ lā/ lta bu'o/ /ma zhes pa ni kun lci ba ste/ dper na/ he mā driḥlta bu'o/ /de rnams lci ba'i steng nas bshad do/ /yang ba'i thog nas ming 'dogs pa ni/ ya zhes pa ni yi ge gsum gyi thog ma kho na yang ba ste/ dper na/ su dha rmā lta bu'o/ de bzhin du ra zhes pa ni dbus kho na yang ba ste/ dper na/ zla 'od/ tsa n+ni kā/ lta bu'o/ /ta zhes pa ni mtha' kho na yang ba ste/ dper na/ ā na kun dka'/n+da/ lta bu'o/ /na zhes pa ni gsum ga kun yang ba ste/ dper na/ ga ru ḍa dug 'joms/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar yi ge gsum tshan re la brda chad byas pa'i yi ge brgyad po 'di skabs gang dang gang du brjod ngas der de dag gis mtshon pa'i don rnams dran par bya dgos so / /sdom tshig ni/ bha thog lci ba dza dbus lci/ /sa mtha' lce ba ma kun lci/ /ya thog ya nga ba ra dbus yang / /ta mtha' yang ba na kun yang / /lci ba ga dang yang ba la/ /ngal gso'i lci yang wa dang ka/ zhes pa blo la nges shing byang bar bya'o/ /da ni mnyam pa'i brit+ta'i sdeb sbyor spyi'i ming 'dogs bshad pa ni/ yi ge drug re la rkang pa rer byas pa nas bcoms te/ phyi ma phyi mar yi ge re re 'phel ba'i rkang pas sdeb sbyor rnams rtogs par bya ste/ yi ge drug pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi ming dbyangs sgrog de bzhin du bdun pa rab dga'/ brgyad pa rjes bsngags/ dgu pa bṛ ha tī ste/ che ldan ma'am yangs ma zhes bsgyur ro/ /bcu pa phreng ldan/ bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags so/ /skye 'gro sogs bzhi la so sor rkyang pa re re'i phyi mar mgor shin tu re sbya ra ba spel mar byas pas brgyad du 'gyur te/ 'di ltar/ bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro/bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro/ bcu bzhi pa nus ldan/ bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan/bcu drug pa legs spyod/ bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod/ bco brgyad pa brtan 'dzin/ bcu dgu pa shin tu brtan 'dzin rnams so/ /de nas byed ldan dag pa zhes pa'i dag pa'i sgra ni 'ba' zhig pa'i don dang / rab sogs drug gi phyi ma la'ang byed 294

ldan sbyar bas bdun du 'gyur te/ nyi shu pa byed ldan/ nyer gcig pa rab byed ldan/nyer gnyis pa kun byed lda na/ nyer gsum pa rnam byed ldan/ nyer bzhi pa legs byed ldan/ nyer lnga ba shin tu byed ldan/ nyer drug pa lhag par byed ldan zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dbyangs sgrog sogs drug skye 'gro sogs brgyad/ rta ni bdun gyi brda yin pas/ byed ldan sogs bdun te kun dril nyi shu rtsa gcig yod do/ /yi ge nyer bdun pa phan chad na gnyis kyi rjes su ra 'ba' zhig bdun sogs bsgrigs pa'i ming rgyun chags dang / na gnyis kyi rjes su ya 'ba' zhig bdun sogs bsgrigs pa'i ming rab bsags zhes bya'o/ /yi ge gcig pa nas lnga pa'i bar gyi sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas gzhung rtsom pa ches nyung bas na/ slob dpon gyis de'i ma/tshan nyid dang dper brjod sogs gzhung 'dir dngos su ma mdzad mod/ mi bzhed pa ma yin te/ rang 'grel du ngo ma tshar rtogangs byed kyi skabs/ de lta bu ni re shig yi ge gcig pa'i ldeb sbyo ra yin te/zhes dang / yi ge gnyis si 'i sdeb sbyor la dang / yi ge gsum pa la/ zhes dang /yi ge bzhi nga 'i sdeb sbyo ra la zhes sogs ngo mtshar rtogs byed drug gi dper brjod yi ge bzhi pa'i sdeb sbyor la mdzad nga 'i phyir ro/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sdeb sbyor sogs kyi ming ni/'jam dbyangs paṇa gyis/ me tog chun por/ brjod dang shin tu brjod bar ma/ /rab gnas legs par rab gnas dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yi ge gcig pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi ming brjod pa/ gnyis pa la shin tu brjod pa/ gsum pa la lhan cig bar ma/ bzhi pa la rab gnas/ lnga ba la legs par rab gnas zhes bya zhing / yi ge gcig pa/'i sdeb sbyor la gnyis dang / yi ge gnyis pa la bzhi dang / yi ge gsum pa la brgyad dang / yi ge bzhi pa la bcu drug dang / yi ge lnga ba la rnam grangs so gnyis yod do/ /bod yig la lci yang gi tha snyad med phyir ldeb sbyor ji bzhin med kyang /yi ge gcig pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad yod de/ paṇa chen de nyid kyis yi ge gcig pa'i tshigs bcad/ blo/ mchog dpal/ dbyangs/ zhes dang / yi ge gnyis pa la/ dbyangs can/ khyod bsgrubs/ spobs pa/ brtan thob/ ces dang / yi ge gsum pa la/ khyod kyi gsung / gnyis med blo/ lcags sgrog bis/ sbrel legs 295

'dra/ zhes dang / yi ge bzhi pa la/ rgyal sras dpa' bo/ 'jam dbyangs khyod kyi/ leb/sa bshad nor rgyun/ bdag blo tshim mdzad/ ces dang / yi ge lnga ba la/brtse ldan khyod kyi gsung / dri za'i pi wang ltar/ snyan cing 'jebs pa yis/ /gdul bya'i yid 'phrog byed/ / ces bod skad kyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir/ rang 'grel las gsungs pa'i nyer mkho grangs kyi brda chad ni/gzugs gcig zung gnyis me ni gsum/ /rig byed chu gter mtsho chu bzhi/ /mda' dbang byed pa yul rnams lnga/ / dus dang ro dang mtshams ni drug/ 'jig rten rta dbyangs thub pa bdun/ /nor lha yan lag myos byed brgyad/ /bu ga nam mkha' gza' gter dgu/ / phyogs dang sgra sgrog bcu yi ming / / drag po 'phrog byed bcu gcig dang / /nyi ma sgro la byed khyim bcu gnyis/ /'dod pa srid pa bcu gsum ste/ /yid skyes ma/ nu bcu bzhi'o/ /zhes/ grangs dang ldan par grags pa'i dngos pos grangs rnams go bar byed cing de dag gi grangs 'dren tshul 'dir mangs kyis dogs pas 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel ba 'dod 'jo dang / rtsis gzhung sogs las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ bṛt+ta bshad pa/ dzā ti bshad pa/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i rnam grangs pe/sa thabs ngo mtshar rtogs byed sogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ma/nyam pa dang / phyed ma nyam pa dang / mi mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i bṛt+ta'i dbye ba rnam pa gsum yod de/ de dag so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ tsut+ta gang zhig rkang pa bzhi ga'i sdeb sbyo ra mtshungs pa/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i mtshan nyid/ bṛt+ta gang zhigarkang pa zung gnyis sdeb sbyor 'dra la ya gnyis de dang mi mtshungs pa/ phyed mnyam/ pa'i bṛt+ta'i mtshan nyid/ bṛt+ta gang zhig rkang pa bzhi so so'i sdeb sbyor mi mtshungs pa/mi mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i mtshan nyid/ de dag gi mtshan gzhi ni/ ma/nyam pa'i bṛt+ta ni dbus phra sogs dang / phyed mnyam pa ni nyer bkra sogs dang / mi mnyam pa ni kha sgo la sogs pa rnams dang go rim bzhin du sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /mnyam pa la gzhung du dper brjod dngos su yod pa dbus phra sogs dgu bcu go bdun yod de/ yi ge drug 296

pa nas nyer drug pa'i bar dper brjod yod pa brgyad cu'i steng / nyer bskyed kyi dper brjod gcis yi ge nyer bdun pa man chad la rgyun chags brgyad dang / rab bsags brgyad bsnan pas go bdun yod pa'i phyir/ phyed mnyam la nyer bkra sogs bcu gsum dang / mi mnyam pa la kha sgo sogs bcu gcig rkang bzhi 'phel sogs lnga/ steng 'gro sogs gsum/ dal 'gro sogs sasum ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod do/ /skabs 'dir nga' bso zhes pa ming mthar 'jog mtshams bya tshul bshad pa ni/ gang 'dod pa'i ming tshig rnams kyi mthar ngal bso bya rigs te/ gnas pa dang / sdod pa dang / ngal bso dang / 'jog pa dang / rdzogs pa dang / gcod mtshams rnams ming gi rnam grangs so/ /de lta bu'i ngal bso de rkang pa rnams kyi mtha' la byed na/rkang pa zung gnyis kyi mtha' la nges par bya dgos kyi/ rkang pa zung min gyi mthar bya ba'i nges pa med do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rgya gar gyi tshigs bcad gcig la phyed snga phyi gnyis su bcad nas/ phye da snga ma rkang pa dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis ka shad gcig gi bar du chud par byas nas mthar tshig shad dang / phyed phyi ma rkang pa gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis kyang shad gcig gi bar du chud par byas te tshigs bcad rdzogs pa'i mtha' yin pas nyis shad byed par bshad do/ /des na phyed snga phyi'i rkang pa zung min gnyis kyi mtha' la ngal bso'i nges pa med cing / rkang pa zung gnyis kyi mthar shad kyis chod pas ngal bso dgos so/ /rkang pa so so'i nang yi ge gsum tshan re'i mthar ngal bso na bha sogs yi ge brgyad po la uta de u thung sbyar ba'i/ sau dzu su mu yu ru tu nu zhes byung na de dag gi mthar ngal bso ba'i brda yin pas ngal bso nges par dgos/ yi ge re re la ngal bso tshe lci ba la ngal bso na wa dang / yang ba la ngal bso na ka zhes ming btags shing / rgya gar gyi yi ge la wa dang ba gnyis yig gzugs gcig go/ ngal bso'i rtags la prasta ra'i steng du thig le re bya dgos/ wa dang ka ni di dang e ga'i ming mthas brda byed pa 'dra snyam/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta la rkang pa so so'i nang ming gang gi mtha' la ngal bso 'dod na bya rung ngo ngal bso ni gcod mtshams yin pas ming de rdzogs pa'i mtha' la bya ba yin gyi/ de ltar ma yin par ming gi thog ma'am dbus su 297

ngal bso na ngal bso nyam sa pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta la yi ge drug pa nas nyer drug pa'i bar nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pas/ 'di man chan bṛt+ta dang dzā ti'i dper brjod thams cad kyi skabs gong gi lci yang gi khyad par dang / lci ba la ga dang / yang ba'i ming la dang / gsum tshan rnams kyi brda bha sogs yi ge brgyad kyi ming brda dang / ngal bso'i lci yang ni wa dang / ka zhes tha snyad btags pa rnams blo la byang bar byas na dper brjod bklags pa tsam gyis tshegs med du go ba yin pas gnad du 'dzin dgos so/ /de la dang po yi ge drug pa dbyangs sgrog la spyir rnam grangs drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ mtshon byed tsam du rtsa ba'i dper brjod gcig mdzad pa ni/ to tse t+ta na man+ta/ gal te ta ya dbus phra'o/ /zhes pa ste/ gal te tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa ba'i po so so la yi ge drug re yod pa gsum tshan gnyis su bcad pa'i dang po ta rma tha' yang ba dang / gsum tshan phyi ma ya thog yang ba yin na sdeb sbyor de'i ming dbus phra zhes bya ste/ yi ge drug gi dbus ma gnyis yang bas de ltar btags pa'o/ /de yang rtsa ba'i bod skad kyis sdeb sbyor so so'i mtshan nyid dang ming ston par byed cing / rgya skad kyis dper brjod kyang go chod pa ni bṛt+ta dang dzā ti thams cad la 'dra/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i dper brjod rnams tshigs rkang re re yin pas lan bzhi bskyar nas tshigs bcad bya ste/ dper na/ a ṣa k+ṣi ti po bi khyu ta skru ṭa kyi tiḥya su dha dzi nī ke tū da sta ga rna ghā/ /gang gi rgyal mtshan tog dag ni/ /rgya che stug por tshogs gyur pa/ /grags pa rab rgyas 'di nyid ni/ /sa skyong nyid du rnam par bshad/ /ces pa lta bu dbus phra'i sdeb sbyor yin/ 'di'i zung min gyi rkang pa gnyis kyi mthar ngal bso med do/ /dbus phra ni dbyangs sgrog gi bye brag bcu gsum pa yin te/gzhan rnams ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyis shes par 'gyur ro/ / yi ge bdun pa rab dga' la rnam grangs brgya dang nyer brgyad yod pa las/'dir dper brjod gcig ste/ kumā ra la li tā rdzas ga/ gzhon nu rol pa dza sa ga/zhes pa ste/ rkang pa bzhi po so so la yi ge bdun re la gsum tshan dang po dza dbus lci 298

ri dang / gsu ma tshan gnyis pa sa mtha' lci dang / yi ge tha ma gcig pu ga ste lci ba byung tshe ming gcon nu rol pa zhes bya zhing / dper brjod ni rtsa ba'i gaskad dod lta bu ste thams cad la 'dra/ rab dga'i bye brag sum cu pa yin/ /yi ge brgyad pa rjes bsnga gas la rnam grangs nyis brgya dang nga drug yod pa las 'dir dper brjod lnga ste/ gau tsa tuḥs mā n+ya sau hi/ lci yang bzhi pa de ni 'dra mtshungs so/ /zhes rkang pa so so la lci yang gnyis po lan bzhi bar du bskyar ba de ni ming 'dra mtshungs zhes bya ste/ rjes bsngags kyi bye brag brgya dang don gcig pa yin/'di nu/ gar 'grel du/ brgyad pa'i nang tshan las brgya re gsum pa la yod do/ /zhes 0pa nor ba ste/ bod yig gi ang grangs bris pa phal cher la nor 'khrul byung 'dugarkang pa bzhi po so so la zhes pa mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i rtsa ba'i dper brjod kun tshigs rkang re re yin pas thams cad la sbyar ro/ /la gau tsa tuḥpra mā ṇa sau/ la ga bzhi pa de gzhal dpag go/ lta bu bshad ma thag pa'i lco yang zhes pa ldog nas la ga ste yang lci gnyis po lan bzhir gyur pa de ni ming gzhal dpag ces bya ste/ gya drug pa'o/ /tsi tra pa dā ya di snyo gau/ gal te bha dag ga dag rkang bkra/ /lta bu gal te bha dag ste bha gnyis dang ga dag ste lci ba gnyis byung na ming rkang bkra zhes bya ste/ nga lnga ba'o/ /dag ces pa ni gnyis tshig gi rnam dbye bsgyur ba yin pas grangs gnyis la go bar bya'o/ /mo gi tse tā bi bla drwa lā/ gal te ma dag ga dag glog phreng / /lta bu gal te ma dag dang ga dag byung na ming glog phreng zhes pa ste/ yi ge brgyad pa'i sdeb sbyor dang po yin/ bhā t+ta la gā mā ṇa ba ka/ bha las ta la ga bram ze'i bu/ /lta bu bha las pha rol tu ta dang la ga byung na ming bram ze'i bu zhes bya ste/ mā ṇa ba kai/ 'dir bram ze'i bu zhes 'byung yang /gzhan du mā na baḥ'am mā na ba kai shed ma bye ba dang / shed bu dang / yin ldan dang /shes ldan sogs su bsgyur ba mang ngo / /'di rjes bsngags kyi nang tshan brgya dang gsum pa yin/ /yi ge dgu pa bṛ ha tī la rnam grangs lnga brgya bcu gnyis yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gnyis te/ rā n+da sau ya di ha la mu khri/ gal te ra las na sa dag gshol 299

gdong / /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor ra las pha rol na sa dag byung ba'i tshe ming gshol gdong zhes bya ste/ bṛ ha tī'i bye brag nyis brgya nga gcig pa yin/ bhu dza ga shi shu bu tā gau maḥn dag ma ni lag 'gro khye'u'i bu/ lta bu rkang pa so so la na dag dang ma byung na ni ming lag 'gro khye'u'i bu zhes bya ste/ drug cu re bzhi pa yin/ /yi ge bcu pa phreng ldan la rnam grangs stong dang nyer bzhi yod pa'i nang nas 'dir dper brjod lnga byung ste/ rnyo yā shun+ta bi rāts+tsha sau dza gau/ ma sa dza ga dag pa'i snang bar shes par bya/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so so la ma dang sa dang dza dang ga byung na ming dag pa'i snang ba zhes bya bar shes par bya ste/ phreng ldan gyi bye brag gsum brgya zhe lnga pa yin/ mo āṅgāḥkha lu pa ṇa ba:khyu taḥm na ya las lci nges 'khar rngar bshad/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma dang na dang ya las pha rol tu lci ba gcig nges par yod tshe ming 'khar rnga zhes bya bar bshad de/ brgya nyer gcig pa'o/ /sgyu d+ma yu ra sā ri ṇi re dzi gau/ ra dza ra dang ba/ ni rma bya'i 'gros yin/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra dang dza dang ra dang ga yod pa ni ming rma bya'i 'gros zhes bya ba yin te/ brgya don gcig pa'o/ /rumi ba tī sā ya tra bha smra sau/ gang la bha ma sa ga de ni gser ldan/ /lta bu gang gi rkang bzhi so so la bha dang ma dang sa dang ga yod pa de ni ming gser ldan zhe (she bya ste/ brgya go dgu pa'o/ /rnye yā ma'i ma bha sa ga sriX/ ma bha sa gas bskyed pa myos mar shes par bya/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma dang bha dang sa dang ga yis bskyed pa ste byung na ming myos ma zhes bya bar shesapar bya ste/ phreng ldan gyi bye brag nyis brgya zhe gcig pa'o/ / yi ge bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags la rnam grangs nyis stong zhe brgyad yod pa las/'dir dper brjod bcu bzhi 'byung ste/ tadz+dza ga gi tī ya mu pa sbri tā sgyutwa/ ta las dza gnyis ga ga zhes 'di nyer 'khod 'gyur/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ta las pha rol dza gnyis dang ga dang ga zhes yod pa 'di ni ming nyer 'khod ces bya bar 'gyur te/gsum bsngags kyi bye brag sum brgya re lnga pa yin/ sgyu di n+d+ra bsto ya di kau dza go gaḥ/gal te dbang po rdo rje ta gnyis dza lci gnyis/ /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so so la ta gnyis dang dza dang lci ba gnyis yod pa'i tshe ming dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ste/ sum brgya nga 300

bdun pa'o/ /u ben+d+ra badz+ra hi dza kau dza gi gaḥ/ dza ta dza lci gnyis ni nye dbang rdo rje ste/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor dza dang ta dang dza dang lci ba gnyis yod pa ni ming nye dbang rdo rje zhes bya ste/ sum/ brgya nga brgyad pa'o/ /dbang po rdo rje dang nye jibang rdo rje gnyis kyi rkang pa bsre ba'i nyer bskyed tshigs su bcad pa gcig ni/ a nat+na rot+ta bi ta la k+ṣa ṇa rdzu/ pā rda bha be tā bi bi dhe rbi ka lpaḥ/ yā sā mu kau shra bya ya di pra pastso/ smṛ twaḥbla tī shi ru pa dzā ta ya stuḥ/ de ma thag tu brjod zin la sogs mtshan nyid dag/ sna tshogs rnam rtog rnams kyis rkang pa dag tu 'gyur/ /gang de gnyis ka mnyan 'os ngal gso'i spros pa can/ /de rnams nyer bskyed rnams su dran pa'i dbang pos bshad/ /ces pa lta bu gong de ma thag tu brjod zin pa'i dbang po rdo rje dang la sogs pa nye dbang rdo rje gnyis ku'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rkang pa dag gang 'dod sna tshogs pa'i rnam rtog rnams kyis spel bas nyer bskyed bcu bzhi'i rkang pa dag tu 'gyur ba gang yin pa/dbang rdor nye rdor gyi rkang pa bsres pa de gnyis ka rna bar mnyan par 'os shing ngal bso'i spros pa can/ de rnams ni nyer bskyed rnams su dran pa'i dbang po ste mkhas pas bshad do/ /zhes pa ste/ mdor bsdu na/ dbang po rdo rje dang nye dbang rdo rje gnyis kyi rkang pa rnam rtog la shar tshod bsrengan pa ni nyer bskyed ces mkhas pas bshad ces pa'o/ /'di nyer bskyed bcu bzhi'i nang tshan nyer bskyed dgu pa yin/ 'dir nyer bskyed bcu bzhi brtag thabs ni/ yi ge bzhi pa'i prasta ra bzhin blta bar bya ste/gcig gnyis bzhi brgyad ang ku'i 'og/ yang grangs dang bstun i dang u/ /steng nas 'og tu brtsegs te bris/ /sngon ma gsum yang yang grangs dang / /mthun par bcu drug bar du spel/ /yi ge re re rkang pa re/ /mtshon phyir steng gi phreng bsgrigs kyi/ /i bzhi dbang po rdo rje dang / / tha ma'i u bzhi nye rdor ma/tshon/ / bar gyi bcu bzhi nyer sgyu bskyed yin/ /re'u mig 'di lta bu'o/ /( )do ḍū ka mi ts+tsha ti bha tri ta yutho/ bha gsum las ni ga dag 'jo ba por 'dod do/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor bha gsum las pha rol tu ni ga dag ste lci ba gnyis yod pa'i tshe ming 'jo ba po zhes par 'dod do/ /'di bzhi brgya so dgu pa yin/ mo/ ba ro ba shā li ri be da lo skaX/ ma wa ra gnyis wa ri ga 'jig rten tshoḥ( lhaḥji tshoḥji (ཿste /)/du/)kyi

shā li nī/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma dang wa ste lci ba gcig la ngal bso ba dang ra gnyis kyi mthar wa ste lci ba la ngal bso ba rig byed de bzhi dang 'jig rten te yi ge bdun pa la ngal bso na ming shā li nī zhes bya ste/ bsgyur na skyon med ma/ zer/ wa zhes pa ni lci ba'i yi ge gcig la ngal bso ba'i don te/ lci ba wa/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /nyis brgya gya dgu pa'o/ /mo bāḥsi bā ya di bā ro rmi mā lha/ gal te ma wa sa ra wa ni chu rlabs phreng / /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor ma wa dang sa dang ra wa dang bcas te gong ltar bzhi dang bdun la ngal bso ba ni ming chu rlabs phreng ba zhes bya ste/ sum brgya dang lnga pa'o/ /mo bā rna bā bh+ra ma ra ba la li tā/ ma wa na dag wa ni bung ba rol ba'o/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma wa na dag ste na gnyis wa dang bcas te gong ltar bzhi dang bdun la ngal bso ba ni ming bung ba rol ba zhes bya'o/ /sto nga dang dgu pa yin/ nāt+pa re na ra la gā ra thosta tā/ ra las pha rol na ra la ga shing rta dregs/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra las pha rol tu na dang ra dang la dang ga sbyar ba ni ming shing rta dregs pa zhes bya ste/ 'di la rig byed dang 'jig rten la ngal bso med do/ /drug brgya go dgu pa'o/ /snya ga twa ra na bha ge rgu ru ṇa tsa/ ra na bha ga rnams dang lci bas legs 'ongs so/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra na bha ཿka/ rnams dang mthar lci bas mtha' brten pa ni ming legs 'ongs zhes bya ste/ bzhi brgya zhe gsum pa'o/ /dang don tsa thung ngu yin yang rkang ma tha'i dbyangs thung phal cher lci ba dang prasta ra 'khyog po thob pa yin te/ rkang pa'i mtha' rnams su mang po zhig lci ba dang ga dang 'khyog po'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /na na sa ga gi ti tsa lha ben+d+ra dh+wa/ na na sa ga ga zhes bya ba zlum por 'gyur/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na na sa rnams kyi mthar ga dang ga zhes bya ba yin na ming skum po zhes par 'gyur te/ nyis brgya dang nga drug pa'o/ /na na ra la gi ti tsi ba bha dri kā/ na na ra la ga zhes bya ba bzang ldan nyid/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dang na dang ra dang la dang ga zhes bya ba yin tshe ming bzang ldan zhes pa nyid yin te/ bdun brgya dang bzhi ba'o/ /ཿrlu dī ri tā ra dzi ra la gu ruḥ/ ra dza ra la dang ni lci ba dkar mor brjod/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra dang dza dang ra dang la dang ni lci ba sbyar na ming dkar mo zhes bya bar 302

brjod pa yin te/ drug brgya dang gya gsum pa'o/ /dza sau tsa ta ga gzhu pa sbri ta sgyuta/ja sa ta dang ga ga rnams ni nyer gnas 'gyur/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sgor dza dang sa dang ta dang ga dang ga rnams sbyar ba ni ming nyer gnas zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ nyis brgya gya drug pa'o/ / yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro la rnam grangs bzhi stong dang go drug yod pa las 'dir dper brjod bco lnga ste/ tsan+d+ra waṭ+wā tsa ra yas ra na bha si:/ ra na bha sas rgyu zhing 'khor ba zla ba'i lam/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra dang na dang bha dang sa rnams kyis tshigs rkang la rgyu ba ste 'gro zhing 'khor ba ni ming zla ba'i lam zhes bya ste/ stong dang dgu brgya don dgu pa'o/ /u shan+ti baṃ shas mi rda dza kau dza ro/ dza ta dza ra 'di ni rigs gnas nyid du 'dod/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor dza dang ta dang dza dang ra rnams sbyor ba 'di ni ming rigs gnas zhes bya ba nyid du 'dod pa yin te/ stong sum brgya gya gnyis pa'o/ /sgyu dirnga baṃ shā kha lu ya tra kau dza ro/ gang la ta gnyis dza ra nges par dbang po'i rgyud 'gyur/ཿ /lta bu sdeb sbyor gang gi rkang pa so so la ta gnyis dang dza dang ra yod pa de ni nges par ming dbang po'i rgyud ces bya bar 'gyur te/ stong sum brgya gya gcig pa'o/ /pu ṭa i ha ba su be dā rna ga bo rba/ na dag ga wa ra wa nor rig byed 'dir sbyor ba'o/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dag ste na gnyis ga dang wa dang ra dang wa rnams nor te brgyad dang rig byed la ngal bso ba ni skabs 'dir ming sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ lnga brgya don drug pa'o/ /ṛ tū dza su dza smu dza lod+dha ta ga tiḥ/ dus dag la ni dza su dza su chu 'thor 'gro/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor dus dag la ni zhes pa yi ge drug drug gi mtha' la ste dza su dang dza su zhes dza dang sa mtha' lci la ngal bso na ming chu 'thor 'gro zhes bya ste/stong brgyad brgya gya drug pa'o/ /su zhes pa ni sa mtha' lci'i tshogs mthar ngal bso ba'i don yin pas gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ bha sogs uta la de ldan no/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir no/ /ngal bso mtshon byed u thung yin yang dper brjod skad dod la sru zhes ring cha btags pa ni sdeb sbyor gyi lci yang 'grig pa'i ched rnam dbye au byin pa yin pas bod yig la ring cha mi dgos pa de 'dra'i rigs gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ /a tha to 303

ṭa ka mabho sa kā ra kurta/ sa yig chu gter byas pa de nas 'gro byed do/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor sa yig chu gter te bzhi bkod par byas pa ni de nas ming 'gro byed ces bya ste/ stong bdun brgya nga drug pa'o/ /dru ta pi la m+bi ta mā ha na kau bha ro/ na dang bha dang bha ra dal myur yin par smra/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dang bha dang bha dang ra yin tshe ming dal myur zhes bya ba yin par smra ste/ stong bzhi brgya re ba'i pa'o/ /bhu ji gi pra yā haṃ tse tu r+bha r+ya kā riḥ/ ya yig bzhi rnams kyis ni lag 'gro ltung ba yin/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ya yig bzhi rnams kyis ni ming lag 'gro ltung ba zhes bya ba yin te/lnga brgya gya drug nga/'o/ /kirti tai ṣā tsa tū re phi ka sra gī ṇi/ ra yig bzhi pa de ni me tog phreng can grags/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra yig bzhi dang ldan pa de ni ming me tog phreng can zhes grags pa ste/ stong dang brgya don gcig pa'o/ /pra mi tāk+ṣa rā sa dza sa soḥka thi tā/ sa dza sa sa rnams kyis yi ge nyung ngur grags/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor sa dang dza dang sa dang sa rnams kyis ni ming yi ge nyung ngu zhes par grags te/ stong dang bdun brgya don gnyis pa'o/ /ma gā ra pho bā be+e shwa de wī sha rā shīḥ/ ma ga wa ra ra wa ma nga' rtas sna tshogs lha mo'o/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma ga wa dang ra ra wa rnams mda' dang rta yis ngal bso na ming sna tshogs lha mo zhes bya ste/ lnga brgya don bdun pa'o/ /mo bā n+ya ga dza la dha ra mā lā s+t+waṃ taḥ/ ma wa na ya ga wa rgya mtsho yan lag chu 'dzin phreng / /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma wa dang na ya ga lawa rnams rgya mtsho dang yan lag la ngal bso na ming chu 'dzin phreng ba zhes bya ste/ nyis brgya zhe gcig pa'o/ /na na ra ra gha ṭi tā tsa mahā ki nī/ na na ra ra 'dus pa dal gyis 'bab pa yin/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na na ra ra 'dus pa ni ming dal gyis 'bab pa zhes pa yin te/ chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ stong nyis brgya bcu drug pa'o/ /ba nga ti mu nirla mu māṃ na dzi dza ro/ na dza dza ra ya mu nā ru thub pa smra/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dza dza ra rnams yin tshe ming ya mu nā zhes pa ru thub pa dmar ser gyis smra'o/ /ya mu nā bsgyur na 'gog byed ma dang gang thub pa zhes pa'ang snang / chu bo ya mu nā'i ming btags pa ste/ stong sum brgya go gnyis pa'o/ /i ha na ba mā li nī ya di na dzi bho/ gal te 'dir ni na dza bha ya 304

phreng ba gsar ba'o/ /lta bu gal te sdeb sbyo ra 'dir ni rkang bzhi so sor na dza bha ya sbyar tshe ming phreng ba gsar ba zhes bya ste/ dgu brgya zhe bzhi pa'o/ / miyi ge bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro la rnam grangs brgyad stong chig brgya go gnyis yong pa las 'dir dper brjod lnga ste/ dra shā bhi rmu na dza ra bāḥpra ha r+sha ṇi sum̐ te/ mu na dza ra wa rnams gsum dang phyogs kyis rab dga' can/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor mu na dza ra lha rnam sa yod cing yi ge gsum pa dang phyogs kyis ngal bso na ming rab dga' can zhes bya'o/ /mu zhes pa ni ma ku na lce'i mthar ngal bso ba ste/ stong bzhi brgya rtsa gcig pa'o/ /dza bo na rdza ri ti ru tsi rā tsa tu rga hiḥ/ dza wa na dza ra zhes bzhi dang gza' yis mdzes pa yin/ /lta bu rkyang bzhi so sor dza wa na dza ra zhes pa rnams yod pa bzhi dang gza' yis ngal bso na ming mdzes pa'am dga' mdzes zhes pa yin te/nyis stong brgyad brgya rtsa drug pa'o/ /mo bo bha stoḥsi ba ya ti mat+ta me yu raḥ/ ma wa bha ta ya rnam sa de nyid ngal bso rma bya myos/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma wa bha ta ya rnams yod cing gong ltar bzhi dang gza' de nyid la ngal bso na ming rma bya myos pa zhes bya ste/sto nga drug brgya so gsum pa'o/ /sa dza hāḥs gi tsa ka thi tiḥka la ha saḥ/ sa dza sa dang sa ga rnam sa ni snyan pa'i ngang par bshad/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor sa dza sa dang sa ga rnam/sa yin pa ni ming snyan pa'i ngang pa zhes par bshad de/ ka la haṃ saḥyid 'ong yang zer/ stong bdun brgya don gnyis pa'o/ /sa dza sā dza gau tsa ya di mdzi bhā ṣi ṇi/ gal te sa dza sa rnams dang ni dza ga 'jam pa'i dag/ lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor sa dza sa rnams dang ni dza ga yin na ming 'jam pa'i ngag ces bya ste/ nyis stong bdun brgya go drug pa'o/ /yi ge bcu bzhi pa nus ldan la rnam grangs khri drug stong sum brgya gya bzhi yod pa las 'dir dper brjod lnga ste/ mā gā bā rna māḥsha ra na ba bhi ra saṃ bā d+mā/ ma ga wa dang na gnyis ma rnams mda' dang dgu yis gnod med do/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma ga wa dang na gnyis dang ma rnams ni mdang dang dgu yis ngal bso na ming gnod med ces bya ste/ nyis stong dang bcu bdun pa'o/ /na na bi dza dza bi tsi swa ri ra pa rā dzi tī/305

na na wa dang dza dza wa rnams dbyangs kyis gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na na wa dang dza dza wa rnams sbyar ba dbyangs kyis te yi ge bdun bdun pa la ngal bso na ming gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ste/ lnga stong brgyad brgya nyer bzhi pa'o/ /pra ha ra na 7 li tā na na bi na na bi rtaḥn na wa dang na na wa rnams de yis mtshon cha kha 'bus so/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na na wa dang na na wa rnams snga ma ltar yi ge bdun bdun pa de yis ngal bso na ming mtshon cha kha 'bus zhes bya ste/ brgyad stong tshig brgya nyer brgyad pa'o/ /rnye yaṃ ba san+ta ti la ka ta bha dz+rī dza gau giḥtabha dza dza ga ga dpyid kyi thig ler shes par bya/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ta bha dza dza ga ga rnams sbyor na ming dpyid kyi thig le yin par shes par bya ste/ nyis stong dgu brgya so gsum pa'o/ /ba su bhā sla bo na pi tsa ro tsa pañtsa gra lhaḥs la wa na gzhan yang ra dag lnga dang gza' yis ror 'dzin no/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor sa la wa dang na dang gzhan yang ra dag ste ra gnyis de lta bu la lnga dang gza' yis ngal bso na ming nor 'dzin zhes bya ste/ bzhi stong brgyad brgya zhe bzhi pa'o /yi ge bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan la rnam grangs sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya re brgyab/ yod pa'i nang tshan 'dir dper brjod lnga ste/ gu ru ni dha na ma nu la ghu ri ha sha shi ka lā/ lci ba tha ma yang ba ma nus 'dir ni ri bong can gyi cha/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor lci ba gcig rkang pa'i tha mal bkod nas yi ge gzhan thams cad yang ba 'ba' zhig ma nu ste bcu bzhi rnams kyis 'dir ni sdeb sbyor gyi ming ri bong can gyi cha zhes bya'o/ /ri bong can gyi cha ni zla ba'i cha ste/ zla ba'i cha shas bcu drug yin pas 'dir phyi mo'i grangs las ming btags par mngon/ sra gi ya ma pi tsa ra sa na ba ka bi ra ma ṇa/'dir ni gzhan yang ro dang dgu yis ngal bsor gyur na phreng pa'o/ /lta bu ri bong can gyi cha 'dir ni gzhan yang ro dang dgu yis ngal bso bar gyur na ming phreng ba zhes bya'o/ /ba su mu ni ya ti ri ti ma ṇi ku ṇa ni ka raḥde lta bu la nor dang thub par ngal bso yon tan nor bu'i tshogs/ /zhes pa ri bong can gyi cha de lta bu la nor dang thub par ngal bso na ming yon tan nor bu'i tshogs zhes bya'o/ /ri bong can gyi cha dang / phreng ba/306

yo na tan nor bu'i tshogs 'di gsum ni yi ge bco lnga pa'i nang tshan khri drug stong sum brgya bya bzhi pa yin yang ngal bso ba'i khyad par tsam gyis phye ba yin/ri de ltar na sdeb sbyor re re la'ang ngal bso'i khyad par las du ma dbyer rung ba ni/ 'dod pa rnams kyi gnas pa sdod/ ces sogs mdo gsum/ gyi dgongs pa'o/ /na na ga ba ra ra bāḥsu rmā li nī twakhya lo gaḥn na ga wa ra ra wa rnams brgyad dang 'jig rten phreng ldan ma/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na na ga wa dang ra ra wa rnams la brgyad dang 'jig rten la ngal bso ba ni ming phreng ldan ma zhes bya ste/ bzhi stong drug brgya don gnyis pa'o/ /na dza bha dza ra rbi rā dzi ta mi rda sa mu dra rki/ na dza bha dza ra rnams rnam par spel ba 'di ni rgya mtsho can/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dza bha dza ra rnams rnam par spel ba 'di ni ming rgya mtsho can zhes bya ste/ khri chig stong brgya gya bzhi pa'o/ / yi ge bcu drug pa legs spyod la rnam grangs drug khri lnga stong lnga brgya so drug yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gnyis te/ bhak+ta na hā mu naḥkha mṛ ṣa bha ga dza bi la pi rta/bha ra ka na na sa thub las mkha' la khyu mchog glang chen rtsen/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor bha ra ka dang na na sa rnams yod cing thub pa dang de las pha rol tu mkha' ste yi ge dgu pa la ngal bso bar gyur na ming khyu mchog glang chen rtsen zhes bya ste/ ka zhes pa ni yang ba'i yi ge gcig la ngal bso ba'i don te/ yang ba ga zhes bshad do/ /sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya nyer bdun pa'o/ /na dza bha dza rā gu ru sh+tsa ya di tat+ta dku su m+bha/ gal te na dza bha dza ra lci de ni de tshe le brgan rtsi/ /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor na dza bha dza ra rnams kyi mthar lci ba gcig yin pa de ni de tshe ming le brgan tsi zhes bya ste/ khri dang chig stong brgya gya bzhi pa'o/ /yi ge bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod la rnam grangs tshig 'bum sum khri chig stong dang don gnyis yod pa las 'dir dper brjod bdun yod de/ ya mū nā sā bhā m+wa ra sa ha ra bi rā mā shi kha ri ṭī/ ya mu nas bha la wa rnams ro dang 'phrog byed ngal bso gtsug phud can/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor yu mu na sa bha la wa rnams sdeb cing ro dang 'phrog byed la ngal bso ba ni ming gtsug phud can zhes bya ste/ lnga khri dgu stong sum 307

brgya sum cu pa'o/ /dper brjod kyi skad dod la mu nāhā bhā m+wa zhes ring cha rnams sdeb sbyor gyi lci yang gi dbang gis rnam dbye au dang dzas byin pa'i shul yin pas bod skad kyi mtshan nyid ston pa'i tshe mi dgos te/ tshul de gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ /dza sa la na ra rā ba su gra ha ya ti stu bru bī ma hā/ dza sa la wa na ra ra rnams nor dang gza' la sdod la yangs ldan ma/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor dza sa la wa na ra ra rnams nor dang gza' la sdod pa ste ngal bso na ming yangs ldan ma zhes bya ste/ sum khri brgyad stong bdun brgya lnga bcu pa'o/ /dis ni paṃ sha pa tra pa ti haṃ bha ra na ba na na baiḥ bha ra na wa na na wa rnams phyogs dang thub par 'od ma'i 'dab ma lhung / /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor bha ra na wa na na wa rnams yod pa phyogs dang thub par ngal bso na ming 'od ma'i 'dab ma lhung ba zhes bya ste/ drug khri bzhi stong dgu brgya gya gsum pa'o/ /na su ma ba dza dzā bāḥswā dā d+dhi swa ri rta ri ṇi ma/ dā/kyi na su ma wa dza dza wa rnams ro chu dbyangs la ri dwags mo ru 'dod/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na su ma rnye dang dza dza wa rnams ro dang chu dang dbyangs la ngal bso ba ni ming ri dwags mo zhes bya ba ru 'dod de/ bzhi khri drug stong brgya dang bcu gnyis pa'o/ /man+da kran+ta ma ba na su ra rā dzaḥs mu 2tu lo kiḥmawa na su ra ra wa rnams mtsho dus 'jig rten ngal gyis gnon/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so so la ma wa na su ra ra lwa rnams yin pa rim bzhin mcho dang dus dang 'jig rten la ngal bso na ming ngal gyis gnon zhes bya ste/ chig khri brgyad sto nga dgu brgya nyer dgu pa'o/ /na dza bha dza dzā la gau tsa ya di n-i rkugs kun+tu ta dā/ gal te na dza bha dza dza la ga rnams de tshe bum pa can/ /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor na dza bha dza dza la ga rnams yin pa de'i tshe ming bum pa can zhes bya ste/ lnga khri drug stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu pa'o/ /na dza ba na rtsa bha bo mu ni ra so da dhe ko ki la kai/ na dza wa na bhu dang bha wa thub pa ro dang chu gter khu byug can/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dza wa dang na bhu bha wa rnams yin pa thub pa dang ro dang chu gter la ngal bso na ming khu byug can zhes bya ba/ lnga khri drug stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu pa ste/ bum pa can dang khu byug can gnyis nga' bso'i khyad par ma gtogs lci yang 'dra zhing /dper brjod kyi bhu'i ring cha ni sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis rnam dbye au sbyar ba yin pas 308

bod skad la mi dgos so/ /yi ge bco brgyad pa brtan 'jin la rnam grangs nyis 'bum drug khri nyis stong chig brgya zhe bzhi yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gnyis te/ ma gwa nu ro baḥku su mi ta la tā bal+li tā k+ṣartu lo kiḥm ga wa na su dang ra gnyis wa rnams dbang dus 'jig rten me tog g.yo ba'i 'khri shing ngo / /lta bu rkang bzhi so so la na ga wa na su dang ra gnyis dang wa rnams yin pa rim par dbang po dang dus dang 'jig rten la ngal bso bar gyur na ming me tog g.yo ba'i 'khri shing zhes bya ste/ sum khri bdun stong brgyad brgya nga bdun pa'o/ /i ha na na ra tse tuṣ+ka sriṣ+ṭa chu nā rā tsa mā tsak+ṣa te/ 'dir ni na gnyis ra bzhi bsgrigs pa lcags kyi mda' ru 'chad par byed/ /lta bu sdeb sbyor 'dir ni rkang bzhi so sor na gnyis dang ra yig bzhi bsgrigs pa ni ming lcags kyi mda' zhes bya ba ru 'chad par byed de/ bdun khri bzhi stong dgu brgya zhe bzhi pa'o/ /yi ge bcu dgu pa shin tu brtan 'dzin la rnam grangs 'bum phrag lnga dang nyis khri bzhi stong nyis brgya gya brgyad yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gnyis te/ ya snan re pho baḥṣa ṣ+ṭṛ tu tu ra ga magha bisbu dzi twa sgyu ta/ ya mun su ra ra wa rnams drug dus mgyogs 'gros sprin rnam sgrog tu 'gyur/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ya mu dngan su dngar ra wa rnams yin pa de lta bu'i drug dang dus dang mgyogs 'gro ste rta rnams kyis ngal bso na ming sprin rnam sgrog tu 'gyur te/ bdun khri lnga stong bdun brgya bcu bzhi pa'o/ /arka shīn dem/ཿsa rdza su ta ta bāḥshād la bi spyi'i haṃ/ gal te ma sa dza su ta ta wa rnams nyi ma rta yis stag rnam rtsen/ /lta bu gal te rkang pa so sor ma sa dza su ta ta lwa rnams yod pa nyi ma dang rta yis ngal bso na ming stag rnam rtsen zhes bya ste/ chig 'bum bzhi khri dgu stong sum brgya so bdun pa'o/ /yi ge nyi shu pa byed ldan la rnam grangs ya gcig dang bzhi khri brgyad stong lnga brgya don drug yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gnyis te/ sa bhā shā swā da bhi n+d+ra ma ra ba na na ba tāḥsu sh+tsa t+pa ba danā/ gal te ma ra wa na na wa ta su rnams la bdun rta ro yis phye ba kha mdzes so/ /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor ma ra wa dang na na wa dang ta su rnams yod 309

pa la bdun dang rta dang ro yis phye ba ste ngal bso ba ni ming kha mdzes zhes bya ste/ bzhi 'bum drug khri drug stong brgyad brgya so gsum pa'o/ /bṛt+ta mā dri shas nā ma to ra rdza ra rdza ra dzi gu ru rā ghu sh+tsa/ ra dza ra dza lci ba yang ba 'di lta bu rnams zlum po zhes byar 'dod/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ra dza ra dza ra dza dag lan gsum dang mthar lci ba dang yang ba yod pa 'di lta bu rnams ni ming zlum po zhes bya bar 'dod de/ drug 'bum dgu khri dgu stong dang ra gcig pa'o/ /yi ge nyer gcig pa rab byed ldan la rnam grangs sa ya gnyis dang dgu khri bdun stong chig brgya dang nga gnyis yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gcig ste/ mo bo ni rna ba: ro bas bhi ri ti bi ra tiḥs p+ta naḥsrag rā sgyu ta/ ma ra wa na na wa ra ra wa rnams bdun pa gsum gyis sdod pa phreng 'dzin zhes byar 'gyur/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor ma ra wa dang na na wa dang ra ra wa rnams te 'di lta bu'i bdun pa gsum gyis sdod pa ni ming phreng 'dzin zhe sa byar 'gyur te/ sum 'bum nyis stong dgu brgya go gsum pa'o/ /yi ge nyer gnyis pa kun byed lda na la rnam grangs sa ya bzhi dang chig 'bum dgu khri bzhi stong sum brgya dang bzhi yod pa las 'dir dper brjod gcig ste/ ya tra bha ro na bo dza sa dza sā da sho'i gu ba rā mi ma bra ka mi rda/ gang la bha ra na wa dza sa dza sa phyo gas dang nyi mar ngal bso 'di ni zab mo'i dbyangs/ /lta bu rkang bzhi gang yin so so la bha ra na wa dang dza sa dza sa rnams yin pa phyogs dang nyi mar ngal bso ba 'di ni ming zab mo'i dbyangs zhes bya ste/ sa ya gcig dang dgu 'bum sum khri bdun brgya bcu gcig pa'o/ /yi ge nyer gsum pa rnam byed ldan la rnam grangs sa ya brgyad dang sum 'bum brgyad khri brgyad stong drug brgya dang brgyad yod pa las 'dir gnyis te/ ha ra na bi bha n+ni ma shwa la li rta na rdza tsa bha la bā dza so tsa dza su tsa/ na dza bha la wa dang dza sa dag dang dza su'ang 'phrog byed nyi mar tha dad pa ni rta rol pa/ /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor na dza bha la wa dang dza sa dag dza su'ang yod cing 'phrog byed dang nyi mar tha dad du sdod pa ni ming rta rol pa zhes bya ste/ sa ya gsum dang brgyad 'bum drug khri chig stong bzhi brgya nyer bzhi 310

pa'o/ /ma'i spyi ḍi ba swa gla shā ya di ma mi tsa ga bi tsa na la ka na na na bāḥgal te ma ma ga wa na la ka na na na wa rnams nor dbang phyogs kyis myos ma rtsen pa'o/ /lta bu gal te rkang bzhi so sor ma ma ga wa dang na la ka dang na na na wa rnams yod pa de lta bu'i nor dang dbang po dang phyogs kyis ngal bso na ming myos ma rtsen pa zhes bya ste/ sa ya bzhi dang chig 'bum dgu khri bzhi stong dang zhe dgu pa'o/ /yi ge nyer bzhi pa legs byed ldan la rnam grangs bye ba gcig dang sa ya drug dang bdun 'bum bdun khri bdun stong nyis brgya bcu drug yod la 'dir dper brjod gcig ste/ sgyu di ha ta na bha ga wa tha na na bā kau rlu sha ra su ra ta ra ṇi pi rā mā/ 'dir bha lci ba wa dang de nas na na wa dang bha dag na yu mda' dbyangs sgrol byed ngal bso lus por 'gyur/ /lta bu sdeb sbyor 'dir rkang pa so sor bha lci ba wa dang de nas na na wa dang bha dag ste gnyis dang na dang yu yin pa mda' dang dbyangs dang sgrol byed de nyi ma rnams la ngal bso ba ni mi nga lus phra zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ sa ya bzhi dang chig 'bum lnga khri lnga stong sum brgya re bdun pa'o/ /yi ge nyer lnga ba shin tu byed lda na la rnam grangs bye ba gsum dang sa ya gsum lnga 'bum lnga khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya dang so gnyis yod la 'dir dper brjod gcig ste / nanyu pa dā bha gwa bha ga bā rna lka na na pa i ṣ+ṭha sha ra ba su mun bi ra tiḥbha ga wa bha ga wa na dag la ka na na wa rnams mda' mda' nor dang thub par ngal bso khrung khrung rkang / /lta bu rkang bzhi so sor bha ga wa dang bha ga wa dang na dag ste na gnyis dang la ga dang na na wa rnams 'o da pa mda' dang mda' dang nor dang thub par ngal bso na ming khrung khrung rkang zhes bya ste/ bye ba gcig dang sa ya drug bdun 'bum bdun khri drug stong sum brgya go gcig pa'o/ /ye ge nyer drug pa lhag par byed ldan la spyir rnam grangs bye ba drug dang sa ya bdun chig 'bum brgyad stong brgyad brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa las rtsa bar dper brjod gnyis mdzad de/ mo gau rna la su rdza bāḥswācu su ma da na da ha na mu ni nyispyo dza ga bidz+ra rdzi haṃ/ ma dag ga wa na dag la ka su dang dza dag wa rnams nor lha myos byed med 311

dang thub pa rnams kyis lag 'gro rnam bsgyings so/ /lta bu rkang pa bzhi po so so la ma dag ste ma gnyis dang ga wa dang na dag ste na gnyis dang la ga su dang dza dag ste dza gnyis dang wa rnams yod cing nor lha dang myos byed dang me dang thub pa rnams kyis ngal bso na ming lag 'gro rnam bsgyings zhes bya ste/ bye ba gnyis sa ya gsum brgyad 'bum lnga khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya zhe dgu pa'o/ /mi nu rdi rna nu sa ga bi ti na ba ra sa ra sa ka ra ṇa ba ri ti ra ba bā haḥsatwa/ ma na nu dang na nu rnam gnyis sa ga wa zhes bya rnams dgu dang ro ro byed par ngal bso bzlog phyogs 'bab tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa bzhi po so so la ma na nu dang de nas na nu lan rnam pa gnyis kyi mthar sa ga wa zhes bya ba rnams yod cing dgu dang ro dang ro dang byed par ngal bso na ming bzlog phyogs 'bab tu 'gyur ro/ /sdeb sbyor 'di ni lhag par byed ldan gyi nang tshan sa ya brgyad dang sum 'bum brgyad khri brgyad stong drug brgya rtsa gcig pa yin no/ /de nas yi ge nyer bdun pa man chad kyi sdeb sbyor ni/ rtsa 'grel gnyis kur yi ge nyer drug pa yan ltar yi ge re 'phel bas nyis 'gyur sogs kyi grangs mang po ma mdzad par rgyun chags dang / rab bsags zhes rtsa ba'i dbye ba gnyis dang / de re re la ming dngos su smos pa gtum pa'i char 'bebs sogs brgyu da brgyad dang / de phyin sogs khongs kyis bsdus pa ma gtogs gzhan dngos su ma gsungs so/ /dang po rgyun chags gtum pa'i char 'bebs ni/ pra tha ma ka i ha daṇ+ḍa ka sh+tsa ṇ+ḍa bṛṣ+ṭi pra yā to bha be+en+da dwa ye nā tha riḥsap+ta bhiḥ'adi nyid du ni rgyun chags dang po gtum pa'i char 'bebs dag tu 'gyur te na gnyis dang ni de nas ra bdun rnams kyis so/ /zhes pa ste mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta 'di nyid du ni rgyun chags rnams kyi dang po ni ming gtum pa'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba dag tu 'gyur ba yin te/ gang gis na rkang pa bzhi po so so la na gnyis dang ni de nas bar ma chad par ra bdun yod pa rnams kyis so/ /zhes rkang bzhi so sor na gnyis kyi mthar ra bdun yod pa ni rgyun chags dang por bshad do/ /gnyis pa rgyun chags chu rgyun ni/ pra ti pa da mi ha ra pha bid+dhāḥsu ra ṇ+ḍi ṇ+ḍi ba byā la dz+rī snyu ta lī lha ka ro t+tha ma sha'i da yaḥ/ 'dir ni rkang pa so sor re pha 'phel bar gyur rnams chu rgyun rgya mtsho sbrul 312

dang char sprin rol pa'i 'byung gnas shin tu klubs dang dung sogs so/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de yang rgyun chags kyi skabs 'dir ni rkang pa bzhi bo so soru re pha ste ra yig re re 'phel bar gyur pa rnams kyis snga ma snga ma las sdeb sbyor tha dad par 'gyur ba yin te/'di ltar rkang pa thams cad la na gnyis gzhir byas pa'i rjes su ra brgyad kyis chu rgyun zhes bya ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i na gnyis ra brgyad kyi dper brjod lta bu'o/ / de bzhin du ra dgus gsum pa rgya mtsho dang / ra bcus bzhi pa sbrul dang / ra bcu gcig gis lnga pa char sprin dang / ra bcu gnyis kyis drug pa pha rol ba'i 'byung gnas dang / ra bcu gsum gyis bdun pa shin tu klubs dang / ra bcu bzhis brgyad pa rgyun chags dung zhes bya ba sogs so/ /zhes pa ste/ sogs sgra smos pa ni/ ra bco lnga sags phan chad kyi tshigs bcad rnam/sa kyang rgyun chags dang rab bsags gnyis las gzhan pa'i tha snyad gdags su med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang tshigs rkang ha cang ring na tshig lhug lta bur 'gyur ro/ /rgyun chags rgya mtsho man chad kyi dper brjod mangs kyis dogs nas snga ma'i rigs 'gres go sla ba'i phyir ma mdzad do/ /gnyis pa rab bsags la'ang brgyad yod de/ dang bo rab bsags gtum pa'i char 'bebs ni/ pra tsi ta i ha na yu g.yo sta thā tsaṇ+ḍa bṛṣ+ṭi pra yā tā da mo ya r+ya thā daṇ+ḍa ko riḥ'adir ni na zung dag las ya rnams kyis ni rab bsags gtum pa'i char 'bebs sogs bzhin ra yis rgyun chags bzhin du ya yis so/ /zhes pa ste rab bsags kyi skabs 'dir ni snga ma dang 'dra bar rkang bzhi so so la na zung dag las pha rol ra'i tshab tu ya bdun sbyar ba rnams kyis ni dang po rab bsags gtum pa'i chad 'bebs dang / sogs khongs nas de bzhin du na gnyis gzhir byas kyi rjes su ya brgyad kyis gnyis pa rab bsags chu rgyun dang /ya dgus gsum pa rab bsags rgya mtsho dang / ya bcus bzhi pa rab bsags sbrul dang / ya bcu gcig gis lnga pa rab bsags char sprin dang / ya bcu gnyis kyis drug pa rab bsags rol pa'i 'byung gnas dang / ya bcu gsum gyis bdun pa rab bsags shing tu klubs dang / ya bcu bzhis brgyad pa rab bsags dung zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ snga ma na gnyis kyi rjes su ra yis rgyun chags su 'gyur ba bzhin du 'dir 313

na gnyis kyi rjes su ya sbyar ba yis rab bsags su 'gyur bas so/ /mdor na rgyun chags ni na gnyis kyi rjes la ra bdun la sogs pa sbyar ba dang / rab bsags ni na gnyis kyi rjes la ya bdun sogs sbyar ba'i khyad par tsam mo/ /rab bsags chu rgyun sogs kyi dper brjod kyang snga ma'i rigs pas rtogs sla zhing rgyun chags dang rab bsags gtum pa'i char 'bebs sogs ni re re las dbye ba gzhan med do/ /mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yi ge nyer drug pa yan re re la'ang spyir rnam grangs ji tsam yod pa dang /de'i nang nas gang 'dod ngos 'dzin tshul dang / sdeb sbyor du ba yin pa sogs ni mjug gi ngo ma/tshar rtogs byed drug gis zhib par sto na par byed do/ /gnyis pa phyed mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta zhes pa'i don ni/ bṛt+ta gang zhig/ rkang ba zung min gnyis sdeb sbyor 'dra zhing / zung gnyis de dang mi 'dra ba'i sdeb sbyor gcig pa'i tshigs bcad do/ /zung dang / 'cham pa dang / phyags dang / mnyamapa dang /cha dang / mtshungs pa zhes pa ni rnam grangs dang / zung min dang / 'cham min dang / phrugs min dang / mi mnyam pa dang / ya dang / mi mtshungs pa dang kha yar dang / rkyang pa zhes pa rnam grangs su bshad do/ /de yang tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa gnyis la zung min dang / mi mnyam pa zhes bya la/ rkang pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis la zung dang / mnyam pa zhes nga/'i brda byas pa blo la nges shing gong gi bha thog lci ba sogs kyi brda chad rnam sa kyang byang bar bya dgos so/ /'dir phyed mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta la bcu gsum yod pa las/ dang po nyer bkra zhes bya ba'i bṛt+ta ni/u pa tsa tra la mā hu ra yum yuka sa la gā ya di bha tri ta lngango/ gal te zung min sa dag sa dang lag dag dang / /zung la bha gsum can las ga dag nyer bkrar smra/ /zhes rkang pa zung min dang po dang gsum pa gnyis po re re la sa mtha' lci ba gsum dang la ste yang ba gcig dang ga ste lci ba gcig yod pa dang / rkang pa zung gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis po re re la bha thog lci ba gsum dang ga dag ste lci ba gnyis te/ rkang pa re re la yi ge bcu gcig re bsgrigs pa'i sdeb sbyor yin/ 'di ltar phyed mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta rnams kyi rtsa ba'i dper brjod thams cad tshigs bcad kyi phyed rkang pa gnyis gnyis yin pas 314

lan gnyis bskyar la tshigs bcad bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa myur ba'i dbus ni/ bha tri ta ār+ya di gau dru ta mchi ya di pu na ra ba bha ba n+ti na dzi rdzu/ gal te bha gsum can las ga dag gyur pa la/ /gal te slar nyid na dza dza ya myur ba'i dbus/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis la bha gsum dang ga gnyis te yi ge bcu gcig re dang / rkang pa zung gnyis len dza dza ya ste yi ge bcu gnyis re sbyar ba'i sdeb sbyor ro/ /gsum pa shugs ldan ma ni/ya di sa tri ta yaṃ gu ru yurnya ba ga ba tī ya di bha tra ta yugi/ gal te sa gsum can las lci ba dang ldan zhing / /gal te bha gsum can las ga dag shugs ldan ma/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis la sa gsum dang lci ba gcig ste yi ge bcu re dang / zung gnyis la bha gsum dang lci ba gnyis te yi ge bcu gcig re yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ro/ /bzhi pa bzang po'i snang ba ni/ ya sum̐ ta dza ra pha gā a yug yum bha dra bi rāṇa sau dza gau gaḥgang la zung min ta dza re pha lci ba/ /zung la ma sa dza lci ga ni bzang po'i snang / /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis la ta dza ra dang lce ba ste yi ge bcu re dang /1 zung gnyis la ma sa dza dang lci ba gnyis te yi ge bcu gcig re yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ro/ /lnga pa tog ldan ma ni/ bi ṣa mi sa mi ya di sa dzi sau ka tu ba tī bha re pha na ga gā sh+tsa/ gal te mi mnyam sa dza sa dang lci ba/ /mchi nyam pa bha ra na ga lci ba tog ldan ma/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis la sa dza sa dang lci ba gcig ste yi ge bcu re dang / zung gnyis la bha ra na dang lci ba gnyis te yi ge bcu gcig re sbyar ba'o/ /drug pa kun bsgrags ni/ ā khyu ni ka t+yā r+ya di kau dza gau ga ka yuk+ta da yuk+ta dza kau dza gau gaḥgal te rkang pa zung min ta dag ga lci ga zung ni dza ta dza ga lci ba kun bsgrags so/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis la ta gnyis dza dang lci ba gnyis dang /byu zung gnyis la dza ta dza dang lci ba gnyis te rkang pa so sor yi ge bcu gcig re sbyar ba 'di nyer bskyed bcu pa yin/ bdun pa bzlog pa'i kun bsgrags ni/ dza kau dza gau gatra tsa kau dza gau gā ā khyu ni kā sau bi pa rā ta snu rba/ 'dir yang dza ta dza ga ga ta dag dang dza/ /ga lci de ni kun bsgrags bzlog pa snga ma can/ /zhes snga ma kun bsgrags kyi rkang pa zung min dang zung gnyis so sor go bzlog par byas pa ste nyer bskyed lnga pa yin/ kur 'grel du/ snga ma ni nyer bskyed bdun pa yin la phyi ma ni bcu pa la yod 315

do zhes pa nor ba'o/ /brgyad pa ri dwags 'phyong ni/ ya di sa tri ta yurnya ba to la gau na bha bha dā sh+tsa ta rā ha ri ṇa slu hā/ /gal te sa gsum can las la dang ga yin zhing / /na bha bha ra rnams kyang de tshe ri drags 'phyong / /zhes rkang ba zung min las gsum dang yang ba dang lci ba re ste yi ge bcu gcig re dang / zung la na bha bha ra ste yi ge bcu gnyis yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ro/ /dgu pa gzhan sgo ni/ ya di na na ra la gā na rdza dza ro ya di tsa ta rā& pa ra ba tra mi 6 te/ gal te na na ra dang la dang ga yin zhing / /gal te na dza dza ra de tshe gzhan sgor 'dod/ /ces rkang pa zung min gnyis la na na ra dang yang ba dang lci ba ste yi ge bcu gcig re dang / zung gnyis la na dza dza ra ste yi ge bcu gnyis re yod pa ste/'di phyi mo bgrang na dzā ti ro langs can yin/ bcu pa me tog rgyas pa'i rtse mo ni/ a yu gi ha ya de rna ra yo tsa yumi na dza dza re gaḥka tha yan+ti pukhyi tā gro/ gal te 'dir ni zung min na dag ra ya 'o zung la/ / na dza dza ra ga rnams me tog rgyas pa'i rtse mor brjod/ /ces rkang pa zung min gnyis la na na ra ya ste yi ge bcu gnyis re dang / zung gnyis la na dza dza ra dang lci ba gcig ste yi ge bcu gsum re yod pa ste/ 'di phyi mo bgrang na dzā ti nye ba'i sdeb sbyor yin/ bcu gcig pa nas ldan ma ni/ ra pha dzi ra dzi ta thā dza ro dz+ra gci ya badha nā t+ma tu pi yā sa mā bhi d+mā nā/ ra dza ra dza de bzhin dza ra dza ra ga rnams/ /ya ba'i sgra 'a sa ma tu pu yin te bud med mtshungs par brjod/ /ces rkang pa zung min gnyis la ra dza ra dza ste yi ge bcu gnyis re dang / zung gnyis la de las bzlog nas dza ra dza ra ga ste yi ge bcu gsum re yod pa'o/ /'di la ya ba'i sgra las ma tu pu yin te bud med mtshungs par brjod/ ces pa ni sdeb sbyor gyi yi ge kha bskang ba dang ming ngos gzung ba'i ched yin te/ ya ba'i sgra zhes pa nas kyi ming yin zhing nas kyi skad dod ya ba la de phan gyi rkyen ldan pa'i don ma tu pra sbyar la de phan gyi le'u ltar bsgrubs pa'i ya ba mā na'am ya ba ma tī ni nas ldan zhes pa la sdeb sbyor gyi ming bud med dang mtshungs par ma zhes sbyar te nas ldarno ma zhes brjod par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /bcu gnyis pa rgotsug phud can ni/ da sha da sha ba su la ghu tsa ya di bi ṣa ma mi ta ra da pa tsa da sha da sha da sha la ghu gi/ gu ru ni dha na mu bha ya ma bi be hi ta la li ta bi da bi 316

bri ti ya di bha ba ti bha ba ti shi khā/ gal te mi mnyam bcu dang bcu dang nor ldan dag ni yang ba yin la cig shos dag kyang bcu dang bcu dang bcu rnams yang ba yin zhing / /gal te tha ma gnyis ka dag kyang lci bar byas pha rol ba'i rkang pa rnam par spro bar gyur pa dag ni gtsug phud can du 'gyur/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis po re re la yang ba'i yi ge nyer brgyad kyi mthar lci ba gcig ste yi ge nyer dgu re dang / zung gnyis po re re la yang ba sum cu'i mthar lci ba gcig ste yi ge so gcig re sbyar ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa 'gro ldan 'theng po ni/ sa ma bi ṣa ma tsa ra ṇa pa ri ga di ta ni dza ni la ya ba bi ni ma ya bi hi ta da la bi ra la tsa nā/ /ni ya ta mi ya mi ha bha ba ti dza ga ti ku ṭi la pa da ni ga da na sa phroṃ sha sa ma bhi d+mā mnyam dang mi mnyam rkang pa dang dag gis yongs su brjod pa'i nges pa'i gnas ni nges pa dang bral byas pa 'dab mar bkod pa'i nges pa 'di dag ni/ /'dir ni rkang pa 'khyog bo'i 'gro ba dang ldan 'theng nong ni mtshungs shing 'dra bar mngon par brjod par gyur ba yin/ zhes bshad ma thag pa'i gtsug phud can gyi mnyam mi mnyam gyi rkang pa go bzlog par byas pa ste/ zung min gyi yi ge nyer dgu zung dang / zung gi yi ge so gcig zung min gyi rkang pa la bkod nas/ dper brjod kyi kha bskang ba dang sdeb sbyor gyi ming ngos gzung ba'i ched/ 'dir ni rkang pa 'khyog po'i 'gro ba dang ldan 'theng bo dang ni mtshungs shing 'dra bar mngon par brjod par gyur pa yin/ zhes gsangs so/ /de ltar phyed mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta bcu gsum gyi don mdor bsdus te go bde bar brjod pas rtogs sla'o/ /gsum pa mi mnyam pa'i bsta zhes pa'i don ni/ bṛt+ta gang zhig rkang bzhi so so'i sdeb sbyor mi 'dra ba'o/ /dbye na/ kha sgo dang ni rkang bzhi 'phel/ /steng 'gro dang ni dal 'gro bzhi/ /de las dang po kha sgo ni/ rkang pa re la yi ge brgyad re sdeb pa yin pas thog mtha' re re bor ba'i bar gyi yi ge drug sum tshan gnyis byas pa'i sum tshan dang po de sa mtha' lci dang na kun yang gang rung ma yin par bha dza ma ya ra ta drug po gang rung gis byas pa/ yi ge dang po nas bgrang pa'i mtsho ste bzhi pa'i pha rol sum tshan gnyis pa ya thog yang dang / dza dang / na da nga / ta dang / bha dang / ra 317

dang / ma rnams ci rigs pas khyad par phye ba'o/ /de la bcu gcig las dang po kha sgo spyi ni/ aṣ+ṭha k+ṣa rnga ṣ+ṭha pā de 6/ /nā dh+yā kau yo3 sbru dhe bosnyi/ /rkang pa yig brgyad dang bo las/ /sa na min mtsho las ya kha sgo/ /zhes rkang pa'i yi ge thog mtha' re re bor ba'i bar gyi sum tshan dang po sa dang na gang rung ma yin pa ni bla bre ma gtogs thams cad la gzhir byas yi ge dang bo nas bgrang ba'i mtsho las pha rol ya thog yang ba rkang pa tham sa cad la byung na ming kha sgo zhes bya ste kha sgo spyi'o/ /gnyis pa kha sgo phan pa ni/ yuka nga yo rdza kā re ṇa/ /blti pargya ti gīrti haṃ/ rkang pa zung dag dza yig gis ni/ /kha sgo phan pa zhes par grags so/ /gzhan 'dra ba la rkang pa zung gnyis la mtsho las pha rol dza yig sbyar ba'o/ /gsum pa bzlog pa'i phan pa ni/ je nā yu dza ru dā hro tā/ /pi pa tī twa di ta ṣā smin/ /dza yis zung min brjod pa 'di ni/ /bzlog pa dang po can gyi de'o/ /snga ma las bzlog ste rkang pa zung min gnyis la rme tsho las pha rol dza sbyar ba'o/ /bzhi pa gya gyu can ni/ bsnyi ta de ba tsa pa lha/ /na kā re ṇa yu dzo rnye yā/ /kha sgo de nyid gya gyu can du/ /na yig zung min las shes bya'o/ /rkang pa zung min gnyis la mtsho las pha rol na sbyar ba'o/ /lnga ba yangs ma ni/ la ghu sasnya ma yum yā/ /bi pu lā sau ma hā mu naḥzung la bdun pa yang ba yin pa/ /thub pas de ni yangs mar 'dod do/ /rkang pa zung gnyis kyi yi ge bdun pa yang ba yin pa ni thub pa dmar ser gyi yangs ma'o/ /'di yan chad co ba'i dper brjod rkang pa gnyis re yin pas lan gnyis bskyar te tshigs bcad rdzogs par bya'o/ /si ba ta su sā sarba taḥthams cad nas de de nyid de yin/ /rkang pa zung zung min thams cad kyi bdun pa yang ba ni slob dpon dang lugs kyi yangs ma'o/ /yangs ma'i bye brag drug pa bha yi yangs ma ni/ nye nā sbra dhe sta di pu lā/ /mtsho las bha yis de yi yangs ma/ /gzhan 'dra ba la rkang pa kun la mtsho las pha rol bha sbyar ba'o/ /bdun par yangs ni/ re phi ṇa tse baṃ ta to ju/ ri pas de las gzhan yang de bzhin/ /de bzhin du mtsho sbyar ba dang / brgyad pa na yangs ni/ na kā re ṇa pi tsa ta thā/ na yig gis kyang de bzhin yang ngo / /de bzhin du na sbyar ba dang / dgu pa ta yangs ni/ e paṃ ta kā re ṇa pi bā/ ta yig gis kyang de bzhin nyid do de bzhin du ta 318

ci sbya ra ba dang / bcu pa ma yangs ni/ dra1 ma kā ra ṇa pya baṃ/ ma yig gis kyang de ltar blta'o/ /de bzhin du ma yig sbyar ba ste/ thams cad kyi mtshan nyid gzhan rnams spyi ltar ro/ /bcu gcig pa bla bre ni/ a n+ya da to hi bi tā rna/ de las gzhan ni bla bre yin no/ /zhes gong du bshad zin pa'i kha sgo'i mtshan nyid de rnams las gzhan pa'i kha sgo'i mtshan nyid yod pa thams cad ni/ bla bre zhes ming gcig tu 'gyur te/ yi ge brgyad kyi thog mtha' bor ba'i sum tshan dang po'ang gong ma rnams dang mi 'dra bar sa dang na gang rung yin pa dang / mtsho las pha rol tu'ang sa dang na sogs sngon ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi mtshungs pa byung na bla bre yin pas 'di la nang gses kyis mang du yod par snang ngo / /mtshan nyid la brtags na yangs ma ni/ bha yangs dang /ta yangs dang / na yangs rnams dang mi 'gal bar sems/ rang lugs kyi yangs ma nas bla bre'i bar rtsa ba'i dper brjod tshigs rkang ra re yin pas lan bzhi bskyar la tshigs bcad bya'o/ /kha sgo'i sdeb sbyor go sla bas don bsdus te bshad do/ /de nas kha sgo'i bye brag rnams kyi don bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad gcig ni/ nā byu tisna sarba pā da 6/ /dzo nyus dhenam pā da yoḥ.a yumi yon thā sho bha/ /mi ti phywa yaḥpra yo ga dṛ kra/ rkang pa kun las thog ma las sa/ /na min rkang zung rgya mtsho las dza/ zung min dag gis ji ltar mdzes pas/ /sbyor ba phal cher blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ mdor na kha sgo'i sdeb sbyor gyi rkang pa bzhi ga kun la thog ma'i yi ge gcig po bor ba las pha rol sum tshan dang po de sa dang na gang rung min pa gzhir byas la/ rkang pa zung gnyis la rgya mtsho las phyi mar dza yig yin pa dang / rkang pa zung min dag gi mtsho las pha rol sngar brjod pa'i bha ra na ta ma'am/ de lnga las gzhan ji ltar mdzes pa snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis de lta bu'i sbyor ba phal cher blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i skad dod kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor yin/ /gnyis pa rkang bzhi 'phel ni/ tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa dang po yi ge brgyad dang / gnyis pa sogs gsum ni rang gi snga ma las yi ge bzhi bzhi 'phel ba ste/ dbye na lnga yod/ dang bo rkang bzhi 'phel spyi ni/ pra tha ma bhak+ṣa raḥpā da sh+tsa kusti ra ti brta 319

tāḥpa re3 puṣ+ṭhata/ kra ma sho ya su ta de tan+d+ra nā bit+yā sa saṃ sho p+taḥs la li ta pa da pa da bā kai pa da tsa tu ru r+bha bu sgyuḥpra huḥrkang pa dang po yi ge brgyad yin no/ /'di las phyi ma rim bzhin bzhi rnams mngon par 'phel ba/ /de dang de rnams sna tshogs rnam par bkod pas yang dag mdzes pa can la/ /rol sgeg dang bcas rkang pa rkang par ldan pa dag ni rkang bzhi 'phel du mkhas rnams smra'o/ /zhes rkang pa dang po'i yi ge brgyad ni kha sgo spyi ltar dang / rkang pa gnyis pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis ni dzā ti 'phags ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa bzhin yin te/ de phyi mo bgrang na 'phags ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa ltar tshogs lngar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rkang pa gsum pa'i yi ge bcu drug dang / rkang pa bzhi pa'i nyi shu ni/ dzā ti 'phags ma'i phyed gnyis pa bzhin yin te/ yi ge bcu drug dang / nyi shu yod kyang phyi mo bgrang na so so nas tshogs brgyad re las med cing dzā ti 'phags ma'i phyed phyi ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na bṛt+ta dang dzā ti'i cha shas tshogs pa yin kyang yi ge bgrang ba'i dbang du byas pas na bṛt+ta yin no/ /'di la 'phags ma'i dbyangs kyi zhes sogs 'bru bsnan pa ni nor ba'o/ /gnyis pa kun nas bcer ba ni/i ha pa da tsa tu ru r+bha/ /ga ga na ni dha ni khi 'a la ghu pā daḥyadi mu da mu pa na ya ti dza ga ti yu ta ā'i/ /sa mu pa hi ta sa la li ta ya ti ga ti ra tha bha pa ti pā ḍaḥ'adi ni rkang pa bzhi 'phel la/ /ga dang ga yi mtha' can rkang pa ma lus yang ba/ /rol sgeg dang bcas nye bar phan pa ngal bso'i 'gro bas gal te 'jig rten/ /dga' ba nye bar 'dren byed āng dang ldan pa'i t+pā ḍar de nas 'gyur te kun nas bcer ro/ /de yang snga ma bzhin rkang pa bzhi ga 'phel ba gzhir byas la/ rkang pa re re'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gnyis gnyis yod pa ma gtogs yi ge gzhan thams cad yang ba kho na sbyar ba'o/ /rol sgeg dang bcas zhes sogs ni don la cher mkho ba min yang skad dod kyi sdeb sbyor bsgrig pa'i ched yin te/ gong 'og rnams su de 'dra mang du 'byung ba'ang de ltar du shes par bya la/ skad dod rkang pa gsum pa'i mthar ā dā zhes dang / bzhi pa'i mthar 'iḍa zhes yod pa gnyis tshogs pa'i ā ḍā bī ḍa ni kun nas bcer ba zhes pa ste/ sdeb sbyor gyi ming ston pa'o gsum pa me tog kha ma phye ba ni/ ya di ni ka ṭa mi ha tsa ra ṇa mā duḥs ma 320

ti pa ta ti pā daḥpa ri kṛ ta pa ra ba sa ti ra tha ba sa ti ma rnye/ /tra ya mi ta ra da tsa yi ta ni dza ni la ya mi ti ka yi kāsatwa/ 'dir ni yang dag shin tu ltung ba'i rkang pa dag ni/ /rkang pa dang po nye las pha rol/ /gnas pa gal te yongs su byas te de nas dbus su gnas par 'gyur/ /cig shos gsum rnams g.yo ba med par gnas ni nges par gyur pa me tog kha ma phye ba/ /kun nas btser ba de nyid kyi rkang pa dang po ni rkang pa gnyis pa'i pha rol tu spos pa ste/ ga'an rnams kun nas bcer bzhin no/ /yang dag shin tu ltung ba zhes pa kun nas bcer gyi ming yin/ bzhi pa yud tsam rol ba ni/ ya di tsa ra ṇa yu ga ma ti sa sī paṃ/ /pra tha ma ka thi ta i ha sa ma ti pa ta ti pā daḥta di ta ra tsa ra ṇa nāmā/ /tri ta ya ma bi tsa li ta ni dza ba sa ti bha ba ti la ba lī lā/ /'dir ni yang dag shin tu ltung ba'i rkang pa dag ni/ /dang por grags pa gal te nye ba'i rkang pa zung dag 'das pa yin la/ /de 'a sa cig shos rkang pa rnams kyi/ /rnam pa gsum ni rnam par g.yo ba med cing nges par gnas par
