gyur pa yud tsam rol pa/ /kun nas bcer gyi rkang pa dang po nyid rkang pa gsum pa'i pha rol tu spos pa'o/ /lnga pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni/ dra ya mi ta ra da bi tsa li ta me baḥpra tha ma ka i ha sa ma ti pa ta ti ya di pā daḥb hu bi dha bi hi ta la li ta ya ti ra risnyi ra ti dza na nī yaṃ/ /ni ya ta ma mṛ ta d+mā rā/ /'dir ni rkang pa dang bo zhes bya cig shos gsum rnams/ /rnam par g.yo ba med pa nyid ni yang dag 'das par ltung bar gyur cing / /gal te rnam pa mang por byas pas rol sgeg sdod kyis mngon par dga' ba bskyed pa can 'di/ /nges par bdud rtsi'i rgyun du 'gyur ro/ /zhes kun nas bcer ba'i rkang pa dang po de nyid rkang pa bzhi pa'i pha rol tu spos pa yin te/kun nas bcer ba de nyid kyi rkang pa dang po gcig po rim par spos pa ma gtogs rkang ci pa gzhan gsum ni rang gnas las g.yo ba med do/ /rkang bzhi 'phel gyi rtsa ba'i dper rī ci brjod lnga tshigs bcad re tshang ba'o/ / ༷ ci gsum pa steng 'gro la gsum las/ dang po steng 'gro spyi ni/ pu ra e ba tsitā dza ji sa lā ni/ /na sa dza gu ru kā ṇa nan+ta raṃ/yar+ya tha bha na dza la gāḥsur tho/ /sa dza sā dza gau tsa bha peX / ba tī ya muṅgā tā/ /gal te snga ma sa dza sa la nyid dang / /bar ma chad du na sa dza lci rnams ༷ /skyimi/lnga/)kyibyed tsho

dang / /de nas gal te bha na dza la ga rnams 'gyur/ /de nas sa dza sa dza lci 'gyur 'di ni steng 'gro nyid/ /ces rkang pa dang po sa dza sa la dang / rkang pa gnyis pa na sa dza lci ste yi ge bcu re dang / rkang pa gsum pa bha na dza la ga ste yi ge bcu gcig dang / rkang pa bzhi pa sa dza sa dza lci ba ste yi ge bcu gsum yod pa ni ming steng 'gro zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa dri zhim ldan pa ni/ tra ya muṅga tā sa dṛ sha ma ba/ /bha ba ti hi traṃ tī ya man shā/ /rnye ya te ra na bha ga gra thi haṃ/ /ka tha yan+ti sau ra bha ka ma ta dī dṛ shaṃ/ gsum ni steng 'gro de lta nyid du gyur cing / /gsum pa rnam pa gzhan du shes par bya ste/ /ra dang na dang bha dang lce ba bsgrigs pa/ /de 'dra de ni dri zhim ldan par brjod par gyur pa yin/ /zhes rkang pa dang bo gnyis pa bzhi pa gsum po steng 'gro gzhir byas la/ rkang pa gsum pa gzhan du 'gyur te ra na bha dang lci ba gcig ste yi ge bcu'o/ /gsum pa rol geni/ tro ta yaṃ na yo ra tha sa yo sh+tsa/ bha ba ti tsa ra ṇa tro tī ya ki/ pra sbo ta pa da ra tsa na yā la li tai/la li tai hi nā ma ka bi bhi sta de sh+ya te/ /gsum pa'i ming can rkang par na dag dang ni/ /sa dag tu'ang 'gyur te rnam pa gsum po ni/ /rab tu spros pa'i tshig gi bkod pas rol sgeg ldan pa/ /de ni rol pa zhes byar snyan ngag mkhan rnams bzhed/ /ces pa rkang pa gzhan gsum gong ltar gzhir byas la/ rkang pa gsum pa ni na gnyis dang sa gnyis te yi ge bcu gnyis yod pa'o/ /mdor na stong 'gro gsum ni/ rkang pa dang po gnyis pa bzhi pa gsum 'dra ba kho na la rkang pa gsum pa gcig po mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas phye ba'o/ /rtsa ba'i dper brjod kyang tshigs bcad re yod/ /bzhi ba dal 'gro la'ang gsum las/ dang po dal 'gro spyi ni/ pā de sut+pa tha me ma sau dza r+ghaṃ gu ru ṇi tsa/ su ra tho sa na dza ra gāḥpa ralca rna saḥ.a tha na yu ta na na dza yuḥpra tsu pi ta mi da mu di ta mu pa sbri ta pūrbe/ /gal te rkang pa dang bor ma sa dza bha phyi ba dag tu 'gyur/ /de nas sa dang na dang dza dang ra dang ga rnams te/ /pha rol na dag dang ni sa yin cing / /de nas na sbyar na na dza ya nyer gnas snga 'di dal 'gror glubarjod/ /ces pa ste/ rkang pa dang po ma sa dza bha dang lci ba gnyis te yi ge bcu bzhi dang / rkang pa gnyis pa sa na dza ra ga ste yi ge bcu gsum dang / rkang pa gsum pa ni 322

na na sa ste yi ge dgu dang / rkang pa bzhi pa ni na na na dang dza ya ste yi ge bco lnga can ni ming dal 'gro zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'phel ba can ni/ pā de sur+ya di rna sa rna na so tsa tro tī ye/ ka ba ya sta da bhi ga dan+ti brta mā rna/ /pra tsu pi ta sa dṛ sha ka men di ha bha ba ti sa ka lam̐/ pra ti ni ya tsa ra ṇa ga ta la lagra pi d+mā ni/ /gal te rkang pa gsum pa la ni na dag sa na dag dang / / sa yin de ni 'dir gzhan mtha' dag dal 'gro dang 'dra zhing / /rkang pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid sgrub pa so sor nges pa snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyis/ /de ni 'phel ba can du mngon par brjod par gyur pa dag yin no/ /'di ni rkang pa dang po gnyis pa bzhi pa gsum dal 'gro gzhir byas la/ rkang pa gsum pa ni gzhan te/ na na sa dang na na sa ste yi ge bco brgyad sbyar ba'o/ /gsum pa rab ma chog ldan ni/yo smin ba ya dā n+t+ra tī ya ka ta dza re hāḥpra tha ma tsa bi ra ti rā r+sha lha ba dan+ti/ /tadz+dza bi 5ḍi sho ṣa ṇi/ /pra tsu pi ta ga ṇa sa ma ma pa raṃ n+t+ra ta yañtsa twa/ /gang tshe gsum pa ta dza ra rnams 'di nyid dang por ngal bso/ /gal te gzhan gsum rnams ni dal 'gro dag dang tshogs de dag/ mtshungs par gyur pa dag pa snang ldan gyi/ /khyad par rab mchog ldan du de ni rjod par byed pa yin/ /rkang pa gzhan gsum dal 'gro gzhir byas la/ rkang pa gsum pa ni gzhan te/ ta dza ra ste yi she/ dgu sbyar ba ni/ ming dag pa snang ltar gyi khyad par rab mchog ldan zhes kyang bya ba'o/ /dal 'gro'i bye brag phyi ma gnyis rkang pa gzhan gsum dal 'gro dang 'dra ba kho na la rkang pa gsum pa gcig po mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas phye ba'o/ /rtsa ba'i dper brjod tshigs bcad re yin no/ /mi mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i bye brag rnams kyi don go sla bar brjod pas rtsa ba'i dper brjod las bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor la/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang / bshad pa dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ bṛt+ta'i rnam par rtog pa bshad zin nas/ /'di las phyi nas dzā ti brjod par bya/ /zhes pa ste go sla'o/ /gnyis pa bshad pa dngos la gnyis/dzā ti'i dgos chos brda chad bshad pa/ so so'i dper brjod rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yang ba phyi mo gcig ste lci ba ni/ /phyi mo gnyis te gsal byed dag gis 323

min/ /bha dang dza sa lci zung yang ba bzhi tshogs pa/ /phyi mo bzhi pa de lnga rnams ni tsa zhes bya/ /yang ba bzhi ni kha yang yin/ /phyi mo gcig pa ka ste phyi gnyis da/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor la phyi mo bgrang bar bshad pas/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi yang ba'i yi ge phyi mo gcig tu 'gyur bas ming ka zhes 'dogs te/ gcig gi skad dod e ka zhes pa'i yi ge phyi ma'i brdas mtshon par byed pa'o/ /lci ba'i yi ge ni phyi ma gnyis su 'gyur bas de'i ming da zhes bya ste/ gnyis kyi skad dod di zhes pa'i yi ge gzhan phyis pa'o/ /de ni srog gi dbyangs yig bgrang ba yin gyi gsal byed kyi yi ge bgrang ba ma yin no/ /thog ma lci ba bha dang / dbus lci ba dza dang / mtha' lci ba sa dang / lci ba zung dang / yang ba kho na bzhi tshogs pa lnga bo de phyi mo bzhir 'gyur phyir tsa zhes bya sde/bzhi zhes pa'i skad dod tsa tar gyi yi ge thog mas brda byed pa'o/ /yang ba kho na bzhi tshogs pa la sgos ming kha ces kyang bya'o/ /de rnams kyi dper brjod ni/ pañtsa bha dza sā gu ru yu gi la lhu ka tsa tuṣi ga ṇa sh+tsa tu rmā/ āḥmā dro dri mā tho daḥbha dang dza sa lci zung yang ba bzhi tshogs las/ /phyi mo bzhi pa de lnga rnams ni tsa zhes bya/ /yang ba bzhi ni kha yang yin/ /phyi mo gcig pa ka ste phyi gnyis da/ /zhes 'chad 'gyur 'phags ma spyi'i sdeb sbyor sho lo ka gcig go/ spyir 'phags ma'i dzā ti la tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa bzhi po phye sne snga phyi gnyis su bcad de tshigs rkang dang po dang / gnyis pa gnyis po phyed snga ma dang /tshigs rkang gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis la phyed phyi mar byas te/ phyed snga phyi re re la'ang tshogs brgyad brgyad tu byas pa'i rkang pa zung ma yin pa dang po dang gsum pa gnyis tshogs gsum re dang / rkang ba zung yin pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis yangs ma gcig po ma gtogs gzhan thams cad la tshogs lnga lngar byed par bshad do/ /des na dper brjod 'di'i rkang pa dang po'i tshogs gsum dang / rkang pa gnyis pa'i mgo nas tshogs gnyis kyis phyi mo bzhi pa tsa'i ming can lnga'i dper brjod dang / rkang pa bzhi pa'i tshogs lnga'i gsum pas phyi mo gcig pa yang ba kho na ku'i ming can gyi dpe dang /rkang ba zung gnyis kyi tshogs lnga pas phyi mo gnyis pa da'i ming can gyi dper brjod bstan to/ /gnyis pa so so'i dper brjod rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ 'phags ma dang ni 324

ro langs can/ /phyi mo mnyam pa'i dzā ti gsum/ /rang 'grel las/ de la dbyangs gsum ma gtogs pa'i 'phags ma ni mi mnyam pa'i brit+ta dang 'dra'o/ /phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs pa'i ro langs can ni phyed mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra'o/ /phyi ma gsum ma gtogs pa'i phyi mo mnyam pa ni mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang mtshungs so/ /zhes 'phags ma'i dzā ti'i dbyangs gsum ma gtogs pa phyi mo bgrang ba'i khyad par ma gtogs mi mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang mtshungs par bshad mod/ 'dir bshad pa'i mi mnyam pa dang phyogs glumatshungs tsam las ji bzhin 'dra ba min no/ /de la dbye na bcu yod pa las/ dang po 'phags ma spyi'i dper brjod ni/ bi ṣa me ṣ+ṭha dza ra hi tī 6shīr+ṣa la da le3kho ga ṭī bha bturlu/ /pas dz+nyo gaḥṣaṣ+ṭha donyuṣ+ṭha ma u bha ya tra tsāḥshe ṣ+ṭhaḥgal te 'dab ma 'dab mar tshogs brgyad rnams/ /mi mnyam rnams la dza spangs 'phags mar 'gyur/ /phyi ma phyed la drug pa ga'o gnyis ka yi/ /brgyad pa da ste lhag ma tsa rnams so/ / zhes pa lta bu ste/rgya skad kyis dper brjod dang / bod skad kyis mtshan nyid dang ming ston pa ni thamasacad 'dra'o/ /'dab ma ni 'dir tshigs bcad gcig gi phyed kyi ming yin zhing phyed snga phyi gnyis la tshogs brgyad brgyad bskor ba las/ tshogs dang bo dang / gsum pa dang / lnga ba dang / bdun pa ste ya bzhi la mi mnyam pa dang / tshogs gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / drug pa dang / brgyad pa ste cha bzhi la mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /des na snga phyi'i tshogs mi mnyam pa rnams la dza dbus lci spangs pa ste med cing / phyed phyi ma'i tshogs drug pa ka ste phyi mo gcig pa yang ba'i yi ge gcig kho na dang / phyed snga phyi gnyis mo'i tshogs brgyad pa da ste phyi mo gnyis pa dang / snga phyi'i tshogs lhag ma thams cad tsa ste phyi mo bzhi ba kho na yin pa de ni/ 'phags ma spyi'i sdeb sbyor te/ mdor na/phyed snga phyi re rer tshogs brgyad brgyad yod pa/ tshogs mi mnyam pa rnams la dza dbus lci med pa/ phyed phyi ma'i tshogs drug pa ka yin pa/ tshogs snga phyi gnyis ga'i brgyad pa da yin pa/ phyed snga ma'i tshogs lhag ma bdun dang / phyed phyi ma'i tshogs drug rnams tsa yin pa ste khyad par lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /khyad chos dang po gnyis dang / tshogs brgyad pa'i da de ni lci ba'i yi ge zhig dgos pa dang / phyed snga phyi'i tshogs lhag ma tsa'i 325

ming can bdun nam drug yin pa ni 'phags ma'i dbyangs ma gtogs dang po dgu po thams cad 'dra'o/ /gong gi dper brjod gnyis 'phags ma spyi'i sdeb sbyor dang / de nas lhag ma dgu 'phags ma'i bye brag ste/ phal cher 'dra ba la khyad par cung zad re'i sgo nas so sor phye ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'phrod ma'i dper brjod ni/ snub r+bha ṣa ṣ+ṭha dzaḥkho bā kha tar+ya la ghu ni bha ba ti ya taḥṣaṣ+ṭhaḥkha pa ro ྅rnya ya ti snacho bya tha bha ba ti tsa ra ma da la/ /phyed sngar drug pa dza'am kha'o kha la ni/ /dang po la ni yang ba'i ngal bsor la 'gyur/ /kha pha rol la drug pa'i mthar ngal bso/ /'dab ma phyi mar bzhi pa'ang de nas 'gyur/ / zhes pa ste/ 'di ni phyed snga ma 'i tshogs drug pa dza'am kha yin ba dang /ri gal te kha'i ming can yang ba kho na'i yi ge bzhi byung tshe de'i yi ge dang po la ngal bso dgos la/ tshogs drug pa de'i pha rol tshogs bdun pa'ang kha yin na tshogs drug pa'i mtha' de la'ang ngal bso bya'o/ /'dab ma phyi ma la tshogs bzhi pa'i pha rol tshogs lnga pa kha yi na na tshogs bzhi pa'i mthar ngal bso bya ba dang / 'ang sgras de'i tshogs drug pa'i pha rol tshogs bdun pa kha yin na drug pa'i yi ge la ngal bso bya dgos shing / ngal bso'i mtshan ma brastu ra'i steng thig le re bya ba'o/ /dzā ti 'phrod ma 'di ni/ ngal bso'i mtshan nyid de rnams tshang zhing rkang pa zung min gnyis tsa gsum re dang / zung gnyis tshogs lnga lnga yod pa'i khyad par ldan pa ste/ 'di'i rkang pa gnyis pa tsa gnyis kha gnyis nga gcig ste lnga dang / rkang pa bzhi pa la tsa dang kha dang ka dang kha dang nga bcas lnga yod cing tshigs bcad phyi ma'i skabs 'di'i ming dang yangs ma'i dper brjodaskebacas bstan to/ /gsum pa yangs ma'i dper brjod ni/ tsi s+t+ri bhi ra yumi pā do ya dī sa lngapo ta dā bha pat+pa bya/ /a ko3 pi ni khyi to na ya de tre+e ra yum sta dā bi pu lā/ /tsa gsum rnams kyis zung min rkang pa dag/ gang tshe rdzogs pa de tshe 'phrod mar 'gyur/ /gal te zung min gcig kyang rdzogs min par/ /de rnams kyis ni de tshe yangs ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ 'phags ma spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ tsa gsum gyis zung min gyi rkang pa gnyis las gcig kyang rdzogs pa ma yin par tsa bzhi re tshang dgos te/ gcig kyang zhes pa'i kyang sgras zung min gnyis ka tsa gsum res mi rdzogs par bstan to/ /'di'i 326

dper brjod ni sgo g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid tshang ba ltar snang yang rkang pa bzhi po tshogs bzhi bzhi cha mnyam pa ni yangs ma'i khyad chos su snang ste/ 'phags ma'i dzā ti gzhan thams cad rkang pa zung zung min gnyis tshogs mi mnyam par bshad pas so/ /bzhi pa kun nas g.yo ba'i dper brjod ni/ gu ru mgyo ba'i rna sarnyi tī ya tur+ya ga ṇi dza kā rā kau/ /adhe dwa yi bha baṃ tī bha bat+ta rda sarba sh+tsa pa lā/ gal te gnyis pa bzhi pa'i tshogs/ /lci gnyis dbus zhugs dza dag bshad/ /phyed pa gnyis la gyur de tshe/ /kun nas g.yo bar gyur pa yin/ /zhes pa ste/ gzhan rnams 'phags ma spyi dang 'dra ba la/ phyed snga phyi gnyis ma'i tshogs gnyis pa dang bzhi pa ja dbus lci yin pa la bar tu tshogs gsum pa lci ba gnyis zhugs pa'o/ /lnga ba sgo g.yo ba'i dper brjod ni/ pūrba rna a btsete ba la bha ba l+la k+ṣa ṇa tu tsa pa lā yuḥn s+thā t+pa nar parādhe mu kha tsa pa lā sau te dā bha ba ti/ /gal te snga phyed 'ba' zhig nyid/ /g.yo ba yi ni mtshan nyid gyur/ /slar yang phyi phyed la gyur min/ /de tshe de sgo g.yo bar 'gyur/ /zhe she pa ste/ 'di ni snga phyed 'ba' zhig kun nas 0lo ba'i mtshan nyid ltar la/ phyed phyi ma de ltar ma yin par spyi dang 'dra ba'o/ /drug pa lus rten g.yo ba'i dper brjod ni/ ni rde ṣ+ṭha tsa pa lā yā lak+ṣa ṇa ma pa hā ya yatwa sarbarta/ /pa'i r+bha me ka mā krit+ya bsta te dza gha na tse pa lha sā/ /gang la bstan pa'i g.yo mtshan nyid/ /snga ma phyed la spangs nas kyang / /phyi phyed gcig pur brten nas zhugs/ /de ni lus rten g.yo ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni bshad ma thag pa las bzlog ste phyed snga ma spyi lta ra la/ phyed phyi ma gcig pu kun nas g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o/ /bdun pa dbyangs kyi dper brjod ni/ sgyu tulha yo ra pi da la loḥṣaṣ+ṭha garto yatra dzaḥkha kā ro bā/ /pūrbarta btsu deḥpra ti ni ya mo bha btibhab ti sngag tiḥgang du 'dab ma gnyis ka yang / /drug tshogs dza 'am/ kha yig gyur/ /phyed snga bzhin dang lhag ma yang / /so sor nges gyur de dbyangs 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ 'dab ma snga phyi gnyis ga sa dpyad par bya'o/ /'phags ma'i dzā ti sdeb sbyor rnams/ /ma 'dres gsal bar phye snyam yang / /nor 'khrul mchis na mkhas la bshags/ /legs chas kun la phan gyur cig/gnyis pa ro langs can gyi dza ti la brgyad las/ dang po drug phyi mo bgrang ba'i tsho 327

khyad par ma gtogs phyang mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang phyogs 'dra bar gsungs shing / phyi ma gnyis kyi dper brjod dngos bstan yi ge bgrangs na mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yin no/ /de las dang po ro langs can spyi ni/ da tra ya ma yu dzi rmu kha yu rdza rnga tsa tuṣ+ka ra la gi stu praṣ+ṭha ltaḥbi ṭ+wāṃ lī yaṃ ta du n+ya ta la bhu dzisnyi na ni ran+ta raṃ yu dzoḥzung min dang por da gsum zung da bzhi/ /phyi ma la ni ra la ga rnams te/ /zung la yang drug bar ma chad du min/ /de ni ro langs can du brjod par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang pa bzhi'i zung ma yin pa dang po dang gsum pa gnyis kyi dang por da ste phyi mo gnyis pa gsum dang / rkang pa zung gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis ga'i dang por da bzhi'i rjes su ra la ga yod cing / rkang pa zung gnyis la yang ba'i yi ge drug re yod pa de bar ma chad par 'byung ba ma yin par lci ba'i yi ge bzhi ci rigs par bar bcad de byung ba'o/ /rtsa ba'i dper brjod 'di sho lo ka gcig tshang ngo / /'di man chad khyad par cung zad re'i sgo nas ro langs can las so sor phye ba yin pas/ gnyis pa nye ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/ ba tā lī yi pa rma mu khe tse rda pats+tshan+da si skar yo tu praṣ+ṭha/ gal te dang por ro langs can lta bu/ /phyi ma ra ya dag ni nye sdeb sbyar/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis kyi dang por da gsum dang / zung gnyis kyi dang por da jibazhi yod pa ni ro langs can spyi dang 'dra ba la phyi mar ra ya sbyar ba'o/ /gsum pa kun nas srab ba ni/ ā pā ta 'a kā bha ga gan+ta mu kha mi ha ba nywa lā ya sa mā ni/'dir ni dang bo ro langs can dang mtshungs/ /bha ga ga mtha' kun nas srab pa yin/ /zhes da gsum da bzhi gong mtshungs la mthar bha ga ga spyad pa'o/ /bzhi pa snga 'phel ni/yum mu kha shāt+pa rdo dza do pya tsu bṛt+ta ra ba shes mā du bta/ da las pha rol dza nga zung dang po/ /lhag ma dang po lta bu snga 'phel yin/ /zhes rkang pa zung gnyis kyi dang por nga las pha rol tu dza da sbyar ba ma gtogs lhag ma thams cad ro 'a/ngas can spyi dang 'dra ba'o/ /lnga pa phyi 'phel ni/ /u dī tsu bṛt+ta dza rda ya dā mu kha ma yu dzoḥpa ri shi r+bha mā t+ya bta/ gang tshe zung min dang por dza da dag/ lhag ma dang po lta bu phyi 'phel yin/ /zhes rkang pa zung min gnyis kyi dang por dza dang sbyar ba tsam ma gtogs lhag ma gzhan thams cad ro langs can spyi ltar ro/ /drug pa rab 'phel ni/ a dī tsu bṛt+ta ra yum bhā la tsu bṛt+ta yu 328

ga bhā ཿbṛt+ta kai/ zung min cha ni phye 'phel las/ /zung cha snga 'phel rab 'phel lo/ /zhes zung min gyi rkang pa gnyis phyi 'phel gyi zung min ltar dza dang da lag dang / rkang pa zung gnyis snga 'phel gyi zung gi rkang pa ltar da dza da ra la ga sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad do/ sgyu/'dir rang 'grel gyi 'gyur las/ snga 'phel sogs gsum la rab 'phel /phyi 'phel/ kun 'phel zhes 'byung yang / rtsa ba dang / chos dpal gyi 'grel par/snga 'phel/ phyi 'phel/ rab 'phel zhes dbyung ba skad dod dang mthun pas legs/nye sdeb sogs lnga'i rtsa ba'i dper brjod tshigs rkang gnyis re yin pas lan gnyis bskyar te tshigs bcad bya dgos so/ /bdun pa gzhan gyi mtha' can ni/ sgyut+pa bṛt+ta ka yu dzāñtsa pa rān+ti kā/ rab 'phel zung ni gzhan gyi mtha' can 'gyur/ /'di ni rab 'phel gyi zung gi rkang pa da dza da ra la ga lan bzhir bskyar ba'i tshigs bcad dang /brgyad pa mdzes rgod ma/ ni/ a yuka da lha ru hā si nā/ /zung min rkang pas mdzes rgod ma'o/ /rab 'phel gyi zung min gyi rkang ṅge lan bzhir bskyar ba'i tshigs bcad yin no/ /phyi ma gnyis kyi dper brjod 'di phyi mo bgrang ba'i khyad par ma gtogs yi ge bgrangs na mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yin te/ de la gzhan gyi mtha'abyu can ni/ yi ge bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags la rnam grangs nyis stong zhe nga rgyad yod pa'i nang tshan rtsa ba'i dngos zin drug brgya go dgu pa shing rta dregs zhes bya ba yin/ mdzes rgod ma ni/ yi ge dgu ba thra ha tī la rnam grangs lnga brgya bcu gnyis yod pa las 'di brgya dang drug cu re drug pa yin/ dang po drug phyi mo bgrang ba'i cha nas phyed mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra bar rang 'grel du gsungs kyang / gzhung las dngos su bshad pa'i phyed mnyam bcu skogasum gang yang min no/ /no langs can gyi dzā ti go bde bar bshad zin to/ /gsum pa phyi mo mnyam pa'i dzā ti ni/ rang 'grel sal/ dang po bdun mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra bar bshad kyang / mtshan nyid la brtags na dang po gcig pu ma gtogs phyi ma drug yi ge bgrangs na'ang mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yin dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ /dbye na bcu las/ dang po mi g.yo brtan ni/ a gu ru ra tsa la bh+ra ti ru da dha tsa ba di pa di/ /rkang pa rkang pa chu gter tsa ste lci med mi g.yo brtan/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang 329

pa so sor lci ba gcig kyang med pa'i yang ba kho na'i tsa bzhi re bsgrigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyi mo mnyam pa ni/ gan+ti mā tā sa ma kai li de lhatwa/ /mthar lci 'dab las yang ba phyi mo mnyam/ /zhes rkang pa so sor tsha bzhi las tsa gnyis kyi pha rol na yang ba'i yi ge yod cing rkang mtha' rnams lci ba'o/ /gsum nga nyer bkra ni/ bho ya de ca di ta yā tu pa tsi tā/ /gal te tsa gnyis las bha nyer bkra yin/ /zhes rkang pa so sor tsa bzhi las tsa gnyis kyi pha rol tu bha thog lci yod pa'o/ /bzhi pa khyad par tshigs bcad ni tsā h+la dza e ba bā baṃ blo gaḥtsa las kha 'am dza nyid khyad par tshigs bcad/ /ces rkang pa so sor tsa bzhi las tsha dang po'i pha rol tu la 'am ga gang rung yod pa'o/ /lnga ba nags khrod gnas ni/ yo jo bā bā na bā si kā lhatwa/ phyed las kha 'am dza ni nags khrod gnas/ /zhes rkang pa so sor tsa bzhi re las tsa gnyis kyi pha rol tu kha 'am dza gang rung yod pa'o/ /drug pa bkra ba ni/tsā khuyi di sa di ta yi tsitā/ /tsa zhes bya las gal te sa gnyis bkra ba'o/ /zhes rkang pa so sor tsa bzhi las tsha dang po'i pha rol tu sa mtha' lci ba gnyis yod pa'o/ /'di yan sdeb sbyor drug gi tshigs rkang re la tsa bzhi bzhi yin zhing rtsa ba'i dper brjod rkang pa re yin pas lan bzhir bskyar dgos so/ /bdun pa rkang dkrugs ni/ sa ma nan+ta ra ni ga di ta lak+ṣa ṇa bhā d+mā tā sa mā da pā dā ku la ska/ a bi di ta bṛt+ta pa ri mā pa ri ga ha/ mu ni nā&d+ma pi dhā pa pā dā ku la ka/ bar ma chad du bshad pa'i mtshan nyid bsten/ /phyi mo mnyame sogs rkang pa dkrugs pa la/ /bṛt+ta'i tshad rnams rtogs pa med gyur pa/ /thub pas rkang 'khrugs su ne mngon par brjod/ /ces pa'i sho lo ka gcig ste/ dang po mi g.yo brtan dor ba'i lhag ma lnga'i tshigs rkang rnams ci rigs par dkrugs mar skebasgrigs pa yin te/ tshigs bcad 'di'i rkang pa gsum pa nags khrod gnas dang /gzhan gsum khyad par tshigs bcad yin/ de ltar phyi mo mnyam pa nas bkra ba'i bar lnga'i rkang pa gang 'dod bsres nas spel ba na sdeb sbyor mang por 'gyur ba la ming rkang dkrugs zhes bya bar thub pa dmar ser 'dod cing / slob dpon rang lugs la mi bzhed par yang bshad do/ / brgyad pa lus med rtsen ni/ aṣ+ṭha biṣ+ṭha tsā r+bha ya sgyu/gāḥhrīḥsolnganyu na gaspyi skyu/ sa ka la ma pa ra ma pi sa la la ni dhi gu ṇi ta ba su la lhuka mu 330

pa ri gha ṭi ta bar bisra ti/ /gang gi phyed la brgyad brgyad dang ni ga/ gzhan yang mtha' dag chu gter nor gyis bsgyur/ /yang ba phyi mar bkod pa'i snorkang pa spro/ /de ni lus med rtsen du brjod pa yin/ /zhes rkang pa so sor tsa bzhi las sho lo ka gcig la phyed snga phyi gnyis byas pa'i phyed snga ma'i tsa brgyad kyi yi ge lci ba kho na bcu drug dang / phyed phyi ma'i tsa brgyad kyi yi ge yang ba kho na so gnyis bkod pa'i yi ge grangs mi mnyam yang phyi mo sum cu rtsa gnyis re mnyam pa ste/ tshigs rkang re la phyi mo bcu drug re yod cing rtsa ba'i dper brjod sho lo ka tshang ngo / /dgu ba shin tu gsal mdzes ni/ pra ti da la mu pa ti ta da sha da sha la ghu ra ba si ti bi ra tsi ta gu ru ra ti du tsi rā/ /'dab ma so sor bcu bcu bcu rnams yang ba bkod mthar lci byas shin tu gsal mdzes so/ /zhes rkang pa re la tsa bzhi las sho lo ma'i phyed snga phyi so sor yang ba sum cu'i mthar lci ba re re yod pa ste/rkang pa re raṃ phyi mo bcu drug sde mnyam zhing rtsa ba'i dper brjod sho lo ka phyed yin/ /bcu ba bum bu ni/ tsa da ka da ka tri rtsa dza ka ti khaṇ+ḍa ma dza bha ra ti da ma ā+oṃ da me/ /dza med rang gi dang po min pa bha bral gang zhig tsa da ka da ka dang tsa gsum dza ga zhes dum bu/ /zhes pa ste/ tshigs rkang re la tsa da ka da ka dang tsa gsum dang dza dbus lci dang ga ste tshigs bcu bcu yod pa'i tshogs dgu ba ma gtogs gzhan du dza shādabus lci med cing /tshogs dang po ma yin pa tshogs gzhan du bha bral ba ste bha thog lci ba mi 'byung ba de ni/ming sdeb sbyor dum bu zhes pa ste/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i dper brjod rkang pa gcig yin pas lan bzhir bskyar dgos so/ /sdeb sbyor dang po dgu tshigs rkang re la tsa bzhi re gzhir byas dang / bcu pa la tsa bgrang na bdun yod/ dang po mi g.yo brtan ni/ phyi mo bgrang ba ma gtogs yi ge bcu drug pa'i bṛt+ta legs spyod kyi mtha' ma drug khri lnga stong lnga brgya so drug pa yin/ phyi mo mnyam pa sogs lnga ni phyi mo'i cha nas rkang pa bzhi po khyad par med pa la dgongs nas mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra bar bshad kyang / yi ge bgrangs na mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yin min gnyis gnyis 'jog dgos te/ tsa'i ming can la phyi mo bzhi par 'dra ba zhig dgos kyi/ yi ge mtha' gcig tu 'dra ba mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lus med rtsen dang / gsal mdzes gnyis phyi mo'i sgo nas phyed mnyam dang 331

'dra na dang 'dir bshad pa'i byed mnyam bcu gsum po gang dang yang mi 'dra/ dum bu la yi ge'i sgo nas mnyam phyed mnyam mi mnyam ci rigs gzhag chog par mngon no/ /rjes paṇa chen po'i sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po las/ 'phags ma phal cher mi mnyam mtshungs/ /ro langs can ni phyed mnyam 'dra/ /phyi mo mnyam pa mnyam pa bzhin/ /de dag phyi mo bgrang bas phye/ /zhes dang / 'phags ma ni phal cher mi mnyam pa'i rgyud 'phel bzhin dang / phyi mo bgrang ba ma gtogs mtshungs so/ /ro langs can ni phal cher phyed mnyam pa'i rgyud 'phel dang mtshungs so/ /phyi mo mnyam pa ni phal cher mnyam pa'i rgyud 'phel dang mtshungs par bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje garma pa'i 'grel pa dang / lo chen chos dpal gyi 'grel par/ nye ba'i dbyangs dang / mchog dbyangs dang 'phags ma'i dbyangs gsum ma gtogs pa'i 'phags ma'i bye brag rnams ni mi mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra/ phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs pa'i ro langs can ni phyed ma nyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra/ phyi yaṃ gsum ma gtogs pa'i phyi mo mnyam pa ni mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dang 'dra bar bshad pa tsam las gsal med do/ /'dir go bde ched phyed mnyam ma/na tshig grogs dor nas mtshan nyid rnams mdor bsdus te bstan pa yin pas rtsa ba'i dper brjod kyis don bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang rin 'byung 'dir rtsa ba'i rgya skad kyis sdeb sbyor so so'i dper brjod go chod par mdzad pa yin pas/ ngo bo dang las brjod pa sogs don re re la'ang si sogs kyi rnam dbye bdun po 'jug pa dang / gcig tshig la gnyis tshig dang / mang tshig gi rnam dbye dang / gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la gcig tshig gi rnam dbye sbyar ba sogs ni/ lci yang sdeb pa'i dbang gis sbyar rung ba yin te/ dbyangs can gyi mdo las/ sdeb sbyor las ni si sogs thams cad du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na rnam dbye de dag bod skad la ji bzhin bsgyur dgos pa min no/ /yang rgya gar la yi ge lci yang sdeb pa'i sdeb sbyor yod cing bod la de 'dra med pas/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgya dpe yi ge brgyad pa rjes bsngags kyi sdeb sbyor du bzhugs kyang / bod la bklag bde ched tsheg bar bdun par bsgyur ba dang / bzang spyod smon lam yi ge bcu 332

gcig pa'i nang tshan 'jo ba po dang / 'dul ba sum brgya pa dbang po'i rdo rje'i sdeb sbyor yi ge bcu gcig pa tsheg bar dgu par bsgyur/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang /sgrol bstod phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs kyi rgya dpe kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor yi ge brgyad ba la mtshan brjod tsheg bar bdun re dang / sgrol bstod tsheg bar brgyad par bsgyur ba sogs ni bod yig la rgya gar lta bu'i sdeb sbyor med phyir klog bde ba'i ched yin no/ /gsum pa mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i rnam grangs shes thabs ngo mtshar rtogs byed sogs ni/zhib rgyas sngar zur du bkod pa zhig yod pa der blta bar bya la/ 'dir yi ge mang nyung 'tsham pa'i phyir rtogs byed drug po thams cad yi ge bzhi ba la dper mtshon nas/tshigs su bcad de go bde bar brjod pa ni/ prasta ra yi cho ga ni/ /dang por 'phred la lci ba bzhi/ /lci ba thog ma'i 'og yang ba/ /phyi ma gsum ni steng 'dra lci/ /de nas snga ma'i 'og yang sogs/ /lci yang rim par spel ba na/ /thams cad yang bar gyur pa ni/ /rdzogs pa'i tshad yin dmar ser lugs/ 'di ni thog mtha' tsam ma gtogs/ /bar tu spel tshul mi gsal lo/ /slob dpon rang lugs 'di lta ste/ /thog mar ang ki nyis 'gyur du/ /gcig gnyis bzhi brgyad 'phred la bri/ /ang ki so mo'i thad drang 'og/gcig 'og lci gcig yang ba gcig/ gnyis 'og lci gnyis yang ba gnyis/ /bzhi 'og lci bzhi yang ba bzhi/ / brgyad 'og lci brgyad yang brgyad rnams/ / steng nas 'og tu brtsegs mar bri/ /de nas snga ma'ang ang grangs bzhin/ /bcu drug bar du spel ba na/ /yang ba kho na bzhir gyur pa/ /yi ge bzhi pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi/ /prasta ra yi rdzogs tshad yin/ /steng gi 'phred kyi lci ba bzhi/ /bṛt+ta dang po nas bzung ste/ /tha ma'i yang ba bzhi po ni/ /bcu drug pa yin gzhan la'ang mtshungs/ /na bṛt+ta gang 'dod pa/ /'phral tu rnyed pa'i thabs yin te/ /bṛt+ta bcu pa gang zhe na/ /de ma thag tu bcu grangs bri/ /yang grangs mnyam la yang ba dang / /mi mnyam lci ba'i pra stur/ /'thob phyir bcu mnyam yang ba bri/ /de nas rim par phyed phyed bgo/bcu phyed lnga ni mi mnyam lci/ /mi mnyam rnams la grangs gcig bsnan/ / drug phyed gsum ni mi mnyam lci/ /gcig bsnan bzhi phyed gnyis mnyam yang / /'phred la bkod 333

pa'i/22/prasta ras/ /bṛt+ta gang 'dod 'khrul med ston/ /ud+dha ni bṛt+ta de/ /tu pa yin pa shes thabs te/ /prasta ra rnams bkod pa'i steng / /gcig gnyis bzhi brgyad nyis 'gyur bri/ /de nas yang ba'i steng gi grangs/ /bsdoms nas gcig bsnan grangs gang longs/ /bṛt+ta de ni 'di yin zhes/ /shes par bya ste ngo mtshar che/ /yang ba'i bya ba gcig bris la/ /de steng yig grangs gcig yig bzhi/ /brtsegs la steng ma dor nas 'gro/ /rang rang ma phyis gong ma la/ /rim par zung dus lan gsum bsres/ /bṛt+ta yang med gcig yang dang / gnyis yang gsum yang kun yang grangs/ /rim bzhin ston pa dmar ser lugs/ /slob dpon rang gi bzhed pa ni/ /dang bor gcig yig steng du bkod/ /de rjes 'og nas yig grangs kyi/ /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi brtsegs te bri/ /gsum grangs man chad sngar ltar du/ /lan gnyis bsres pas chog pa yin/ /grangs zhes bya ba ang ki gcig/ zung gis lan bzhir bsgyur ba'am/ /uḥs yi yang ku'i mthag /brgyad de nyis 'gyur byas pa dang / /yang ba'i bya ba'i grangs kun bsdu/ /bcu drug longs pa bṛt+ta'i grangs/ /bṛt+ta bcu drug yig grangs bzhis/ /bsgyur ba re bzhi yig grangs yin/ /de nyid phyed du bgos pa yi/ /so gnyis lci yang re yi grangs/ /de dang yig grangs re bzhi bsdoms/ /go drug phyi mo'i grangs yin no/ /yi ge bzhi dang bṛt+ta'i grangs/ /bcu drug gnyis kyis bsgyur nas ni/ /gcig phris bdun ni 'phed dang ni/ /so gcig 'og gi a dh+wa yin/ /pratsho ra ni gral lam phreng / /nas 'dren byed adhiṣ+ṭha/ /stong nas ston dang a dha ni/ /lam zhes bsgyur snang sa khongs )sbos zigazide nas bṛt+ta dzā ti ya/ /lci yang yi ge phyi mo'i grangs/ /rtogs byed skabs 'dir rang 'grel las/ /shis brjod tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa/ /re re'ang lci ba bcu bdun dang / /yang ba nyer gsum yi ge'i grangs/ /bzhi bcu phyi mo nga bdun las/ /gang rung zung zhig 'phri bsnan gyis/ /cig shos grangs rnams bde blag tu/ /shes byed thabs mchog gsum gsum bstan/ / gsum pa bcoms pa'i dge ba bsngo ba dang /334

bzhi pa mjug gi don go sla bas ma bris so/ /smras pa/ mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs rig gnas skyed tshal las/ /legs 'ongs puṇ+ḍa ṭīka'i 'phreng ma dzes 'di/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar skyes kyi dam pa ste/ /blo gsal mkhas 'dod tshogs rnams bsten par rigs/ /de phyir rig gzhung rin chen 'byung gnas kyi/ /dgongs don dka' gnad dkar ba'i lhag bsam gyis// /rnam dpyod sor cho/sa gsal bar bkrol ba 'di/ /gzur gnas blo ldan blo mtsho rgyas phyir yin/ / sngon bsags las smon dag pa'i gru rdzings kyis/ /dal 'byor rin chen gling du phyin dus 'dir/ /'di snang bya bzhag mching bu ring dor nas/ /gtan 'dun thos bsam nor mchog len pa gces/ / mnog chung snyigs dus tshe la long med pa/ /bsam tshe snying gi khur de lcid che yang / /skul byed nan tan che bas g.yar khral du/ /gseng bar sug pa'i ngal ba 'di bgyis so/ /mkhas pa'i dgongs don zab brling chu gter che/ / bdag blo ri bong rkyal gyis brgal dka' yang / /ded dpon mkhas pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug rgyan du/ /bsten pas legs bshad yid bzhin nor skal rnyed/ /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs kun tu bdag/ rigs bzang blo gsal dam pa gtsug tu khur/ /mang thos byams dang snying rjes rgyud phyug ste/ /skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho dam par gyur cig gu/ /zhes pa 'di ni rig gnas rgya mtshor mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs pa u cu mun chi zhabs drung dka' bcu mer gan er te ni paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal ye shes bstan 'dzin dang / rtsis rig sogs la rnam dpyod rab tu yangs pa a pa ka gu thi 'jam dbyangs nor bu gnyis kyis lha dar maṇ+ḍal bcas snga phyir nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ nges pa don gyi mkhas grub chen po shing za rdo rje 'chang gi bka' drin gyis rig gnas 'di la blo mig cung zad bye ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis sbyar ba don gnyer can rnams la phan par gyur cig/o swa sti/ 'phags yul mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog/ ngo mtshar yon tan brgyad ldan gyi/ /sdeb sbyor 'grel ba don gsal 'di/ /sku 'bum chos sde chen po ru/ /bkod legs par du bsgrubs pa yi/ /dge bas mthun rkyen sbyar ba sogs/ /'brel thogs lus can ma lus pa/ /deng nas tshe rabs phreng ba ru/ /tshangs spyod yon tan brgyad ldan gyi/ /rnam dag rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin nas/ /kun 335

khye mi go ci ce po ṇ+ḍi 'ido tsem na nga du ba da gyur ga/ sa pa'ang skul pa zhabs drung pa ta bla ma' nga khron sum ca dang gu shri 'jam dbyangs nor ba dong tse khron bca bcas mthun rkyen sbyar nas par du ma ga su gabasgrubs pa'o/ /shulhas dzagatī/ / 336

༄khya/ /ngo mtshar rtogs byed nag 'gros su bkod pa legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / cimakhyen rab nyin byed 'od stong gis/ /gdul bya'i blo mun sel mdzad cing / /rnam dpyod 'dab brgya bzhad mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i dbye ba rnams/ /tshegs chung bde blag rnyed pa'i thabs/ /ngo mtshar rtogs byed go slar bri/ /de yang mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i sde ba sbyor la rnam grangs shin tu mang ste/ yi ge gcig pa'i sdeb sbyor la gnyis/gnyis pa la bzhi/ gsum pa la brgyad/ bzhi pa la bcu drug lnga ba la so gnyis/yi ge drug pa'i sdeb sbyor la drug cu re bzhi sogs phyi ma phyi ma rnams yi ge re re 'phel bas grangs nyis 'gyur du 'gro ste/ yi ge nyer drug pa'i bṛt+ta'i sdeb sbyor gyi grangs bye ba drug sa ya bdun 'bum phrag gcig stong phrag brgyad dang brgyad brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pas/ gzhung gi dngos zin la dper brjod 'ga' zhig tsam bkod pa ma gtogs mtha' dag pa ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /des na mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i rnam grangs shin tu mang po de rnams tshegs chung dus bde blag tu go ba'i ched du ngo mtshar ba'i rtogs byed drug gsungs te/ prasta ra dang nas urnyis/ /yang ba'i bya ba grangs dang a dh+wa ste/ /de ltar drug po de rnams rim pa bzhin/ /bṛt+ta rnams la rtogs byed rnams yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar drug yod pa las/ dang po pustu ra'i cho ga ni/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta rnams kyi yi ge lci yang ji ltar spel tshul dang go rim sogs ma nor bar bde blag tu rtogs byed kyi thabs yin te/ de la dmar ser gyi lugs dang / slob dpon sharnyi pa'i rang lugs gnyis las/ dang po 'chad pa la/ bṛt+ta'i dang po thams cad lci/ /lci gtso'i 'og yang phyi rnams 'dra/ /snga mar lci 'di sras ra/ /ji srid thams cad yang de 337
ca po te

1 1mjug ma rig 2/sdi rto ga lagang mjug ///shā mjug 'a ga phag (/ribasras pas drug sta/ 6 'ad lta bu'/ /da nas ga ga gsum dang bsras pas bzha sto4/ trī'adi lta bur gyur pa ni yang ba'i bya ba yin te/ stong nas rim bzhin yi ge bzhi pa'i bṛt+ta bcu drug las yi ge yang ba med pa'i bṛt+ta ni gcig dang / gcig yang ba bzhi/gnyis yang ba drug gsum yang ba bzhi/ thams cad yang ba gcig ces shes par bya'o/ / des lci ba'i bya ba'ang 'dra ste/ lci ba med pa gcig gcig lci ba bzhi/gnyis lci ba drug gsum lci ba bzhi/ thams cad lci ba gcig ces go bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ gzugs ni dang por ma byas kyang / /steng gzhug grangs bri de nas 'og gnas pa'i rang rang 'og mnyam bsre/ /bṛt+ta yang med gcig yang sogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge gcig pa'i sdeb sbyor la dang por gzugs te gcig gi grangs ma bkod kyang yig grangs/1/bris pas kyang lci ba gcig dang / yang ba'ang gcig ste sdeb sbyor gnyis yod pa shes nus la/ gzugs bkod nas yig grangs 'di ltar/ 2 bris kyang rung ngo / /yi ge gnyis pa'i bṛt+ta la gcig zung gi dang po'i gcig gi grangs steng du gzhug pa ste bkod nas gcig zung gi bar du yig grangs/ 'di ltar 1 1'bri'o/ /yi ge gsum pa la stong gi gcig 'og tu yig grangs/ bris nas de'i gnyis kyi 1 1grangs la 'og gi gcig bsre bar bya'o/ // yi ge bzhi pa la stong gi gcig 'og tu bzhi'i 1 1 14 4grangs2 'di ltar bris te 'og gi grangs mnyam pa rnams sngar ltar bsres pas6 'di / rnyi342
—— —— rte/ re —/rwa/byu/rnga /rwa /ci

༄7/ /sdeb sbyor las nyer mkho rags rim bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mdzi sgo ṣ+pe ya/ tshigs bcad rkang bzhi de yang ni/ /bṛt+ta dzā ti zhes rnam gnyis/ /yi ge bgrang ba bṛt+ta ste/ /phyi mo bgrang ba dzā ti yin/ /gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun/ /'dir ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis/ /'di rnams yi ge lnga bcu dgu/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang bar bya/ /yang ba la yin lci ba ga/ ngal bso'i lci yang wa dang ka/ bha thog lci ba dza dbus lci/ /sa mtha' lci ba ma kun lci/ /ya thog yang ba ra dbus yang / /ta mtha' yang ba na kun yang / /srog med brtsegs pa'i dang po dang / /tsheg drag can dang thig le can/ /tshig mtha' ring po'i dbyangs rnams lci/ /lhag ma yi ge yang ba'o/ /de yang spyir sdeb sbyo ra gyi lus ni tshigs bcad kho nar nges la/ tshigs bcad la bṛt+ta'am 'phel ba dang / dzā ti'am bskyed ma gnyis su ngese so/ /bṛt+ta ni yi ge bgrang ba dang / dzā ti ni phyi mo bgrang ba yin la/ de yang dbyangs yig bgrang ba yin gyi gsal byed bgrang ba gtan nas min no/ /phyi mo bgrang ba ni/ dbyangs yig gcig yun/ gnyis yun/ gsum yu na rnams so sor bgrang ba ste/ dper na/ā yī zhes pa yi ge bgrang na gnyis dang / phyi mo bgrang na bzhir gyur pa lta bu'o/ /des na dbyangs thung ni phyi mo gcig pa/ ring po ni gnyis pa/ shin tu ring po slu ta'i mtshan ma can ni phyi mo gsum par bshad do/ /'on kyang yang ba ni phyi mo gcig dang /lci ba ni phyi mo gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /sdeb sbyor gyi skabs 'dir sngags dang sgra'i gzhung las byung ba dang mi 'dra bar/ dbyangs yig nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang / gsal byed so bdun te yi ge lnga bcu nga dgu bshad de/ dbyangs yig nyer gnyis ni/ thung ngu lnga ste/a i u ṛ bla'o/ /ring po ni brgyad de/ ā yī u ṛ e i o au rnams so/ /shin tu ring po ni slu ta'i mtshan ma can dgu ste/ ā&9྅u32྅7྅iX.o3.o37nyu rnams so/ /gsal byed so bdun ni/ ka nas ha'i bar so gsum dang / rjes su nga ro dang /347
——— ri

ring po rnams dang / tshigs rkang gi tha ma'i dbyangs thung ngu yang phal cher lci'o/ /'on kyang sdeb sbyor ma/nyam pa'i 'dra mtshungs dang / dbang po rdo rje la —sogs pa'i tshig gi mtha' la de ltar ma yin no/ /tshig mtha' ma gtogs pa'i dbyangs thung ngu rnams yang ba'o/ /de yang bṛt+ta'i sdeb sbyor la dbye na gsum yod de/ mnyam pa dang / phyed mnyam pa dang / mi mnyam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshigs bcad de'i rkang pa bzhi ga sdeb sbyor 'dra bas bcings pa la byed de/ dbye na/ yi ge drug pa dbyangs sgrog nas yi ge nyer bdun man chad la rgyun chags sam rab bsags zhes bya ba'i bar nyi shu rtsa gnyis bshad/ phyed mnyam pa ni/ tshigs bcad re'i rkang pa zung ma yin pa dang po dang gsum pa gnyis sdeb sbyor 'dra la rkang pa zung gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis zung min dang mi 'dra bar sdeb sbyo ra gzhan gyis bcings pa'o/ /de la nyer bkra sogs bcu gsum yod/mi mnyam pa ni/ tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa so so'i sdeb sbyor mi 'dra'o/ /dbye na/ kha sgo dang / rkang bzhi 'phe(ge dang / steng 'gro dang / dal gyis 'gro ste bzhi'o/ /dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor la dbye na gsum yod de/ 'phags ma dang / ro langs can dang /phyi mo mnyam pa'o/ /de rnams so so'i nang gses kyi dbye ba dang / mtshan nyid dang /dper brjod rnams ni sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel dag las shes par bya'o/ /sdeb sbyor 'di dag legs sbyar gyi skad la byed cing bod skad la de'i yi ge lci yang sogs ji lta ba bzhin med par rje bdag nyid chen pos rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba gsungs so/ /sdeb sbyor gyi dgos pa ni/ mkhas rlom dag gis chos la tshig don gyi lhad 'jug mi nus pa'i ched du yin te/ sdeb sbyor nges pas bcings pa dang /tshigs bcad kyi grangs nges pa mdzad pas yi ge gcig kyang 'dzud par mi nus pa'i phyir/sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi gzhung gis dngos zin gyi bṛt+ta la/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta dgu bcu go bdun/ phyed mnyam pa bcu gsum/ mi mnyam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod la/ nyer bskyed bcu bzhi gcig tu bgrang / 'di bcu bzhi las gzhung du gsal ba dgu pa yin no/ /spyir na bṛt+ta'i nang gses kyi dbye ba shin tu mang po yod pa ni ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyis shes so/ /dza ti'i sdeb sbyor la/ 'phags ma'i bye brag bcu/'a 349

ro langs can brgyad/ phyi mo mnyam pa bcu ste kun sdom nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod do/ /zhes :de /khye/ 'ji /dros11 /) snon ston :depa 'a yang na ba dbyangs can dga' ba' sa sa rang da ga gnas 'a la bag chags 'jog phyir bris pa'o/ / 350

༄tsho/ /dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du skye ba'i rgyu chogs la 'bad cing bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs bya tshul zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma ār+ya mi tra ye/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i gtso/ /gang gi dbu la mdzes pa'i cod paṇa mchog/ bcings nas lha brgya'i mgon du mnga' gsol ba/ /rgyal tshab dam pa'i zhabs zung spyi bos mchod/ /zhabs sen nyin byed 'od stong gis/ /nye zho'i mun pa kun bcil te/ /dge mtshan snang ba 'bum spro ba'i/ /rab dga' ldan pa'i zhing gi mngo /na/ /mi pha ma mdun sa pad tshal du/ /bgrod nas gsung gi sbrang rtsa'i bcud/ /myang 'dod skal bzang rkang drug tshogs/ /rmad byung thabs tshul 'di bsten rigs/ /de la 'dir dag pa'i zhing mchog dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du skye ba kharidzin pa la/ zhing gi yo na tan shes nas dad 'dun drag pos yang yang sems pa la rag las pas thog mar zhing gi yon tan dran par bya'o/ /de yang rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams kyis ma/ba' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du thog mar thugs bskyed de rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che 'a slob pa na/ thugs smon ji ltar gnang ba de bzhin du grub pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa ngo mtshar ba dag mtha' yas mod/bska la pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren stong gis gang du skye ba mngon par skye ba'i mdzad pa rim par ston pa'i dag pa'i zhing mchog dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin ni/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i 'dzam bu bṛk+ṣas mtshon pa'i gling 'di nas steng du dpag tshad brgyad khri 'phags pa'i ri rab kyi rtser snod bcud kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas dang / de nas steng du dpag tshad brgyad khri 'phags pa'i nam mkhar 'thab bral gyi lha gnas dang / 'thab bral nas yar 351

dpag tshad tshig 'bum drug khri na dga' ldan gyi gnas yod do/ /mdor na 'dzam gling 'di nas steng du dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri na lha'i bu rab dga' ldan gyi gnas dga' ldan zhes bya ba 'dod pa'i lha'i gnas snod bcud kyi 'byor ba phul du byung ba dang ldan pa yod la/ lha gnas de ni rin po che sna tshogs las grub cing rgya'i tshad ngos re re la dpag tshad brgyad khri re yod pas mtha' skor du sum 'bum nyi khri yod par chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos las gsungs/ der skyes pa'i lha rnams kyi lus tshad rgyang grags gcig dang / tshe tshad ni mi lo bzhi brgya la zhag gcig de sum cu la zla ba gcig dang / de 'dra'i zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo bzhi stong thub bo/ /gang 'dod pa'i zas gos gnas mal sogs bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub cing / nyi zla med pas snang ba'i bya ba ni/ rang gi lus kyi 'od phun sum tshogs pas byed do/ /nyin mtshan gyi khyad par ni/ dus kyi dbang gis me tog ku mu da kha phye zhing pad+ma kha zum pa dang / bya skad mi 'byin pa dang / gnyid bro ba dang / lus kyi 'od mi gsal ba'i dus ni mtshan mo dang / de las bzlog pa nyin mo'i dus so/ /de lta na yang gnas de ni 'dod pa'i 'dam las ma brgal ba'i 'khor ba'i gnas yin no/ /de lta bu'iladaga' ldan gyi lha byings kyi gnas nas gro nga las dgon pa'i tshul du rgyang grags kyis 'phags pa'i char/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi pho brang dag pa'i zhing rgyal mtshan mthon po zhes bya ba yod de/ sa gzhi rin chen rin thang bral ba yi/ /du mas spras pa shin tu nyams dga' ba/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam zhing reg na bde/ /rdul bral gtsang ma shel gyi me long bzhin/ /rin chen be+eḍūr+ya yi mig mangs ris/ /rnam par bkra ba dbang gzhu'i rjes su 'gro/ /mnan na rnam byed bteg na spar byed pa/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong rnam par dag pa'i zhing / /zla shel zhun ma 'khyil 'dra'i mtsho rdzing dang / /ga bur gzegs ma 'thor ba'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /lhung lhung 'bab pa'i yid du 'thad pa'i sgras/ /'dod ldan 'dod dgu'i mgron du 'gug par byed/ /mtshar sdug gsar ba'i me tog sna mang po/ /dri bzhon pho nyas 'khyer ba'i bsung zhim gyis/ /bung ba'i khyu tshogs mgron du 'gug pa na/ /rab dga'i phur lding gar gyis rtsen par byed/ /khor lug rin 352

chen ri bo tshar du dngar/ /phal ba'i sa 'dzin kun gyis dben zhing gtsang / /brtan cing brjid chags gsal 'tsher 'od 'bar bas/ /phan tshun 'khyud 'dra'i rtsed 'jo ci yang byed/ /rin chen sna tshogs khams las legs grub pa'i/ /ljon pa'i 'khri shing ldem pa'i do ra na/ /'dab ldan snyan pa'i mgrin rnga 'khrol ba las/ /chos kyi sdom bzhis bag yod gnas la 'god/ /bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i/ /mkho dgu'i 'byor ba stob pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ /gtong phrod yon tan mthong bas yid g.yo 'am/ /gdeg dka'i nor mang khur gyis ngal ba 'dra/ /e ma de lta'i ya mtshan ni/ /srid zhi'i mtshar sdug yod do cog/ rlabs chen tshogs gnyis sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /dbang med gcig tu bkug pa bzhin/ /pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po de ni khang bzang sum khri nyis stong yod pa lha'i khang bzang gi yon tan dang rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bye bas rab tu phyug cing dpal dang ldan pa ste/ chu dang rgyar dpag tshad drug cu rtsa bzhi yod cing / de'i mdun du rje btsun gyis chos gsungs pa'i kun dga' ra ba yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes bya ba yod par gsungs te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ shin tu nyams dga' zhing lag mthil ltar khod snyoms pa/ shel gyi me long phyis pa ltar dag cing 'od 'tsher ba/ lha'i gos ka na tsa leldaka ltar 'jam zhing reg na bde ba/ be+eḍūr+ya'i mig mangs ris rnam par bkra ba/ mnan na rnam byed cing bteg na spang byed pa/ mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa dang / yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho dang /rdzing bu dang / chu mig dang / 'bab chu dang / me tog kha dog sna tshogs mtshar sdug mthong ba dang dri tshor ba tsam gyis kyang dga' bde skyed nus pa dang / kho ra khor yug rin po che'i ri bo brtan cing brjid chags la 'od 'tsher bas bskor ba dang / rin po che'i khams sna tshogs las grub pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad rang gi mdun du 'byung ba la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / dra ba dra phyed dril bu g.yar kha sogs ji ltar 'dod pa de lta bus spras pa 'phyang bas zhing de yongs su gang ba dang / sprul ba'i bya sna tshogs kyis skad snyan par sgrog cing / de las chos kyi sdom bzhi'i sgra byung bas lha rnams bag med pa'i gnas las zlog par byed pa ste/353

mdor na sum rtsen lha'i bdag po'i gzhal med khang las kyang bye ba phrag 'bum 'gyur gyis mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od kyang zil gyis gnon pa'i 'od zer phyogs kun tu 'phro ba sogs brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i dpal gyi yon tan rmad du byung bas brgyan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i shin tu ngo mtshar zhing lta bas mi ngoms pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i khar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu gser gyi ri bo la nyi ma bye ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa ltar gzi brjid dang ldan zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' mdzes par gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nger bzhugs pa'o/ /de nyid kyi mtha' smor du jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha lha'i bu nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang / rje bla ma lha'i bu 'jam ngapal snying po zhes bya ba'i tshul bzung nas bzhugs shing / gzhan yang phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang / dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu du mas mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pas mchod bzhi'i pa la/ gsung dbyangs yan yag drug cu dang lda na pa'i gsung gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgra lhang lhang gsungs bzhin pa la/ rang nyid gnas der dngos su slebs nas zhing gi yon tan thams cad dang / rje btsun gyi sku dngos su mthong zhing gsung snyan po lhang lhang thos pa'i mos pa shugs drag po yun mi thung tsam re yang yang bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas 'di nas 'phos ma thag zhing der skye ba'i bag chags khyad par can 'jog cing zhing sbyong du yang 'gro ba sogs kyi dgos pa shin tu che'o/ /gzhan yang dga' ldan du skye ba'i rgyur rje btsun byams pa'i sku yid la byas te gsol ba shugs drag tu gdab pa dang / byams pa dam bcas pa'i gzungs kha ton byas pa dang / byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa dang / khas blangs pa'i bslab khrims bsrungs shing tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la 'bad pa dang / byams pa'i smon lam sogs dga' ldan du skye ba'i smon 354

lam shugs drag tu btab na 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro bas zhing der nges par skye bar gdon mi za'o/ /smras pa/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi thugs bskyed dang / /rlabs chen smon lam stobs kyis grub pa yi/ /snod bcud zhing gi yon tan cimesam mi khyab/ /nyam chung blo yi bu gar shong ba min/ /'on kyang dam pa'i gsung ngag la brten nas/ /cha tsam brjod pa'i dbyar rnga'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ /skal bzang mdongs mtha'i rna ba'i bdud tsi dang / /dad pa'i sru long g.yo ba cis mi byed/ /de ltar dga' ldan du skye ba'i rgyu tshogs la 'bad bzhin pas bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs bya ba ni/ dus gsum legs byas gaṅgā gtsang ma'i rgyun/ /gnas skabs mngon mtho'i rlabs phreng ngom bzhin du/ /mthar thug skyagasum go 'phang grub pa'i bgegs/ /sgrib gnyis bag cha gas bcas pa sbyang phyir bsngo/ /nam zhig yun ring mdza' ba'i lus sems gnyis/ /ma rungs dus kyi phra mas phye ba'i tshe/ /rgyal tshab dam pa'i drung du son gyur nas/ /'dab brgya'i lte bar brdzus te skye bar shog/ de ts+tsha byams ma gon 'khor bcas dgyes 'dzum gyi/ /gsung gis dbugs phyungs bla med theg pa yi/ / zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /dad pa'i snyim pas ngoms med 'thung bar shog/ lkog gyur gnas kun shāmajal —ba'i mngon shes dang / /sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byed pa'i phu 'phrul mchog/ mi brjed gzungs dang smra ba'i spobs pa sogs/ /yon tan nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog/ mgon khyod 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba ru/ /mchog gi mdzad pa'i rnam par rol ba'i tshe/ /sras kyi thu bo nyid du bdag gyur te/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu lung bstan shog/ thog med dus nas drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ /ma rgan mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus pa/ /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid mtsho chen po las/ / sgrol la 'jam mgon mchog dang mtshungs par shog/ gting zab 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma zad pa/ /de srid lung dang rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /lhar bcas skye dgu'i phan bde'i 'byung gnas su/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/ ces dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du skye ba 'dzin pa'i rgyu tshogs la 'bad cing bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs bya tshul zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ cha gawa kho bo chag na nas dad brtson mkhyen 355

dpyod yangs pa tā bla ma phun tshogs bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ mkhas grub dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten pa'i snyoms las pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis g.yar khral du sbyar ba'o/ /༄༅/ / na mo ār+ya mi tra ye/ dag pa'i zhing mchog dga' ldan yul na/ /sa bcu dbang phyug rgyal tshab mgon por/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis myur du drong mdzod/ /mtha' med 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las/ /nyam thag 'o dod yang yang 'bod cing / /gdung gdung yid kyis gsol ba 'debs so/ / phyis shol ma mdzad myur du drong mdzod/ /snyigs ma las kyang ches cher snyigs ma'i/ /dus mthar skyes pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba/ /snying med bsam brlag bdag cag rnams la/ /rnam kun byams brtse'i thugs rjes skyong mdzod/ /phyi nang snod bcud gang la bltas kyang / /lo zla zhag gis je thur song nas/ /dus ngan tshe lo bcu par nye ba/ /'di las skyobs shig rgyal tshab mgon po/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid gtan nas 'dzad de/ /'jigs rung nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa/ /thos pa tsam gyis ya nga de las/ /skyobs shig skyobs shig rgyal tshab mgon po/ /mtho dman skya btsun su la bltas kyang / /cha lugs rnam 'gyur tsam zhig ma gtogs/ /sdug gis mi tshe 'byid pa skal mnyam/ /thugs rjes skyobs shig rgyal tshab mgon po/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i skye bo phal cher/ /yid la bsam rgyu nyon mongs dug gsum/ /byed rgyu sdig las med pa 'di rnam sa/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal tshab mgon po/ /nam zhig tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus su/ /mgon khyod 'jom gling sa yi lte bar/ /mchog gi sprul pa'i mdzad pa ston tshe/ /bdag cag 'khor gyi thog mar gyur cig/ der ma son pa'i tshe rabs kun tu/ /mi bzad ngan song 'jigs 'a sa bskyabs te/ /khyod zhal mthong zhing khyod gsung thos pa'i/ /skal ba ldan par byin gyis rlobs shig/ ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan blo bzang ming can gyis skyo tshig tu smras pa'o/ /༄7/ /dga' ldan du skye ba'i gsol 'debs smon tshig dang bcas pa zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣā ya/ steng dga' ldan lha brgya'i mdun sa ru/ /rje sa bcu'i dbang phyug sems dpa'i tshul/ /lha skal ldan yongs kyi 'dren pa mchog/ mgon mi pham chos rje'i zhabs la 356

'dud/ /spyir deng sang bska la pa mar 'grib dus/ /sgos tshe lo bcu pa'i mtha' la nye/ /:do/ 1re//bye/ /sde/ rnga ga the:rdo nyerdordo ༷/| zu byu thore/ /sde/ stoje/ /༷/na ra gas ma' rang ma nga ba la/ /ma 'a ba' ba da com par 'a ba/ /mi rang gzhan spyod tshul gar bltas kyang / /yi mug cing snying khong chu bzhin grang / /da 'di snang 'gag par 'gyur ba na/ /zhing dga' ldan gnas su bgrod na snyam/ /sras dpag med 'khor tshogs 'dus pa'i dbus/ /gsung tshangs dbyangs lhang lhang sgrog pa der/ /bdag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /gzhi rin chen du ma las grub cing / /nor be+eḍūr+ya yi mig mangs bkra/ /zhing ngo mtshar dpag med ldan pa ru/ / thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /gnas dag sa yid dga' chos 'dzin na/ /mtshan rgyal mtshan mthon po zhes grags par/ /sku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung / /thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /thugs byams brtse'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ don zab dang rgya che las brtsams pa'i/ /chos theg chen dga' ston 'gyed pa der/ /thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /ma 'gro kun phan bde spel 'dod kyang / / sngon bsod nams bsags rgyab chung bas na/ /don yid la brnag kyang phan med phyir/ /mgon khyod kyi drung du bgrod par smom// /tshe 'di la rang gzhan don sgrub pa'i/ /las 'phro dang nus mthu ma mchis pa'i/ /don de phyir myur bar dga' ldan du/ /bdeg skye ba'i smon lam snying nas 'debs/ /dpal nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang / /mgon 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs dag la/ /'bangs gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /mi nga la dad cing gus pa rnams/ /zhing dga' ldan gnas su mjal lo zhes/ /gsung 'gyur med bka' yis zhal bzhes bzhin/ /bu snying med nyid kyi zhabs drung du/ /thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /mthar 'di snang 'gag par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /yid bzod glags med pa'i gnad gcod dang / /dgra gshin rje'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /gnas 'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa dang / /'phrang dam po bar do'i 'jigs las sgrol/ /zhing dga' ldan gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /thugs brtse ba'i 'od zer lcags kyu mchog/bdag tshangs pa'i bu gar legs btab ste/ /snying 'dab brgya chos ri 357

'khor lte ba nas/ /gzhi rlung sems dga' ldan gnas su drongs/ /sras snying stobs /byi( (ste/ /bye/ /skyi/ /bye/ /sde/ rdordo1 1)/ :de/ /groḥrnam da da zla da du/ /bdag brdzus bar na sa bas/ /da 'a sa ma na rnam dkar phung po'i mthus/ /bdag 'di snang 'gag par gyur ma thag/ zhing dga' ldan gnas su skyes gyur te/ /chos theg pa che la spyod par shog/ ces rje btsun byams mgon gyi thugs rje bskul cing dga' ldan du skye ba 'dzin pa'i smon tshig 'di yang / dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ / ci ci 358

༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la bstod cing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyan 'bebs sogs bstod pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra satwa ya/ sgrib bral lhan skyes ye shes 'od stong gis/ /'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i rgyu tshogs sdig ltung mun/ /skad cig nyid la drungs nas 'byin mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rab dkar chu skyes 'dab brgya rgyas pa'i rtser/ /rab mdzes ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan ste/ du/ /rab gsal mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan yab zlubya4 zung / /dbo mang 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig khyordo la bstod/ /gangs ri zla 'bum 'od kyis 'khyud 'cha'i sku/ /snyan 'jibs tshangs dbyangs zil gyis non pa'i gsung / /ma lus chos kun gsal ler gzigs pa'i thugs/ /rmad byung yon tan phung po khyod la bstod/ /srab 'jam lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' g.yo/ /yid 'phrog rin chen rgyan phreng du mas brgyan/ /zag med bde ster dbyings phyug mar 'khyud pa/ /thabs shes zung 'jug rdor dril bsnams la bstod/ /mkha' khyab zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /mi bzad sdig ltung dam tshig nyam/sa chag sos/sa/ /khyod kyi gzungs sngags zab mo bzlas tsam gyis/ /dus mtha'i zhugs kyis tshang tshing sreg bzhin bsngags/ /de'i phyir sdig ltung phyi sa'i 'dam rdzob tu/ /bying ba'i skyabs med bsam brlag bdag cag gis/ /snying nas 'o dod 'bod cing gsol 'debs na/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag gis drang du gsol/ /thog med dus nas da lta yan chad du/ /bsags pa'i sdig ltung khur gyis non bzhin du/ /'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang la phyogs pa bdag/ brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag gis myur du drongs/ /rab 'bar lcags kyi khang par sreg byed cing / /mun nag 'khyag rum bu yug 'tshub pa'i khrod/ /khyer byed tsha grang dmyal ba'i rgyu 359

tshogs rnams/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsis da lta 'khrud par mdzod/ /lo brgyar bza' btung ming tsam mi thos shing / /bkres skom duḥkhas khog nas me 'bar ba'i/ /nyam thag yi dwags 'gro bar 'khrid pa'i rgyu/ / thugs rje'i char gyis da lta bcil bar mdzod/ /mun nag brkyang bskum tsam yang mi nus shing / /glen lkug blang dor gnas la rmongs shing 'thibs/ /gsod gcod sdug bsngal bzod dka'i byol song rgyu/ /byin —rlabs snang bas da lta sel bar mdzod/ /kye hud bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal de/ /myong ba lta shog ming tsam thos pas snying / /tshal bar gas ba'i rgyu tshogs ma lus pa/ /myur du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na da nas shes rgyud sdig ltung dang / /zhag tu mi 'grogs dran rig gsal sing nge / /kun byang blang dor chos rnams ma 'dris par/ /gzigs mor bkra ba'i dga' ston bdag la stsol/ /der nas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi/ /go 'phang dam pa ji srid ma non pa/ /de srid mgon khyod dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog/ ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la bstod cing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'beb ces bya ba 'di yang / gyi na pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis rnam 'gyur gyi lo rgyal zla'i yar tshes bzang po gsum pa'i nyin rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi bcad bya'i thun mtshams su bris pa dza yas/ /lhag pa'i lta mchog rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la don rgyan so lnga'i sgo nas bstod pa don rgyan gsal ba'i me long byin rlabs nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mdzi shri ye/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/ yid 'ong 'dab stong rgyas pa'i lte ba ru/ rab mdzes rgyu skar mgon po'i gdan steng na/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /dmar ser 'od phung 'gyed pa khyod la 'dud/ /dpe rgyan/li khri'i rkang 'thung gar bstabs bsgyur 'dra'i sku/ /smin legs chu skyes 'dab ltar rgyas pa'i zhal/ /spyan zung bung ba g.yo ba'i rjes su 'gro/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar dkyus ring zur mig mdzes/ /gzugs can gyi rgyan/ mnyen lhug phyag gi 'khri shing ldem pa la/ /ut+pal na chung lang tsho dar ba'i rtser/ / glegs ral nyin byed mgon po'i 'od stong gis/ /360

rmongs pa'i mtshan mor rgyu ba pha mthar bskrad/ /gsal byed kyi rgyan/ mdzes so ston zlas kun gsal bu mo'i ngos/ /rab brjid lhun po gser gyi sa 'dzin khrod/ /'chi med gtso bo legs ldan nye dbang dang / /mgon khyod rgyal sras bye ba'i dbus na 'o/ /bskor ba'i rgyan/ yid 'phrog sku ni mtshan dpe'i phreng bas mdzes/ /rab snyan gsung 'di yan lag drug cus brgyan/ /zab yangs thugs la chos kun cig car bkra/ /mgon khyod skal ldan skye dgu'i dpal du brjid/ /'gog pa'i rgyan/ srid zhi'i mdzes sdug gcig tu srungs pa yi/ /lta bas mi ngoms ngo mtshar 'di ldan na/ /rnam bkra'i dar gyi gos bzang lhab lhub dang / /rin chen rgyan phreng khur gyis ci zhig bya/ /don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa'i khur/ /mgon khyod snying stobs mchog gi phrag pas 'degs/ /sra brtan nor 'dzin bu mo 'di yis kyang / /rlabs chen rgyu dang mi rgyu'i khur chen 'dzin/ /ldog pa can gyi rgyan/ mtshar sdug mig gi bdud rtsi sku mchog 'di/ /mtshams sprin gzhon nu 'khyud pa'i gser ri dang / /mtshungs mod de ni bem chos rang bzhin te/ /khyod sku sgrib bral ye shes rang mdangs dngos/ /srid pa can gyi rgyan/ ma phyis dri ma dang bral khyod kyi sku/ /bris pa med par mtshan dpa'i ri mo bkra/ /ma bcol na yang rma na bde spel bar mdzad/ /khyod ni yongs kyi ma 'dris mdza' bshes che/ /bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/ mun pa'i go skabs mtha' dag 'phrog byed cing / /lus can tshogs la snang ba'i bdud rtsi 'gyed/ /gzhan yang 'char nub sgrib byed dang bral ba'i/ /nyin byed mchog 'di skal ldan rnams kyi mgon/ /phul byung gi rgyan/ma smad gsang gsum mdzad pa'i yon tan mtha'/ /mu med kun gsal khyon las brgal gyur te/ /sus kyang dpag nus min yang 'dir shong ba/ /e ma khyod thugs shin tu yangs pa lags/ /rab rtog gi rgyan/khyod gsung dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba na/ /yid can mtha' dag ma rig gnyid slong tshe/ /bdag cag btang snyoms bya bar rigs so zhes/ /rgyal rnams chos dbyings ngang du gzims sam snyam/ /rgyu'irgyan/ rmongs pa'i sbyin skyes yan lag mchog breg pa'i/ /mkhyen rab mtshon rnon mkha' la gdengs pa na/ /skal ldan snying la sem pa'i dpal ster kyang / /yid srub sde bcas 'dar bar byed 'di ci/ /phramo'i rgyan/ tshogs gnyis zla ba'i 361

ma ma las 'ongs pa'i/ /lha lam khyon kun gsal ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /cig cad spro ba'i rgyu skar mgon 'di la/ /skal ldan gnyis skyes lag pad snying gar zum/ /cha'i rgyan/yab gcig khyod kyi thugs rje dran pa'i tshe/ /lus skyes g.yo zhing mchi ma byung ba la/ /dri yi bzhon pa me tog rdul dang bcas/ /'dren byed dag tu reg la ci bya smras/ /rim pa can gyi rgyan/ tshogs gnyis chu gter che las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /snyan 'jebs gsung dang zab yangs mkhyen pa rnams/ /rab brjid gser ri dri za'i rgyud mangs dang / /kun khyab rol ba'i gnas kyis 'phrog par nges/ /dga' ba'i rgyan/ khyod zhal mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba las/ /yid la dga' ba'i khyad pa/ra skyes pa de/ /'khor 'das bde ba gzhan gyis mi mtshon de/ /slar yang khyed zhal mthong tshe 'byung bar nges/ /nyams ldan gyi rgyan/ 'jig rten mes po'i dbyangs snyan pham byed pa'i/ /khyod gsung rna ba'i bcud len bdud rtsi 'di/ /e ma sgra 'dzin lam du son pa na/ /rab dga'i bzhin gyi 'dzum ras ci yang rgyas/ /gzi bajid kyi rgyan/sgrib gnyis tshang tshing drungs nas gcod byed pa'i/ /mkhyen rab ral gri 'phyar la khyed cag gis/ /skrag par mi bya sdig to'i sems btang na/ /'gro ba'i skyabs 'di snang ba'i go skabs ci/ /rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan/ rme nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid pa'i mtsho chen las/ /nyam thag gyur pa'i 'gro rnams ma lus pa/ /snying rje'i rkya ba 'dzin pa khyod kyis sgrol/ /kho bo lta bu btang snyoms mdzad kyang bla/ /kun phan gyi rgyan/ ring nas brgal dka' 'khor ba'i me 'ob tu/ /brnag dka'i sdug bsngal brgya yis gtses pa bdag/ brtse chen gdung skyob grib bsil tshol ba na/ /yab gcig thugs rje'i char zim ci yang g.yo/ /rgya cheba'i rgyan/ mkha' mnyam yid can kun gyi phan bde'i khur/ /gang gi thugs rje'i cha shas la brten cing / /sras bcas rgyal kun rlabs chen mdzad pa rnams/ /khyod nyid gcig pus 'khyer 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /bston dor gyi rgyan/ bgrang yas rgyal kun bdag nyid yal bor nas/ /mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'dren par grags pa rdzun/ /bden na rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i klong / /ma lus gcig tu 'khyil ba'i mgon 'dis ci/ /sbyaraba'i rgyan/ kun khyab dbyings nas gzi brgya'i 'od 'bar bas/ /zhing kun cig car 'geng mdzad 'di shar tshe/ /mun nag 362

tshang tshing ma lus rab bsregs shing / /dge legs snang bas khyab mdzad 'di ko ——— mtshar/ /khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/ mgon khyod gcig tu gzhan phan 'ba' zhig dgongs/ /gnod pa'i sems dang dpung tshogs mi ldan yang / /shirne tu 'jam pa'i ye shes mtshon chen gyis/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i rgyal thabs de rmad byung / /mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan/ cher snyigs 'gro ba'i 'dren pa zas gtsang sras/ /snying rje'i gter chen phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs/ /rgyal tshab dam pa ma pham mgon po dang / /mkhyen rab dbang phyug khyed rnams mtshungs pa lags/ /'gal ba'i rgyan/ rab mdzes zhal ras zlum zhing spyan dkyus ring / /dbu skyes bung ba ltar nag tshems phreng dkar/ /sku sked drang la smin ma 'ja' ltar 'khyog/ khyod sku skal ldan yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog/skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan/dbul phongs brel brgyas gzir ba'i skye bo dang / /srid 'byor sgyu mas khengs dregs 'di mthong tshe/ /ye shes rang mdangs dag pa'i longs spyod la/ /ci dgar rol ba'i mgon khyod snying nas dran/ /zolabastod kyi rgyan/ rang don 'ba' zhig goms pa'i nyan rang yang / /'gro la 'tshe pa'i go skabs rgyang bsrings na/ /brtse chen thugs rje mthar son khyod nyid kyis/ /nag phyogs skrag mdzad 'di ni rigs sam ci/ /nges bstan gyi rgyan/ 'on btang bdag nyid chen po'i ngang tshul ni/ /gzhan phan 'ba' zhig lhur mdzad kho na ste/ /legs ldan pad+ma'i gnyen gyi 'od stong gis/ /yid can kun la snang ba'i dpa la ster byed/ /lhan cig brjod pa'i spyan/ khyod zhabs rgyu skar bdag po'i bsil zer shādang / /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zegs ma lhan cig tu/ /spyi bor lhung tshe blo gros kun da dang / /dpag yas yon tan chu gter lhan du rgyas/ /yongs brjes kyi rgyan/ mgon khyod bgrang yas bskal bar sku dang ni/ /mkho dgu gces pa'i dngos po kun btang nas/ /gzhal dka'i spangs rtogs yon tan nor bu'i tshogs/ /thugs kyi bang mdzod yongs su gtams par mdzad/ /shis brjod kyi rgyan/ yid bzhin mtsho la ngang mo rtsen pa bzhin/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying la sim pa las/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la/ /thogs med rnam dpyod mchog gi bkra shis stsol/ /rab spel gyi rgyan/ nyin mor byed pa'i dpal ltar brjid pa'i sku/ /nam yang yid mkhar 'bral med rtag 'char 363

te/ /shes bya'i rig gnas kun gyi tshig don la/ /blo gros thogs pa med pa'i dge legs stsol/ /dgongs pa can gyi rgyan/ byin rlabs char sprin 'khrigs pa'i lding khang du/ /bdag sems mdongs mthas lung rtogs mngal 'dzin te/ /snyan tshig rig gzhung smra ba'i 'gyur bag glu/ /'dod dgur bsgyur nas dga' ba'i gar byed shog/ ces pa 'di ni yul mdo smad kyi mthar skyes pa'i btsun gzugs snyan ngag la blo mig cung zad phye ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis sbyar ba dza yas/ /༄7/ /'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po la bstod cing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / chin ma sti ku la nā thā ya/ mu med mkha' khyab zhing gi lus can kun/ /gang thugs brtse chen kyo bas nyer bzung nas/ /nges legs gtan bde'i mtshon pa'i khang bzang du/ /'khrid mdzad spyan ras gzegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i gzhon nu'i sku/ /rab snyan yan lag drug cu ldan pa'i gsung / /shes bya ma lus cig car gzigs pa'i thugs/ /yab gcig 'jam mgon bla mar gsol ba tre'adebs/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa/ /rab brjid dbang sngon zhu ba 'khyol 'dra'i sku/ /rab gtum khros pa'i gar mdzad log 'idren tshogs/ /rab 'joms gsang ba'i bdag char gsol ba 'debs/ /las nyon 'ching ba dam pos rnob bcings shing / /mi bzad sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba yis/ /ci bya gtol med nyam thag bdag cag la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gang gi mtshan snyan rna bar 'phos pa'i mod/ /ring nas 'thibs pa'i rmongs pa'i dri ma rnams/ /skad cig nyid la drung nas 'byin byed pa'i/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyis bdag skyongs shig/ dwangs ba'i yid mkhar khyod sku'i snang brnyan tsam/ /shar ba'i mod la nag po'i rtsa lag kun/ /sde bcas ming gi lhag mar byed pa'i mgon/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin gyis dus kun skyongs/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs rigs gsum mgon/ /cung zad bstod cing thugs rje bskul ba'i mthus/ /bdag tsosogs deng nas tshangs spyod rten brgyud de/ /'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin 364

gyur cig/ 'gro la brtse chen zhags pas dam 'khyud cing / /shes bya'i gnas la thogs med rnam dpyod rgyas/ /phyi nang bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag gyur cig/ ces pa 'di yang dad brtson ldan pa rdoge slong rgyal mtshan grags pas bskul ngor/ gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis mtsho bdun dgon par sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /〉〉/ /ltag pa'i lha rnam bzhi la bstod pa byin rlabs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo mdzi shri ye/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig 'dus nas/ /rmad byung yid 'ong lha mo'i skur ston pa/ /dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol zhing / /tshe dang mchog stsol yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dud/ /bgrang yas rnam 'dren mkhyen brtse chu klung 'bum/ /gang thugs chu gter klong du 'khyil ba las/ /rgyal sras 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes mtshan snyan gyis/ /ma lus zhing kun 'geng mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /dri bral mkhyen rab khams las legs grub cing / / mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ / skal bzang phan bde'i ku mud bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /yum gcig dbyangs can lha mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sngon tshe rlabs chen gtong ba'i bsod nams gter/ /legs par goms pa'i tshe nor mthu dpal la/ /dbang bsgyur dbyig gi dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ /dpal mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pas tshe rabs kun tu bdag/ tshangs spyod rten brgyud rig pa'i gnas kun la/ /thos bsam sgom pa gegs med mthar phyin cing / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag gyur cig/ces pa ljosnedi yang mdo sngags rig gnas kun la rnam dpyod rab tu yangs ba sngags ram pa blo bzang mkhas mchog gi 'dod mos ltar dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis mtsho bdun dgon par sbyar ba'o/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mdzi sgo ṣā ya/ li khri'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin la/ /thun mtshams gsar ba'i 'od stong 'khyud pa bzhin/ / srid zhi'i mdzes sdug ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ /yid 'phrog ngag gi dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /gnyen ldem chu skyes gang bsil zer steng / /dmar ser dhīḥyig las 'khrungs 'jam pa'i dpal/ /kur 365

gum khu bas byugs pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /dri yi bzhon pas bskyod 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /rgyu skar bdag po bye bas sprun min pa'i/ /zhal bzang rnam par rgyas pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ /skal ldan bye ba'i yid la dpal ster ba/ /zla med skyabs kyi dam par gus pas 'dud/ /mtha' dag rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab klong 'khyil ba/ /rab mdzes rgyal sras zol la nyer bsten nas/ /mu med srid mtshor 'phyan pa'i lus can 'di'i/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes chen po khyod la 'dud/ /zhal bzang ut+pal nags tshal rgyas pa na/ /yid 'ong spyan zung bung ba rnam par rol/ /tshems dkar ze 'bru tshar du dngar ba la/ /mchu sgros bisba'i yal 'dab g.yo la 'dud/ /gang sku sprin bral kun gsal bu mo'i ngos/ /sna mang rgyan gyi rgyu skar rnam par bkra/ /dar gyi na bza'i dbang gzhu'i ri mo brgyas/ /kun nas mdzes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab rang bzhin ral gri 'od 'bar ba/ /gser gyi sngon pa yal ga brkyangs 'dra ba'i/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis nyer bzung 'phyar tsam gyis/ /ma rig 'khri shing cod nas gcod la 'dud/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis bsnams pa'i ut+pal gyi/ /'chi med na chung lang tsho rgyas pa'i steng / /ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gyur glebs bam gyis/ /legs par brgyan pa khyod la snying nas / 'dud/ /'jam mnyen chu skyes mdzes ma'i lto ba ru/ /rab dkar ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan steng na/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i ral ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung mdzad la 'dud/ /bzhi lhag drug cu'i dbyangs snyan dbyar rnga yis/ /skal bzang mdongs mtha' can gyi sgra 'dzin du/ /rab sem dpal ster gser mngal can gyi dbyangs/ /kun nas pham mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod thugs dri bral zla ba'i ma ma ru/ /chos kun skar tshogs gzugs brnyan cig car bkra/ /mi zad legs bshad dbang gi rgyal pos gtams/ /rmad byung yon tan phung po khyod la 'dud/ /rgyal sras rnam sad bye ba'i ral ba'i rgyan/ /shes bya kun gzigs 'dren byed stong g.yo zhing / /mtha' bral mkhyen rab rdo rje rtse brgya yis/ /rab rmongs sbyin skyes 'joms mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /rab dwangs yid kyi a dar+sha yi ngos/ /mgon khyod rmad byung yon tan 'bum gyi gzugs/ /g.yo med ting 'dzin pir gyis rab bris te/ /gtsug skyes 'dzin mar bkod 366

nas lan brgyar 'dud/ /rab mdzes khyod sku thig le na chung zhal/ /nyin bzhin blta ba'i bsam gtan la brtson na/ /ring nas thugs bskyed mdza' ba mya btang bar/ /myur du byin rlabs dga' ston bdag la stsol/ /gang gi thugs rje sgyu 'phrul 'od stong gis/ /bskrun par ma gyur rgyal dang de sras gang / /de slad thar 'dod skyabs med bung ba bdag/ nyid kyi thugs rje chu skyes tshal der chags/ /brtse chen ded dpon don mthun phal cher thal/ /mu med 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon gnas su 'khyams/ /nyon mongs chom rkun gcan gzan gdug pas gtse/ /mgon med bdag la gzigs shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /rgyal bstan nyin byed nub rir g.yur la nye/ /mi bzad snyigs ma'i smag rum ches cher 'thibs/ /bshes gnyen dmigs bus bor ba'i ldongs pa bdag/ re sa gzhan na med do 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ma rig ling thog stug pos blo mig bsgribs/ /blang dang dor bya'i gnas la rab tu rmongs/ /ya nga'i ngan song sgrub thabs lhur len la/ /byin rlabs thur ma/sa mig phye 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ring nas goms pa'i nyon mongs 'dab gshog brkyangs/ /sdig ltung phyi sa'i khur chen thogs nas ni/ /'dod yon mi gtsang dong du 'i khor ba bdag/ thugs rje'i lcags kyus drongs shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /legs bshad g.yu ral rgyas pa'i lang tsho ngom/ /rtsod pa'i nga ros log smra zil gyis non/ /sdebs legs rtsom pa'i lus stobs yongs su rdzogs/ /smra ba'i seng ge'i dga' ston bdag la stsol/ /chos kun dka' gnad sistu wa ra'i kha/ /thogs med rnam dpyod mdzes ma'i 'gram chang gis/ /legs phye 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /ma lus 'gro kun mgron du gnyer bar shog/ deng nas mu med srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /ma 'phags de srid mgon khyod rjes bzung ste/ /mkhas bya'i gnas la rnam dpyod rab rgyas te/ /zla bral mkhas pa'i yang rtse thob par shog/ ji ltar thos bzhin sems rgyud ches cher 'dul/ /thos bsam sgom pa phan tshun 'gran bzhin glu'aphel/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems stobs rgyas te/ /'gro kun sgrol la mgon khyod lta bur shog/ yab gcig mkhyen gter gang de la/ /bstod tshig ut+pal yon po 'di/ /dad pa'i snyim pas 'thor ba po/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros so/ /mgi lam̐/ /367

༄7/ /na mo gu ru mdzi sgo 6ya/ ka ma la yi ge sar bzhad pa la/ /kha ba ltar bsil ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng / /ga shal rgyan gyis spud pa'i gzhon nu'i sku/ /nga yi gtsug rgyan mkhyen pa'i gter la 'dud/ /ca co che ldan gdung ba'i nga ro yis/ /cha shas yongs rdzogs mtshan dpe'i sku la bstod/ /ja bzang btung ba'i mchod tshogs legs 'bul ma/ /nya gang zla ltar rgyas pa'i zhal ston mdzod/ /ta la'i ljon bzang dkrigs 'dra'i dben gnas su/ /tha mal chos brgyad rnam rtog spangs nas ni/ /da nas gtan gyi mdun ma sgrub lags na/ /na 'chi rgud pa'i nyer 'tshe zhi bar mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar gzhan phan sems bskyed de/ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs rnes/ /badz+ra lha ra wa yi lam bzang gis/ /ma dag skye shi bar do legs sbyangs te/ /tsa tur grangs ldan rnal 'byor rim pa la/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas 'bad pa las/ /dza ya'i gsung bzhin tshe 'dir grol nas ni/ /wa sogs 'gro kun sgrol ba'i dga' ston stsol/ /zhwa gos btse ma'i gser mdog la 'gran pa'i/ /za byed ma ho'i zhal can sgyu 'phrul gar/ /'a cag skyabs gcig 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ /ya mtshan bstan pa spel ba'i byin rlabs stsol/ /ra gre/na gser du brdzu 'dra'i tshul 'chos kyis/ /la lung bskor ba'i spyod pa rgyang ba srings nas/ /sha ba ri pa'i rnam thar legs bskyangs te/ /sa steng 'gran zla bral ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /ha cang gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs dang / /arnya la so gas phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mchod tshogs rab 'byams zhing rkyen bkang ste 'bul/ /'dod don lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang agi rar grags pa'i/ /chu sprel rgyal gyi dkar phyogs kyi/ /rgyal ba dang po'i tshes dge bar/ /byed po dbyangs can dga' blo'o/ /༄7/ /na mo mdzi thi ye/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i mdo sngags kyi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa srung mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum la/ /dus kun sgo gsum gus pas mchod cing bstod/ /ka dag lhan skyes bde chen ngang nyid las/ /kha dog mig sman ltar nag rab khros sku/ /ga shal la sogs rgyan phreng lhab lhub g.yo/ /nga rgyal dregs 'joms 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /ca co 'gyur khug 'degs 368

'jog spom phra sogs/ /cha lang rol mo dang bcas bstod bsngags dang / /ja chang sman rag gtor ma legs 'bul gyis/ /nya rgyas zla ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa'i snying po 'di/ /tha ma'i dus mtha' 'dir yang phyogs kun tu/ /da dung sngar ltar spel srung ma g.yel zhing / /na 'chi rgud pa'i ming yang med par mdzod/ /pa ra mi ta'i dgongs don 'tshol ba la/ /pha rol mi bzad bdud sde'i tshogs rnams kyis/ ba spru g.yo 'gul tsam yang mi nus pa'i/ /ma smad mthu rtsal chen po'i dngos grub stsol/ /tre ri la sogs dben pa'i gnas chen du/ /tsha grang ngal dub yid la mi byed par/ /dza lang gces 'dzin sems 'di 'dul ba'i phyir/ /wa ler rtse gcig sgom la mel tshe mdzod/ /zha mo la sogs sngo rngad tsam zhig la/ /za ma'i chog shes bsten pa'i dka' spyad kyis/ /'a re 'u re yo lang rgyang bsrings te/ /ya ma tshan zab lam sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ra ri dri mas sbags pa'i rang sems 'di/ /la 'ur 'dul ba'i thabs la rab 'bad de/ /sha wa ri ltar sgrub pa mthar son nas/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i mgon du bdag gyur mdzod/ /ha la'i dug sdong dkrigs 'dra'i srid mtsho 'dir/ /a long ltar 'khor ma rgan mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la/ /ring min 'god pa'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /mthu ldan khyod la mchod bstod bskul ba'i mthus/ /thos bsam sgom pa phyogs su ma song zhing / /phyi nang 'gal rkyen ma lus kun zhi nas/ /mthun rkyen legs tshogs grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ ces pa'ang gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis bris/ /369

ro༅/ /rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po slob dpon seng ge bzang bo la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /susti/ rlabs chen tshogs gnyis gangs ri'i spo la 'gying / /rmad byung lung —rtogs g.yu ral rnam par rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mche sder rab tu rno/ /rgyal sras seng ge bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /ring nas thugs bskyed rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /thub bstan snying po phyogs brgyar spel ba'i skad/ /phun tshogs dpal gyis mtho ba'i rgyal rigs su/ /bsam bzhin 'khrungs/ par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe ring min mtsho yi 'dab brgya lta ra/ /bskyed bsrengs srid 'byor glog gi rol rtsed la/ /zhen log drag pos bstan la rab byung mdzad/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyis mdzes la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyes sbyangs mkhyen dpyod nyin byed 'od stong gis/ /rang gzhan sde pa'i gzhung mang 'dam skyes tshal/ /legs par phye ba'i gnad don sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /thar 'dod tshim par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma'i sro la bzang po/ /'byed mkhas slob dpon zhi 'tsho'i zhabs bsten nas/ /dbu ma'i gzhung dang gdams po'i bdud rtsi yis/ /thugs rgyud gtams par mdzad la gsol ba — tso'adebs/ /rang gi mkhan po rnam snang mdzad kyi drung / /sher phyin gsan cing byams pa'i sgrub thabs zhus/ /shar phyogs kha sa spa ṇi'i nags tshal du/ /sgrub pa snying por mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe mi pham mgon po mnal lam du/ /zhal bstan gsung gis dbugs dbyung lung bstan mdzad/ /rgyal po dharma pā las spyan drangs tshe/ /bstan 'gro'i don du byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /tri ka tu ga'i gtsug lag khang bzang du/ /bzhugs nas skal ldan stong phrag mang po la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul yum don 'chad/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /sher phyin nyi khri'i 370

bsdus don le'u brgyad ma/ /brgyad stong 'grel chen 'grel ba don gsal dang / /sdud 'grel rtogs sla sher phyin bsgoms pa sogs/ /legs bshad gter chen spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub gsung snying po mdo sde zab mo'i don/ /'phagasal yul 'grel byed dbus na nyi zla ltar/ /gsal mdzad blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa/ /gzhal dka'i bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas mang nyin mtshan mgon gyis 'byed min pa'i/ /rgyal yum sbas don sirnyu wa ra'i kha/ /khyod gsung mdzes ma'i 'gram 'chang gis phye tshe/ /snyan grags srid gsum khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul 'di 'dzam bu bṛk+ṣas mtshan pa yi/ /gling 'dir spel la khyod nyid 'os so zhes/ /byams mgon dga' ldan gnas su gshegs sam snyam/ /zab sangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bstod pa'i rnam/ dkar zla zer ltar/ /mchog tu dkar ba ji snyed mchis ba yis/ /srid lam 'khyams pa'i lus can ma lus pa/ /theg mchog lam bzang myur du bgrod gyur cig/ nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas srid mtsho chen po las/ /ma 'phags de srid dal 'byor rten brgyud de/ /shing rta chen po rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi/ /gzhung la phu thag chod par sbyang bar shog/ ji tsam thos bzhin sems rgyud lhag par dul/ /thos bsam sgom pa 'gal med nyams su bstar/ /lung rtogs yon tan dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas te/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog/ ces pa 'di yang hal ha tshe chen han gyi shog gi dge slo nga bstan 'phel gyis 'dod mos bzhin/ /snyoms las pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis 'phral du sbyar ba'o/ /371
