brda rnying / rdzud pa ni rid pa/ bsnyil cig ni skyod cig che bzhi ni dpang po/ ming po ni gcen nam phu bo/ nan tur ni chad pa/bye'u zul ni sa 'og tu thogs med du 'dzul ba/ 'og pag ni ska rags rgyan can/bzhams te bsgo ba ni gsang ste bsgo ba'am shub bus bsgo ba/ 'jud pa ni 'jug pa ste 'dzud pa'ang zer/ ngo so las byung ba sbyin pa ni bya dga' ster ba/ dge bsnyen chu rgyun can ni dge bsnyen dad pa rgyun brtan pa/ bka' blo mi bde ba ni/ nyes pa gleng du mi 'jug pa'am gleng mi bde ba/ rlung gis slags pa ni rlung gis bsdus pa'am ded pa/ 'tshal ma ni kha zas dang / rad pa'am nod pa ni/ gos kyi ming ngo / /spang ltung skabs ni/ khri brling ba ni/ khri yangs pa'am dbyibs legs pa/bam por sbres pa ni mnyam por bsdams pa/ kha dum pa ni kha 'cham zhing 'dus pa/'phrigs pa ni shes pa'am blos thigs pa/ bka' mchid 'tshal ba ni gsung gleng —457

bgyid pa/ mdun du bdar ba ni/ gus pa'i ched mdun sar mdzes par 'khod pa'am mdun nam sngon du 'gro ba/ dog sa ni sa gzhi/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed tshe thugs la gar dgongs srog chags grog sbur yan chad kyis shes la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thugs bskyed na sar gnas kyi 'phags pas kyang thugs dgongs mi shes pa yin gsung / mi bra ba ni mi phrod pa'am mi gtong ba/ zud nga ni gos sogs bkal ba'i thag pa'i gdangs bu/ brtad pa ni glo bur ba'am brel ba/mdun sa ni tshogs sa/ shing nga dpung bcad ni dge slong ma'i gos te/ dge slong ma la chos gos rnam gsum gyi steng du brang gi mdun phyogs gab pa'i ched du sheng nga dpung bcad dang rngul gza na te chos gos lnga dgos shing / phyi ma gnyis kyi tshad bla gos dang 'dra'o/ /tshur gsol zhes pa yi ge nor te/ tshul stsol te tshur gnang zhes pa'o/ /gos kyis cha ba la brtson pa ni gos bzang po'i phyir du brtson pa/ dra ba ni/ yo byad rnams sdud rgyu'i skud pa las byas pa'i dra khug go/ dkyus mo byed pa ni rgyug cing 'gro ba/drungs ma zos pa ni rtsa ba ma zos pa/ sa thams su chug pa ni sa dong du chug pa/ kim pa'i 'bras bu ni/ zhing thog phyi bzang la nang ngan pa dang por za ba'i tshe zhim pa ltar snang yang zas rjes nad bskyed nas sdug bsngal ba zhig yin gsung / skabs 'dir khum zhig ni sod cig ces pa'i skul tshig phyi 'phred ni phyi dro/ khur tsa bar 'gyur ni khur po 'khur du bcug go zhes pa'o/ /tron bya ba ni nan tan rjes su bsgrub par bya ba/gzhing bu ni gzhong pa chung du/ za ma tog ni sgam kha sbyar/ dor thung ni rkang gos sam rkang dkris kyi gos/ bh+ring ka ra ni 'dzin byed ces pa ste/ gser gyi spyi blugs kyi ming yin te/ mngon brjod nor bu'i phreng ba las/ bh+ring ka ra ni gser spyi blugs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dngar kha byas pa ni 'greng thabs su gral byas pa/ stabs ma snga ni brel rtabs ma snga'am ma rings/ bla mkhyen ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyi spyan no zhes 'byung bas/spyan ni spyan pa ste bya ra byed mkhan nam lta rtog pa'i ming ngo / /drod mi shes pa ni tshod mi shes pa/ gcam bu ni bcos ma gzugs can snying po'i snying tshoms pa mchis pa zhes pa ni/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i snying ltar gces par yod ces pa ste/ snying 458

tshoms ni/ bkrabs pa zhes 'byung bas mang po'i nang nas 'dams pa'i don no/ /mtshams chen po gcad do ni/ gnod pa chen po bya'o zhes pa'o/ /pañtsa la ni lnga len pa ste/ lnga len ni yul gyi ming ngo / /skabs 'di'i phan phun med pa sne chud zos su mi 'gro ba zhes pa'i don no/ /hral po ni 'chal ba'am 'dod zhen can/ 'god pa ci yod ni khyad par ram 'gal ba ci yod/ khye'u zhig rnyos shig ni bu chung zhig g.yor zhigartug pa ni phyi sa'am dri chen/ dkar po dang 'khob bal gyi khyad par ni/ glo dang rgyab dang gnya'i bal la dkar po dang / mgo dang rkang pa dang lto nas skyes pa la 'khob bal du mdo rtsa 'grel las bshad do/ /'khob pa ni ngan pa zhes pa'i brda rnying yin pas/bal ngan pa'am dman pa zhes pa'i don no/ /u dum wa ra ni/ bod du bsgyur na mchog 'phags dang / bdud 'joms dang / ltar ltar shing sogs su bsgyur zhing de khyad par ba ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon dus ma gtogs mi 'byung bar rtogs brjod brgya pa las gsungs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang ni mi 'bring tshad kyi khru phyed dang do yin/ 'phag pa ni 'gro ba dang / 'phags so ni song ngo zhes pa'o/ /khur tsa pa ni khur po pa/ ka ka ṇi ni bon ṭika zhes pa 'gron bu nyi shu'am de'i rin thang gi ming dang / ka ka ṇi bzhi la ma sha ka gcigaldang / ma sha ka lnga kur ṣa pa ṇa'i bzhi cha'i tshad du brtsi la/ 'on kyang yul dus kyi dbang gi brtsi tshul mtha' gcig tu ma nges par bshad do/ /gzhol lo'i skabs 'dir bcol lo zhes pa'i don dang / bstan pa la 'brums pa ltung bas zhes pa ni bstan pa cher ral cing ltung ba 'byin par byed pa zhes pa'i don no/ /mngon mtshan can ni dbyig dang gser dngul sogs kyi ming ngo / /kun dga' ra ba pa ni me tog dang shing thog gi ra sogs srung ba'i mi skya/ skabs 'di'i khrol bu ni sha dum dang 'tshogs pa ni sha g.yos pa la bya'o/ /bza' ba lnga dang rin po che lnga sogs ni/ 'bras chan zan dron snum khur dang / /sha dang nya sha bza' ba lnga/ /ci tse khre rgod rgya sran khre/ / bra bo bza' bar smos pa lnga/ /gser dngul be+eḍūr+ya ya dang shel/ /mu tig rnams ni rin chen lnga/ /zha nye zangs dang ro nye khro/ /lcags te rin chen smos pa lnga'o/ /ci tse ni ko dra ba zhes pa dang / ci tse dang tsi tsi mi gcig par bshad de/459

tsi tsi ni a ṇa zhes pa khre dang 'dra ba la de las rtsub cing chung ba 'bru dkar po can zhig yin par bshad/ rgya sran ni sran chung ril mo dkar nag ci rigs yod/ khre ni snye ma che la/ khre rgod ni de dang 'dra ba la snye ma chung zhing ser skya dang dmar smug ci rigs yod/ nu rdzi ni nying khu ste chang gi ming du'ang bshad/ gzong gis kyang khrag gis phyis bu len 'dod pa ni/ lcags gzong gis lus phug nas snod du khrag len 'dod ces pa ste/ gzong ni shing dang rdo sogs 'big byed kyi lcags kyi lag cha dang / phyis bu ni snod kyi ming ngo / /sla tsas ma gtal ba ni skyag pa ma shor ba'am skyag pas gang bar ma byas zhes pa'o/ /mi zad pa ni gser dngul pa ṇa sogs kyi ming dang / gta' nyi ri ni gte ma nyis 'gyur/ spogs pa ni khe 'dod pa/ skugs su 'jug pa ni rgyal du 'jog pa/ dos shig ni ded cig nos shig ni long zhig 'jong tshe ni khri'am cog tshe/mnos pa ni blangs pa/ dog pa ni skud pa/ thor to ni rtse mo dang 'dir gtsug phud/hwags kyi la thu ni/ bu ram gyi lbu ba gtso bor byas te zhim pa'i spod mang po btab pa'i zas mngar po zhig go/ hwags dang li kha ra'i khyad par ni/ bu ram gyi lbu ba'i phye ma rdog por ma byas pa la hwags dang / rdog por byas pa ni li kha ra ste/ sha kha ra dang ka ra zhes kyang bya'o/ /zhes mtsho ṭīka 'a sa gsung ngo / /la thu'am la du ni/ tshogs bdag gi rtog pa las/ la du zhes bya'i zhal zas ni/ /mngar gsum 'bras bu gsum dang ni/ /de bzhin zhim pa'i spod kyis bran/ /bag zan gyis ni ril bu bya/ /'o ma mar du bcos byas la/ /zhes bag phye dang ngos brgyad sogs sbyar ba'i kha zas khyad par can la bshad de/ mdo myang 'das las kyang de mthun gsungs so/ /bda' ba ni zhim pa/khrun ring ni dkyus ring / thar gyis zhag pa ni ngos 'jam shing 'jur mdun med pa/bang rim du skya rengs 'char bar byed ces pa'i bang rim ni/ gtsug lag khang gi khya mos kyi bang rim la bya'o/ /pu sa la'i 'dab ma ni 'u su'i 'dab ma yin par lung phran tshegs las gsungs shing / 'grel chung mkhan pos/ pu sa la'i 'dab ma zar ma'i 'dab ma yin par bshad do/ /'u su ni/ ldum ra bzang por skye zhing lo ma sdong bu metog rnams go stod dang 'dra ba la 'bras bu ga'u kha sbyar 'dra ba rigs dkar nag gnyis460

byid cing / nag po la shu ti zer zhing me tog ser po yin zhes sman gzhung las 'byung ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa'i skabs ni/ pib pa la ni chu ldan zhes pa ste/ 'di dang a shat+ta dang byang chub kyi shing ming gi rnam grangs so/ /ma tang ka nas byung ba zhes pa ni/ ma tang ka ni gdol pa'i rigs ri khrod pa ste de nas byung ba'o/ /bye brag rtog byed chen por mā tan ni gdol pa'am glang mo zhes byung ngo / /ru 'drel ni rwa thad kur brkyangs pa dang / khu yu ni rwa 'khyog ste/ rnam 'byed 'grel par/ ru 'drel zhes bya ba ni rwa thad gar 'dug pa'o/ /khu yu zhes bya ba ni yon rwa'o zhes gsungs so/ /bya myang ni rkang lag brkyangs te bya rmyang bya ba dang / glal ba ni kha gdangs te glal ba/phrag phrig ni rkang lag gis sa 'thor ba'o/ /skyo sngogs ni rtsod pa zhi ba slar slong ba/ se riring :bdar gyis bdar 'tshal ba ni/ sag bdar gyis bdar dgos pa ltar rtag par rtsub pos bskul dgos zhes pa'i don te/ se bdar ni lcags bdar nas ngo mnyam par byed pa'i sag bdar gyi ming ngo / /mi bsnyings pa ni mi 'jigs pa/ dku ni lto ba'am gsus pa'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad do/ /sgrun pa ni 'gran pa'i brda rnying yin/chu 'bog ni chu brga9lo ba/ chab ni chu'i zhe sa'i ming ngo / /ko bi dar ku'am kho/ bi dā ra ni bsgyur na sa rdol zhes pa ste/ lha'i ljon shing gi bye brag go/ gor shi sha ni ba lang mgo zhes pa ste/ tsan dan dkar po'i rnam grangs su bshad do/ /byi bo ni gzhan gyi bud med dang brkus nas 'grogs pa/ spyar ma ni nyes par spyod pa can yin no/ /zhes phran tshegs 'grel par gsung / ngur yang mi dbang ngam ni gnyid log ste ngu ba 'then pa'am mgrin pa bsal ba'ang mi dbang ngam zhes pa'o/ /bser ma ldang ba ni rlung dal bu lang ba/ gzhogs 'phyas ni zur gyis 'phya ba/ bsgo ba rna la gzon pa ni bslab bya la mi nyan par phyir zlog pa'am bskul tshig dang du mi len pa ste/ gzon pa ni mi nyan pa zhes brda rnying du bshad do/ /brubs pa ni bsdus pa'am do dam byed pa/sril ni skabs 'dir rtswa 'bu zhig la zer/ glongs te ni mgo mjug bzlog ste zhes pa'o/ /dang ra ni ra skor/ 'tham pa ni gcig gi sa gcig la 'khris pa/ lteng ka ni 461

char chu 'khyil ba/ sbyang 'dra ba ni 'bru blug pa'i bang ba 'dra ba/ mi spyoms pa ni gzhan la mi ngom pa'am bdag nyid mi sgrog pa/ bu zan mo'i bu zhes pa ni/ bu zan mo 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang srin mo la 'jug pas/ lam pa'i ma la dang por bu skyes tshad shi bas bu za mkhan mo zhes smad pa'o/ /rtsabs sam rtsabs mo ni 'bras dang khre sogs btsos nas rtsi med par bsnyal ba'i khu ba skyur po tsang shu zhes pa ste/ 'di la phab mi gtab ste phab btab na chang du 'gyur bas rab byung la mi rung ngo / /rdzi'u ni rdza'i phru ba'am khog ma/ sbrul khas bsdigs pa ni sbrul bzung ste gzhan la 'jigs pa skyed pa/pho sha'i khu ba ni sha'i dum bu dang bcas pa'i thug pa'i ming du bshad do/ /ri brags ni mtha' 'khob ri brag gi grong ba'o/ /ri'i krong zhes dul lhas gsungs/ rlung yor thogs pa ni/ gru mkhan gyi ming yin te/ rlung yor ni gru'i dar po che'o/ /baiḍūr+ya ni shin tu dngas pa zhes pa ste/ de la rigs gsum dang kha dog dkar ser sngo ljang sogs yod par bshad do/ /man shel ni me shel te/ mchog ni kha dog dkar zhing rang gi 'od las de ma thag me 'byung ngo / /byu ru ni/ rgyu dngos rdo yin yang skye lugs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi brag dang bye ma las shing ltar skyes pa ste/ rigs dkar nag dmar gsum yod/ dngul la sa dang rdo dang shing las byung ba gsum yod par bshad/ sa le sbram ni/ gser la dmar po dang ser po gnyis yod pa'i ser po la mchog dman gnyis kyi mchog la sa le sbram zhes bshad do/ /rdo'i rnying po ni/ chu nang gi rdo las skyes pa'i tshul du 'byung bas rdo'i snying po zhes bya zhing / mdog gnag pa la 'od zer dmar po 'byung ba dang / yang mdog dmar po bshad pa dang / 'ga' zhig tu margad la bshad pa'ang snang / spug ni/ chab rom lo stong lon pa na gong bur chags pa la rin po che spug ces bya la/ mdog ljang ser dang khra bo'ang yod par bshad/ dmar po ni pad+ma rā ga ste rigs dgu yod/ g.yas su 'khyil ba ni/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil te/skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par dung gi skye ba lnga blangs pa'i tshe tha ma g.yas 'khyil du 'byung bas na de la skye ba lnga pa'i dung zhes kyang bshad do/ /rin po che de dag la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang tsam snang ngo / /chu srin kum+bir ni/ chu srin sgrog byed ces pa ste/ 462

'di dang na kra ni chu srin chen po la bshad do/ /snar ma ni snying chung / sprog ma ni me tog sogs 'jog pa'i snod lhug ma/ las byas pa/ byug ris ni gral/ zil mngar gyis gcin pa ni sbrang rtsis sbrus pa'am sbags pa/ rta bres ni rta 'ashegs sa'i ra'o/ /pa ṭa ha ni rnga chung gi ming ste/ pags sgrog dang / sgrog can yang zer zhing / skabs 'dir dmag rnga'i ming ngo / /tshon gyis ma bcal ba ni tshon gyis kha ma bsgyur ba/ lhan cig 'thams pa ni mnyam du tshogs pa'am lag sbrel sogs byed pa/ ya mtshan can ni mu stegs pa'i rab byung spyi'i ming dang / dgu bcu rtsa drug ni ston pa drug po re re las bco lnga re gyes pas gyes gzhi ston pa drug bcas dgu bcu rtsa drug go/ sha na'i gos ni rtswa sha na zhes pa las byas pa'i gos so/ /dbyig gi gdangs can ni gser gyi snod ltar sgra mtho zhing zab pa dang ldan pa dang / klu'i ming can ni klu'i rgyal po 'od srung zhes pa dang ming mthun pa'o/ /thig thrig ni ko lham 'khregs po'i sgra'o/ /rtug khung ni phyi sa'i khung / lag gi bla dang lag dpon don 'dra'o/ /a mra'i 'khur ba ni shing thog a mra las byas pa'i bca' ba'o/ /mul lto pa dang mu to pa ni slong mo la/ 'gyed par mi 'dod ni/ rtsod par mi 'dod/ thab snod lta bu ni thab tu 'dzug pa'i sla nga lta bu'i lhung bzhed tshad las 'das shing che ba/ bu mo ma lo ma ni bu mo ma blang ngam brdzang ma nus/ gud du 'dug ni logs su 'dug pa/ ldam lhum ni rtsa ba'i bca' ba dang shing thog sogs kyi ming / 'di dag skyed pa dag gis skyes ma thag kha lan tshwas 'gengs ma nus pa zhes pa ni/ pha ma dag gis gal te 'di dag btsas ma thag tu khar lan tshwa brdzongs te bkang bar byas na mod la shi bas 'di 'dra mi yong ba la de ltar ma byas pa dang / brla brag tu khron pa bcug nas 'brang bar ma nus pa de dag gis ci thob ces pa ni/ gal te 'di dag brla phral te khron pa'i kha gtad nas rkang mgo nas drang ba'am drud par gyur na shi bas de ltar mi 'gyur ba la/ pha mas de ltar ma nus pas 'di dag bskyed pas ci thob ste dgos pa gang yang ma grub ces pa'i don du sems/ grong khyer gyi sgub mo dag ces pa la rnam 'byed 'grel par/ grong khyer gyi sgab mo can dag ces bya ba ni grong khyer gyi mi dag ste/ grong khyer dang grong rdal na de dag la sgab mo'i khyim yod 463

pa'i phyir no zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ sgab ni gos sgab ces pa'i sgab de yin pas khyim pa dag la sgab dgos sam skyong dgos kyi bud med yod pas na sgab mo can zhes bya'o/ /lag nya ni/ rang gar zas la lag reg pa/ mon sran gre'u dang mon sran sde'u ni/sran ma che chung yin par bshad cing / zha lu ni gsar du kha 'bus pa ste myu gu thon ma thag pa'i ming ngo / /ke ta ka ni dngas byed ces pa ste/ chu rnyog pa dngas par byed pa ste 'di la nor bu dang shing 'bras sogs ci rigs yod par bshad/ 'or la tshogs shig ni bor la chu tshags kyis btsag par gyis zhes pa'i skul tshig go/ bkad sa ni zas kyi g.yos khang ngam zas za ba'i khang pa/ rus skya'am ru skya ni chu la btsug nas gru skul ba'i shing ring po'o/ /mi ngas ni mi nad dam rims nad/ ma smad ni ma dang bu mo/ma bu la'ang zer/ gce'u ni du ba rngub pa'i sbu gu ring po/ shes pa can ni mu stegs gcer bu pa ste/ rtsis kyis shes pa yod pas de ltar btags/ nyod pa nyod dam ni zas zos sam zhes pa ste/ nyod pa kha zas kyi ming ngo / /yug sa mo ni khyo shi pa'i bud med/ ras yug glegs pa 'tshal ba ni ras dras nas dum bur byas te gyon pa/skabs 'dir khrom gyi ru sna ni g.yul 'byed pa'i ming / rton pa ni yid ches pa dang 'dod pa dang rjes su 'brang ba sogs la 'jug snam phyis ni sbyor lam ste zag pa dor ba'i khang pa/ dgra bcom pa'i sgo nga ni dgra bcom pa'i rgyu'am sa bon/ bru ba tsha ba ni ltogs pa/ bsnyil ba sdud pa ni gnas dbyung byas pa sdud pa/ ngam grog ni g.yang sa zab mo/ g.yar snga brim par bgyi ni gdong bstan par bgyi/ be'u ras ni ras bal las byas pa'i gos ngos gnyis shar sbus khebs pa zhig yin par phran tshegs 'grel par gsungs/ ka ra bī ra ni lag pa dpa' ba'am dpa' ba'i lag pa zhes pa ste/ bod kyi sho gu bzo rgyu ldam bu re lcag pa'i ming ste/ rgya gar du de'i me tog gsod pa'i mi'i mgrin par bcings pas na gsod rtags me tog zer ro/ /g.yas 'phong dang g.yon 'phong ni lag pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pas mda' 'phangs pa'o/ /shes re skan ni shes mi yong dam shes pa'i re ba ma byas/ rol mo'i dpong sa ni rol mo bslab pa'i gnas/drug ldan nas ke'u shi ga'i bar ni dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun zhes pa yin la/ dbyangs 164

de'i 'jug yu la mi 'dra bas 'jug byed kyi dbyangs kyang mi 'dra bar bshad do/ /skabs 'di'i rin po cher smos pa ni tshon cha dang rol mo'i cha byad do/ /sna ma'i me tog ni dzā ti'i me tog bskyud pa ni brjed pa/ sre mo'i rkyal bu di na ras rgeng ba ni/ ne'u le'i rkyal bu dong tses gang ba ste/ sre mo'am sre mong ni ne'u le'i bod skad dang / di na ra ni dong tse'i ming yin zer ro/ /'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs pa'i sku gzugs ni/byang chub sems dpa' lang tsho gsar ba'i skabs shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs pa'i sku gzugs kha spu ma skyes shing rab tu ma byung ba'i cha lugs can no/ /rgyan slob mar bzhag pa zhes pa'i slob ma ni/ spang leb bam lcug ma phra mo sogs las byas pa'i yo byad 'jog pa'i snod gru bzhi dang sgor mo sogs so/ /spral ris ni dpral ris te dpral par sor mos sa dkar gyi ri mo gsum byas pa dang / tshangs skud ni phrag pa gnyis kyi steng nas mchan khung g.yas g.yon du bsnol mar bcings pa'i srad bu'o/ /rna blags te ni rna ba gtad de zhes pa dang / ko ki la ni yid 'dzin nam khu byug ces bsgyur ro/ /rgya shug la bshad tshul mang yang re zhig sman gzhung ltar na/ shug pa la lha shug tsher shug rgya shug ces gsum bshad do/ / skad kyi gtang rag gis gzhung 'don pa ni/gdangs dbyangs snyan pos gzhung 'don pa/ brang btab pa ni sdod sa byas pa ste/brang ngam brang khang ni gnas khang ngam sdod sa'i ming ngo / /lhan cig kha spya zer ni lhan cig kha gshags 'debs pa dang ngag 'khyal smra ba/ nya tshar gyis bskor ni nya ltar phyi gan du brgal zhing bskor ba/ dbang bskur ba'i khrus ni bum pa sogs kyis spyi bo nas chu blugs te khrus bya ba dang / 'jug pa'i khrus ni chu nang du zhugs te khrus bya ba'o/ /dzi char ni rlung char 'dres pa ste/ rdzi ni rlung zhes pa'i brda rnying ngo / /gag tshil ni g.ya' sgog pa ste mchan khung du sor mos reg cing nyed pa'o/ /spyi brdol can ni ngo tsha mi shes pa/sna sbrang ni mde'u ste mda'i 'big byed kyi lcags/ skyes ni nor gyi rdzong ba/ dngangs par byed pa ni glo bur du skrag par byed pa'i ming ste/ 'di la dngangs pa dang /snga ngas pa zhes gnyis 'byung ba'i dang po ni byed pa'i tshig da lta ba dang / phyi ma ni bya ba'i tshig 'das pa'o/ /'di'i la ba ni snam bu spu can te/ rgya cher 'grel pa las/165

la ba zhes bya ba ni bal las byas pa'i gos sru dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /te por gtal ba ni shin tu'am rab tu brdeg pa'am brdung ba/ thags zangs ni snam bu thags pa'i shing yin snyam/ rnang sgang bcur ni zhing tshigs bcos pa ste/ rnang ni zhing zhes pa'i brda rnying ngo / /phyag tshang ni thab ga pa'am za ma bcos mkhan/ khu sha ni brda rnying ste sha khu/ khur bslang ngo ni skabs 'dir ngag gi nyes pa gsog go zhes pa'i don du gsung / nyan rna ni 'jab ste lkog nas nyan pa/ phru rtog btsugs ni thab btsugs pa/ che zhe dang lcam mo dang sring mo rnams nu mo'i ming dang / dral po dang ming po phu bo'i ming ngo / /glo bas bas par mi 'gyur ni khrel bar mi 'gyur zhes pa'i don no/ /pham phabs ni zas lhag 'khu ba ni zhe sdang ba/ bya mo lab ni mchod pa'i rdzas sam dga' ba'i sbyin pa/ rtsang nan ni ba tung ba/ re lde ni rtsid pa las byas pa'i snam bu dang smyug ma'i lhas ma la'ang zer/ 'bru'i chang ni/ nas 'bru sogs btsos nas phab btab ste mnan pa'i zas kyi tshang ste sbyar ba'i chang zhes kyang zer/ bcos pa'i chang ni phab med par mnan pa'i rgun chang dang / bu ram gyi chang dang / me tog gi chang la sogs pa rdzas kyi chang ste/ gnyis ka yang myos 'gyur gyi btung ba'o/ /chab stsal na ni gnod pa bgyis na zhes pa'o/ /'di'i skabs kyi phan phun ni 'khrug long /khri mon ni btson ra/ snog bran ni snum du btsos pa'i 'khur ba/ kham phor ni rdza phor zhes mngon brjod mang por 'byung ngo / /yog pa ni khebs pa/ rims dang khyed par 'gyur ro ni brims dang 'dang bar 'gyur ro/ /bkas rma bar ci gnang ni bka' dris gnang zhes pa'o/ /rnga bran ni ba lang gzhon nu/ tre ma bu ka ni dbyar dus mi zog la so btab nas khrag 'jib pa'i srog chags chung ngu de dang / tre la ta ka ni de 'dra'i sbrang bu che tsam pa de yin nam snyam ste/ gzhi 'grel las/ tre ma bu ka zhes bya ba ni srog chags kyi bye brag phra mo zhig go/ tre la ta zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rigs chen po'o zhes dang / rnam 'byed 'grel par yang de dang mthun par byung ngo / /che bzhi ni dpang po/chud 'dza' ba'i mtshan ma ni 'chi ltas/ stes dbang ni stobs shugs sam stabs rkalegs/ dong pa dang / gang ba can dang / sag thag dang / stag ral rnams 466

mda' shubs kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /ral pa sa la bslags pa ni ral pa sa la bting ba'am spungs pa/ sing ga la ni seng ge 'dzin zhes pa ste/ ded dpon zhig gi ming ngo / /shal ma li ni shing tsha tsha zer ba tsher ma chen po can zhig tu bshad do/ /gro ba ni 'dir gro ka ste/ shing stag pa'i bar shun yi ge 'bri chog pa de yin/ shing bal ni ras bal la'ang bshad do/ /lung bong dang ban lang ni ba lang gi brda rnying ngo / /lus ma rnyis pa ni lus zungs ma nyams pa'am mdangs ma shor ba/ ma bzlugs pa ni ma zhus pa'am ma dris pa/ gdod shes ni da lta rang shes/ khab ral ni khab snod/ mchil ba ni lcags kyu/ bzang mkhan ni gos bzo ba'o/ /sor bshags kyi skabs ni/ ut+pa la'i ze 'bru'i mdog 'dra ba ni/ kha cig ser po zer/ 'ga' zhig mig sman sngon po'i mdog 'dra'o zer ro/ /shed mthun 'i /yid mthun te/ mdza' bo'am gnyen phyogs kyi ming / sa 'dzin ma ni chung ma gnyis pa/ skyo ma grang mo mi 'thung ni skabs 'dir nang mthun pa mi yong zhes pa'i don/sgros ni rma shul/ phyi mo ni ma/'i ma/ ste a phyi yang zer/ chen chun ni chung ma che chung /glas pa ni sdod sa spos pa/ rma 'byed pa ni mo mtshan gdangs pa/ khud par byas pa ni thun mong ba bdag nyid gcig pus dbang du byas pa/ skud po ni chung ma'i spun zla/ga gon ni nyung ma zhes pa la phug gi rigs so/ /thibs po ni nags tshang tshing 'thug po/zla ba'i rgyab sus mthong ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab sus mthon ste mdun gyi cha mthong bas dga' ba ltar/ gang phrad pa 'di dga' bas blang gi phyis cir 'gyur mi dpyod ces pa'i don no/ /chu thag ni shing rta'i gnya' shing sbrel ba'i 'breng thag go/nyes byas kyi skabs su/ skyon med pa la bkod pa ni/ mthong lam la bkod pa ste/ mthong lam thob na ngan song dang rigs mthun gyi srid pa brgyad pa len pa sogs kyi skyon zad pa'i phyir ro/ /sham thabs yon tan bdun ldan du gyon pa ni gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyi khyon tshul yin par gsungs so/ /rgyan po la ni cho lo mkhan yang zer te sho rtse mkhan/ sha za ni yi dwags kyi bye brag ste sha khrag za ba nag po chen po la sogs pa dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za ni phyag dar khrod kyi 'dre'am tshub ma'i nang gi 'dre'o zhes 467

rnam 'byed 'grel par gsungs/ shes rab byed pa las/ sha za ni mi la kyal ka byed pa den po'am the'u rang lta bu'o zhes dang / gzhi 'grel las/ yi dwags zhes bya ba ni rkang pa phyir lta ba ltogs pa rnams so/ /sha za zhes bya ba ni yi dwags kyi bye brag ste/ sha khrag za ba nag po chen po la sogs pa'o zhes bshad do/ /'dom pa ni thug pa'am phrad pa/rib ma/ ni shing rdo sogs kyis gyang gi tshul du bskor ba/ gtsangs pa ni rtsangs pa zhes pa srog chags rmigs pu che ba de yin nam snyam/ gor ma chag ni the tshom med pa'am thag bcad pa/ skyu rum ni tshod ma/ mkhur ba nas mkhur bar spo ba ni 'gram pa'i nang g.yas g.yon du spo ba/ lhung bzed bskyams pa ni lhung bzed du chu blugs te bskor nas bshal ba/ ba kru sman ni bshal sman/ ldum pa ni tshod ma mkhan no/ /gzhi smad las gso sbyong sogs kyi skabs ni/ seg ma ni/ skabs 'dir smyug ma sogs kyi thags ma'am lhas ma gru bzhi dang / re lde ni de dkyus ring ba la bshad do/ /gzhi 'grel las/ ma tu lung ga zhes bya ba ni lung ngo / /zhes 'byung zhing / 'di la ba lung kha lung ngam/ pha la snu raḥste/ 'bras bus gang ba dang / bī dza snu raḥste/gang ba'i sa bon zhes kyang 'byung bas bī dza pū raḥni se 'bru yin par 'ga' zhig tu bshad cing / gang ltar na'ang sa bon nam 'bras bus / gang ba zhig tu mngon pas slar dpyad/ arka ni/ shing ni sba'am// nyi ma'i shing zhes kyang bshad pas de'i bal dang / yang arka ni lcam pa ma ning dang / ras bal dang / spra ba la bshad pa la'ang 'dug ste/ arka dang aṅgā la khyad par yod dam dpyad/ spar thar snum par gyur pa ni 'chags sar thags ma khra bo'i stan bting ba rkang pa la bskus pa'i snam gyis snum can du byas pa'i don te/ spar thang ngam par thang ni thags ma'i stan ring khra bo'o/ /yo na bshad pa ni sbyin pa'i phan yon bshad cing dge ba bsngo ba/ mtshams kyi sgo nang ni mtshams bu chung dang / slad rol ni de'i phyi rol gyi mtshams po che stebaskyung ba dang bskyed pa ni las gcig gis de gnyis ka dus gcig tu bcad rung zhesapa'i don no/ /mtshams bskum pa ni mtshams bcad pa/ nya las sug nya cung zadabagyis pa ni/ nya sha las ma sbyin par cung zad blangs pa/ btsogs pa ni brdungs pa 468

gsing ma ni spang sa/ ri 'or ni ri brag dang ra ni ra ba/ dgon dung ni 'dir ba tshwa can/ 'thab krol ni 'thab rtsod slong ba/ ma la kye khye ma/ khu 'phrig za ba ni dogs pa za ba'am rnam rtog byas pa/ khyim phub pa ni bag ma blangs pa/ dril cong ni dril bu'i khog pa lta bu'i cong / nod rod po ni rtab rtab po/ khu gu ni khu bo ste pha'i spun/ gzem pa ni 'dzem pa zhes ngag sgron gyi mchan du 'byung ngo / /bkris shig ni khrid de shog ces pa'o/ /g.yar tsha ni ngo tsha/ phrum tshud ni 'o ma dang dar ba bskol ba'i snyigs ma'o/ /gos gzhi'i skabs ni/ bal glang mo ni glang mo/ be snabs ni be'u 'byung ltas gcin snabs lud lta bu 'dres pa/ gzu lums ni rang bzo/ gteng pa bzung zhes pa'i gteng pa ni gta' ma dang gte ma dang gte'u zhes kyang bya la/ gzhan las nor blangs pa'i tshab tu bzhag pa'i rdzas kyi ming yin pas/ yul lugs kyi bu dang bu mo gte mar gzung ba'i chad pa byas pa'o/ /'tsho ba pa ni mu stegs gcer bu pa'i ming yin srog bdag tu smra bas de skad zer ro/ /seng ras ni ras phra mo shin tu lhod pa sha rjen ji bzhin g.yogs mi thub pa/ klam ni la ba 'thug po/ sa lu la 'jam byas zhes pa'i 'jam ni thug pa'i ming yin/ glang po che'i bla ni glang po che'i lta rtog pa/ gzeb ni lhug ma las byas pa'i sgro ma kha sbyar/ tshan po che chen po'i stobs ni skabs 'dir glang chen phal ba bcu'i stobs ni/ spos kyi glang po che gcig gi stobs dang / spos glang bcu'i stobs ni/ tshabs po che'i stobs kyi tshad du phran tshegs 'grel par gsungs so/ /mdzar ba ni gyes kyi rgyags/ mon dar ni rtswa'i rigs kyi shun pa las byas pa'i gos shig dang / srin bal ni srin bu'i rigs kyi srog chags las byung ba'i bal yin/ra char ni ra phyar zhes 'byung ste ra bal las byas pa'i snam bu'i rigs/ ral kha ni/dge slong ma'i shing nga dpung chad las rnam pa cung mi 'dra ba'i stod gos so/ /cha ga ne gos kyi mtha' mi zeg pa'am mi zad pa'i ched sor gnyis kyi tshad kyi ras mas glan pa la cha ga btab pa zer te/ mtha'i lcags ri zheng chung ngu'i ming ngo / /dus kyi zhags pas bcings pa ni 'chi ltas kyis 'gugs pa/ gzhu mchog ni gzhu'i sne mo'am rtse mo/469

tseg tseg pa por langs nas sud de shi ba ni kha zas brtsegs brtsegs pa lto sbos nas ma zhu ste shi ba/ yid gcugs pa ni shin tu mdza' ba/ dos shig ni ded par gyis shig ces pa'i skul tshig rngam pa su su ni rings stabs sam dbugs 'tshang 'tshang / zho can ni snum can nam tshi can zhes pa ste/ 'di'i zho ni sra rtsi dang thang chu lta bu la bya'o/ /glam gyis khyer ni rlam zhes kyang 'byung bas/ dbyar dus snod spyad sogs rlan che sar bzhag na steng du spu lta bu zhig chags pa'i ming / bsugs pas ma 'khus ni chur btsir ba'am bshal bas ma gos/ bla skyes ni gla skyes te sho gam dang gru gla sogs kyi nor gyi ming ngo / /'o bze ni 'gro 'dug yang zhing sgrin po/ dan grogs ni stongs grogs te phan grogs/ kha gdag go ni gsad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /dus kyis bcus pa ni dbang gis bcus pa ste dbang du bsdus pa'i don/ ma lom ni ma 'dang ba/sbrebs pa ni khyas/sa pa'am grang ba/ ma smyungs tsam ni ma ltogs tsam/ ka di da ni kha di ra ste seng ldeng / pun ḍa ri ka ni pad+ma dkar po'i ming / kha zas bsnyems nga/ ni kha zas khebs pa/ 'byor tshogs ni sam pra pa ta zhes pa bsgyur na/ 'byor tshogs sam mnyam par gyur cig ces pa ste/ mnyam pa ni dug med pa'i don no/ /ko nga gas kyi gzhi skabs/ nye zho med pa ni bde ba dang / legs pa dang skyon med pa dang / bkra shis pa sogs la 'jug go/ khyi sre bo ni khyi ser smug kāt+yaya na ni ka t+ya'i bu zhes pa ste/ drang srong ka t+ya zhes bya ba'i rus sam rigs rgyud 'a /bu brgyud kyi rkyen ā ya na ḍā byin pas/ kā t+ya ya na ste ka t+ya'i bu zhes nga/'o/ /byi bo byedapa ni mtshan mo gzhan gyi bud med dang gsang ste 'grogs pa/ de las skyes pa'i bu 'anal bu zer ro/ /mchis lham thi gi ni mchil lham cung zhig gsogs su bcings pa niras kyis btums pa/ kha chu chus phyung ni bol gyi sne mor spubs sam bu gu yod pa'i lham/ rtswa mun dza ni dres ma'am skyer ma'o/ /sman gzhi'i skabs ni/ tso tsa ni shing thog ku shu ste/ ston dus smin pa'i shingathog dmar po dri zhim pa rgya nag skad bahā' chin zer ba de yin par bshad/ 'bru: chang las tshwar gyur pa ni/ 'bru'i chang bskol te skyur por bcos pa'o/ /snag tshog sbyo470

sha dum bur btsos pa yin nam dpyad/ skabs 'di'i bstod ni nor ram blu rin/bka' khyod mi rma ba ni bka' bkyon mi 'beb pa'am gyod mi byed rtas/ dan gong ni 'jim pa'i ri lu skam po 'phen du rung ba/ gnya' bo ni dpang po dang / che bzhi ni bden dpang zhes brda rnying las 'byung ngo / /'ur pa ni/ rnam 'byed 'grel pa las/'ur pa zhes bya ba ni bya la pa ka yin no zhes 'byung la/ de yang lus cung chung pa phal cher zhing gi nang na 'dug pa'i bya zhig la brta ka dang / de las chung ba ni bya la pa ka yin no/ /zhes phran tshegs 'grel par gsung / lham bu chu bsher ni/ srin 'bu zhig gi ming ngo / /skad sa ni skad tsa dang slad tsha zhes kyang 'byung ste skyag pa'i ming ngo gtsang sbyor ni/ phran tshegs 'grel par/ gtsang sbyor ba ni zas kyi zhal ta pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dam bzhag pa ni gnyer pa'i ming yin nam slar dpyad/ phru ba ni za ma btso ba'i zang nga / kha gzar ni skyog thum/ phul ba'i btung phor ni zas mgul du thogs pa phul ba'i btung ba 'thung ba'i phor ba/ khrag dron po zhes pa ni/ snying ga'i phyogs su gnas pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i khrag go/ phyi myug ma ni phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i sprang mo/ 'ching phor ni rdza'am rdo rigs las byas pa'i por ba yin nam snyam/ srin bu pad ma'am pad pa ni/ chu nang gi 'bu mi'i nad khrag 'jib cing zungs khrag 'jib mi 'dod pa'i 'bu zhig tu bshad do/ /rgyal mo ga gon ni nyung ma che legs shig go/las gzhi man chad ni/ snyi ba ni sra snyi zhes pa'i snyi ba'o/ /tshwa sgo ni ba tshwa/ ba grus ma'am ba drus ma ni/ bzho ma ste be'u 'brangs pa'i ba lang mo'o/ /com chung ba ni sgra skad chung ba/ bcos pa ni 'dir spyos pa ste gshe ba/ sprid pa byung ba'i tshe/ snying ga'i rtsa kha phye bas bar chad 'jug nyen yod pas/ sos par gyur cig dang / nad med par gyur cig sogs brjod par bshad do/ /mdangs 'phrog pa zhes pa ni/ snying ga'i phyogs na gnas pa srog 'dzin par byed pa'i rdzas kyi bye brag cig la mdangs zhes bya la/ de 'phrogs na tshe ring du mi gnas so/ /gtsang ni shing thags kyi ra ba ste/ shing phra sbom ran pa 'dom do ba sogs mang po phred bsgrigs su bskor ba'o/ /gzhi spyil ba ni/sa gzhi zhal zhal legs par byas pa/ zhugs ling ni/ me 'jog pa'i gyo mo sogs kyi 471

snod/ dril bsgrags pa ni/ dril bu dkrol bzhin par sgrog par byed pas na de ltar brjod par phran tshegs 'grel par bshad/ gzhong khung ni gzhong ba/ rmang tsher ni/sna spu bdog spyad/ mchig dang mchi gu ni/ yos 'thag pa'i lag skor gyi 'og gi rdo leb la mchig dang / steng rdo la mchig gu zer ro/ /'bru mar gyi 'brag ni/ snum blug pa'i rdza snod chen po'i ming ngo / /na me ru ka ni/ ldum bu dri ma can zhig go/ a ri sta ni/ a riṣ+ṭha yang zer te/ shing nim pa'i ming du bshad do/ /snang g.yol ni/phyi rol thams cad mthong ba'i skar khung sogs kyi ming dang / sang kug k+ṣi ni/ rdul gzan/ rtsa khab ni/ gtar kha byed pa'i khab/ rams phyis ni/ snag bum/klan ka btsal ba ni/ skabs btsal ba'am snyad ka btsal ba/ bya dgu la phyi lang byed pa ni/ byas tshad la skyon du bzung ba/ tshig bla dwags ni/ btags ming / yus kyi ni/ bden gyi zhes pa dang / rtas pa ni/ dar ba'am rgyas pa'i ming ngo / /smras pa/ ming dang brda rnams yul dus kyis/ /'gyur zhing brjod 'dod rjes 'brang phyir/ /gcig tu nges pa ma yin mod/ /'dir ni skabs don dang bstun te/ /brda rnying la sogs go dka' ba/ /rags rim nyung ngu'i tshul gyis bkral/ /nor 'khrul gang mchis mkhas la 'chags/ /legs cha blo ldan dgyes phyir dbul/ /'di ni rab 'byams gzhung smra ba'i/ /bshes gnyen shes rab mtshan can gyis/ /bskul phyir la dbyangs can dga' blos bris/ / skal mnyam dag la phan gyur cig/ / sarba mja lam̐/dza yachu/ / 472

༄7/ /bslab bya'i skor bzhugs so/ / cha na ma ཿshrī mā na ru bh+yaḥbla ma yi dam dkon ma/chog gsum / /mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs bcas la/ / byang chub bar du skya bas su mchi/ / bral med rjes su gzung du gsol/ /blo gsal skal bzang thar 'dod rnams/ /'khrul med dam pa'i lam bzang la/ /nye bar bkri phyir bsla ba tshig gi/ lha yi rnga chen dal bur bsgrag/ sngon bsags legs byas bye ba'i ma thus/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten/ /lan cig tsam/ zhig thob dus 'dir/ /nyin mtshan dal med snying po longs/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i bshes gnyen gyi /zhabs zung spyi bor blangs nas ni/ / bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten/ / yon tan kun gyi gzhi rtsa yin/ /blang dor gnas la 'thoms pa'i mun/ /thos pa'i sgro na mes ma bas la na/ /dmu sa long byes bu 'khyams pa ltar/ /ci bya gtol med ngang du 'dzad/ /de phyir thog mar gzhung chen la/ /slob gnyer phu thag chod pa gces/ / bsdus sbyor chung 'bring che gsum la/ /sbyangs pas rig pa'i sgo chen 'byed/ /de nas rgyan 'jug mdzod rtsa dang / /'dul ba mdo sogs rtsa 'grer la/ /blor 'dzin skyor sbyang rtsod gleng sogs/ /chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsten pa gces/ / thal phreng rigs pa'i 'gros bzang dang / /spyi don dag gis khog 'bub cing / /mkhas pa dag la 'dri gtugs kyis/ /gzhung chen dka' gnad 'tshol ba gces/ /de tshe thad ku'i gzhung tshan gyi/ /rtsa 'grel spyi don thal phreng sogs/ /legs par sbyar te tshig dang don/ /'khrul med dgongs don rnyed pa gces/ /thal phreng tsam gyis chog shes dang / /gzhung tshig mi 'dzin dpe klog rem/ /gzhan ma/go bskor ba'i zol sbyor sogs/ /don chung mi tshe skyel ba'i rgyu/ /gzhan yang rnyed bkur snyan grags dang / /khe 'dod bsam pa'i thos bsam sogs/ /btsan dug bsres pa'i zhim lto ltar/ /thar ba'i srog rtsa gcod byed yin/ / bag med le los dus 'da' zhing / / chos grwar mi 'grim lto gdung can/ /473

'grogs 'dris mang 'ing long gtam sogs/ /gdug pa'i sbrul bzhin spong ba gces/ /ngo tshe 'khrel gzhung chung ba dang / /don med bya byed rtsed 'jo sogs/ /gnas skabs phan pa ltar brdzu ba'i/ /grogs ngan ring du spong ba gces/ /bzhin 'dzum gcam bu ngo bstod byed/ /gsar 'grogs che zhing phyi thag thung / /cung zad tsam la'ang 'gyur ldo ga ston/ /srang mda' lta bu'i grogs de spong / /ngo tsha khrel yod gos kyis mdzes/ /tshul ldan thos pa'i nor gyis phyug/ khengs dreg mi mang 'phan sems can/ /de 'dra'i grogs bzang rgyun du bsten/ /thub pa'i rjes 'jug rab byung gi/ bya ba klog pa thos bsam dang / /spong ba bsam gtan gnyis gsungs phyir/ /don nyung bya ba nyung ba gces/ /'di snang bya ba rgyang bsrings shing / / bza' btung rnyed dang 'du 'dzi sogs/ /nyin mtshan yid la mi byed par/ /dka' spyad sdug rus bsten pa gces/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ /mkhas par slob pa'i dus na sdug/ bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /ces dang dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ /bde ba 'dod na rig pa dor/ /rig pa 'dod na bde ba dor/ /bde ldan rig pa ga la 'grub/ /rig pa don gnyer ga la bde/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang gso thigs las/ / yon tan dag la 'bad bya yi/ /'gying tshul dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /ba ni 'o ma med pa la /dril bu btags kyang nyo mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs don rnams sems pa gces/ /rang rgyud snod rung zhing sa ru/ /yon tan myu gu skye ba yang / /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong chu lud la/ /ltos phyir tshul der 'bad pa gces/ /khas blangs dam sdom srog dang bsdos/ /bla ma lha dang rang sems gsum/ /dbyer med sgom bzlas mchod bstod dang / /thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs gces/ /thos bsam phyogs rer ma lhung zhing / / gzhung chen gdams par shar ba dang / /gang shes rgyud la sbyor mkhas pa/ /mi de bstan 'gro'i dpal du mdzes/ /yon tan nang bar 'chi yang slob/ /phyi mar nor bcol len dang 'dra/ /de phyir rgas shing khogs dus su'ang / /thos pa bsag par bya ba gces/ /phyi mar thos pas phan pa tsam/ /dge sogs gzhan gyis ga la phan/ /sa gsum brnyes pa'i byang 'phags kyang / /thos pas ngom sa pa med par gsung / /thos mang tshe 'dir g.yeng ṭ+wāṃ 74

ba dang / /thos bral mos sgom tsam byed dang / /phal cher zang zing nor tsam la/ /snying por rlom rnams shin tu 'khrul/ /thos pas blang dor legs phye nas/ /bsam pas nges pa rnam dag btsal/ /yang yang yid la goms 'dris kyis/ /nyes pa'i dug sdong rtsad nas 'byin/ / thos don snying por 'dril byas te/ /nyams su blang bya'i man ngag mchog/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i gshegs bshul lam/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /gang gi mtshan tsam mjal dka' ba/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /bag chags ci thebs 'jog pa gces/ /mnyam med ri bo dge lugs pa'i/ /dpal ldan rgyud grwar legs zhugs nas/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi tshig don la/ /mkhas par slob pa shin tu gces/ /cho ga'i ngag 'don byang ba dang / /thig tshon bkye dang mthong rgyud sogs/ /phyag srol tsam gyis chog shes shing / /mkhas par rlom pa byis pa'i blo/ /de ltar gdams pa'i gter gyur tshe/ /phyi nang g.yeng ba kun dor te/ /cha tshang mdo sngags 'a/ma rim la/ /tshig sgril byed pa mkhas pa'i phul / /mdor na 'khor 'das skyon yon kun/ /rang sems 'di 'a rag las phyir/ /spyod lam kun tu dran shes kyis/ /rang rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs la 'bungs/ /phan par smra ba shin tu dkon/ /de las nyan nga byu ches dkon phyir/ /tshul 'di dgos nus chung mod kyi/ /blo ldan 'ga' la phan phyir bris/ /dge bas blo gsal don gnyer rnams/ /sde sno da gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir/ /ma nor thos bsam sgom pa yis/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang myur thob shog/ ces bslab bya lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba 'di yang / blo gsal don gnyer can rnam sa la phan sems kyi kun nas blangs te snyoms las pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis dam pa'i gsung bzhin bsdebs pa dza yachu/ /bslu med bla ma mchog gsum la/ / sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / kwa ye gson dang blo ldan dag/ dam pa'i lha chos byed 'dod na/ /dang por thos pa gal che bas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa legs bsten nas/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis gzhung chen la/ /phu thag chod pa'i slob gnyer gces/ /chos grwar mi 'grim rtsod gleng dor/ /dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang mi nus shing / /gnyid dang lto la chags pa rnams/ /slob gnyer gegs kyi gtso bo yin/ /phyi shol le los dus 'da' zhing / /bag med 'du 'dzi'i gtam la 475

g.yeng / /grogs ngan rtsed 'jo la dga' ba/ /'go nad bzhin du ring du spang / /khas blangs dam sdom gtsang ba'i ngos/ / grags snyan bde 'dod ring dor te/ /lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /bsam rgyu chos las med pa 'tshal/ /de yang dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ /bde ba 'dod na rig pa 'dor/ /rig pa 'dod na bde ba 'dor/ /bde ldan rig pa ga la 'grub/ /rig pa don gnyer ga la bde/ /zhes dang 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ /mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug/ bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ / ces gsungs don la yang yang soms/ /rigs pa'i sgo 'byed bsdus sbyor dang / /tshad ma'i 'gag sdom blo rtags la/ /sbyangs pas rigs pa'i blo mig phye/ /ma/do sde kun gyi rab dang phul/ /yum mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi/ /sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ /de la bslab cing mkhas gyur na/ /zab cing rgya che gzhung kun gyi/ /don la nges pa mchog ster 'gyur/ /'ar byung byams chos gzhan rnams la 'ang /legs par sbyangs shing nan tan bya/ /chos rnams kun gyi gdod ma'i gshes/ /zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba'i gzhung / /rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum la sogs dang / /rang dang spyi yi mtshan nyid sogs/ /ston pa'i mngon pa gong 'og dang / /lung rtogs yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa ston pa yi/ /'dul ba'i mdo rtsa 'grel bcas dang / /rang gzhan log rtog the tshom sogs/ /rigs pa'i lam nas 'gog byed pa'i/ /mdo dang sde bdun la sogs pa'i/ /tshad ma'i gzhung la zhib tu sbya ngas/ /de ltar dka' chen gzhung rnams la/ /bslab pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'thob/ /thos don rgyud la sbyor ba yis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub/ /de bas dang por thos mang btsal/ /thos don 'phral du rgyud la sbyo ra/ /de las lhag pa'i bslab bya dang / /man ngag btsal na nor ba yin/ /e ma bstan la zhugs gyur kyang / /dka' spyad sdug sgur ma nus par/ /bde 'dod rang nyid 'phung ba ma/nga / /chos phyir dka' ba spyad par 'tshal/ /'di bris dge bas bdag gzhan kun/ /'di snang zhen pas ma 'ching bar/ /thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin te/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni dad brtson chos la 'dun pa u cu mun chen dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis kyis ya nga yang bskul ngor/ snyoms la sa pa dbyangs can dga' 476

ba'i blo gros kyis bris pa'o/ /sarba mgi lam̐/ /pha drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kye gson dang rnam dpyod ldan pa dag/khyed tshe 'di'i bde la ma chags par/ /bde 'dod na dam pa'i lha 6sa mdzod/ /rten dal 'byor yid bzhin nor las dkon/ /'jig sla ba chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /dgra 'chi bdag gshin rje'i bsu ma de/ /dus de ring mi 'ong gdeng tshad med/ /don de phyir da lta nas bzung ste/ /dus gtan gyi skyed mgo tshugs na legs/ /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i bde 'byor la/ /sngar ma myong bya ba cung zad med/ /da soms shig snying bo ci zhig 'dug/ lang spyad cing zhen chags je cher 'phel/ /dbyar tsha bas gdung nas skom pa'i mi/ /dpe lan tshwa'i chu la btung ba bzhin/ /sngon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /rang bde 'dod chos las phyir phyogs te/ /blo rmongs pas sdug bsngal rgyu la rngams/ /sdug yod dgu myong yang sun dus med/ /rang gces 'dzin gdon gyis brlams gyur te/ /sbyang bye leb mar me'i 'od la bzhin/ /yi da skyid 'dod rgyu yis kun tu phung / /a tsa ma rang la snying rjer ltos/ /chos dge las bde ba kho na dang / /rgyu chos min sdig las sdug bsngal 'byung / /las dge sdig 'bras bu mi 'chol phyir/ /bde 'dod na dam chos kho na mdzod/ /srog mi brtan rlungasdu nang mar me bzhin/ /nor longs spyod kisba'i 'bras bu dang / /gnyen mdza' bshes tshong 'dus mgron dang mtshungs/ /don de phyir gang la'ang chags rin med/ /da snying nas lha chos byed 'dod na/ /dus thog mar dgra zun shan 'byed dgos/ /tshe 'di snang phun tshogs don gnyer ba'i/ /blo 'di las bar chad che ba med/ /'di dgra yi gtso bor ma/ bltas na/ /chos gang byas lam du 'gro mi srid/ /don de phyir dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / /tshe long med bsams pas dgra de gzhom/ /gnas 'jigs rung ngan song sdug bsngal che/ /lan yang yang dran pas rgyud bskul te/ / skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad nas/ /las rgyu 'bras 'dor len tshul bzhin bya/ /gnas 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi/ mtshang ngan pa'i nyis dmigs kun bsam/sa te/ /rgyud nges 'byung drag pos rab bskul nas/ /sems thar pa'i lam du kha 'o bsgyur/ /phyi thos pas sgro 'dogs legs bcad nas/ /nang bslab gsum them skas 477

rab 'dzegs te/ /mchog nges legs dam pa'i khang bzang du/ /dus ring min bgrod pa mdun ma'i rtse/ /ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa'i tshul bsams nas/ /byams snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed de/ / don phan bde 'ba' zhig snying dbus bcang / /gzhi 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /'dang rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /phar rtog pas btags pa tsam du zad/ /don bden par 'dzin pa tsam ste zhog/ sngon thog ma med nas snying dbus su/ /rang gces 'dzin gdon 'di tshang bcas nas/ /thabs sna dgus rang don bsgrubs bsgrubs kyang / /dus da snga rdul phran tsam ma grub/ /da phung byed 'gong po'i mtshang brdol te/ /ma 'gro kun gces par 'dzin pa'i blos/ /dus 'phral yun kun tu gzhan phan gyi/ /sems bzang po'i yid dam cis mi byed/ /gzhi mngon mtho'i rtsa ba tshul khrims te/ /lam thar pa'i srog shing shes rab dang / /mchog kun mkhyen sa bon byang chub sems/ /'di nyams len mthil du gzung bar 'tshal/ /dge 'dis mtshon rnam dkar ji snyed pas/ /ma 'gro kun 'jigs rung srid ma tsho las/ /lam thabs shes zung 'brel gru rdzings kyis/ /mchog sku gsum gling du phyin gyur cig/ ces pa 'di yang chos gzugs snyoms las pa dbyangs can dka' ba'i blo gros kyis skyo tshig tu smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru mdzi sgo tshe ya/ rje blo bzang rgyal ba'i ye shes gar/ /chos mdo sngags bstan pa rab rgyas phyir/ /deng gsurme ldarno mkhan po'i tshur ston pa/ /pha khyed kyi zhabs zu/ snyi/ naXs draXn/ /ma/gon drin can khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /dus da res dal 'byor rten bzang brnyes/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan dang mjal/ /chos zab rgyas gdams pa'i skal bzang thob/ /da mnog chung 'di snang bya ba la/ /yid chags shing zhen pa rgyang bsrings te/ /dus gtan du phan nges dam chos la/ /yid rtse gcig bsgril ba mdun ma'i rtse/ /che mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /gnyen nye du tshong 'dus mgon dang mtshungs/ /nor longs spyod rtswa rtse'i zil ba dang / /gnas mtho dman thag mkhan rkang stabs 'dra/ /lha tshangs dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal sogs/ /dpal mtho ris phun tshogs rtser son kyang / /las dge ba'i 'phen pa zad pa na/ /slar bran dang yang bran 478

nyid du 'gyur/ /khong gling bzhi'i mun sel nyi zla yang / /gnas 'og mar lhung zhing mun par skye/ /gnyen nye du grogs bshes la sogs kyang / /rkyen cung zad tsam gyis 'gyur ldog byed/ / don de phyir srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /yid brtan dug rung ba cung zad med/ / da rang la rang gis ma bslu bar/ /las byas pas 'tshengs pas dge la 'bung / /dus spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du/ /pha drin can bla ma spyi bor bkur/ /rten dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla bsam/ /gnas ngan song duḥkhas yid skrag nas/ /skyabs mchog gsum dam par blo gtad de/ /las rgyu 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin gyis/ /dran shes bzhin bag yod brtan po yis/ /lam lhag pa'i bslab gsum rgyud la bsten/ /khong nyam thag 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / dus thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ / rang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan yin/ / don de phyir rgyun du phan sems sbyo nga / /lar rang la ltos bcas rnams la yang / / bka' mdzangs blun sogs las gsungs pa yi/ /las rgyu 'bras rnam gzhag legs bstan nas/ /rgyun gang 'tsham dge la bskul bar mdzod/ /las bya ba ci dang ci byed kyang / /yid re dogs rgya yis ma bcings bar/ / skyabs bslu med bla ma mchog gsum la/ /blo rtse gcig bkal nas bgyid pa da 'tshal/ / sems 'khor 'das rtsa bar gsungs pas na/ /lar dus dang gnas skabs tham/sa cad du/ /lha bla ma dkon mchog dran bzhin du/ /nang shes rgyud zhi zhing dul bar 'tshal/ /gtam 'di la brten nas 'gro ba kun/ /blo nges 'byung byang chub sems mchog dang / /chos yang dag lta bas rgyud phyug ste/ /lam rim gnyis bgrod pa mthar phyin shog/ ces pa 'di yang shes bya'i rig pa'i gnas la mkhyen dpyod kyi 'jug pa rab tu yangs pa dad brtson rnam dpyod ldan pa dka' bcu blo bzang bstan pa'i thugs mos bzhin/ gyi na pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis dben gnas dga' ldan chos sdings su bris pa dge legs 'phel/na mo gu ru mañdza sgo ṣā ya/ gnas spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /skyabs kun 'dus drin can bla ma rje/ /'bangs 'khos med snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /blo chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon legs byas dge la spyad pa'i mthus/ /rten 479

dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob/ /mgon dge ba'i bshes kyis zin pa dang / / rje sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba ni/ /lha tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /'di don che rnyed par dka' bas na/ /tshe 'di snang bsru brid bya bzhag gis/ dus don med 'da' ba shin tu blun/ kho brtse med 'chi bdag gshin rje de/ /dus de ring mi 'ong cha med pas/ /sems ngang ring phyi tshis mdun grabs 'di/ /blo nang du khus dang 'khrul min nam/ /dus da lta'i skyid sdug sna tshogs 'di/ /dpe rmi lam yul gyi bde sdu ga bzhin/ /yid chags sdang sa bon gsos 'debs shing / /gdod 'chi tshe dran pa'i yul tsam 'gyur/ /dgra 'chi bdag thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ /phan nges pa dam pa'i chos las med/ /don de phyir rang la ma bslu bar/ /yid dge la sbyor ba'i nyams len 'tshal/ /rang 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du/ /rje drin can bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /skyabs kun 'dus ngo bor gsol gdab na/ /don gang bas ma lag tu stsol bar nges/ /rkyen legs nyes mtho dman ci byung yang / /mi gzhan la le lan mi bda' bar/ /rang sngon bsags las su blta ba dang / /thabs zab mos lam du 'khyer ba gces/ /mtho srid rtse nas bzung mnar med par/ / gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'di la/ /me 'bar ba'i rlubs ltar mthong ba yi/ /blo nges 'byung shugs drag bskyed par 'tshal /ma/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dus yun ring thog ma med pa nas/ /bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa sha sta ga yin/ /don de phyir phan sems yid la bcangs/ /skyabs don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas de/ / thabs byang chub sems kyi rtsis zin pa'i/ /lam byin drug spyod la rag las pas/ /las gang byas thabs des sgrub pa gces/ /dpal zung 'jug yid bzhin nor bu de/ /skad cig nyid la ster byed pa'i/ /chos zab lam rdo rje theg pa la/ /blo thos bsam bag chags ci thebs gces/ /sems 'khor 'das rtsa bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /lar thos bsam sgom pa gang byed kyang / / kha phyir blta'i dbang du ma song bar/ /rgyud 'dul thabs kho nar 'khyer ba gces/ /tshur rang la blo gtad byed pa rnams/ /rje rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs pa yi/ /las 'bras kyi byung ba rnams bstan nas/ /rgyud gang 'tsham dge la sbyor bar 'tshal / /gtam 'di la brten 480

nas mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /blo nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul te/ /lam thabs shes zung gi bgrod pa yis/ /dpal zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob shog/ ces pa 'di yang thos don sgrub pa la gzhol pa'i rnam dpyod yangs pa tho yon bi lig thu dge slong blo bzang tshe ring skyabs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' 'bangs gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis 7'jam mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po gang du sku bltams pa'i gnas mchog chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs dben gnas dga' ldan chos sdings su bris pa'o/ /gnas spyi gtsug seng khri pad zla'i steng / /skyabs kun 'dus drin can bla ma rje/ /'bangs 'khos med snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ / blo chos la bsgyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam yul thag ring por 'gro ba'i tshe/ / rkyen bzang ngan snang ba ci byung skeske yang / /rang sngon gyi las su bltas nas ni/ /skyabs bla ma lha la gsol ba thob/ /gnas dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams der/ / rten byin can dpag tu med pa dang / / rje sangs rgyas dngos 'dra bshes gnyen bzhugs/ /yid dag snang chen pos mjal ba dang / / rten dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' zhing / /lar 'jig par sla ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /dgra le lo'i dbang du ma song bar/ /rang dam/ pa'i chos kyi bgo skal longs/ /gnas 'khor ba'i chos las yid 'byung zhing / /lam bslab gsum them skas la 'dzegs te/ /ma 'gro kun sgro spra ba'i khur 'khyer ba'i/ /khong rgyal sras spyod la yid smon 'tshal/ /lar legs nyes ci dang cir 'gyur ba/ /nang rang sems kho na'i 'phrul yin pas/ / don de phyir spyod lam thams cad du/ /blo zhi zhing dul 'a bag yod bsten/ /khyed blo gsal rnam dpyod ldan pa la/ / tshig skam pos gsal 'debs mi dgos kyang / /nan che phyir tshig 'ga' smras pa 'di/ /don ma brjed yid la 'jog par 'tshal/ /gtam 'di la brten nas rang gzhan dag/ blo chos la phyogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ces pa ni rig gnas la rnam dpyod ya ngas pa bā rin dge slong gu shī lung rigs rgya mtshos dbus gtsang du 'gro skabs bslab bya zhig dgos zhes nan tan che ba'i ngor/ gyi na pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis sbyar ba'o/ /481

༄khya/ /nges don gyi lta ba la bag chags 'jog tshul dang /gsung 'thor bu'i skor bzhugs so/ /dpal rigs brgya'i byed po rdo rje 'chang / /deng ngur smrig zol la nyer brten pa/ /rje blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs/ /'bangs sgo gsum chos la bsgyur du gsol/ /dgra nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i sman/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong snying po'i bcud/ /lam mtha' bral dbu ma/'i lam bzang de/ /dus myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam rten 'byung zab mo'i gnas tshul la/ /yid mos pa'i som nyi tsam gyis kyang / /gnas 'kho ra ba hrul por byed do zhes/ /mgon sras bcas rgyal bas yang yang bsngags/ /don de'i phyir nges don zab mo mchog/ khong 'grel mdzad klu sgrub yab sras srol/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad pa/ /'dir thos bsam byed pa skal pa bzang / /chos zab mo'i 'di la mos gyur na/ /la sa sdig sgrib tshabs chen 'dag pa dang / /chos dge tshogs rgya cher sdud do gsung / /tshul de phyir brtson pa shugs drag bsten/ /phyi snod bcud sna tshogs 'di kun kyang / /blo 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam zhig las/ /don ngo bos grub pa med par gsungs/ /yongs tshogs drug snang ba 'khrul bar ltos/ /gshis gnas lugs rang bzhin med na yang / /lar rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i tshe/ /dpe 'chi med lam nas 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /rgyu 'bras kyi rol ba sna tshogs bkra/ /ming kyang ba btags yod tsam zhig las/ /yul steng nas tshugs thub grub pa med/ /lung rigs pa non pos dpyad pa'i tshe/ / kho rang tshugs mi thub 'ja' ltar yal/ /sngon thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /gdon ngos 'dzin chang gis rab myos te/ /phyi 'khrul snang kun la a 'thas 'cha'/ /de'i mthu las srid pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /da bden med rtogs pa'i mtshon non gyis/ /gzhi bdag 'dzin lha min dpung 'joms te/ /ma/chog sku gsum 'chi med khang bzang du/ /dus ring min myur du bgrod 482

par shog/ ces pa 'di yang nges don gyi lta ba la bag chags 'jog phyir gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis se ra theg chen gling gi nye 'dabs su bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /rgas pa'i ngang tshul dran nas dben pa la yid spro ba'i gtam phan bde'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugathe so/ /na mo gu ru mdzi shri ye/ rje blo bzang rgyal kun ye shes nyid/ /chos bshad sgrub bstan pa rab rgyas phyir/ /deng gsum ldan ngur smrig tshul 'dzin pa/ /pha bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la 'dud/ /gnas gting zab 'jigs rung 'khor mtsho 'dir/ /sngar skye rga na 'chi'i 'khor lo bskor/ /da rje btsun bla ma thugs rje can/ /las nyon mongs skye 'chi'i 'jigs las skyobs/ /nang mi gtsang rdzas gang dri nga zhing / /gnas mun rum ma yi mngal gyi khrod/ /sdug bzod glags med pas mnar bzhin skye/ /'di bsams na 'jigs skrag ya re nga / /dus rim bzhin nar son gzhon nu de/ /lus lang tsho rgyas shing skye mched bkra/ /mthar lo zla 'gyur bas rgas shing 'khogs/ /'di rang lus yin yang yid mi 'ong / /sems col chung byis pa rgan po'i gzugs/ /nang sha khrag bri bas pags pa 'khum/ /yid mi sdug ro langs mngon sum bzhin/ /'di gshin rjes khrel rgod byed pa'i yul/ /lus mda' ltar drang ba gzhu ltar gug/ gdong gnyer ma mang pos rgya gram bcings/ /so phal cher lhung bas ldab ldeb smra/ /mdun mi gtsang kha chus chag chag 'debs/ /lus lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sdug gi/ mdangs 'chor sgeg yid 'ong 'ja' ltar yal/ /skra bung ba ltar nag skya zhing zegs/ /'di bsams na lus la yid brtan ci/ /sgo dbang po mi gsal nang du bros/ /blo rmongs shing stobs dang dran pa nyams/ /yul 'dod la spyod pa'i rang dbang bral/ /'di yi chad sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi/ / rkang byin pa'i gyad zung stobs bskyed kyang / /khur lus po mi theg ling ling 'dar/ / rten 'khar ba grogs su sbran na yang / /'gros gyal khyol 'khyor zhing res 'ga' 'bub/ /tshul de ltar rgas shing 'khogs pa'i lus/ /shing sdong po rnying pa khong rul bzhin/ /rkyen chung ngus sang sgyel nangs sgyel dang / /mi bdag gzhan de la shi smon byed/ /de rang gi thog tu ma bab gong / /tshe 'di snang rnam rtog rbad kyis bcad/ /blo bla ma lha la lings kyis bkal/ /las rgyu 'bras 'dor len tshul bzhin ngos/ /sdig sngar 483

byas rnams la mthol bshags dang / /phyis srog la bab kyang sdom sems bsten/ /chos dge ba bre gsog phul gsog gis/ /dus nyin mtshan 'da' ba mdun ma'i rtse/ /lar de 'dra'i rgas pa'i snang tshul 'di/ /mi kun la 'byung ba'i rang bzhin mod/ /gzhon lang tshos rgyags pa'i byis pa rnams/ /'di mi shes na tshod rtag tu re/ /don de phyir lus kyis rkyen bzod tshe/ /ri sman ljongs nags tshal nyams dga' bar/ /gtam lto gos gsum la gyong bskur nas/ /khong sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs/ /lha sum rtsen dga' tshal 'phos 'dra der/ / steng dgung sngon chu 'dzin bla bre g.yo/ / bar na bun dngul mdog yol bas bres/ /sman nags tshal sngo ljang gsham bus mdzes/ /spang ne'u sing me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /chab dwangs bsil lhung lhung mdzes par 'bab/ /yid bag phebs ri dwags zlos gar sgyur/ /bya sna mang gre 'gyur skad snyan sgrog/ des skyo ba'i snang ba ngang gis sel/ /yid chags sdang skye ba'i dgra gnyen dben/ /nor bsog bsrung brlag pa'i sdug bsngal med/ /'phral gang byung chog shes bde bas 'tsho/ /mi mtho dman bar ma'i ngo srung gi/ blo rnam rtog dra ba'i rgya las grol/ /sems gu yangs sna thag rang gis bzung / /gdon chos brgyad snang shas rgyang du bsrings/ / nor 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi'i mdzod 'dzin cing / /chos mang du thos pa'i gnad rnams sems/ /yid ting 'dzin bde ba'i ngang du rol/ /slar rjes thob sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor skyong / /mgon rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang po yang / /chos ma nga thos nor gyis phyug pa yi/ /tshe lang tsho yol ba'i dge slong dag/ gnas dben par gnas pa bde zhes gsung / /don de phyir chu skyes gzhon nu yis/ /steng mdzes par khebs pa'i yid bzhin mtsho/ /bya ngang pa'i yid la 'thad pa bzhin/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal snying nas dran/ /der 'di snang grogs la zhen thag bcad/ /rkyen 'du 'dzis dben pa'i brag phug tu/ /dkor log 'tsho'i dug chus ma sbags par/ /chos mnyam rjes dge sbyor mchog la spyod/ /gos phyag dar khrod dang btang snyoms kyis/ /srog nyer 'tsho g.yong ba'i long gtam bral/ /dus res 'ga' sa 'dzin mthon po'i rtse/ / res spang ljongs nags tshal ngogs su 'chag/chos thun mong byang chub lam rim nas/ /dpal gsang chen rim/ pa gnyis kyi bar/ /4 84

gzhi stan thog gcig tu dril byas te/ /bdag g.yong med rtse gcig bsgom par spro/ /mgon sras bcas rgyal pa'i byin rlabs dang / / don rten 'brel chos nyid bslu ba med/ /sgos bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /yid re 'byes don rnams myur grub shog/ ces pa 'di yang mang thos nyams len gyis dbul ba btsun gzugs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis gang shar tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'o/ /༄7/ /na mo mdzi shri ye/ sgrib bral chos dbyangs ngang nas/ /gang 'dul sprul ba'i gar mkhan/ /kun 'dus gcig chog rgyal po/ /drin can bla mar 'dud do/ /kye hud las ngan dbang gis/ /snyigs dus mtha' 'khob skyes nas/ /bstan pa'i chos sgor zhugs te/ /ngur smrig gos kyis g.yogs kyang / /khyim pa tha mal pa las/ /shes rgyud gyong bor lus shing / /da snga yan gyi bya byed/ /don med las ror song ngo / /dam chos byed 'dod ngang la/ /phyes shol le 'o sa brid nas/ /na tshod phal cher yol te/ / sa/sa pa'i sdug bsngal sleb song / /da ni tshe yi lha ga ma/ /yud tsam lus pa 'di la/ /don med bya byed spangs nas/ /ri khrod dben par 'grims sheg/ las nyon dbang gis grub pa'i/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor/ /skye 'chi'i rlabs kyi phreng bas/ /dbang med 'ded pa soms la/ / kwa ye don yod rdo rje/ /ri khrod dben par 'grims shig/yid bzhin nor las lhag cing / /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i/ /don chen rnyed dka'i rten 'dir/ /snying po dam pa len phyir/ /kwa ye don yod rdo rje/ /ri khrod dben par 'grims shig/ khams gsum kun tu nyul ba'i/ /ma rung gshin rje'i pho nya/ /brtse med khrel rgod byed bzhin/ /de ring mi sleb cha med/ /kwa yo5/ /ri khrodasmo/ /nam zhig 'chi ba byung tshe/ / gnas khang lus dang longs spyod/ / gnyen grogs phun sum tshogs kyang / /phan pa ci yang med pas/ /kwa yismo/ /ri khrodastu/ /da lta'i rang nyams 'di la/ /sdug bsnga'/ phra mo'ang bzod dka'/ /kye ma ngan song sdug bsngal/ /bzod glags 'dug gam soms la/ /kwa ye)/ /ri khrodastu/ /nyam nga'i sdug bsngal de las/ /skyob byed dkon mchog gsum por/ /snying nas skyabs su song la/ /sdig spong dge ba bsgrub phyir/ / kwa yes/ /ri khrodasmo/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'di/ /rab 185

'bar me 'obs lta bur/ /mthong ba'i nges 'byung drag pos/ /bslab gsum rgyal mtshan bsgreng phyir/ /kwa yeya/ /ri khrodasmo/ /thog med dus nas da bar/ /tshad med drin gyis bskyangs pa'i/ /mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro la/ /byams dang snying rjer bltas nas/ /kwa yistu/ /ri khrodasmo /lhag bsam tshan gyis phul ba'i/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed de/ /phyin drug bsdu ba rnam bzhi/ /nyams len mthil du bzung la/ /kwa yismo/ /ri khrodasmo/ / snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun/ /ming rkyang btags yod tsam la / / bya byed thams cad 'thad pa'i/ /sgyu ma lta bur ltos la / /kwa nasmo/ /ri khrodastu/ /mdo sngags la ma gyi nying khu/ /byang chub lam rim 'di la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bag chags/ /'gyur med brtan po 'jog phyir/ /kwa ye don yod rdo rje/ /ri khrod dben par 'grims shig/ deng nas skye zhing skye bar/ /tshangs spyod rten bzang brgyud de/ /bstan 'gro kho na'i don du/ /lus srog gtong nus gyur cig/ ces pa'ang chos med ban rgan don yod rdo rje'am/ ming gzhan dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rang gi gnas tshal thol byung du smras :ཿdi//rdo/(/ / snye riri mi༄7/ /na mo mañdzu shri ye/ e ma shing rta chen po'i lam srol/ /dpal ldan a ti sha yi man ngag/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad / /mnyam med byang chub lam gye rim pa/ /a ho chos kyi nying khu rang yin/ /e e bag chags ci thebs mdzod cig/ sra/sa bcas rgyal ba kun gyi gshegs bshul/ /pha rol phyin pa'i zab rgyas gnad 'gag/ skal ldan thar par bgrod pa'i cha rkyen/ /ma nor tshang bar gcig tu dril ba/ /a ho chos kyi nying khu rang yin/ /e e bag chags ci thebs mdzod cig/ rgyal bas gdul bya'i rgyud tshod dbang gis/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong / /gang bstsal 'gal med dngos dang brgyud pas/ /theg chen lam du gzhol bar ston pa/ /a hom/ /e mes/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos/ /yi ge gcig kyang lus pa med par/ / gdams pa'i mchog tu 'char bar byed pa'i/ / mun sel legs bshad 'od stong 'phro ba/ /a hom/ /e es/ /gdul bya blo dang rtsol ba zhan pas/ /rgya chen chos la thos bsam rgyal gyis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs bzhed rgya mtsho brgal 486

dka'/ /'di yis tshegs med bde blag bgrod nus/ /a ho'i/ /e eya/ /theg pa che chung ris su bcad nas/ /rmongs chen dam chos spong ba'i rnam thar/ /mi bzad g.yang sa che las srung ba'i/ /rmad byung lam srol chen po yin ya/ /a hos/ /e es/ /sngon byon rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyis/ /'di la thugs dam tshig dril rmi dzad pas/ /grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te/ /don gnyis nor bu lag rtser son pa/ /a hosnu/ /e em/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i rgyal po 'di ni/ /rdo rje rin chen nyin byed bdag po/ /'dod dgu stsol ba'i dpag bsam shing bzhin/ / gang bsam mtha' dag yid bzhin 'jo ba'i/ /a ho chos kyi nying khu rang yin/ /e e bag chags ci thebs mdzod cig/ yun ring bskal pa mang por bsags pa'i/ /legs byas zong gis khug nus min yang / /da res thos bsam bsgom byar yod pa/ /a ho chos kyi skal ba mi dman/ /e ma thog med dus nas da bar/ /'di 'dra'i chos dang mjal bar ma myong / /da nas snyes 'khyams long bas glang mjug/ so med rnyil gyis 'brad pa'i dpe bzhin/ /zin med mnog chung 'di snang bya 'phro/ /da lta rang nas rbad kyis bcad nas/ /spyod lam 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug kun tu/ / gus rtag brtson pas rtse gcig bsgom a/ /'dis mtshon dge bas tshe rabs phreng bar/ /tshangs spyod rten bzang rim par brgyud de/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi 'di dang / /mi 'bral bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni chos gzugs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis bris pa dza yas/ /na mo ma/dzi shri ye/ zhing 'og min gtso bo lnga ldan mgon/ /deng ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /rje bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma la/ /bdag byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /chung na tshod gzhon nas chos sgor zhugs/ /chos byed 'dod ngang la mi tshe zad/ /mi mtho dam/na skyid sdug sna tshogs mthong / /de bsam bzhin skyo dang 'jigs pa skyes/ /sngon bsags pa'i las ngan bgrang las 'das/ / de ma byang da lta srog 'gag na/ /gzod dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /gdon chos brgyad snang shas dus 'da' ba/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /mgon 487

dge ba'i bshes dang mjal na yang / / bka' tshul bzhin mi sgrub skyon rtog rem/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /rje sangs rgyas bstan la zhugs skabs 'dir/ /gnas blang dor go log tshul du byed/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /rgyud sdom gsum/ rim par blangs gyur kyang / / gzhi tshulakhrims kha ral sna ral btang / /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /chos theg chen mang du thos na yang / /nang rang don 'khri ba grwa ma nyams/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /chos gsang chen theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /'gag dam tshig sdom pa rtsa ltar dor/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /phyi ngur smrig gos kyis klubs na yang / /nang khyim pa las kyang zhen pa dam/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /rang nyes pa'i rgya mtshor bying gyur kyang / /mi gzhan gyi skyon ma tshang ye mi bzod/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /rgyud phyi nang bag med dkor gyis 'tshos/ /yid nyon mongs dug lngas rgyun du bslad/ /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /chos kha bshad tsam du lus nas ni/ /sems chos dang ma 'dres dred por song / /'dis dmyal ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /a tsa ma ci drag nga re 'jigs/ /gnas 'jigs rung dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de/ /dus de ring nyi ma ma nub gong / /rang steng du mi 'bab gdeng tshad med/ /a tsa ma 'jigs drag ya re nga / /'og dpag tshad sum khri nyis stong na/ /gnas tsha grang dmyal ba 'jigs rung yod/ /gzhi lcags bsregs 'bar bas kun nas bskor/ /dgra gshin rje'i 'jigs pa du mas gtses/ /lus bcad gtubs btsir bas khrag rgyun bab/ /sgo kun nas me chen lhab lhab 'bar/ /lus me dang dbyer med gcig tu 'dres/ /sgra nyam thag nga ro 'don pa tsam/ /mtha' gangs ris bskor ba'i 'khyag rum steng / /rlung bu yug 'tshub pa'i mun nag khrod/ /lus nyam chung grang reg mi bzad pas/ /kha brgya stong gas pa'i sdug bsngal 488

myong / /tshul de lta'i dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de/ /khyed bzod glags 'dug gam zhib tu soms/ /yid 'jigs shing skrag pa bden te mchi/ /da 'jigs chen de yis yid skrag da/ /skyabs bla ma lha la blo snying gtong / /las dge sdig 'dor len tshul bzhin gyis/ /sdig sngar byas rnam/sa ni 'dag nges sbyang / /phyis srog la 'bab kyang legs bsdoms na/ /dus deng nas bzung ste ngan song du/ /phyis rdog pas phul yang 'gro re skan/ /gtam 'di la brten nas bdag 'dra ba'i/ /blo dred por song ba'i sdig can kun/ /chos nges 'byung mchog gis rgyud bskul nas/ /dus gtan bde'i btsan sa zin gyur cig/ces pa 'di yang rang gi skyon mtshang la yi mug nas/ gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis smras pa'o/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru mdzi shri ye/ skyabs kun 'dus dran pas gdung ba sel/ /mtshan thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'phrog/ rje drin can bsod nams mtshan can zhabs/ /'bangs 'khos med spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /pha mtshungs med khyed kyi bka' drin las/ /chos mdo sngags tha snyad rig pa sogs/ /gzhung mang po'i don la thos bsam bgyis/ /de bsam bzhin skal ba bzang snyam spro/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos 'dra'i bla ma las/ /dbang rjes gnang lung dang zab khrid sogs/ /chos gdams ngag bdud rtsi mang du mnos/ /de bsam bzhin skal ba bzang snyam spro/ /mtha' gol sar shor ba'i nor 'khrul dang / /yid som nyi'i mdud pa legs bsal te/ /mchog sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i 'a ma bzang mjal/ /de bsam bzhin skal ba bzang snyam spro/ /tshig thos pa'i nor gyis phyug na yang / /don lag tu len pa'i nyams len dbul/ /des ngan song skye sgo mi khegs zhes/ /mgon rnam 'dren thub pa'i bka' las gsung / /mar ngan 'gro'i sgo tsam ma khegs na/ /de chos min kho nar ma song ngam/ /tshig thos rgya che bas mi phan te/ /don rgyud la skor ba'i nyams len dgos/ /dpal a ti sha yi thugs kyi glubacud/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad mchog/ chos byang chub lam/ gyi rim pa la/ /dus da res mjal ba skal pa bzang / /sngon bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams/ /'di chig dril byas pas grub pa thob/ /dus deng sang chos byed mang po zhig/ ming zab zab 489

skad pas slu ba mang / /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs/ /chos mdo sngags gnyis las gang yang med/ /de gang zag gcig gi nyams len du/ /don hril gyis dril ba lam rim yin/ /gzhan man ngag blo sbyong zab dgu cog/ chos zab rgyas 'di yi cha lag tsam/ /'di dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /lam bgrod pa gcig pa'i gshegs bshul yin/ /don de'i phyir sgo gsum chig dril gyis/ /chos lam rim 'di la 'bungs gsum thongs/ /dus gtan gyi mdun ma legs grub nas/ /dpal don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par nges/ /gtam 'di la brten nas bdag 'dra rnams/ /tshig skam bshad wu bas mi ngoms par/ /don rgyud dang 'dres nges nyams len gyis/ /ma 'gro kun phan bde spel bar shog/ ces pa'ang btsun gzugs dbyangs can dga' blos sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /༄/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra su ma dhī dz+nyā na sha sa na pra pu ṣa ṇi/ rje blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /thugs bde ba chen po ye shes sku/ /chos bshad sgrub bstan pa reb rgyas phyir/ /deng gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rmyel/ /snying chos kyi 'khor gle 'debaX brtsod dbus/ /khams mi shigs ngo bor rtag bzhugs nas/ /lam bde stong nyams brgya'i rol pa yis/ /yongs ma dag 'khrul snang bzlog tu gsol/ /pha thugs rje can khyod bka' drin gyis/ /dus da res dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /chos mdo sngags zab rgyas bdud rtsi yis/ /bdag rnam dpyod lus stobs cung zad brtas/ /da 'di snang 'khri ba btsan thabs bcad/ /gnas 'du 'dzis dben pa'i ri sul du/ /pha bla ma 'bral med gtsug tu bsten/ /skyabs kun 'dus ngo bor gsol btab cing / /rten dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' zhing / /dgra 'chi bdag nam 'ong cha med pas/ /skyabs mchog gsum dam par blo gtad nas/ /las dkar nag blang dor tshul bzhin bgyid/ /dpal mtho ris lha mi'i phun tshogs kyang / /lar ji tsam spyad bzhin sdug bsngal gzhi/ /don de phyir srid pa'i bde 'byor la/ /yid gting nas zhen log skyo shas bsten/ /rgyud tshul khrims dag pa'i gos kyis klubs/ /sems bde gsal mi rtog ngang du bde/ /blo shes bya'i gnas la gsal zhing bkra/ /lam lhag pa'i bslab gsum rgyud la bsten/ / dus yud tsam mi 490

gnas rang sems 'di/ /lar dbang po'i sgo nas ma bsrungs na/ /dgra nyon mongs chom rkun zin nges pas/ /dran shes bzhin bag yod brtan po gces/ /ma drin gyis bskyangs pa'i rigs drug rnams/ / gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ṅge'i g.yang sar lhungs/ /byams snying rje lhag bsam gyis drangs pa'i/ /blo dam bca' brtan pos sems mchog bskyed/ /dpal don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas de/ /thabs phyin drug spyod pas sgrub lags na/ /khong rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen la/ /yid zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs 'tshal/ /gzhi ji snyed chos kyi spros pa kun/ /blo 'khrul bas btags pa tsam zhig la sa/ /don ngo bos grub pa cung zad med/ /yul gang shar rang bzhin med par ltos/ /lam thun mong ba yis rgyud sbyangs te/ /dpal rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /deng tha mal tshul bzung slob dpon gyis/ /lha yi dam dkyil 'khor chen por bcug/thabs 'jug sgo rnam dag dbang bzhi bskur/ /yongs ma dag dri ma rnam bzhi bkrus/ /lam rim gnyis zab mo sgom la dbang / /dpal sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges bzhag/bka' mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel bcas pa las/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa'i/ /gzhi dam sdom srog bsdos byed pa la/ /lan brgya phrag bsngags pa gnad du bzung / /lam zab rgyas lha yi rna' / 'byor gyis/ /yid tha mal snang zhen rgyang bsrings te/ /gzhi srid pa skye 'chi bar do'o rgyun/ /lam sku gsum ngo bor 'khyer la brtson/ /yid gang sna nga bde stong rol pa las/ /lha rten dang rten me'i 'khor lor shar/ /sgra gang grag gsang sngags gsung du 'dzer/ /zab bdud rtsi'i ngo bor 'bul ba sogs/ /dus thun dang thun mtshams rnal 'byor gyi/ /thabs zab mos ci bgyis lam du bsgyur/ /lam bskyed rim phra rags mthar phyin nas/ /mchog sku gsum tshe 'dir bsgrub la brtson/ /zhing ma bcos lhan skyes pho brang che/ /lus rdo rje'i bkod pa gsal dwangs dbus/ /rtsa 'dab brgyad chos 'khor lte ba ru/ /khams mi shigs rlung sems dbyer med pa'i/ /pha nges don bla ma'i zhal bzang la/ /yid rtse gcig lta ba'i rol rtsed las/ /phyi brtan g.yo chos kun ji snyed pa/ /yum 'od gsal lha lam dbyings su thim/ /slar sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'ja' tshon 'khrungs/ /chos brtan g.yo spro bsdu'i gzhi byed 491

cing / /lam lhag ma'i bgrod pa mthar phyin te/ /rten de la phyag rgya chen po sgrub/ /dus srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /ma rigs drug 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dpal kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi/ /sku zung 'jug dga' ston mchog la sbyor/ /gtam 'di la brten nas mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /rje sangs rgyas las kyang ches dkon pa'i/ /lam 'di 'dra'i bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /dpal zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku thob shog/ ces pa 'di ni gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis rang nyid lam 'di la bag chags 'jog phyir dben gnas dga' ldan chos sdings su bris pa dza yachu/ /na mo gu ru mdzi nā thā ya/ dpal rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /deng gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /mtshan yongs su grags pa ra bsgreng zhabs/ /pha rtse gcig dran pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas gting zab 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher/ /sngon thog ma med nas 'khyams lags kyang / / mgon sangs rgyas sus kyang bdag ma 'dul/ /dus da res thugs rjes 'dul bar gsol/ /pha khyed kyi gsang gsum byin rlabs kyis/ /bu gnyis me da seng ger song ba bdag/ tshe 'di snang che thabs kun dor te/ /dus gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub par smon/ /da mtho dman skyid sdug ci byung yang / /skyabs kun 'dus rje la blo bkal te/ /yid zol med gting nas re ltos zhu/ /rgyud dmu rgod 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos legs tshogs rtsa ba zla med pa/ /mgon bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa la/ /khong rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang dang / /rje thos pa dga' bzhin byin gyis rlobs/ /chos dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten/ /'di don che rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul/ /blo gting nas nges pa legs drangs te/ /don snying po len par byin gyis rlobs/ /srog mi brtan g.yo ba ston ga'i sprin/ /lus lang tsho dbang po'i gzhu ris mtshungs/ /nor longs spyod kim pa'i 'bras bu la/ /yid chags zhen zlog par byin gyis rlobs/ /slar bsags pa'i las ngan bgrang las 'das/ /dus phyi mar phan pa'i dge bas dbul/ /gnas 'jigs rung dmyal ba'i gting rdo la/ /pha thugs rje'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /da bsten pas bslu ba med pa yi/ /skyabs bla ma khyed la blo snying gtod/ /las dge sdig 'dor len tshul bzhin du/ /blo srog bsdos byed par 492

byin gyis rlobs/ /dug bdud rtsir 'khrul nas 'thung ba bzhin/ /gnas 'khor ba'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs la/ /lar ji tsam spyad bzhin zhen pa 'phel/ /da nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bu bdag la thog ma med pa nas/ /phan yang yang btags pa'i drin can gyis/ /ma 'gro kun phan bde'i khur khyer bar/ /mgon thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /yid zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /khong rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen la/ /dus 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /brtson lhod pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /sdug sna dgu 'dren pa'i phung byed mkhan/ /nga bdag tu zhen pa'i gces 'dzin 'di/ /da rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos brtan ga rngo tham sa cad sgyu ma bzhin/ /yul gdod nas grub pa rdul tsam med/ /blo rtog pas btags tsam gnas tshul de/ /dus myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos zab la myur ba rdo rje theg/ rgyud smin byed dbang dang grol byed kyi/ /lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar phyin te/ /tshe 'di la grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos tshul bzhin sgrub la gegs byed gtso/ / nang tshe 'di snang gsal 'bur 'joms kyis/ /rkyen gang byung nyams rtogs 'phel ba yi/ /grogs kho nar 'khyer par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'khor ba'i gcong rong zab mo nas/ /pha thugs rje bskul ba'i smre ngag 'di/ /ma/ bus pa chung la brtse ba ltar/ /dus da lta gsan la byin gyis rlobs/ /dge 'dis mtshon dus gsum legs byas tshogs/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung zhing / /chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ces pa'ang dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis dben gnas dga' ldan chos sdings su bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /༄7/ /rje gsum lda na bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /bdag snying gi pad+ma'i dbus bzhugs la/ /dus byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /'bangs 'bral med rjes su bzung du gsol/ /sngon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i btson khang 'dir/ /las nyon mongs zhags pa dam pos bcings/ /dgra sdug bsngal gsum gyi gshed mas gtses/ / mar ngan song gnas su gtan du 'khyams/ /'og dmyal khang 493

lcags bsregs 'bar ba'i nang / /lus me dang dbyer med 'dres bzhin du/ /ngag ngu 'bod lhang lhang sgrog cingasreg/ yang khyags rum bu yug 'tshub pa'i nang / /lus grang bas brgya stong mang por 'gas/ /snying rus par zug pa'i nad slong ste/ /so tham tham byed cing smre ngag 'don/ /dus bskal ba'i bar du bza' btung gi/ ming tsam yang mi thos khong pa'i nang / /me 'bar zhing yang na rang sha dang / /rnag khrag dang mi gtsang bshang gci za/ /rgyud gti mug mun pas 'thibs bzhin du/ /mgon skyabs med gnyen med dud 'gro rnams/ /nang phan tshun gcig la gcig za zhing / /brdeg 'tshog dang bkol spyod sdug bsngal myong / /dus da res bla ma mchog gsum mthus/ /lan gcig tsam thar pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /yid skyid 'dod sdig pa'i las byas na/ /slar ngan song gnas su ldog par nges/ /don de phyir 'di snang phun tshogs la/ /yid chags shing zhen pas ma 'ching bar/ /gcon lang tsho rgyas pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /las byas pas 'tshengs pa'i chos la 'bungs/ /mi rgan gzhon go rims ma mchis par/ /dus glo bur 'chi ba yang yang soms/ /dgra le lo'i dbang du ma song bar/ /dus nyin mtshan med par chos la 'bungs/ / da rang sems nang du legs bkug nas/ /yid ma g.yeng bsam blo zhib tu thongs/ /rang don med nyin rma tshan 'da' 'gyur na/ /phyis 'gyod pa'i me yis sreg par nges/ /kho 'chi bdag gshin rje sleb pa'i tshe/ / grogs gnyen bshes longs spyod kun bor nas/ /rang gcig pur phyi mar 'gro ba na/ / phan nges pa dam pa'i chos las med/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad nas/ /las rgyu 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin ngos/ /dpe 'dzin skyong slob gnyer la 'bad na/ /tshe 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par nges/ /sngon bsod nams bsags rgyab chung ba la/ /ngag snyan po chos gtam rna la gzan/ /mi blun po phyugs dzi'i glu dbyangs snyan/ /don de phyir dman la phan dka' yang / /'di dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ /yid skyo tshe tshigs su bcad par bsdebs/ /gtam 'di yis skal mnyam mar gyur 'gro/ /blo chos la phyogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ deng bstan dang lan cig mjal dus 'dir/ /chos 'dzin skyong thos bsam la brtson nas/ /dpe yar ngo'i zla bzhin yon tan tshogs/ /kun 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bkra shis/ /494

a kyā yongs 'dzin sgru bka' 'bum bzhugs so//rtsom pa po/cha ris skal bzang thogs med kyis legs sgrig byas/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur 0/'brug rgyal mkhar/mdun shog mdzes risari/zhus cin lin/dpe sgrun/dzin su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /'grems sprel/gan su'u mi rigs 〈pe skrun khang /par 'debs/zen tso zhin hwa par khang /debacad/ho smis787monyo smis/092 tsā/6dpar gog64 75yig grangs/khri 6 par thengs/201/phi zla)par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/20//i zla par dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/1—3000dpe rtags//5289787542/—876——7rin gong /(ra gnyisakyisgor/4800par dbang 'di gar yod pas par bskusabargyab nasams mad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya/
